nodes.description: You are a novice of Total Concentration Breathing, a breathing technique that raises blood oxygen and better activates your muscles, granting a superhuman physique while maintained. As a novice, you know only the very basics, but you can improve with practice.

nodes.name: Intermediate Total Concentration Breathing
nodes.description: You are learned in Total Concentration Breathing, a breathing technique that raises blood oxygen and better activates your muscles, granting a superhuman physique while maintained. As an intermediate, you actively maintain it in combat, but you can improve with practice.

nodes.name: Adept Total Concentration Breathing
nodes.description: You are an adept in Total Concentration Breathing, a breathing technique that raises blood oxygen and better activates your muscles, granting a superhuman physique while maintained. As an adept, you easily maintain it in a fight without added strain, and in daily life unless exhausted or excessively distracted. You also use it to stop your own bleeding and speed recovery.

nodes.name: Expert Total Concentration Breathing
nodes.description: You are an expert in Total Concentration Breathing on par with a Hashira, a breathing technique that raises blood oxygen and better activates your muscles for superhuman performance. You have achieved Total Concentration Breathing Constant, maintaining it even while sleeping. You also forcefully close wounds, expel poison, and speed recovery.

nodes.name: Pre-Initiative
nodes.description: Pre-Initiative is an advanced form of a fighter's foresight; you know an enemy's move before they use it and counter before they throw it. It comes from extensive martial arts familiarity and analyzing opponents' styles. It demands much training, sparring, and familiarity with many styles, but a master seems almost omniscient against a lesser opponent after only a few exchanged moves.

nodes.name: Reduced Earth
nodes.description: Reduced earth is a movement technique for covering a short distance in a single extremely fast movement through practiced breathing, footwork, and exertion. But it is quite exhausting to use.

nodes.name: Ryu's Shotokan
nodes.description: You practice Ryu's Shotokan, a special Karate school created by Ryu. It focuses on direct, powerful strikes with kicks and punches, mixing aggression and defense. With enough practice, you tap into the Kyoi no Hado and harness Ki to empower your blows, perform special techniques, and use the Hadoken.

nodes.name: Akuma's Shotokan
nodes.description: You practice Akuma's Shotokan, a special Karate school created by Akuma. It focuses on direct, powerful strikes with kicks and punches, emphasizing brutal aggression and offense. With enough practice, you tap into the Satsui no Hado and harness raw killing intent as Ki to enhance your body, imbue your strikes, turn your inner energy into dark flame-like Ki, use the Gohadoken, and take a more demonic form to further boost power, but overuse without control can make you lose yourself and turn into a demon. You need great skill and control to avoid losing yourself and master it.

nodes.name: The Shotokan
nodes.description: You practice Goutetsu's Shotokan, a special Karate school. It focuses on direct, powerful strikes with kicks and punches, but its heart is the Satsui and Kyoi no Hado, Dark and Light. As you practice, you may awaken and train in one Hado to tap its full power, reinforcing your strikes with Ki and releasing energy waves to supplement your style.

nodes.name: Master Total Concentration Breathing
nodes.description: You have fully mastered Total Concentration Breathing, a breathing technique that raises blood oxygen and better activates your muscles, granting exceptional performance and letting you use your body to its utmost potential. You maintain it as easily as regular breathing. While maintained, your recovery speeds are sped up.

nodes.name: Dapping
nodes.description: You are a master at dapping people up effectively, judging dap distance and producing a satisfying crispy dap regardless of the other party's skill or constitution.

nodes.name: Boggart's Boiling Brilliance
nodes.description: You have learned to boil crab, prawn, and crustaceans in general with great skill, on the level of the great Big Boggart. Even if your crab is the magical kind from the Lands Between, it will taste spectacular.

nodes.name: Hacking
nodes.description: You are skilled at leveraging your skills to breach networks and bypass digital and cyber defenses.

nodes.name: Crying
nodes.description: You cry at will, and very convincingly.

nodes.name: Judging
nodes.description: You are very skilled at judging and discerning the morality of people you meet, as well as spotting ill intent.

nodes.name: Commerce
nodes.description: You are very skilled at haggling, assessing monetary value, and securing a good price for everything.

nodes.name: Tax Evasion
nodes.description: You are a master of tax evasion. If you wish, the government sees no more of your money than you allow. You know the ins and outs of money laundering, obfuscating, and more.

nodes.name: Kidnapping
nodes.description: You are very skilled at kidnapping targets, planning such operations with great skill and finesse and executing them with practiced moves.

nodes.name: Factory Planning
nodes.description: Lay out production lines, manifolds, and bus feeds that scale up without dissolving into spaghetti.

nodes.name: Machine Override
nodes.description: Hack overridden machines to fight for you or serve as mounts.

nodes.name: Bushcraft
nodes.description: Forage, hunt, craft, and read the land in any hostile wild.

nodes.name: Colony Medicine
nodes.description: Triage, surgery, and glitterworld care with whatever counts as a hospital.

nodes.name: Colony Construction
nodes.description: Raise bases fast and sturdy, from wooden shacks to plasteel fortresses.

nodes.name: Deep Space Survey
nodes.description: Chart stars, anomalies, and habitable worlds with professional thoroughness.

nodes.name: Galactic Diplomacy
nodes.description: Federations, vassals, and first contact without starting an extermination war. Usually.

nodes.name: Sneaking
nodes.description: Move unseen, pick pockets, and backstab with professional discretion.

nodes.name: Persuasion
nodes.description: Talk down fights, talk up prices, and talk your way into restricted areas.

nodes.name: Masonry
nodes.description: Cut stone blocks and raise fortresses that outlast civilizations.

nodes.name: Brewing
nodes.description: Turn pig tails and plump helmets into life-giving dwarven ale.

nodes.name: Deckbuilding
nodes.description: Build sixty-card engines where every draw does exactly what the plan needs.

nodes.name: Slime Science
nodes.description: Gadgets, pumps, and teleporters powered by slime science and questionable ethics.

nodes.name: Computer Hacking
nodes.description: Breach security ratings, ATMs, and robots with time to spare and no alarms.

nodes.name: Exocraft Piloting
nodes.description: Handle Nomads, Pilgrims, and Minotaurs across every biome without scratching the paint.

nodes.name: Pal Training
nodes.description: Raise, breed, and work Pals to peak performance without anyone getting eaten.

nodes.name: Animals
nodes.description: Handle Vertumna's alien fauna calmly, from fur-antlered grazers to things with too many legs.

nodes.name: Combat
nodes.description: Defend the colony with blades, bows, and level-headed aim when the planet pushes back.

nodes.name: Creativity
nodes.description: Art, music, and writing that lift the whole colony's spirits through hard years.

nodes.name: Engineering
nodes.description: Keep the colony's generators, walls, and weird alien-tech hybrids running.

nodes.name: Leadership
nodes.description: Organize expeditions and councils so the colony actually follows the plan.

nodes.name: Logic
nodes.description: Solve colony problems with clear reasoning, from supply math to alien puzzles.

nodes.name: Organization
nodes.description: Keep stockpiles, chores, and expeditions sorted no matter how chaotic the season.

nodes.name: Reasoning
nodes.description: Argue, deduce, and mediate with a cool head when colonists disagree.

nodes.name: Nothing Wrong Here
nodes.description: People instinctively rationalize your actions and accept you more readily.

nodes.name: Efficient Physique
nodes.description: You gain more energy from breathing, eating, and sleeping through incredible bodily efficiency, and your abilities consume slightly less energy to use.

nodes.name: Hygienic
nodes.description: You stay hygienic with no bad breath or germs.

nodes.name: Digestive Expulsion Independence
nodes.description: You never need to piss or shit.

nodes.name: Blind Eye
nodes.description: You disappear in a crowd and go unnoticed as long as you should not stand out.

nodes.name: What's Monogamy
nodes.description: Your potential partners accept your harem without questioning the logistics or logic of multiple lovers.

nodes.name: Antibody
nodes.description: You strongly resist most diseases.

nodes.name: Longevity
nodes.description: You live 100 times longer and regenerate your own lifespan even if it is drained or destroyed.

nodes.name: Devil's Advocate
nodes.description: People instinctively justify your actions and give you the benefit of the doubt even when you act against their morals.

nodes.name: Cardboard World
nodes.description: You perfectly control your exerted strength, so you can spare a foam brick even with planet-shattering power.

nodes.name: Photosynthesis
nodes.description: You subsist on sunlight alone for food and breathing and regenerate energy faster under sunlight. You still need water.

nodes.name: Enhanced Stamina
nodes.description: You have inordinate stamina relative to your current form, so it persists if you change species.

nodes.name: Terrifying Presence
nodes.description: You terrify others at will, making children cry and grown men piss themselves as you seem more a sadistic force of nature than a man.

nodes.name: Battle Continuation
nodes.description: You fight through wounds, exhaustion, and injuries without dulling pain, and you recover fine as long as the wound is not lethal and you can still stand.

nodes.name: Mountman
nodes.description: You ride any vehicle as if you have years of experience with it.

nodes.name: Magic Resistance
nodes.description: You naturally resist magic and all magical effects, scaling with your energy level.

nodes.name: Energy Acceleration
nodes.description: Your energy moves far faster, making all your abilities and spells far faster.

nodes.name: Headpat
nodes.description: Your headpats bring targets comfort, pleasure, and affection while helping dispel negative mental effects.

nodes.name: Greater Headpat
nodes.description: Your headpats bring targets comfort, pleasure, and affection, possibly arousal if they are kinky, while helping dispel negative mental effects. Even the most frigid emo cannot resist your palms.

nodes.name: Efficient Cells
nodes.description: Your cells convert sustenance to energy supernaturally efficiently, so you regain energy significantly faster.

nodes.name: Protection From Arrows
nodes.description: You sense incoming projectiles and instinctively dodge them like a sixth sense.

nodes.name: Blessing of Fae
nodes.description: You gain increased energy capacity from the fae's blessing. Fairies start at least neutral to you, fae do not trick you, and spirits like you.

nodes.name: Golden Rule
nodes.description: You sense nearby wealth and treasure opportunities like a sixth sense and can spot treasure from a mile away.

nodes.name: Hero's Reward
nodes.description: Whenever you save someone, they feel deeply indebted and compelled to repay you.

nodes.name: Reward Assurance
nodes.description: Whenever you complete agreed work for someone, from quests to chores, they feel compelled to deliver your due reward.

nodes.name: In Shining Armor
nodes.description: Whenever you save a damsel in distress, they are almost guaranteed to develop romantic feelings for you.

nodes.name: Winner's Rights
nodes.description: Whenever you win a competition or bet, you dictate your reward terms and the other party cannot refuse as long as your demand is directly proportional to the bet won.

nodes.name: Kakyoin's Gift
nodes.description: Married women and MILFs find you more attractive and consider you a potential romantic interest more easily.

nodes.name: King of Disco
nodes.description: You are the best dancer around, with enhanced body control, finesse, balance, rhythm, and nimbleness.

nodes.name: Mmmm Milk
nodes.description: Drinking milk replenishes your Energy.

nodes.name: Animal Lover
nodes.description: Mundane animals like you, and non-mundane ones warm to you more easily.

nodes.name: Taming Specialist
nodes.description: You are skilled at turning wild animals into domesticated ones.

nodes.name: Sunshine Charm
nodes.description: You exude goodness and purity, so good-aligned beings like you more and you more easily convince others you are doing good.

nodes.name: Bad Boy/Girl Charm
nodes.description: You carry a raw bad boy/girl edge that attracts emos and edgy people, and your rudeness more often comes across as cool.

nodes.name: I Know a Guy
nodes.description: Once every 30 days, you retroactively rewrite reality to know someone who can help with your current situation. That person must already exist and not be a full tier above you in power. You do not choose who they are, only that you learn you know someone who can help.

nodes.name: Serene Grace
nodes.description: You project a noticeable aura of refinement and grace that calms those around you.

nodes.name: Voice
nodes.description: You have a powerful, versatile voice that can be loud, quiet, smooth, rugged, feminine, masculine, and more. It boosts the power of voice-based abilities.

nodes.name: Tough Skin
nodes.description: Your skin is abnormally tough, enhancing your durability beyond the norm.

nodes.name: Fire Resistance
nodes.description: You resist fire and fire-based effects and attacks. This resistance scales with your basic stats.

nodes.name: Water Resistance
nodes.description: You resist water and water-based effects and attacks. This resistance scales with your basic stats.

nodes.name: Air Resistance
nodes.description: You resist air and weather-based effects and attacks. This resistance scales with your basic stats.

nodes.name: Lightning Resistance
nodes.description: You resist lightning and lightning-based effects and attacks. This resistance scales with your basic stats.

nodes.name: Earth Resistance
nodes.description: You resist Earth and earth-based attacks and effects, but metal does not count. This resistance scales with your basic stats.

nodes.name: Ice Resistance
nodes.description: You resist ice and ice-based attacks and effects. This resistance scales with your basic stats.

nodes.name: Thermal Balance
nodes.description: You maintain a comfortable, optimal body temperature as long as the environment is no hotter than 1000°C and no colder than -100°C.

nodes.name: Disney Princess
nodes.description: All animals adore you and stay friendly toward you, and animal-aligned entities like you more easily so you earn their affection and bond faster. You also sing incredibly well even without training.

nodes.name: Sartorial Savant
nodes.description: Your clothes and wardrobe stay clean and tidy, and small damage mends itself.

nodes.name: Quantum Disentanglement
nodes.description: You are an anomaly who somehow untangles yourself whenever you are bound or restrained.

nodes.name: Linguist
nodes.description: You understand all mundane languages and learn non-mundane ones very easily.

nodes.name: Silent Steps
nodes.description: You naturally walk silently and softly like an assassin or cat.

nodes.name: Counter Curse Mantra
nodes.description: Whenever someone tries to curse you, the curse is nullified or reflected back depending on the power difference between you and them.

nodes.name: Chameleon
nodes.description: When you stand still you blend into your surroundings, and after 10 minutes people neither detect your breathing nor acknowledge you. This effect ends when you make any major movement like attacking or fleeing.

nodes.name: Perfumer
nodes.description: You have no distinct scent and smell like whatever the person smelling you likes.

nodes.name: Magpie's Eye
nodes.description: You spot treasure and valuables very easily, with treasures in sight highlighted.

nodes.name: Iron Palate
nodes.description: You can eat and digest just about anything that is not lethal poison to you.

nodes.name: Prophecy
nodes.description: You see the future in your dreams, with or without your consent.

nodes.name: Winner Takes All
nodes.description: When you win against someone, you can force them to grant you a reward proportional to your victory. Minor victories yield minor rewards, while a fight to the death yields a reward equal in value to their life. The reward must be something they are capable of granting.

nodes.name: Natural Scent
nodes.description: Upgrade of Perfumer - You smell really good, even your sweat, with natural body odor like perfume most people like. You never smell bad.

nodes.name: Poisonous
nodes.description: You are poisonous, so anyone who eats your flesh has a mildly bad time.

nodes.name: Venomous
nodes.description: Your bite contains paralyzing venom that scales with your physical abilities.

nodes.name: Iron Man
nodes.description: You tolerate horrible sleeping conditions, strain, wounds, and exhaustion far better, making you very hardy and enduring.

nodes.name: Shiver
nodes.description: You are supernaturally attuned to the world around you, hearing its voice in whispers of wind and city.

nodes.name: Inland Empire
nodes.description: You are unusually attuned to supernatural instincts, randomly hearing insights and flashes of the future you must decipher. Honing this sense grants otherwise-unobtainable insights, but without control you cannot distinguish reality from intuition like a schizophrenic.

nodes.name: Half Light
nodes.description: You are unnaturally attuned to your baser fight, flight, and fuck instincts, almost hearing them speak to you. Honing this sense helps you gauge others, fight, and know when to run, but without control you become a paranoid savage.

nodes.name: Volition
nodes.description: You are unnaturally connected to your inner morale, determination, and will to keep going. Honing this sense lets you hold your will against extreme adversity and perform feats of willpower with ease, but losing control leads to overconfidence.

nodes.name: Raphael Ambrosius Costeau
nodes.description: You listen to your inner detective with increased deductive reasoning and cue-reading, making you basically a detective without any real detective training.

nodes.name: Blood Pack
nodes.description: Your body holds approximately 5 times the average person's blood with no noticeable effect on you.

nodes.name: Steady
nodes.description: You are incredibly steady with no small shakes and no lost footing, so you can hold a gun like it is on a tripod even hopped up on adrenaline.

nodes.name: Empathy
nodes.description: You empathize with and understand others' emotions to a savant degree.

nodes.name: Receptive Body
nodes.description: Your body accepts change without damage and curbs negative side effects, so healing works better on you and changes like super soldier serum or unstable abilities harm you less.

nodes.name: White Mage
nodes.description: Your recovery abilities are more potent and cost less energy, and people feel more grateful for your healing.

nodes.name: Endbringer Physiology
nodes.description: Race Change - You look unchanged but your physiology is overhauled into an Endbringer's, granting extreme physical stats and complete immunity to all Biological and mental abilities. Your body has hundreds of layers that grow exponentially more durable toward your core through warped spacetime, though outer layers are not much more durable, and you eventually regenerate as long as your core survives. Reaching your core requires destroying at least a planet-sized mass even at minimum durability, you resist unwilling Spacetime effects, your durability and stats scale with base stats, and you retain all prior bodily functions.

nodes.name: Healthy
nodes.description: You are very healthy with slightly increased vitality and virility, and any prior natural health complications are fixed.

nodes.name: Cardio
nodes.description: You have great cardio with slightly increased stamina and exhaustion recovery from a good heart and lungs.

nodes.name: Nimble
nodes.description: You are pretty nimble with slightly faster reflexes and speed.

nodes.name: Durable
nodes.description: You are fairly tough with slightly increased defense to take more punishment.

nodes.name: Strong
nodes.description: You are naturally strong with slightly increased strength to exert more force.

nodes.name: Reservoir
nodes.description: Your energy reserves and recovery speed are greater than average.

nodes.name: Breathless
nodes.description: Your body does not need to breathe but still gains all breathing benefits even in airless environments. You can also speak without air.

nodes.name: Red Tear
nodes.description: Whenever you are near death, your energy output and strength increase considerably until you are no longer in danger or are healed.

nodes.name: Blue Tear
nodes.description: Whenever you are near death, your energy output, defense, and resistance increase considerably until you are no longer in danger or are healed.

nodes.name: Magician
nodes.description: You are a natural-born Magician who learns, understands, and develops magic far faster with unique intuition for it.

nodes.name: Pugilist
nodes.description: You are a natural in martial arts, moving efficiently and powerfully by second nature while learning and developing them far faster with unique combat intuition.

nodes.name: Esper
nodes.description: You are a naturally born Esper who understands, develops, and masters abilities far faster with unique intuition for them. Ability cooldowns are halved.

nodes.name: Poseidon's Kiss
nodes.description: You are blessed by Poseidon to move underwater as naturally as above water, and all mundane aquatic life is friendly to you.

nodes.name: Tinker
nodes.description: You are a natural at building technology with more potent Tinker abilities, easier innovation and building, and further-pushed specializations. (A/N: If you pulled this perk without having a Tinker ability, reroll the ticket) 4/28288.

nodes.name: Hacker
nodes.description: You have heightened intuition for interfacing with technology, bypassing code and technological defenses, infiltrating networks, and exploiting faults.

nodes.name: Empath
nodes.description: You easily sense what people feel, understand emotions better, and control your own emotions far better.

nodes.name: Grand Mage
nodes.description: Your unsurpassed one-in-3000-years talent makes learning, understanding, and developing magic as natural as breathing. What takes an average mage a hundred years, you learn in one.

nodes.name: Master Pugilist
nodes.description: Your inhuman martial arts talent makes learning and developing as natural as breathing, grasping styles from simple glances. What takes 100 years to master takes you barely a year.

nodes.name: Esgod
nodes.description: You are an esper beyond espers whose monstrous potency makes using, developing, and mastering abilities as natural as breathing at much less energy cost. You can even train out hardcoded effects like cooldowns and limits.

nodes.name: Tinker Supreme
nodes.description: You are the supreme Tinker who innovates wondrous constructs on your own merits without needing specializations, which now only boost your natural prowess. You cannot utilize Tinker abilities that are not from your native world.

nodes.name: Lady Killer
nodes.description: Women always find you at least a little attractive regardless of preferences, and many consider you handsome.

nodes.name: Charming Smile
nodes.description: Your smile charms others, putting people at ease and making you more attractive to preferred partners.

nodes.name: Minty Breath
nodes.description: Your breath always smells fresh and minty regardless of what you ate.

nodes.name: Loveable Pervert
nodes.description: When you act perverted it comes across as charming or at most exasperating, so people do not mind as long as you do not cross the line.

nodes.name: Iron Fist
nodes.description: Your iron-like fists enhance the power of your unarmed strikes and fist-type abilities.

nodes.name: High Specs
nodes.description: You learn, process, and utilize knowledge far faster than anyone of your caliber should, outpacing most computers.

nodes.name: Child Friendly
nodes.description: You can activate a filter that censors your privates, removes gore, and otherwise makes you presentable to a younger audience.

nodes.name: Fast Reflexes
nodes.description: Your reflexes are beyond the norm, letting even a base human weave around punches and aim-dodge guns with training. This scales with your stats.

nodes.name: Reactive Precognition
nodes.description: You sometimes receive short precognitive visions before stumbling into danger, like stepping on a trap or being shot. This does not always trigger but grows more likely the greater the danger to your life.

nodes.name: Mysterious Stranger
nodes.description: In moments of need, a stranger with a revolver and fedora briefly assists you, like crippling an enemy or disabling a trap. (Once a skilled man with a gun becomes useless to you, he drops by one last time to give you a gold rarity trait ticket as a refund before this trait disappears.)

nodes.name: Iron Skeleton
nodes.description: Your skeleton is exceptionally durable, with bones that break far less easily and absorb shock far better.

nodes.name: Tough Claws
nodes.description: Your claws are exceptionally sharp and durable, strengthening all claw-based attacks and abilities, and you can turn your nails into simple claws at will.

nodes.name: Iron Nerves
nodes.description: Your nerves are iron; you never flinch or startle, without any loss to your reflexes.

nodes.name: Smell the Magic
nodes.description: You smell magic and mysticism, deciphering people through their magical scent — a necromancer reeks of death and decay, an ice magician smells like crisp winter air, etc.

nodes.name: Salt Detection
nodes.description: You sense the location of salt, but only salt ready for human consumption.

nodes.name: Commander
nodes.description: You exert authority and receive obedience from subordinates more effectively, and you organize, manage, command, and sustain their morale better.

nodes.name: Healing... Fluids
nodes.description: Your sweat, saliva, and cum heal others, scaling with your physical stats. The effect is mild but real — someone can lick sweat off your abs to heal.

nodes.name: Blessed Child
nodes.description: Gods favor you, making it easier to garner favor and affection from divine beings, and your Blessing-type abilities are slightly stronger.

nodes.name: Undeniable
nodes.description: Your senses cannot be hindered — sand in your eyes will not blind you, and sonic blasts will not deafen you. Only physically removing the organ impairs them.

nodes.name: Aware
nodes.description: Your awareness far exceeds average; you easily detect problems in your body, resist surprise, and read your surroundings.

nodes.name: Avian Ally
nodes.description: You share great affinity with birds, avians, and aligned creatures, earning their affection, favor, and relationships more easily. All flight also feels more natural and costs less energy to maintain.

nodes.name: Thick Skin
nodes.description: Your skin is far denser and tougher than average yet smooth and pleasant to touch, scaling with your physical stats to serve as natural armor at higher levels.

nodes.name: Strong Legs
nodes.description: Your legs are stronger and tougher than average, slightly increasing your speed and substantially boosting your kick power.

nodes.name: Pyromaniac
nodes.description: You are a natural pyromantic; your fire abilities cost less energy and your fire and heat resistance increase. You recover energy faster when hot and slower when cold.

nodes.name: Cryonist
nodes.description: You are a natural with cold; your ice-based abilities cost less energy and your ice and cold resistance increase. You recover energy faster when cold and slower when hot.

nodes.name: Nature's Child
nodes.description: Nature subtly favors you: you find fresh, healthy fruit on walks, grow gardens with minimal care, and earn favor from nature-aligned beings more easily. You also recover energy faster the closer you are to nature.

nodes.name: Mind Palace
nodes.description: Your mind is a palace under your absolute control; you are immune to all mind abilities below Mythical level, with enhanced thought speed and perfect memory. You learn much faster than average and can freely reshape your mindscape.

nodes.name: Polymath
nodes.description: You are a once-in-a-generation polymath in all areas, improving in every field vastly faster than average.

nodes.name: Talented
nodes.description: You are talented in every field, picking up and improving any skill considerably faster than average.

nodes.name: Persuasive
nodes.description: You are very persuasive, bringing people to your perspective and agreement more easily.

nodes.name: Manager
nodes.description: You excel at organizing and managing, distributing tasks and prioritizing effectively.

nodes.name: Thinker
nodes.description: All your Thinker abilities are more potent and cost less to use, and your Thinker headaches are mitigated.

nodes.name: Dramatic Tumbleweed
nodes.description: During tense, dramatic moments like standoffs, a stray tumbleweed passes dramatically between you and your opponent. It fades from existence the moment it stops being observed.

nodes.name: Herbalist
nodes.description: You hold vast knowledge of plants, discerning a plant's function and origin by sight, and you can make basic medicines.

nodes.name: Feline Friend
nodes.description: You share great affinity with cats, tigers, felines, and aligned creatures, earning their affection, favor, and relationships more easily. Your feline affinity also grants unusual flexibility, heightened balance, and slightly improved reflexes.

nodes.name: Golden Shot
nodes.description: Your swimmers are the strongest in the world; any woman you cum inside WILL get pregnant, even if she is more barren than arid deserts. (If you didn't have the right equipment before, you will now if you choose to. If not, reroll this trait.)

nodes.name: Ygdar Orus Li Ox
nodes.description: "You only live once." At the moment of your death, you resuscitate with all lethal wounds healed and some energy restored, then this trait is deleted from your status.

nodes.name: Hero Candidate
nodes.description: You are a Hero in training, fit for the title or not; all your Holy and Light abilities are slightly enhanced, and your blessings gain strength and duration.

nodes.name: Demon Scion
nodes.description: You are a Demon Lord to be, fit for the title or not; all your Darkness and Unholy abilities are slightly enhanced, but you are more vulnerable to Holy and Light abilities.

nodes.name: Goth Magnet
nodes.description: Goths, emos, and those with daddy issues are drawn to you, making their affection and favor easier to garner. People also overlook your less-favorable actions more easily.

nodes.name: Background NPC
nodes.description: You fade into the background easily; unless you draw attention, people often overlook you and find you hard to notice. This fails against those looking for you or aware you are there. Your Stranger-class abilities are slightly more potent.

nodes.name: Untraceable
nodes.description: You are very hard to track: cameras stop recording when you enter frame, the elements cover your footprints, and witnesses cannot recall which way you went.

nodes.name: The Favorite
nodes.description: People want you on their side and dote on you to prevent your defection; higher-ups in your organization like and accommodate you more easily. Kings and queens who meet you will likely take a liking to you as well.

nodes.name: Ex Nihilo
nodes.description: All your abilities that create constructs or new matter cost significantly less energy to produce and maintain.

nodes.name: Peerless
nodes.description: You are peerless in bed, quickly adapting to partners' preferences and learning their weak spots, and you improve in the tantric arts much faster. None leave your bed unsatisfied.

nodes.name: Helltaker
nodes.description: "You wake up, dreaming of a harem of demon girls." Infernally aligned/Demonic beings find you more attractive and grant their affection more easily.

nodes.name: Heaventaker
nodes.description: "You wake up, dreaming of a harem of... angel girls? That doesn't sound right-" Holy aligned/Angelic beings find you more attractive and grant their affection more easily.

nodes.name: Denied from Oblivion
nodes.description: Hell's gates are closed to you and heaven kicked down the ladder, leaving you stuck here. You remain in the mortal world as a soul after death.

nodes.name: Curse Devouring Physique
nodes.description: Your unique physique devours curses like a hungry animal, fighting and slowly eating any curse placed on you, scaling with your maximum energy. Fully devouring a curse slightly increases your maximum energy, with diminished returns for repeats of the same curse. You also recover energy faster in places with more negativity.

nodes.name: Mysticism
nodes.description: Your energy reserves and recovery speeds exceed the norm, letting you use abilities and spells longer.

nodes.name: Hyper Reflexive
nodes.description: Your nervous system is overhauled, making your reflexes so fast they almost seem like precognition.

nodes.name: Surging Magic Power
nodes.description: Your mystical connection is far more potent; any magic you use is far stronger, and you can overload spells without breaking them.

nodes.name: Nine Lives
nodes.description: You have nine lives; each time you die, you expend one life and return to full health.

nodes.name: Scholar
nodes.description: You excel at reading, learning, and retaining information; you can read 50 books in a day and retain all their information.

nodes.name: Winterman
nodes.description: You were born in harsh winter winds; you resist cold and ice-based abilities better, and your ice-based abilities cost less energy.

nodes.name: Constant
nodes.description: You are a constant; your body cannot be changed by outside influences without your consent (such as soul manipulation or biomancy, not regular attacks). You are immune to paradoxes, and only one of you exists since you cannot be cloned or replicated.

nodes.name: Master Rider
nodes.description: You master riding any mount; when mounted, your senses link and you communicate your intentions to your mount instantly.

nodes.name: Dragon Rider
nodes.description: You are destined to ride dragons; all dragons view you more favorably and grant their affection far more easily.

nodes.name: My Master
nodes.description: You are an excellent master; servants under you view you more favorably and grant affection more easily. This also applies to submissive people.

nodes.name: Corrupting
nodes.description: Your presence is very corrupting; the longer you influence people, the more willing they become to betray their morals for you and ignore your actions' morality.

nodes.name: Pacifism
nodes.description: You can turn off your killing potential; even if you hit a medieval serf with a final flash, he survives, albeit barely.

nodes.name: Gym Nut
nodes.description: You are a gym nut; your body recovers from exercise far quicker and better, and your physical training efficiency is considerably increased. You can achieve peak human fitness in a few months of decent training.

nodes.name: Fireborn
nodes.description: You were born in flames and molded by them; you are completely immune to all fire-based attacks. The higher your body temperature, the faster you recover energy and health, up to 500%.

nodes.name: High Capacity
nodes.description: You gain an extra ability slot.

nodes.name: Immutable
nodes.description: Your body refuses to change; you incredibly resist transformative abilities, forcing anyone changing you without consent to wrestle control first. Abilities like rot or wither inducement, sickness inducement, biokinesis, etc. are automatically resisted.

nodes.name: Ice Monarch
nodes.description: You are the Ice Monarch, ruler of all ice; you massively resist all elemental effects, and every element contacting you freezes. All your ice and frost-related abilities below Mythical Tier are increased by rank and cost less energy. All ice and frost-aligned beings instinctively recognize you as Monarch, and you are immune to ice and cold-based abilities.

nodes.name: Fire Monarch
nodes.description: You are the Fire Monarch, ruler of all Fire and Plasma; your energy is massively enhanced, as your soul is an eternal reactor. All your Fire and Plasma-related abilities below Mythical Tier are increased by one rank and cost less energy. All fire and heat-aligned beings instinctively recognize you as Monarch, and you are immune to Fire and Plasma-based abilities.

nodes.name: Earth Monarch
nodes.description: You are the Earth Monarch, ruler of all Earth; your durability is massively enhanced, as you are as immovable as earth. All your Earth and Metal-related abilities below Mythical Tier are increased by one rank and cost less energy. All earth-aligned beings instinctively recognize you as Monarch, and you are immune to earth and metal-based abilities.

nodes.name: Sea Monarch
nodes.description: You are the Sea Monarch, ruler of all Water and the depths; your vitality is massively increased, as the sea is the mother of all life. All your water-related abilities below Mythical Tier are increased by one rank and cost less energy. All water and sea-aligned beings instinctively recognize you as Monarch, and you are immune to water and ice-based abilities.

nodes.name: Sky Monarch
nodes.description: You are the Sky Monarch, ruler of all Sky; your agility is massively enhanced, as you are as free as wind. All your wind and lightning-related abilities below Mythical Tier are increased by one rank and cost less energy. All sky-aligned beings instinctively recognize you as Monarch, and you are immune to wind and lightning-based abilities.

nodes.name: Hero
nodes.description: You are a Hero, a child blessed by light and holy. All your Light and Holy-based abilities strengthen alongside your physical abilities. Divine/Clergy-aligned beings view you with greater favor, reverence, and affection, rewarding your merits and service, and all blessings are stronger and last longer on you.

nodes.name: Free Bird
nodes.description: You are a perfect flyer; flight comes as naturally as walking or breathing, and all your flight abilities are more precise, potent, and cost considerably less to maintain.

nodes.name: Relentless Stamina
nodes.description: Your stamina is ridiculous; even as a regular human you can run a marathon unwearied. You recover from exhaustion very fast and are hard to exhaust.

nodes.name: Cat's Feet
nodes.description: You almost always land on your feet when falling and are immune to all fall damage; even falling from space to earth will not hurt your legs.

nodes.name: Cuddle King
nodes.description: You are the king of cuddling; anyone you cuddle or share skinship with feels comfortable. You make the best cuddling partner for building relationships.

nodes.name: Eagle Eyes
nodes.description: Your sight and visual acuity far exceed the norm; you see much farther and clearer than average.

nodes.name: Bloodhound
nodes.description: Your smell far exceeds the norm, rivaling canines, and you differentiate smells with great accuracy.

nodes.name: Sharp Hearing
nodes.description: Your hearing far exceeds the norm; you distinguish quieter sounds easily, differentiate between sounds, and automatically adjust to noise levels.

nodes.name: Soft Hugger
nodes.description: Your hugs feel deeply comforting and therapeutic, helping dispel negative emotional states.

nodes.name: Boundless Stamina
nodes.description: Your stamina is boundless; even as a regular person you can run a marathon with ease and need only a minute's rest afterward. Your stamina recovers incredibly quickly and exhaustion fades much faster.

nodes.name: Spirit Affinity
nodes.description: You are talented with all things spirits; spiritual creatures and objects take a liking to you, and your soul-based abilities are easier to master.

nodes.name: Immortal Soul
nodes.description: Your soul is immortal; it can be wounded and shattered but never annihilated while you possess energy.

nodes.name: Last Stand
nodes.description: When your health drops to 10% or you stand on the brink of death, your physical stats increase by a stage.

nodes.name: Lord Death of Murder Mountain
nodes.description: Your killing mindset is a marvel of nature; you instinctively know how to land lethal blows and find weak points through sheer animal instinct.

nodes.name: Enhanced Strength
nodes.description: Your existing strength is enhanced, increasing the physical force you exert in proportion to your strength.

nodes.name: Enhanced Agility
nodes.description: Your existing agility is enhanced, augmenting your speed and reflexes.

nodes.name: Enhanced Vitality
nodes.description: Your existing vitality is enhanced, letting you recover from wounds and afflictions quicker and stay healthier overall.

nodes.name: Enhanced Endurance
nodes.description: Your existing endurance is enhanced, letting you function longer before tiring and endure more punishment.

nodes.name: Dexterous
nodes.description: You are unusually dexterous, with impeccable hand-to-eye coordination, motor skills, and bodily control.

nodes.name: Vengeful
nodes.description: When fighting any target you have lost to before, all your abilities and traits increase by a stage (+), so Uncommon becomes Uncommon+.

nodes.name: Masochism
nodes.description: "Hurt me more." Whenever you are hurt or damaged, you recover energy proportional to the damage received.

nodes.name: Demon Lord
nodes.description: You are a Demon Lord; all your Darkness and Unholy magic and abilities strengthen alongside your physical stats, increased further if your race is demonic or infernal. You greatly resist all Darkness and Unholy attributes. Demonic/Infernal beings serve you more readily and obey your authority more easily, and those under your service or command are easier to command and manage and gain minor buffs from you.

nodes.name: Item Warranty
nodes.description: Your gacha items carry a warranty; if equipment you own breaks beyond effective use, within 24 hours it and all its parts are replaced with a perfect replica, as long as it was not traded or given away. This applies only to breakage during intended use, not sacrifice, smelting, destruction during modification, etc., and not to consumables.

nodes.name: Hero Time
nodes.description: You can activate this only once a week; when fighting to protect someone, all your enhancement abilities receive a full rank boost.

nodes.name: In Time of Need
nodes.description: -A Hero arises. Once every 120 hours, you restore your stamina and energy to full, but hours afterward you become extremely exhausted.

nodes.name: Seamster
nodes.description: You are naturally talented at sewing; you spot flaws in clothing and easily make or fix garments.

nodes.name: Wrath Made Manifest
nodes.description: You are wrath given form; all your physical stats increase the angrier you get, capping at Epic Rank.

nodes.name: Pride King
nodes.description: Your existence is oppression; in your presence, any creature below Epic rank has all energy lowered by one rank, and anyone more than two ranks below you cannot breathe without your permission.

nodes.name: Gluttonous Abyss
nodes.description: You extract energy from any object you eat to permanently increase your own energy reserves.

nodes.name: Free Flier
nodes.description: You master flight; flying is as natural as walking or breathing while you are capable of flight, and your ability-based flight costs less energy.

nodes.name: Stable
nodes.description: You never lose your balance short of your legs being sheared off.

nodes.name: Zenkai Boost
nodes.description: Every time you return from near death, all your stats permanently increase.

nodes.name: Black Heart
nodes.description: You hold a second metaphysical heart that massively increases your mana capacity and regeneration while significantly boosting all necromancy abilities.

nodes.name: Energy Heart
nodes.description: Your heart is replaced by a metaphysical alternative pumping raw energy through your veins, massively increasing your maximum energy reserves. Your natural regeneration speeds add to your energy regeneration alongside regular recovery.

nodes.name: Mana Substitution
nodes.description: You can substitute blood, food, water, or air with your own mana, but do not depend on it too long or you may instantly die when you run out of mana.

nodes.name: Iron Mind
nodes.description: Your mind is iron and your body obeys; exhaustion and starvation minimally affect your performance, keeping it optimal regardless of suffering. This does not extend to physical limitations or wounds. You also gain increased resistance to all Negative Mental Ailments.

nodes.name: Bloodless
nodes.description: You hardly bleed; even drained of most blood, you feel no effect as long as a cupful remains. If you are a vampire, you no longer suffer the need for blood.

nodes.name: Bloodbank
nodes.description: Your body holds 10x the blood and regenerates blood 10x faster, without changing mass or size.

nodes.name: Eternal Bleed
nodes.description: Your body holds virtually limitless blood and regenerates it 100 times faster; you can feed a whole vampire clan for life or serve as the ultimate bank for a Hemokinetic.

nodes.name: Living Nightmare
nodes.description: You recover energy by converting others' fear of you into energy; if enough people fear you, you may even gain permanent stat increases.

nodes.name: Lord of Fear
nodes.description: You rule fear; if your opponent fears you, their energy drains into yours, and you can physically interact with and absorb fear into your energy.

nodes.name: Necromancer
nodes.description: Specialization - You are a natural-born necromancer dealing in death and souls. Any death or soul-related ability is easier to master and costs less energy.

nodes.name: Plaguemaster
nodes.description: Specialization - You are a natural-born contagion; spreading disease, poison, and decay is second nature. Any poison or disease-related ability is easier to master and costs less energy to use.

nodes.name: Shapesmith
nodes.description: Specialization - You master all biological and body-alteration abilities faster and use them for less energy.

nodes.name: Non-Binding Clause
nodes.description: You can destroy at will any contract or clause bound to you that you agreed to, including soul bindings and magical enforcement.

nodes.name: Lil' Hercules
nodes.description: You are far stronger and more durable than you should be, able to rip a man in two bare-handed as a regular human and withstand your own punches. This bonus strength scales with your current physical abilities.

nodes.name: Peak Specimen
nodes.description: You are the genetic peak of your race, immune to its impurities and genetic defects.

nodes.name: Ancestry
nodes.description: You are the secret child of a great figure, such as a legendary swordsman or magician, rather than of mundane parentage. Once you unlock your lineage ability or talent, this trait is replaced by it.

nodes.name: Chutzpah
nodes.description: You can shrug off panic and fear at will and act with audacity even before a god.

nodes.name: Sisyphean
nodes.description: "A lifetime defined by futile struggle." Your mind may bend but never breaks, even under centuries of boredom, torture, or futile labor. You are MASSIVELY resistant to all external mental interference.

nodes.name: Magic Well
nodes.description: You possess an abnormally large energy pool, letting you use abilities and spells for far longer.

nodes.name: Big Battery
nodes.description: Your energy reserves are noticeably above average, though not at genius level.

nodes.name: Dragon Core
nodes.description: You possess a dragon's energy core instead of ordinary reserves — a power plant where an average mage has a generator.

nodes.name: Energy Abyss
nodes.description: Your energy storage is infinite, though your regeneration and output are unchanged. You can hold the energy equivalent of a billion supernovas, even if you can only conjure a measly fireball.

nodes.name: Lord of Magic
nodes.description: Your magical talent is one in a trillion. You learn even the most complex spells in a hundredth of the time an average "genius" needs and can invent spells on the fly.

nodes.name: Warlord
nodes.description: Your talent in weaponry and warfare is one in a trillion. You master almost any martial art and weapon in a hundredth of the time an average "genius" needs. You are basically Garou.

nodes.name: Demigod
nodes.description: You are the child of an unknown god who may dote on you or turn on you once they learn of you. After you discover your lineage and awaken your ability, this trait is replaced by it.

nodes.name: Untired
nodes.description: "I can do this all day." You never feel tired or exhausted, even when your energy is nearly gone or you have run for days, though your body still suffers the negative effects of overwork.

nodes.name: Infinite Stamina
nodes.description: "I can do this forever." You never run out of bodily stamina and never get out of breath, though you can still strain your body. This does not affect mana/energy.

nodes.name: Recoilless
nodes.description: Your ability drawbacks are severely reduced. You can draw upon more power than your body should handle and barely feel it.

nodes.name: Your Majesty
nodes.description: You carry royal blood and project above-average charisma, making others readily accept you as an authority figure. Those you are responsible for view you with greater respect and authority.

nodes.name: Rivalry
nodes.description: Swordsmen, martial artists, and competitive people seek you out to test themselves and grow fond of you more easily, especially if you defeat them. Your martial skills grow faster in combat.

nodes.name: Demon God
nodes.description: You are the reincarnation of a Demon God. Your Darkness and Unholy abilities and magic below Mythical level gain a tier and cost less energy, your basic physical stats are massively increased, and you can convert your energy directly into a darkness attribute like a Mana Burst. Demonic and infernal beings weaker than you recognize you as absolute authority, while stronger ones still recognize what you are.

nodes.name: Wanted
nodes.description: Organizations want you on their side and refuse to let you leave. You receive far better treatment and face far looser rules in any organization you join.

nodes.name: Quest Marker
nodes.description: "Another settlement needs our help, I'll mark it on the map for you." Whenever you receive a quest or request, you can summon an arrow pointing toward your objective.

nodes.name: Pretty Privilidge
nodes.description: You are not physically more attractive, but others find your face and figure more appealing to their tastes. A 5/10 in their eyes becomes a solid 7/10.

nodes.name: Lese Majeste
nodes.description: People in power, such as nobles, bosses, and royalty, perceive your boldness as charming rather than disrespectful. They also find themselves more attracted to you.

nodes.name: Lovers
nodes.description: You understand others better and express your own feelings more clearly through speech and words. This is essentially talent in communication.

nodes.name: Charming Eyes
nodes.description: Your eyes do not hypnotize people like mystical charming eyes — they are simply very pretty.

nodes.name: Precise
nodes.description: You wield your abilities and spells with exceptional precision and control, and your mastery over your own moves and body is beyond the norm.

nodes.name: Exact
nodes.description: You control your abilities and spells with incredible precision that others struggle to match.

nodes.name: Chronolog
nodes.description: You possess a perfect internal clock. You recall exactly when you last did something down to the millisecond and time things as perfectly as a stopwatch.

nodes.name: Post Mortem
nodes.description: When you die, you keep moving and using your abilities for up to 1 hour before death finally claims you.

nodes.name: Infinite Money Glitch
nodes.description: You can always pull exactly what you need to pay from your pocket as perfect legal tender that causes no inflation. You somehow find enough money whenever you need it.

nodes.name: Magic Circuits
nodes.description: You possess natural Magic Circuits that act as magic computers in your body, helping you regenerate energy and actualise magic and abilities. Their quantity and quality depend on your energy reserves and energy traits, or double if you already have Magic Circuits.

nodes.name: Nature's Embrace
nodes.description: Nature favors you: trees offer you fresh fruit, animals and nature-aligned beings are affectionate and aid you, and you maneuver forests with ease. You recover energy faster the closer you are to nature.

nodes.name: Nature's Chosen
nodes.description: As Mother Nature's favored one, you receive her protection in forests and nature. Wild animals are friendly, understand your words, trees part to guide you, bounties offer fresh produce, and nature-aligned beings recognize her touch on you. You recover energy faster the closer you are to nature.

nodes.name: Hamon
nodes.description: You instinctively use and master Hamon breathing to harness Life Magnetism and sunlight through your breath. Extended practice grants you a superhuman physique, vitality, longevity, and more, and you can grant others Hamon Breathing by punching their diaphragms.

nodes.name: Gaia's Child
nodes.description: You are Gaia's child, and Mother Nature actively defends you in forests with spear-hard branches, rising trunks, and shielding roots. Animals and nature-aligned beings favor you affectionately, and some recognize her touch on you.

nodes.name: Heavy Weapons Guy
nodes.description: "I am Heavy Weapons Guy." The heavier the object you wield, the proportionally stronger you become, and you suffer no penalties for wielding oversized weapons.

nodes.name: Superconductor
nodes.description: Your body channels lightning, making all lightning-based abilities more potent, cheaper, and easier to master. You can also ground lightning and electricity to absorb a portion of their energy.

nodes.name: Earthbound Ancient
nodes.description: You are one with the primordial earth. All earth-based abilities are far more potent, cheaper, and easier to master, and you recover energy faster on the ground and even faster underground.

nodes.name: Grounded
nodes.description: You embody the immovable earth. All earth-based abilities are more potent, cheaper, and easier to master, and you recover energy faster underground.

nodes.name: Skyward
nodes.description: You belong to the skies. All wind-based abilities are more potent, cheaper, and easier to master, and you recover energy faster while in the sky.

nodes.name: Electric Sheep
nodes.description: All Tinker abilities are easier for you to use and innovate with, and you interface with any existing machine and network with greater ease. (A/N: Reroll if you don't have a tinker ability)

nodes.name: Flexible
nodes.description: You are more flexible than an expert contortionist.

nodes.name: Demon King
nodes.description: You are the destined Demon King. Your Darkness and Unholy-related abilities and magic and your physical abilities are greatly enhanced, further increased if your race is demonic or infernal, and you greatly resist all Darkness and Unholy attributes. Demonic and infernal beings are servile and obedient toward you — weaker ones are compelled to serve — and you grow slightly stronger for each creature that submits to you, based on its power.

nodes.name: True Hero
nodes.description: You are the True Hero blessed by the divines. Your Light and Holy-based abilities and physical abilities are greatly enhanced, and all blessings on you are stronger and longer-lasting. Divine and Clergy-aligned beings regard you with reverence and reward your service, and you gain a temporary boost to all stats when fighting to save someone, scaled to your willpower and the stakes.

nodes.name: Chosen Champion
nodes.description: You are the chosen Hero of Humanity. Your Light and Holy-based abilities below Mythical rank gain a rank, your base physical abilities are massively enhanced, and all blessings on you are permanent. Divine and Clergy-aligned beings revere you and reward your service, and you gain a temporary boost to all stats when fighting to save someone, scaled to your willpower and the stakes.

nodes.name: Charisma
nodes.description: You project a charismatic aura that draws people in and elevates you in their eyes.

nodes.name: Harem Lord
nodes.description: You face far less resistance from potential partners and society when building a harem, though it remains challenging.

nodes.name: Harem King
nodes.description: Your preferred partners are more attracted to you, and neither society nor your partners object to your harem itself, though other relationship issues may remain.

nodes.name: Camaraderie
nodes.description: You build affection, trust, and respect with teammates and allies much faster, especially by fighting alongside them. You also cooperate with others far more effectively.

nodes.name: Trustable Face
nodes.description: You strike strangers as dependable and trustworthy, making their trust and respect easier to earn. This does not work on people with a negative opinion of you.

nodes.name: Large Pockets
nodes.description: Any pocket, backpack, or similar container you own is 10x larger on the inside, without changing the object itself.

nodes.name: Conflict Drive
nodes.description: "I love a good challenge." Conflict and worthy opponents are drawn to you like a magnet, challenging your life — but conflict also brings rewards.

nodes.name: Challenge DLC
nodes.description: A challenge board is added to your gacha, offering 3 limited-time quests based on your location, state, and power level. You can take one challenge every 48 hours when the board resets, or every 168 hours after a failure.

nodes.name: Relationship Tracker DLC
nodes.description: A relationship tracker is added to your gacha page, showing your standing with people of interest and what they think of you, plus their interests, likes, and dislikes.

nodes.name: The Real Weapon
nodes.description: Your fists are your only true weapon. Your physical stats are augmented proportionally to the strongest weapon you own, but this bonus is negated the moment you wield any weapon.

nodes.name: One with the Blade
nodes.description: You are one with your weapon: whatever item you wield gains your physical stats added to its own. A copper coin in your hands can out-toughen diamond if you are strong enough.

nodes.name: Caveman
nodes.description: Unga Bunga. You possess a caveman's enhanced strength and endurance, skill with blunt instruments, and ability to tough it out in the wild.

nodes.name: Void Childe
nodes.description: You are a child of the Void with enhanced spatial awareness. You sense portals opening a kilometre away, and all Space-based abilities are more potent and faster to master.

nodes.name: Father Time
nodes.description: You are Time's favourite: you are immune to all time-based abilities, time travel, and paradoxes, and time cannot be stopped in your world even by the mightiest gods. Your time-related abilities and magic cost massively less strain and energy, and you ignore the paradox and time resistance of targets below god level.

nodes.name: Shub's Favor
nodes.description: Thanks to her blessing, your vitality and virility are considerably increased. Those with maternal instincts find themselves more attracted to you, and you are assured to be a great father.

nodes.name: Yog's Blessing
nodes.description: Thanks to Yog's blessing, all drawbacks from your Space-related abilities are mitigated, they cost less energy, and their range is far higher. You also gain incredible resistance to Space attribute attacks.

nodes.name: Four Leaf Clover
nodes.description: You are modestly lucky, with fate's scales skewed toward you without reaching blatantly supernatural levels. (Does not affect Gacha)

nodes.name: Rabbits Foot
nodes.description: You are naturally very lucky and favored by Lady Fate. You can rob a casino blind, and matters without high impact on fate go in your favor. (Does not affect Gacha)

nodes.name: 21 Leaf Clover
nodes.description: You are incredibly lucky without seeming superhuman. You almost never lose games of chance unless you choose to — if it is up to chance, it lands in your favour. (Does not affect Gacha)

nodes.name: Fortune's Lover
nodes.description: You are absurdly lucky, enough for luck alone to count as an ability. Chance falls in your favour and fate bends toward you, though not all luck is good. (Does not affect Gacha)

nodes.name: Hellsing
nodes.description: You are the true hunter of inhumans such as Ghouls, Ghosts, Cryptids, and Demons. Against them, your reflexes and skills are enhanced, you enter a focused state, and your intuition is heightened.

nodes.name: Marksman
nodes.description: You are a natural marksman with exceptional aim and accuracy with most projectiles, especially bows and ranged weaponry.

nodes.name: Rebellion
nodes.description: Whenever you suffer a debuff or binding, your physical stats and magical resistance increase. The more penalties you incur, the stronger this boost becomes.

nodes.name: Child of Artemis
nodes.description: As a child blessed by Artemis, goddess of the hunt, your proficiency and talent with all ranged weapons are greatly increased. Your tracking and wayfinding are supernaturally enhanced, letting you trail prey across a country and never lose your way in the deepest woods.

nodes.name: Master of Arms
nodes.description: You wield any weapon as if you have trained with it for 10 years and bypass any wielding requirements, such as being an angel or chosen hero. All sentient weapons adore you and yearn to be wielded by you.

nodes.name: Qualified
nodes.description: You qualify to wield any item or pass through any qualified door, even if the item deems you unworthy like Excalibur. You must be holding the weapon — unarmed combat does not count — and mastery vanishes when you let go.

nodes.name: Innocuous
nodes.description: People are far more forgiving toward you and cannot stay angry at you for long, even in court.

nodes.name: Sharing Is Caring
nodes.description: People are far more generous toward you, pay you handsomely, and rarely keep secrets from you.

nodes.name: Lucifer's Child
nodes.description: The child of evil rebels against the heavens. All your stats are significantly increased against Holy- or Light-aligned enemies, but you cannot receive Holy or Light blessings or healing.

nodes.name: Nothing Strange
nodes.description: People automatically normalize your weirdness and oddities, from skipping class to speaking strangely.

nodes.name: Common Sense
nodes.description: People rationalize and accept your unusual or alarming actions, though this effect weakens the more drastic and inexcusable your actions become.

nodes.name: Lethal Charm
nodes.description: "This could get problematic." The more evil someone is, the more easily you win their favor and affection.

nodes.name: Titan Crusher
nodes.description: Your body is unnaturally powerful. Even as a basic human, you are at least a hundred times stronger than you should be and can demolish the entire world military with ease.

nodes.name: Motivational Speaker
nodes.description: "Dattebayo!" You are an excellent motivational speaker whose corny words strike hearts instead of sounding cringey. You easily get through to even stubborn listeners.

nodes.name: Blessing of Isis
nodes.description: As a child blessed by Isis, goddess of magic, you learn and comprehend magic with ease regardless of affinity or race restrictions.

nodes.name: Blessing of Durga
nodes.description: As a child blessed by Durga, goddess of righteous fury, you are immune to corruption, negative effects, and mental statuses during combat. The more evil your enemy, the greater your advantage against them.

nodes.name: Blessing of Amaterasu
nodes.description: As a child blessed by Amaterasu, goddess of the Sun, you greatly resist curses and darkness-based attacks while your light-based abilities are much stronger.

nodes.name: Blessing of Izanami
nodes.description: As a child blessed by Izanami, goddess of the Underworld and Death, you greatly resist all curses and necrotic effects. Your affinity for all Spirit and Death abilities, spells, and items is increased, and the dead favour you more.

nodes.name: Blessing of Hestia
nodes.description: As a child blessed by Hestia, goddess of hearth, you resist all mental effects and negative ailments. Your body is far healthier, and your natural aura puts people at ease.

nodes.name: Blessing of Bast
nodes.description: Blessed by Bast, goddess of cats and grace, you gain cat-like reflexes, agility, and night vision. Felines adore you.

nodes.name: Fertility Calibration
nodes.description: You freely adjust your own fertility from absolute sterility to extreme potency. You can impregnate even the completely infertile, or match the Goat of a Thousand Young.

nodes.name: Draw of Fate
nodes.description: Your fate is strong and immoderate, curving toward you like a main protagonist. You draw plenty of luck, both good and bad.

nodes.name: Dealmaker
nodes.description: "A Deal's a Deal." People feel compelled to fulfil their end of any explicit deal they make with you (No clever wording or Fae deals). It is also far easier for you to goad people into outrageous bets.

nodes.name: Honesty
nodes.description: You project an aura that draws honesty from others. People lie worse around you and feel greater remorse for deceiving you.

nodes.name: Truthspeaker
nodes.description: Whenever you speak what you believe to be true, people believe your words, however you choose to word them.

nodes.name: Loyalty
nodes.description: People are naturally more loyal to you, more willing to risk themselves for you and less inclined to betray you.

nodes.name: Vault
nodes.description: Information-gathering abilities and technologies malfunction when targeting you.

nodes.name: Library Mind
nodes.description: Your mind is organized and efficient like a library, with slightly faster memory, clarity, and speed.

nodes.name: Embrace
nodes.description: Your embrace feels as soft as a mother's love — calming, comforting, and therapeutic. Even an evil man might break down crying in your arms.

nodes.name: Transhuman
nodes.description: You are transhuman, whatever your race. Genetic and mechanical augments work exceptionally well on you, and you suffer no penalty for changing race or installing cybernetics.

nodes.name: All Trades
nodes.description: You hold basic mastery over all mundane skills and mild talent in every field — cooking without burning eggs, basic mechanics, dancing without tripping, wielding a sword without cutting yourself.

nodes.name: Paper Trail
nodes.description: You and your familiars always carry the relevant papers. You can reach into your pocket and find whatever legal identification you need.

nodes.name: No Peeking
nodes.description: Information gathering fails against you: scrying spells collapse, precognition fails, and cameras stop recording.

nodes.name: Battery Saver
nodes.description: You spend less energy on your other abilities for each ability slot you leave unused. If you use only one of 3 slots, that ability costs 3x less.

nodes.name: Rule 63
nodes.description: You live in a reality retconned across all existence where some men are now women and some women are now men.

nodes.name: No Enemies
nodes.description: Everyone you meet forms a good impression of you once they get to know you, even evil dictators, violent murderers, or mindless beasts. This only works on named characters.

nodes.name: My Friend Now
nodes.description: Everyone you meet starts friendly toward you unless they already hold a preconceived opinion of you. You can share a drink with even Thanos or Death itself.

nodes.name: Uchiha
nodes.description: You carry Uchiha Clan blood, granting you increased Martial Talent, Energy Reserves, and Fire Affinity. You can potentially unlock a Natural Sharingan (Epic Ability) that costs no ability slot. (Does not give Chakra)

nodes.name: Uzumaki
nodes.description: You carry Uzumaki Clan blood, granting you greatly increased Vitality and Energy Reserves. You heal yourself and others by imbuing your blood with energy and life force, and you can potentially unlock Adamantine Sealing Chains (Epic Ability) that costs no ability slot. (Does not give Chakra)

nodes.name: Hyuga
nodes.description: You carry Hyuga Clan blood, granting you increased Martial Talent, Energy Reserves, and Dexterity. You can potentially unlock a natural Byakugan (Elite Ability) that costs no ability slot. (Does not give Chakra or dormant alien god genes)

nodes.name: Senju
nodes.description: You descend directly from Hashirama Senju, gaining greatly increased lifeforce, energy reserves, and martial prowess. You can potentially unlock natural Wood Release (Legendary Ability) and gain increased Nature Affinity. (Does not give Chakra)

nodes.name: Hanma
nodes.description: You are a Hanma with exceptional genetics, giving you increased poison resistance, far faster physical stat growth, and greatly increased martial talent. You carry overwhelming testosterone compared to other men, or equal genetic gifts without the testosterone if you are female.

nodes.name: Lesser Undead
nodes.description: Race - You are a lesser undead and must choose between zombie or skeleton. You have no stamina and spend energy for everything, gaining unique bonuses and demerits based on your choice, and this race toggle is permanent until contested.

nodes.name: Greater Undead
nodes.description: Race - You are a greater undead and transform into a Death Knight or Lich based on your stats. You have no stamina and spend energy for everything, gaining unique bonuses and demerits based on your form.

nodes.name: Fishman
nodes.description: Race - You are a Fishman of a random hybrid with naturally stronger physical stats than humans. You breathe underwater, hold great water affinity, communicate with sea-bound creatures, and can learn Fishman Karate.

nodes.name: Lunarian
nodes.description: Race - You are a Lunarian of a legendary race with massively increased physical stats, wings, and natural fire manipulation. While the fire on your back stays lit, your durability is massively increased.

nodes.name: Nightkin
nodes.description: Race - You are a Nightkin vampire created from Dead Apostle blood with superhuman physical and magical abilities. You regenerate by rewinding as long as you hold blood, and you grow stronger and can evolve to the next undeath stage by consuming enough blood.

nodes.name: Nightmare
nodes.description: Race - You are a Nightmare vampire born from Dead Apostle blood with superhuman physical and magical abilities. You regenerate by rewinding while you hold blood and can turn people into ghouls. You wield your own unique Elite Rank Ability with no ability slot and evolve to the next undeath stage by consuming enough blood.

nodes.name: Dead Apostle
nodes.description: Race - You are a fully realized Dead Apostle with vastly superior physical stats and time-rewinding regenerative immortality while you hold blood. You gain your own Epic ranked ability that costs no ability slot, turn humans and animals into lower-ranking apostle thralls, and grow stronger and recover energy the more blood you consume.

nodes.name: Dead Apostle Ancestor
nodes.description: Race - You are a true Dead Apostle Ancestor with immense physical and magical power, rewinding your own time to heal whenever you are injured while you hold blood. You wield your own Idea Blood, a Legendary Ability costing no ability slot, turn anyone who ingests your blood into a powerful vampire instantly, and all vampires and undead acknowledge you as the ultimate vampire class.

nodes.name: Beastkin
nodes.description: Race - You are a beastkin of a random animal such as bear, rabbit, cat, wolf, etc., with enhanced physical stats and night vision. You gain unique traits and biological features based on your hybrid.

nodes.name: Ghoul
nodes.description: Race - You are a flesh-eating ghoul with a chosen Kagune and formidable regeneration. You cannot digest anything but human flesh, and you slowly turn feral if you go longer than two weeks without dining.

nodes.name: One-Eyed Ghoul
nodes.description: Race - You are a One-Eyed Ghoul, stronger than an average ghoul, with superhuman stats and a chosen Kagune. You grow stronger by eating human flesh but can also eat normal human food.

nodes.name: Vampire
nodes.description: Race - You are a vampire born of the Stone Mask created by Pillar Man Kars. You gain amped physical stats, ghoul and vampire creation, and flesh manipulation, but you are deathly vulnerable to sunlight.

nodes.name: Pillar Men
nodes.description: Race - You are a pillar man unlocked by the Stone Mask with self-biokinesis, flesh absorption, thrall creation, and massively increased physical stats. You are vulnerable to sunlight.

nodes.name: Perfect Lifeform
nodes.description: Race - You are a perfect lifeform unlocked as a pillar man by the Stone Mask with the super Aja. You gain enhanced physical and magical stats and freely manipulate your own biology and body shape.

nodes.name: Viltrumite
nodes.description: Race - You are a Viltrumite of one of the galaxy's fiercest warrior races with an incredibly powerful body and free flight. You are almost invulnerable except to a specific sound frequency.

nodes.name: Kryptonian
nodes.description: Race - You are a Kryptonian whose physical and energy reserves grow with sunlight exposure. You gain heat vision, ice breath, high-speed flight, no need to breathe, tactile telekinesis, X-ray vision, and more, becoming basically a living god under a yellow sun.

nodes.name: Saiyan
nodes.description: Race - You are a Saiyan warrior with a great natural physique and a monkey tail weakness. Under a full moon you turn into a rampaging giant monkey with massively increased stats, but you still need decades of training to grow truly strong.

nodes.name: Child of Man
nodes.description: You are the child of the God Emperor of Mankind, sharing his gifted physique, charisma, martial prowess, scientific gift, and potential as the strongest Psyker. You can master all non-Chaos Psyker Disciplines and eventually tear apart a planet with Psyker power alone through training, as your power emulates the Warp without connecting to it.

nodes.name: Majin
nodes.description: Race - You are a Majin descendant of Majin Buu with a malleable gum-like physique and massively enhanced physical and magical stats. You survive and regenerate from even a handful of your body and absorb people and objects to strengthen yourself, though you start with only greatly superhuman abilities and increased energy.

nodes.name: Rodrigues
nodes.description: You are a Brazilian descendant of the legendary Jetstream Sam. You can double jump and hold talent in swordsmanship and swordsmithing.

nodes.name: Tepes
nodes.description: You descend from the legendary Tepes bloodline of original vampires. Your Vampirism, Unholy, and Hemokinetic abilities are more potent, and all undead and vampires respect you more.

nodes.name: Mithril Skeleton
nodes.description: Your skeleton is unusually durable, flexible, and better at conducting energy, taking far more punishment before damage. Note that your skeleton isn't real mithril and scales with your physical stats.

nodes.name: Adamantium Skeleton
nodes.description: Your skeleton is incredibly durable and dense, seeming nigh unbreakable without poisoning you. Note that your skeleton isn't real adamantium and scales with your physical stats.

nodes.name: Vibranium Skeleton
nodes.description: Your skeleton resembles Vibranium more than bone, seeming nigh unbreakable while absorbing and storing kinetic energy. You spend that stored energy to temporarily enhance your physical strength. Note that your skeleton isn't real Vibranium and scales with your physical stats.

nodes.name: Adamantium Bonding
nodes.description: Your skeleton is bonded with Adamantium, making it borderline unbreakable but severely poisoning you. You should wait to activate this trait unless you have countermeasures lined up.

nodes.name: Sensor
nodes.description: You hold a knack for sensing and locating energy/mana/chakra, etc. Your energy-sensing and Thinker abilities are enhanced.

nodes.name: Man vs World
nodes.description: You grow stronger the more you are outnumbered in a fight, with enemies counting only if they will inflict grievous harm on you. This caps at 1 vs 1000 and halves for each ally fighting the outnumbering enemies alongside you.

nodes.name: Duelist
nodes.description: Your stats increase during a one vs one fight, and this effect ends if any other combatant intervenes. People are also less likely to interrupt your duels.

nodes.name: Multitasking
nodes.description: You divide your attention across multiple tasks without losing efficiency. Your efficiency may still decline if you take on too many tasks at once.

nodes.name: Scavenger
nodes.description: You hold a better chance of finding something useful whenever you scavenge for treasure, lost parts, artefacts, etc.

nodes.name: Meet Cute
nodes.description: You are much more likely to encounter romantic interests in favourable positions during daily life.

nodes.name: Blood Mana
nodes.description: You can treat your vitality as a secondary mana bar at a 1-to-1 exchange rate. Expended vitality cannot be healed and only returns through rest.

nodes.name: Angel
nodes.description: Race Change - You are an Angel created with holy power, with slightly increased physical stats and natural winged flight. Your Holy and Light-based abilities are more potent and include Holy Light (Rare Rank Ability), while your Darkness and Unholy abilities weaken and you stay vulnerable to Unholy attributes.

nodes.name: Principality
nodes.description: Race Change - You are a Principality, a higher-tier angel with two pairs of wings and holy power. You gain increased physical stats, energy reserves, and natural winged flight, stronger Holy and Light-based abilities including Holy Light (Rare Rank Ability), weaker Darkness and Unholy abilities, and vulnerability to Unholy attributes.

nodes.name: Dominion
nodes.description: Race Change - You are a Dominion, a high-tier angel with three pairs of wings and increased magical and physical abilities.
