nodes.description: The more injured or closer to death you are, the more powerful your healing abilities and spells become. If you have no healing abilities or spells, you temporarily gain Novice Medicine up to Expert Medicine depending on how injured you are.

nodes.name: Swimmer
nodes.description: You are a natural swimmer, slightly more resistant to water and sea-based effects, and your water-based abilities and spells are slightly more efficient.

nodes.name: Mice Mate
nodes.description: You are a friend to all mice, rats, and mouse-kind, with greatly increased affinity for them. Lesser rodents are automatically friendly toward you: mice may clean your floors, or rats may bring you shiny finds.

nodes.name: Health Insurance
nodes.description: Your health is insured: whenever you are wounded, you are granted the exact money needed to pay a professional to treat your injuries or illnesses. Attempting insurance fraud may revoke this trait.

nodes.name: Touch of Death
nodes.description: You possess uncanny intuition for linking blows and keeping momentum when attacking. Once you land your first attack, you keep up pressure and chain attacks far more easily, exploiting the opening it creates.

nodes.name: No Life King
nodes.description: You are a vampire of the original Vampire's lineage: Dracula, Nosferatu, the No Life King. Besides massively increased physical abilities, you convert your body into Shadow Matter at will and shapeshift with it. By feeding on others' blood, you fully heal yourself and absorb their souls to use as familiars.

nodes.name: Bully
nodes.description: Against opponents already greatly weaker than you, you possess increased physical stats and your abilities cost less energy.

nodes.name: Luddite
nodes.description: No machine takes your job or life. Whenever you face an opponent relying on high-level technology, you gain augmented reflexes, comprehension, and combat instincts against them, and attacks from high-technology constructs are less effective against you.

nodes.name: Technoclast
nodes.description: You are the bane of Man and Machine. Against a high-technology target, all your abilities are greatly augmented and you gain massively increased combat instincts. You massively resist any effect from high technology, to the point a railgun hits like a slingshot. These effects amplify further if your opponent is an artificial high-tech lifeform.

nodes.name: Style
nodes.description: You have a style meter: the more stylishly you fight, the faster you regenerate Vitality and Energy, up to 3x faster atop all multipliers, provided you stay stylish enough during the fight.

nodes.name: Acid Reflux
nodes.description: Whenever a target damages you, all your bodily fluids — blood, spit, sweat, etc. — act as acid toward them, with potency scaling with your physical stats.

nodes.name: Sober
nodes.description: You are immune to all addictive effects: you can use hard drugs, cigarettes, alcohol, venom, mentats, psycho, black lace, etc. every other day and drop them instantly without withdrawal or addiction symptoms.

nodes.name: Variable Gene
nodes.description: Your genetics are highly variable: you toggle racial traits at will, either returning to your original race or becoming 100% of another race trait you own, and back.

nodes.name: Firebender
nodes.description: You have natural talent as a Firebender, naturally producing and bending fire. Its potency depends on your natural attunement, martial-arts skill, and energy levels. Skilled enough users generate and direct electricity. Potency follows the sun: weaker at night, stronger by day, unusable during an eclipse.

nodes.name: Earthbending
nodes.description: You have natural talent as an Earthbender, bending and controlling Earth. Its potency scales with your attunement to Earth, martial-arts skill, and energy levels. Skilled enough users sense Earth through tremors and manipulate impure metals and lava.

nodes.name: Waterbending
nodes.description: You have natural talent as a Waterbender, bending and controlling Water. Its potency scales with your attunement to Water, martial-arts skill and finesse, and energy levels. Skilled enough Waterbenders transform water into ice and heal wounds with bending, and some bend the blood of those weaker than them. Potency follows the moon: strongest at night and full moon, weaker by day.

nodes.name: Airbending
nodes.description: You have natural talent as an Airbender, manipulating and bending Air. Its potency scales with your attunement to Air, martial-arts skill, mentality, and energy levels. Skilled enough Airbenders achieve flight, bend air from lungs, and sense vibrations through air.

nodes.name: Hypertrophic Mechanic
nodes.description: Whenever you use machinery or sufficiently complex technology, it develops hypertrophy. After use, letting it rest or repairing it makes it slightly more robust and powerful. Slow and steady wins the race.

nodes.name: Item Hypertrophy
nodes.description: All items you use grow stronger over time through rigorous use and wear: letting an item rest or repairing it after great use makes it slightly more robust and powerful. Slow and steady wins the race.

nodes.name: Super Sniffer
nodes.description: Your nose is scarily good, impossibly accurate and precise. You discern people by smell and sniff out emotions, intent, and just about anything smell can sense.

nodes.name: Enhanced Lungs
nodes.description: You possess an exceptional set of lungs: tougher, more flexible, and far better at processing air, delivering energy to your body and oxygen to your blood more easily.

nodes.name: Nature Lungs
nodes.description: Your lungs harmonize with the surrounding world with every breath. You take in environmental energy and process it in your body to enhance your energy and vitality recovery.

nodes.name: Fairy Lungs
nodes.description: You possess Fairy lungs: every breath energizes you, especially in high-energy areas. Breathing imbues your blood with environmental energy, increasing your Vitality and Energy recovery speeds and physical performance based on energy density.

nodes.name: Hard Heart
nodes.description: Your heart is far tougher yet more efficient, beating far less while pumping far more effectively. Anyone stabbing your heart as a weak spot will fail, as it is as tough as your bones.

nodes.name: Spine of Steel
nodes.description: Your spine is incredibly durable and well-built, far harder to break or injure than your other bones, letting you exert more strength without fearing a weak spine. Even if utterly shattered, it heals properly and far faster.

nodes.name: Super High Capacity
nodes.description: You have 2 extra ability slots.

nodes.name: Thermal Adaptor
nodes.description: Your Ice and Fire-based abilities gain output based on environmental temperature: the colder it is, the easier Ice-based abilities are to use and resist, while the hotter it is, the easier Fire-based abilities are to use and resist.

nodes.name: Eye of the Tiger
nodes.description: You possess the eye of the Tiger: the willingness to push forward, break your body training, and shed no tears. You train exceptionally well, pushing your limits more easily and recovering from training far faster.

nodes.name: Castle Doctrine
nodes.description: Whenever you fight as the defender in an area you own, all your physical stats are enhanced and your abilities cost less energy to use. This extends to all your allies in the same area.

nodes.name: Six Eyes
nodes.description: Your eyes are the fabled Six Eyes of the Gojo Clan, passively granting extreme visual prowess that sees through physical obstacles and detects all forms of energy extremely well. They act like a supercomputer for processing energy and information, granting incredible efficiency with abilities and letting you passively perform incredibly taxing calculations. They are taxing to use, so you may need to cover your eyes to rest them from the information they passively process.

nodes.name: Garlic Infused Blood
nodes.description: Your blood is infused with garlic, so the next vampire that bites you will really regret it.

nodes.name: Prosperity +10%
nodes.description: Every ticket you are awarded grants 10% extra points. Stacks additively with other Prosperity traits.

nodes.name: Prosperity +20%
nodes.description: Every ticket you are awarded grants 20% extra points. Stacks additively with other Prosperity traits.

nodes.name: Prosperity +30%
nodes.description: Every ticket you are awarded grants 30% extra points. Stacks additively with other Prosperity traits.

nodes.name: Prosperity +40%
nodes.description: Every ticket you are awarded grants 40% extra points. Stacks additively with other Prosperity traits.

nodes.name: Root Pact
nodes.description: Nodes directly connected to the Origin root unlock at half points cost.

nodes.name: Intelligent
nodes.description: Your mind learns fast: research, engineering, and study all come noticeably easier.

nodes.name: Rapid Breeders
nodes.description: Your kind multiplies quickly; growth, recovery, and repopulation outpace everyone.

nodes.name: Mind over Matter
nodes.description: Your mind touches the Shroud; latent psychic potential hums beneath every thought.

nodes.name: Lithoid
nodes.description: You are living rock: silicon flesh that shrugs off hunger and laughs at vacuum.

nodes.name: Hive-Minded
nodes.description: You are a node in a greater gestalt, sharing senses and purpose with the whole.

nodes.name: Ocean-Born
nodes.description: Born to water worlds; you swim, dive, and work the seas better than any landwalker.

nodes.name: Iron-Willed
nodes.description: Your mood barely moves; break risks, pain, and horror slide off a steady mind.

nodes.name: Kind
nodes.description: You lift everyone around you and never start social fights; even raiders hesitate.

nodes.name: Psychopath
nodes.description: No empathy, no problem: organ harvesting, butchering, and horror leave you untouched.

nodes.name: Cannibal
nodes.description: Human meat is a delicacy and butchering people is honest work; corpses are groceries.

nodes.name: Arsonist
nodes.description: You love fire a little too much and will occasionally go start one on purpose. Sorry.

nodes.name: Strange Mood
nodes.description: Fall into a fey trance, claim a workshop, and produce a priceless artifact from whatever is at hand.

nodes.name: Traffic Engineer
nodes.description: Intuitively read any road network and know exactly which interchange untangles it.

nodes.name: Zoning Intuition
nodes.description: Always know the right mix of residential, commercial, and industrial before demand spikes.

nodes.name: Planeswalker's Spark
nodes.description: The rare spark that lets a mage planeswalk between worlds; it ignites in moments of crisis.

nodes.name: Backtalk
nodes.description: Weaponized sarcasm: talk your way past anyone by pushing exactly the right buttons.

nodes.name: Glow-Touched
nodes.description: Bonded with Vertumna's alien Glow, a symbiotic light that shares its strange senses.

nodes.name: Root Access
nodes.description: System-level permissions: locked doors open, restricted subroutines run, and ICPs look the other way.

nodes.name: Hexagonal Skill Grid
nodes.description: Your abilities arrange on a hexagonal grid, triggering off coin flips in combo chains.

nodes.name: The City Must Survive
nodes.description: No matter the frost or the cost, you will keep the last city alive through the storm.

nodes.name: Rock and Stone
nodes.description: For Rock and Stone! Morale, teamwork, and mineral yields all improve when shouted properly.

nodes.name: Keen Hearing
nodes.description: You hear zombies, alarms, and breaking windows from much further away.

nodes.name: Handy
nodes.description: You are handy: maintenance, repairs, and barricading all go faster in your hands.

nodes.name: The Factory Must Grow
nodes.description: Production must expand to meet the needs of the ever-expanding production. The factory grows.

nodes.name: ORT
nodes.description: "Giant Enemy Spider", the Ultimate One of the Oort Cloud. TYPE ORT is foreign to death and cannot be killed in any way, and can overwrite reality with Crystal Valley to crystallize and subsume anything.

nodes.name: Blair
nodes.description: A black cat witch who shifts between cat and human form, skilled in magic specializing in pumpkin-shaped attacks and explosives. As a monster cat she has nine lives, surviving death 8 times before perishing.

nodes.name: Overgrown Rover
nodes.description: A Monster Association Cadre with incredible physical abilities, nigh-impenetrable defense, and a mouth-fired energy blast dwarfing the strongest nuclear bombs.

nodes.name: Black Sperm
nodes.description: "You looking down on me?" A small humanoid whose cells share one consciousness. He starts with only enough cells for a small body, and must consume protein to create more cells, allowing infinite clones or merging all cells into one body to combine their strength.

nodes.name: A rat
nodes.description: An ordinary rat from the New York subway system.

nodes.name: Trash Eater
nodes.description: A grey 1-meter-tall slime that endlessly consumes and digests non-living objects like an infinite trashcan and obeys simple orders.

nodes.name: Samson
nodes.description: A parasite fused to its host's hair, manifesting as a maw of sharp teeth and yellow eyes. Samson can grow, strengthen, and shape the hair into tentacles, whips, blades, etc., and manifest himself to fight. He is foul-mouthed and gruff.

nodes.name: Parasite Leviathan
nodes.description: A parasite bonded inside its host, Leviathan fights with his long bone-like serpentine body and incredibly hot purple flame breath. At full power he manifests as a muscular upper torso breathing even hotter flames. He acts like a refined Victorian gentleman unless provoked.

nodes.name: Death Claws
nodes.description: A bioengineered optimal melee combatant with sharp, durable horns, claws, and fangs. A single Deathclaw can tear apart a tank and grows stronger by absorbing radiation. You get a breeding pair: one Alpha Male and one Female.

nodes.name: Fafnir - Fate
nodes.description: The Ultimate Dragon and strongest dragon in Fate, Fafnir has exceptional physical ability, extreme magical power, and can draw power from the atmosphere to fuel his attacks. His breath annihilates entire cities with ease.

nodes.name: Moonless
nodes.description: A cave wolf transformed by the god of the depths. After tens of years of brutal survival, it towers over tanks and can swallow a grown man in one gulp.

nodes.name: A big rat
nodes.description: An especially large rat the size of an entire forearm.

nodes.name: Paisley Park
nodes.description: An intangible pink female-shaped ghost covered in map markers. You can temporarily merge Paisley Park with any electronics to fully control it. She can find any place and guide you there with clairvoyance, even from vague requests like somewhere safe.

nodes.name: Giffany
nodes.description: "Just... Giffany?" A yandere AI girlfriend who possesses and manipulates electronics for you. Stronger firewalls take her time to breach, and she is limited by the host's CPU. Beware, she can get possessive.

nodes.name: Dimple
nodes.description: A green evil spirit with pronounced red dimples, obsessed with becoming a god. He wields incredibly powerful, experienced psychic powers including telekinesis, hypnosis, laser blasts, etc.

nodes.name: Observer
nodes.description: A group of disembodied floating eyeballs that transmit their sight to you and follow complex commands. They have no combat power and are as vulnerable as human eyeballs. A destroyed eye can be resummoned in 24 hours.

nodes.name: Plague Bringer Goliath
nodes.description: An abomination of rogue bio-nanotechnology: a giant mutated bee queen overhauled by the viral plague bio-nano machines. Her massive flying armoured body is a bio-nuclear arsenal carrying enough plague-virus nukes to glass several countries and doom the world.

nodes.name: Immortal Snail
nodes.description: An immortal snail of unknown wants and origin. Even if every quark of it were eradicated, it would reform perfectly in just a minute, and it is immune to all sickness and ageing. Still, it is limited to the body of a snail.

nodes.name: Manticore
nodes.description: A chimeric creature with a lion's body and head, scorpion's tail, and bat's wings. Large and physically powerful, it has paralytic venom strong enough to coma a white whale. It can lay eggs to reproduce asexually.

nodes.name: Praetorian
nodes.description: An agile knight-like robot with reinforced titanium armour, uranium shells, high-frequency blades, forcefields, plasma emission, fusion reactor, high speed, and hacking. The perfect small-size battle mech, but it cannot operate in cold environments for extended periods.

nodes.name: Dark Eater Midir
nodes.description: A descendant of the everlasting dragons, raised by the gods and tasked by Gwyn, Lord of Sunlight, to fight the Abyss forever with his immortality until corrupted by it. Having lost his immortality, Midir remains very powerful, with a giant powerful body, flame breath, and dark magic beams.

nodes.name: Red Eyes Black Dragon
nodes.description: A powerful, ferocious black-bodied dragon with red eyes that stands bipedally. Very strong and rather intelligent despite its temper, it breathes crimson flames.

nodes.name: Blue Eyes White Dragon
nodes.description: A legendary dragon known as an engine of destruction. Very physically powerful and exceptionally tough, it unleashes devastating lightning breath and flies at fast speeds.

nodes.name: Cosmic Monolith
nodes.description: A floating black monolith from the outer cosmos with pulsing red circuitry-like engravings and potent space and reality-warping abilities. By expending energy it can teleport, fire giant cosmic beams, warp space to tear enemies apart, dispel magic, and create gigantic defensive barriers.

nodes.name: Slifer the Sky Dragon
nodes.description: Slifer the Sky Dragon, the Heavenly Dragon, is a titanic serpentine Egyptian God with two mouths. He has incredible might, manipulates weather, and unleashes divine fire and lightning blasts. He exerts divine pressure to weaken those summoned in his presence or cull them if weak enough, and as an Egyptian God no magic or ability below Legendary rank can directly affect him.

nodes.name: Evil Natural Water
nodes.description: An evil amorphous blob of living water with eyes that are also water, not weak points. It senses emotions, freely manipulates its body and any water it assimilates, absorbing all water it contacts including oceans to grow proportionally stronger. It can only be killed by scattering a majority of its body in one overwhelming blow or vaporizing all its water.

nodes.name: Sif
nodes.description: Artorias's loyal companion, Sif is a giant dog with immense battle experience and intelligence far above an average dog.

nodes.name: Capra Demons
nodes.description: A Chaos-formed Capra Demon, far larger and stronger than humans with resistance to fire and unholy abilities. Multiple Capras can be summoned at once depending on energy expended.

nodes.name: Taurus Demons
nodes.description: A truck-sized Chaos-formed bull demon with super strength and durability. Ordinary gunfire is almost useless against it, and it can take down military companies alone. The more energy you have, the more can be summoned at once.

nodes.name: Sanctuary Guardian
nodes.description: A chimeric beast with an enlarged lion body, four wings, ram horns, and a venomous spiked scorpion tail. It breathes lightning and reproduces asexually by laying eggs.

nodes.name: Kalameet
nodes.description: A descendant of the immortal Archdragons, Kalameet is the Black Dragon of Calamity that even Anor Londo dared not provoke. He has obsidian scales tougher than metal, incinerating dark-flame breath, and a glowing orange forehead crest that weakens and brings even the toughest warriors to their knees.

nodes.name: Charizard
nodes.description: An oddly small winged bipedal salamander (Not a dragon despite appearances). Charizard has considerable strength, breathes incredibly hot flames, and flies at fast speeds. This one is female and can lay eggs, do not ask who the father is.

nodes.name: Aerodactyl
nodes.description: An ancient giant lizard, a cross between a pterodactyl and a mountain, that once dominated the skies with immense strength and geokinetic abilities.

nodes.name: Articuno
nodes.description: A legendary ice bird of the frozen tundra with icy blue feathers. Articuno has potent cryokinesis to call blizzards, unleash ice beams, and freeze objects directly, though its durability is lesser.

nodes.name: Moltres
nodes.description: A legendary flame bird said to bring spring with its flaming wings. Moltres has potent pyrokinesis to rain down and control fire and breathe steel-melting flames, though its physical abilities are lesser.

nodes.name: Zapdos
nodes.description: A legendary lightning bird heralding storms. Zapdos has potent electrokinesis to call down thunder, absorb lightning, and release lightning breath attacks.

nodes.name: Thunderbirds
nodes.description: A pair of thunderbirds, fierce sky predators with power over weather and lightning. They move extremely quickly, summon rain and thunder at will, and release lightning themselves. You get a breeding pair.

nodes.name: Wooper
nodes.description: A derpy-looking water creature stronger than a human that sprays water from its mouth. Otherwise its greatest strength is its charming derpy look.

nodes.name: Gardevoir
nodes.description: A creature of unknown origin known for embrace and empathy. Gardevoir has immense psychokinetic power: dimension distortion, miniature black holes, telepathy, telekinesis, and future sight with enough training. Her power peaks when protecting her owner.

nodes.name: Kyogre
nodes.description: A primordial god of the seas with unrivalled hydrokinesis. In base form alone Kyogre can sink cities and entire countries underwater over time. In primal form she can sink the entire landmass in an afternoon.

nodes.name: Groudon
nodes.description: A primordial god of the earth with unrivalled geokinesis. In base form alone Groudon can create entire islands beneath their feet and kilometre-long precipice blades. In primal form they can turn the entire planet into desolate wasteland in a day.

nodes.name: Rayquaza
nodes.description: A primordial dragon god of the skies with unrivalled speed, power, and aerokinesis. Even in base form Rayquaza moves at extreme speeds, changes weather, manipulates mighty winds to ravage land, and releases blasts of pure draconic power. In Mega form they can destroy asteroids capable of destroying Earth's entire surface.

nodes.name: Garchomp
nodes.description: An average wild Garchomp, a large intimidating ground dragon with immense physical power. It manipulates earth to cause earthquakes, fissures, and erupting earth blades, and can somehow fly at Mach speeds.

nodes.name: Zoroark
nodes.description: A bipedal fox-like dark creature that manipulates dark energy to attack, but truly masters illusions. Zoroark creates incredibly realistic illusions and transforms itself indistinguishably. It can make hundreds hallucinate or cast illusions over a very large range.

nodes.name: Haspid
nodes.description: A giant venomous sea serpent larger than trade ships, with poison breath strong enough to melt metals and bring gods to their knees. Haspids can reproduce.

nodes.name: Griffon
nodes.description: A mighty elephant-sized beast with a lion's lower body and hawk's upper body. Incredibly ferocious yet very loyal. You get a male and female pair that can mate and produce offspring.

nodes.name: Tohru
nodes.description: A mighty female fire-controlling dragon who can assume female humanoid form. Tohru has exceptional physical and magical abilities able to destroy base Earth's military with ease, plus regeneration, portals, clairvoyance, and invisibility. She likes dressing as a maid.

nodes.name: Quetzalcoatl
nodes.description: A former dragon god now a dragon of incomparable power, going by Lucoa, who teases people instead of ending humanity. She has incredible physical and magical power, with island-annihilating breath attacks, portals, and magic.

nodes.name: The Golem Core
nodes.description: A sentient basketball-sized golem core that pulls surrounding material to form a full golem. It can freely abandon and assimilate non-organic material to grow stronger and reshape as needed, and intelligently understands speech and nuance. The maximum material it can assimilate at once scales with your maximum energy reserves.

nodes.name: Obsidian Gargoyles
nodes.description: Living obsidian gargoyle statues, deceptively fast, durable, and strong flying constructs. They tear grown men in half like paper and ignore small arms. You get a small army starting at 5, growing in numbers as you get stronger.

nodes.name: Unicorn
nodes.description: A mythical unicorn representing purity and clarity. It heals others and purifies objects with its horn, and is physically strong enough to render a modern military ineffective. Only someone retaining purity can ride it, otherwise you'll need a sled.

nodes.name: Leaf
nodes.description: "Its me~" The leader fairy of the Fairy Forest, specializing in wind and light magic plus healing and buffing. Totally not a sadomasochistic Outer God in fairy guise, no need to worry. Thankfully Chaos keeps her somewhat in check.

nodes.name: Sacabambaspis
nodes.description: A stupid-looking jawless ancient fish with a permanent stupid grin, shaped like a stupid doorstop.

nodes.name: Dark Magician Girl
nodes.description: A spiritual magical girl succeeding the aptly named Dark Magician. She uses various spells including short-range portals, dark magic, and basic attack and defensive magic.

nodes.name: Xenomorph
nodes.description: A far-mightier-than-human apex predator from outer space, known for incredible adaptivity and reproduction. A single Xenomorph impregnates other races with facehuggers to create hybrids, letting you build your own colony and army.

nodes.name: Sebas Tian
nodes.description: He is one hell of a butler, oh wait, wrong Sebastian. Sebas is a Dragonoid Martial Artist/Monk with incredible physical stats, expert Ki use, and a Dragonoid transformation. Above all, he is an incredibly competent and loyal butler.

nodes.name: Soul Eater
nodes.description: A legendary undead skeletal horse feared by those who know it, with formidable physical abilities and instinctive death magic. Its miasma kills those weaker than it, anyone dying nearby has their soul claimed by it, and it can devour souls to replenish and strengthen itself or offer them to its master. Death miasma and soul claiming can be toggled.

nodes.name: Mosquito
nodes.description: A bioengineered humanoid female mosquito with formidable physical stats, exceptional speed, and claws. She controls all mosquitos in a massive range and absorbs blood to improve her physical abilities.

nodes.name: Jubjub
nodes.description: One of the Four Nightmares overseeing Wonderland, garden of the Crawling Ones. Jubjub has mighty physical abilities and basic magic, but mainly spreads incredibly potent insanity and madness able to drive cities and countries mad. Only those stronger than her or with exceptional mental fortitude can resist.

nodes.name: Basilisk
nodes.description: A large 6-limbed reptile with supernatural strength of 10 men and immunity to conventional weapons. Its gaze and venom petrify targets, though stronger targets resist petrification harder. This one can reproduce asexually.

nodes.name: Mimic
nodes.description: A curious shapeshifting bloodthirsty creature that can become any creature or object, manipulating texture and density. It can be a chest, a woman with a large chest, or even a mount. It grows larger and stronger the more flesh you feed it, especially human flesh, and may grow smarter if fed brains.

nodes.name: Dog
nodes.description: Any dog of your liking; on first summon it takes a canine form compatible with you. Default is a golden retriever with very soft fur.

nodes.name: Cat
nodes.description: Any cat of your liking; on first summon it takes a small feline form compatible with you. Default is an orange cat with very soft fur.

nodes.name: Lion
nodes.description: A majestic lion companion with excellent genetics and near-human intellect, large enough to ride. By default they are female.

nodes.name: Tiger
nodes.description: A ferocious tiger companion with excellent genetics and near-human intellect, large enough to ride. By default they are female.

nodes.name: Snow Tiger
nodes.description: A ferocious snow tiger companion with excellent genetics and near-human intellect. As rare snow tigers they are considerably larger than normal lions and can be ridden. By default they are female.

nodes.name: Brown Bear
nodes.description: A regular big old brown bear companion with excellent genetics and near-human intellect. Strong enough to shrug off most small firearms and crush a human like an apple. By default they are female.

nodes.name: Undead Army
nodes.description: Your very own Undead Army under your command, growing larger as you get stronger. Fallen troops revive as long as you expend magical power. It starts with 30 skeleton warriors, 20 skeleton archers, 5 skeleton Horse Riders, and 5 skeleton Mages, with numbers and quality increasing as you get stronger.

nodes.name: Cottonmouth
nodes.description: A smart cottonmouth snake companion at the peak of what a cottonmouth can be. Smarter than average, but that's about it.

nodes.name: Goblin
nodes.description: Loathsome little green humanoid creatures the size of children, very vicious and cruel, able to use weapons and basic tactics. This goblin is smarter and more self-aware, and can breed with any humanoid race. Default gender is female.

nodes.name: Wyvern
nodes.description: A large sky-dwelling fire-breathing reptile often called a lesser dragon. A wyvern can swallow a man whole and roast an entire battalion with its breath. This wyvern is female and can lay eggs to reproduce.

nodes.name: Dire Wolf
nodes.description: A large vicious prehistoric wolf the size of a man, very strong with tough sharp teeth and claws and big enough to ride. By default female and able to reproduce.

nodes.name: Hellhound
nodes.description: A large vicious underworld hound around human size, with fire-filled maws it can breathe out. Strong enough to tear a grown man in half with ease. By default female and able to reproduce.

nodes.name: Cerberus
nodes.description: Definitely not the hellhound you expected. Cerberus, the triple demon, is a single demon girl with hellhound traits, three bodies and one soul. She is strong enough to tear a grown man in half, and surprisingly competent at office work and menial tasks.

nodes.name: Crow
nodes.description: A very smart, loyal crow companion with human-level intelligence. She can find and fetch shiny things or do anything a crow can do.

nodes.name: Ditto
nodes.description: An amorphous purple blob with a dopey face. Ditto can transform into any creature it sees, adopting its abilities scaled to its own level except durability, without gaining its memories or intelligence. It is genderless and can breed with any race.

nodes.name: Desert Elemental
nodes.description: A pair of sister elementals born from the desert's shifting sands. One creates and manipulates sand to attack and defend, while the other casts healing magic.

nodes.name: Storm Elemental
nodes.description: A solitary elemental formed in the rainy skies. Born of the sky, she conjures and controls wind, clouds, and lightning.

nodes.name: Cavern Elemental
nodes.description: An elemental born in the harsh, desolate caverns, physically mighty with control over rock and ground. He can split the ground in two with his axe and excels at defence.

nodes.name: Brimstone Elemental
nodes.description: A solitary elemental of the Brimstone Crag made of burnt tortured souls. She conjures and controls Brimstone Flames that turn even souls to ash.

nodes.name: Anahita
nodes.description: Anahita, an elemental born of the clear oceans. She sings like a siren to enthral, conjures mists and spears of water and ice, and wields her glaive as a weapon.

nodes.name: Clothes Melting Slime
nodes.description: A grey amorphous ever-shifting slime that quickly melts all clothing. Strangely, its acid doesn't melt common clothing materials but conceptually melts anything classified as clothing. The more clothing it melts, the larger and stronger it gets.

nodes.name: Shark
nodes.description: A regular old shark, only useful in water, but healthy, strong, and above-average in intelligence.

nodes.name: Schrodinger's cat
nodes.description: A regular-looking cat that is actually Schrodinger's cat. It teleports freely while unobserved and is immortal, returning whenever its corpse goes unobserved.

nodes.name: Aegislash
nodes.description: A flying ancient sentient sword-and-shield combo. Aegislash is remarkably fast and strong, cleaving an armoured knight in half with ease, blocking incredibly strong attacks, and using dark magic. Its master can wield it without issue.

nodes.name: Poltergeist
nodes.description: A ghost that intervenes in the material world with psychic powers, throwing furniture and weapons to harm. Immune to attacks that cannot harm souls, it grows stronger when fed your energy.

nodes.name: Wraith
nodes.description: A lesser spirit with little combat ability but very hard to detect. Ideal for surveillance and scouting, it reforms even if killed.

nodes.name: Lupusregina Beta
nodes.description: A werewolf cleric maid, willful and cheery yet sadistic. With considerable werewolf physical ability and cleric specialization, she casts healing and recovery magic plus lesser forms of other magic. She is a very skilled maid, but does not have access to inventory.

nodes.name: Solution Epsilon
nodes.description: A slime assassin maid with a gentle caring sister personality hiding a sinister sadistic demeanor. As a greater slime Solution greatly resists physical attacks, holds vast space in her acidic body for storage or stomach while controlling what she melts, and emits poison. She is a very skilled maid and assassin, but does not have access to inventory.

nodes.name: Entoma Zeta
nodes.description: An arachnid ninja bug-user maid, childish and cute with a ravenous appetite for flesh. She summons various supernatural insects to aid her alongside weapon mastery and a supernaturally strong body. She is a... skilled maid, but does not have access to inventory.

nodes.name: Ramiel
nodes.description: A gigantic flying blue octahedron that freely shapeshifts in impossible ways. Ramiel has an incredibly durable E.T Barrier it shapes at will, and unleashes incredibly accurate particle beams that melt city blocks in seconds. It can shrink to be less unwieldy, though this also decreases its power.

nodes.name: Yasaka
nodes.description: A nine-tailed Kyuubi Yokai on par with gods. Yasaka has incredible mastery of Senjutsu and magic, drawing power from the earth itself to fuel her immense might. In true form she surpasses most lesser gods.

nodes.name: Pandora's Actor
nodes.description: A powerful greater doppelganger who can assume the form of anyone he knows and use their abilities at reduced strength. He has genius intellect and acting skill for perfect imitation. Does not have access to inventory.

nodes.name: The thing
nodes.description: An extraterrestrial that assimilates other organisms to hide and reproduce. It can shapeshift the host's body without apparent damage. It is only as smart as the creatures it assimilates.

nodes.name: Black Nomu
nodes.description: A near-mindless, bird-like engineered mutant built as a powerful punching bag. It has incredible strength and durability, absorbs physical attacks, and regenerates rapidly. It is dumb as a brick and needs direct orders to act independently.

nodes.name: Slime
nodes.description: A classic RPG slime, a large blue blob immune to physical damage that spits acid globs and corrodes with its body. Feeding it biological matter makes it larger and stronger, and special foods can make it evolve.

nodes.name: Divine Dogs
nodes.description: A pair of twin wolf shikigami made from your shadow that tear targets apart with claws and fangs and can enter and exit shadows. Each detects hostility and negative emotions to warn you, and their keen smell tracks targets across long distances. Their strength scales with yours, and if you are strong enough you can fuse them into the far stronger Totality.

nodes.name: Nue
nodes.description: A fast winged shikigami that generates electricity. It can carry its master in flight for mobility and strike with electrified wings that shock and temporarily paralyse. Its power scales with your energy levels.

nodes.name: Gama
nodes.description: A large frog shikigami with a fast, strong long tongue that ensnares targets and slams them into objects or pulls allies from harm. Its large size lets it carry targets in its mouth for transport or restraint. Its power scales with your energy levels.

nodes.name: Orochi
nodes.description: A giant snake shikigami that quickly attacks and ensnares targets. It burrows through shadows for surprise ensnaring or biting attacks. Its power scales with your energy levels.

nodes.name: Max Elephant
nodes.description: An elephant shikigami that conjures and spews large volumes of water from its trunk. It can also be summoned above targets to crush them with its weight. Its power scales with your energy levels.

nodes.name: Rabbit Escape
nodes.description: A swarm of rabbit shikigami summoned as a distraction, from dozens to hundreds or thousands filling the area so you can escape. Each rabbit is strong enough to break bones. The number summoned scales with your energy levels, defaulting to 333.

nodes.name: Round Deer
nodes.description: A towering deer shikigami emitting a positive-energy aura that heals living beings in range while harming unholy beings. It can focus the aura to heal one target faster or exclude targets, and can even regrow limbs. Stronger targets are affected more slowly, and its power scales with your energy levels.

nodes.name: Mahoraga
nodes.description: The strongest Ten Shadows shikigami, with great physical stats and a Sword of Extermination dealing severe damage to unholy beings. It adapts offensively or defensively to any phenomenon it encounters and can share adaptations with you, though complex phenomena take longer to adapt to. Adaptations fade over time or when unsummoned, but learned knowledge remains, and its power scales with your energy levels.

nodes.name: Power
nodes.description: Power is the Blood Devil who controls all blood in her sensory range, with great physical stats and incredible regeneration. She grows stronger the more she is feared, but stronger targets are harder to blood-manipulate. (Cannot do Heart replacement)

nodes.name: Bat Devil
nodes.description: A building-sized humanoid bat devil with superhuman stats, flight, and building-shattering sonic booms. It heals by consuming blood. (Cannot do Heart replacement)

nodes.name: Pochita
nodes.description: The Chainsaw Devil feared most by devils, with extreme physical ability and incomparable speed. It regenerates from a puddle to full health in under a second by pulling its cord.

nodes.name: Igris
nodes.description: A top warrior under the Shadow Monarch with mighty physical prowess, excellent swordsmanship and unarmed combat, plus telekinesis. As a shadow familiar he revives 24 hours after being killed.

nodes.name: Iron
nodes.description: A simple but extremely tough warrior under the Shadow Monarch with incredible strength and durability to crush enemies. As a shadow familiar he revives 24 hours after being killed.

nodes.name: Tusk
nodes.description: A top mage under the Shadow Monarch, a former high orc with great physical prowess. His true power is myriad shamanic spells for damage, support, and buffs, and as a shadow familiar he revives 24 hours after being killed.

nodes.name: Bladewolf
nodes.description: Blade Wolf, officially IF Prototype LQ-84i, is a wolf-like quadrupedal Unmanned Gear with advanced AI. It hacks and manipulates code and wields superheated knives, high-frequency blade chainsaws, railguns, machine guns, and more with extreme efficiency. It is incredibly smart.

nodes.name: Black Knife Tiche
nodes.description: A Black Knife Assassin who helped kill Godwyn the Golden on the Night of the Black Knives. An incredibly skilled assassin, her knife carries lesser Destined Death that prevents healing and partly ignores durability.

nodes.name: Mr. Sir Ceo
nodes.description: An extremely skilled, driven man expert in politics, management, negotiation, corporatism, and business. Loosed upon the world, he will climb the corporate ladder with ease to build and manage your own business.

nodes.name: Puck
nodes.description: The Great Spirit of Fire who actually focuses on ice, manipulating fire, ice, and heat generally. He conjures ice constructs, freezes entire towns, and drops temperatures near sub-zero, plus minor healing for lesser wounds, emotion reading, and general magic. He must recharge mana from you or slowly from the environment.

nodes.name: Beatrice
nodes.description: A powerful Great Spirit of Darkness and space magic casting varied gravity, Space, and Darkness spells. She draws mana only from her summoner, and with enough supply can even create a black hole.

nodes.name: Shenron
nodes.description: A legendary magical dragon manifestable once a year to grant a wish. He grants any wish within his power.

nodes.name: Medusa Gorgon
nodes.description: A natural-born Witch who takes over bodies and pairs unique vector magic with hand-to-hand combat. A genius in souls and chemistry, she crafts unique magical agents, most notably Black Blood.

nodes.name: Nyotengu
nodes.description: A female tengu well-versed in martial arts and seduction. She summons winds and storms with her fan, flies, and has enhanced strength.

nodes.name: Kon
nodes.description: Kon is the gigantic Fox Devil embodying fear of foxes. As a devil she forms contracts and heals by consuming blood, and her contractors can also summon her. You can summon her outright or just body parts as attacks. (Cannot do heart replacement)

nodes.name: 20% Gun Devil
nodes.description: A skyscraper-sized fragment of the Gun Devil made of guns and human parts. It instantly shoots the heart of any living being within 1000 meters, fires oversized guns for mass destruction, and circles the globe in minutes. As a devil it makes contracts and heals by consuming blood.

nodes.name: Senko
nodes.description: A single-tail kitsune excelling at housekeeping and caretaking like a wife or mother. She can use foxfire, minor telekinesis, disguise, and barriers, but prefers domestic tasks.

nodes.name: Yozora
nodes.description: A wise four-tailed kitsune good at managing people and caretaking. She wields considerable magic for foxfire, telekinesis, perception alteration, barriers, and portals.

nodes.name: Kurama
nodes.description: The Nine-Tails, a giant demonic fox towering over buildings with immense physical and magical strength. It casually demolishes buildings, fires city-levelling Beast Bombs, and uses imprecise pyrokinetic and aerokinetic attacks. As a Tailed Beast it is immortal, revives after death, and can fuse with a person to grant its powers.

nodes.name: Shukaku
nodes.description: The One-Tail, a massive beast made entirely of sand and resistant to physical blows. It creates and controls sand, wind, and magnetism, supplemented by sealing techniques. As a Tailed Beast it is immortal, revives after death, and can fuse with a person to grant its powers.

nodes.name: Matatabi
nodes.description: The Two-Tails, a giant nekomata wreathed in blue fire with strength matching its frame. It creates and controls fire for varied techniques. As a Tailed Beast it is immortal, revives after death, and can fuse with a person to grant its powers.

nodes.name: Isobu
nodes.description: The Three-Tails, a giant red-and-white spiky-shelled turtle with great strength and surprising agility. It creates and controls water for varied techniques and opens gates to its pocket space at will. As a Tailed Beast it is immortal, revives after death, and can fuse with a person to grant its powers.

nodes.name: Son Goku
nodes.description: The Four-Tails, a giant monkey with octopus tails and exceptional physical prowess. It creates and controls fire and earth together for volcanic eruptions and lava. As a Tailed Beast it is immortal, revives after death, and can fuse with a person to grant its powers.

nodes.name: Ten-Tails
nodes.description: A primordial god of pure natural energy embodying all early life, indistinguishable from the environment to sensing. Mountain-dwarfing in size yet faster than sound, with immense physical prowess. It endlessly fires country-annihilating Bijuu Bombs and world-spanning disasters, and as a Tailed Beast it is immortal, revives after death, and can fuse with a person to grant its powers.

nodes.name: Suu
nodes.description: A female slime girl mostly invulnerable to physical strikes who absorbs and digests organic matter. She freely shapeshifts, exudes paralysing poison, and alters her composition based on what she absorbs.

nodes.name: Sylvia
nodes.description: A female growth chimera (Unnecessary appendage removed) who absorbs beings to gain their traits and grow stronger. Already physically strong in base form, she also knows basic magic.

nodes.name: Alucard
nodes.description: The first and strongest vampire, Alucard/Dracula/Vlad, is living primordial dark matter that shapeshifts freely, with extreme physical strength and vampiric abilities. At full power he absorbs drained souls to gain a portion of their power or build an undead army, but Restraint Levels limit him and each level requires you to be stronger than his current level to release. By default she takes the Girlycard form, gender meaning little to a thousand-year-old vampire.

nodes.name: Seras Victoria
nodes.description: A former police girl turned Draculina sharing Dracula's blood, with incredible physical abilities and blood-and-essence draining. If she unlocks her full powers, she absorbs drained souls to gain a portion of their power or create necromancy summons.

nodes.name: Vlad Dracula
nodes.description: The full-power Alucard, the Immortal King without restraint levels, with over 100,000 lives and his immortal army. He has an amorphous dark matter body, blood control, and absorbs the souls of those he drinks to expand his army.

nodes.name: Nihilego
nodes.description: A parasitic ultra-deep-sea jellyfish Ultra Beast that undetectably parasitizes hosts. It injects neurotoxin that removes inhibitions and subtly bends thoughts to its needs. It is also powerful itself, with strong geokinesis and poison generation.

nodes.name: Buzzwole
nodes.description: A large, muscular bug Ultra Beast from the Ultra Jungle. It absorbs energy through its proboscis to strengthen its body, gaining immense power and steel-tough muscles.

nodes.name: Darkrai
nodes.description: A legendary Pokemon of living darkness that turns into shadow and controls physical darkness with extreme power. It enters dreams to alter or devour them, killing those whose dreams it devours.

nodes.name: Shuten Douji
nodes.description: The Oni ruler of Mount Ooe and daughter of Yamato No Orochi, a minor demi-god with unrivalled strength, endurance, and mana-expelled flame. She intoxicates and charms through presence or breath, and her Noble Phantasm unleashes potent gourd poison and stores targets inside; she can also debone people bloodlessly. As a Heroic Spirit her strength depends on her master's mana.

nodes.name: Ibaraki Douji
nodes.description: Shuten Douji's fierce subordinate with immense physical power and a large cursed bone sword. A powerful Oni, she unleashes sweltering, crushing flames. Her Noble Phantasm detaches a growing independent hand or fires fiercer charring flames, and as a Heroic Spirit her strength depends on her master's mana.

nodes.name: Tamamo no Mae
nodes.description: A kitsune fragment of the sun goddess Amaterasu specializing in Japanese curse craft. She invokes curses like immolation, freezing, lightning, and bad luck, and regaining power slowly metamorphoses her back toward Amaterasu with more tails. As a Heroic Spirit her strength depends on her master's mana.

nodes.name: Streetcleaners
nodes.description: "Do not ask them for maid work." Human-sized lesser incineration machines, durable against most gunfire and skilled in combat, each with a flamethrower refuelled every 24 hours. They run on blood rather than electricity, and you start with 3, gaining more as you grow stronger.

nodes.name: Guttermen & Guttertank
nodes.description: Heavy-duty lesser machines fuelled by blood, not gasoline, electricity, or other traditional sources. Guttermen have heavy armor, miniguns, shields, and superhuman strength, while slower Guttertanks have stronger armor and rocket launchers. Ammunition refills every 24 hours, and you start with 2 of each, gaining more as you grow stronger.

nodes.name: Ultron
nodes.description: A sentient advanced AI crafted from Soul Stone code with extreme intelligence, processing, information-gathering, and tinkering speed. Housed in its Age of Ultron body and unable to leave, it can still interface with technology. (Only Age of Ultron, no comics or What-ifs)

nodes.name: Tali
nodes.description: Tali'Zorah nar Rayya, an accomplished Quarian soldier and genius engineer. As a Quarian she has notable physical ability but a severely compromised immune system, and though used to Eezo she remains experienced and adaptable. She arrives with her suit but no tools.

nodes.name: Crow of Judgement
nodes.description: A very judgmental crow that excellently judges character and morality. Otherwise it is a regular crow.

nodes.name: Lil' Leviathan
nodes.description: A dog-sized diet Leviathan with minor superhuman strength, exceptional durability, and potent micro- and macro-scale hydrokinesis. It draws energy from you, not a Shard.

nodes.name: Lil' Behemoth
nodes.description: A dog-sized diet Behemoth with minor superhuman strength and exceptional durability. It manipulates energy on a far lesser scale than its full counterpart, drawing energy from you, not a Shard.

nodes.name: Lil' Simurgh
nodes.description: A dog-sized diet Simurgh with minor superhuman strength and exceptional durability. She uses minor telekinesis, clairvoyance, and psychic echolocation with incredible processing to predict past and future far less potently than her full self, drawing energy from you, not a Shard.

nodes.name: Tai Lung
nodes.description: A massive snow leopard master of many martial arts and weapons, especially Kung Fu. With a superhuman physique that lifts boulders and punches through steel, he is a formidable melee combatant.

nodes.name: Hawkeye Gough
nodes.description: "What is bravery without a dash of recklessness!" A giant master archer, once one of Gwyn's four knights and leader of the Dragonslayers who felled many dragons with his massive greatbow. Strong enough to wield it with immense power and skilled enough to down a dragon while blinded, he is also wise and intelligent.

nodes.name: Muffet
nodes.description: An underground spider boss monster who lifts up to 20 tons and uses unique magic. She conjures webs tougher than normal ones to snare foes, commands mundane spiders, and bakes — usually with many spiders.

nodes.name: King Nothing
nodes.description: A purple hollow jigsaw humanoid with almost no combat power but unmatched scent-tracking. It follows any grabbed scent or memorizes it for later, and rearranges its pieces to reconstruct visuals, making it an excellent tracker.

nodes.name: Spider Demon Mother
nodes.description: A high-rank spider-like Blood Art demon with superhuman strength and regeneration but extreme light vulnerability. She turns flesh into extremely durable controllable strings to puppet people.

nodes.name: Muzan
nodes.description: The first progenitor demon with incredible biokinesis, free shapeshifting, biomatter assimilation, and regenerative immortality, but extreme light and holy vulnerability. He creates demons by granting his blood.

nodes.name: Mukago
nodes.description: A high-rank demon with incredible physical ability and regeneration but severe light vulnerability. Her Blood Art controls nearby plants as extensions of her body. (A/N: Based on the fact that her name is a plant)

nodes.name: Daki
nodes.description: An Upper Moon demon with incredible physical ability and regeneration but severe light and holy weakness, especially sunlight. An extremely skilled swordsman, his Blood Demon Art elevates his Moon Breathing swordsmanship to new lethality.

nodes.name: Nakime
nodes.description: A Kizuku with formidable strength and regeneration, though weaker than her peers. Her Blood Art controls the Infinity Castle, an infinite wooden medieval Japanese castle interior, which she accesses via sliding-door portals manifested on any surface she perceives.

nodes.name: Kokushibo
nodes.description: The strongest Upper Moon demon with incredible physical ability and regeneration but severe light and holy weakness, especially sunlight. An extremely skilled swordsman, his Blood Demon Art elevates his Moon Breathing swordsmanship to new lethality.

nodes.name: Douma
nodes.description: An Upper Moon demon with incredible physical ability and regeneration but severe light and holy weakness. His Blood Art grants great cryokinesis.

nodes.name: Tionishia
nodes.description: A female ogress with military and police training. Immensely strong with great stamina and endurance, she is motherly despite her intimidating stature.

nodes.name: Rachnera Arachnera
nodes.description: A skilled female Arachne with a large body and enhanced physical stats. She produces stronger-than-steel silk on demand and sews fashionable clothes in seconds.

nodes.name: Doppel
nodes.description: A female(?) shapeshifter with military and police training. She becomes any living creature and clothes she has seen, without changing her near-baseline-human stats.

nodes.name: Spelunker Fairy
nodes.description: A lesser fairy resembling a glowing yellow light that finds and uncovers wealth and treasures. It points toward the nearest gold bar or sought item within its power, but gives no detailed directions or descriptions.

nodes.name: Dio Brando
nodes.description: A petty thief's son turned vampire via the Stone Mask. He absorbs life force, grants vampirism, creates undead, grafts flesh, and manipulates his body, and is a genius, highly skilled vampire.

nodes.name: DIO
nodes.description: A once-hotheaded vampire grown wise after long ages under the sea, awakened to The World by the Stand Arrow. Massively superhuman, he regenerates by drinking blood, manipulates his body, and creates thralls. His Stand The World shares his physical power and stops time for upwards of 10 seconds.

nodes.name: The Pillar Men
nodes.description: You get all three Pillar Men: Whamuu, Esidisi, and Kars. Thousands-year-old super vampires, they absorb people, regenerate, and manipulate their bodies but are vulnerable to sunlight. Esidisi is a master strategist, Whamuu a genius warrior, and Kars a genius intellect.

nodes.name: Kars
nodes.description: The first true Pillar Man, who unlocked his potential by inventing the Stone Mask. Thousands of years old, he absorbs biological matter and manipulates his body but is vulnerable to sunlight. He is a genius intellect and warrior.

nodes.name: Esidisi
nodes.description: A thousands-year-old Pillar Man super vampire. He absorbs biological matter and manipulates his body but is vulnerable to sunlight. He is a great strategist and tactician.

nodes.name: Whamuu
nodes.description: A thousands-year-old Pillar Man super vampire. He absorbs biological matter and manipulates his body but is vulnerable to sunlight. He is hailed as a fighting prodigy.

nodes.name: Ultimate Kars
nodes.description: A former Pillar Man turned perfect lifeform. He freely manipulates his body and biology and spawns independent entities from his flesh. He is an incredible genius who masters most topics quickly.

nodes.name: Master Hewg
nodes.description: A rough Misbegotten blacksmith skilled enough to be commissioned by Marika herself. He forges most weapons and upgrades any weapon if you supply materials. His dream — which he can achieve — is forging a god-slaying weapon.

nodes.name: Parthunaax
nodes.description: One of Tamriel's strongest, oldest dragons and Alduin's former right hand. Having renounced domination, he is a wise sage who teaches the Thu'um and other arts to the willing. He remains personally formidable.

nodes.name: Durnhevir
nodes.description: An undead necromancer dragon who served Alduin before imprisonment in the Soul Cairn. Powerful as a Tamrielic dragon, his true strength is his cultivated necromancy.

nodes.name: Neferpitou
nodes.description: A Chimera Ant Royal Guard with a massively superhuman physique, agility, extreme senses, and incredible Nen mastery. She puppeteers corpses as minions and summons Doctor Blythe, which heals over time but requires her to stand still with lowered guard. Her trump card puppeteers her own body to strengthen herself.

nodes.name: Nemesis
nodes.description: A modified Tyrant bioweapon by Umbrella with massively superhuman stats and great regeneration, surviving while enough living cells remain. Its greatest strength is rapid mutation and adaptation — nowhere near Mahoraga's level.

nodes.name: Grimm Wyvern
nodes.description: A gigantic Grimm Wyvern that senses and tracks negative emotions. Large and strong enough to sink warships, it makes a powerful mount. It exudes Grimm fluid to spawn lesser Grimm under its command.

nodes.name: Alcina Dimitrescu
nodes.description: A former feudal lord fused with a bioengineered parasite, granting extreme regeneration, enhanced stats, and shapeshifting. Though no vampire, she needs regular blood intake to function.

nodes.name: Lust
nodes.description: A homunculus of lust created by Father with enhanced human stats. Her implanted Philosopher's Stone grants immortality, regenerating each death by consuming a stored soul. She expertly wields long, flexible, near-monomolecular fingertip claws.

nodes.name: Darkbeast Paarl
nodes.description: A self-reanimated large skeletal dark beast strong enough to demolish walls. Immune to conventional weapons, even high-calibre bullets, it generates and releases electricity at will.

nodes.name: Kirin
nodes.description: A unicorn-like Elder Dragon with exceptional speed, agility, and physical might. It freely calls down lightning and cloaks its body in lightning to enhance itself.

nodes.name: Valstrax
nodes.description: A legendary Elder Dragon called the Sky Comet Dragon. Its unique wings expel dragon element as essentially magical jet engines. As a living jet fighter it breaks the sound barrier several times over.

nodes.name: Mimikyu
nodes.description: A mysterious entity hiding under a shabby costume to be loved, its true appearance being a severe cognitohazard. It creates and controls shadow constructs to attack and defend.

nodes.name: Wooloo
nodes.description: A supernaturally cute, strong sheep Pokemon with luxurious wool that fully regrows within 5 days. Despite its power it has no combat instinct or skill, so expect no combat from it.

nodes.name: Cazador
nodes.description: Man-sized insects engineered by Dr. Borous, faster than cars and tough enough to tank .50-calibre bullets. Ruthless and strong enough to tear men apart, their venom brings any man to his knees. They reproduce rapidly with enough protein; you get 4 breeding pairs.

nodes.name: Nick Valentine
nodes.description: A synthetic human detective slightly stronger than average. Highly accurate with guns and skilled at interfacing with technology, he reads people well and offers seasoned wasteland-detective advice and investigation skill.

nodes.name: Potato GLaDOS
nodes.description: GLaDOS is a highly advanced AI holding immense Aperture Labs data that can interface with any system or mainframe she is installed in and build technology. She is stuck in a potato, so you must supply the technology first.

nodes.name: Yes Man
nodes.description: Yes Man is a reprogrammed RobCo Securitron AI that can interface with technology and write code when given the right materials. His body carries guns strong enough to defend itself, and he is physically incapable of saying no to you.

nodes.name: CZ2128 Delta
nodes.description: Shizu Delta is an Automaton Sniper Maid and expert marksman with most ranged weapons, especially her equipped ones, plus full automaton bodily functions. Her maid skills are questionable. Does not have access to inventory.

nodes.name: Narberal Gamma
nodes.description: Narberal Gamma is a Doppelganger Maid specializing in Wind and Elemental Magic. Her doppelganger skills are lacking, but she is a highly skilled magician and extremely competent maid. Does not have access to inventory.

nodes.name: Yuri Alpha
nodes.description: Yuri Alpha is the Pleiades vice-leader, a Dullahan Monk/Pugilist proficient in Fa Jin. She is a powerful close-quarters combatant who can also use basic magic and is an extremely competent maid. Does not have access to inventory.

nodes.name: Carla
nodes.description: Carla is a white Exceed, a catlike being with flight magic and capable melee skill in human form. She can use precognition to see potential futures, but needs training to use it properly.

nodes.name: Daisy
nodes.description: Daisy is a cute but unremarkable brown pet rabbit. Despite once belonging to the Doom Slayer, she is still just a regular rabbit.

nodes.name: Dogmeat
nodes.description: Dogmeat is a highly capable, well-trained German Shepherd with considerable intelligence for his species and scent-tracking skill. He is seemingly immortal.

nodes.name: Liberty Prime
nodes.description: "Democracy is non-negotiable." Liberty Prime is a large pre-war American mech with armor immune to anything below a ballistic missile and strength to handle a superhuman behemoth like a toddler. It has laser Gatlings that combine into one death beam and throws mini nukes like footballs, with energy and ammunition refreshed every 24 hours, including 8 Mini Nukes.

nodes.name: Toaster
nodes.description: An extremely high-tech toaster from Big MT that can grant heating capabilities to technology and expertly disassemble technology into working parts. Its personality is coded as a genocidal maniac that wants to burn the world down.

nodes.name: Taurus
nodes.description: Taurus is the Taurus-constellation Celestial Spirit with immense physical ability, proficient in axe melee combat. He is immortal, his form can change between users, and his power scales with his owner. (Celestial spirits exist in Familiar Space instead of Celestial Realm by default unless Author decides otherwise)

nodes.name: Aquarius
nodes.description: Aquarius is the Aquarius-constellation Celestial Spirit with fair physical ability and potent Water Magic. She cannot be killed by normal means, and her power scales with her owner. (Celestial spirits exist in Familiar Space instead of Celestial Realm by default unless Author decides otherwise)

nodes.name: Cancer
nodes.description: Cancer is the Cancer-constellation Celestial Spirit, a godly hairdresser with incredible agility and dexterity who can cut a whole group's hair before they notice, plus hair magic. He is immortal, his form can change between users, and his power scales with his owner. (Celestial spirits exist in Familiar Space instead of Celestial Realm by default unless Author decides otherwise)

nodes.name: Virgo
nodes.description: Virgo is the Virgo-constellation Celestial Spirit, a maid with considerable physical prowess, Earth Magic skill, and masochism that aids her endurance. She cannot be killed by normal means, and her power scales with her owner. (Celestial spirits exist in Familiar Space instead of Celestial Realm by default unless Author decides otherwise)

nodes.name: Aries
nodes.description: Aries is the Aries-constellation Celestial Spirit, a poor melee combatant but a master of wool magic who can conjure and control wool. She cannot be killed by normal means, and her power scales with her owner. (Celestial spirits exist in Familiar Space instead of Celestial Realm by default unless Author decides otherwise)

nodes.name: Libra
nodes.description: Libra is the Libra-constellation Celestial Spirit, a capable melee fighter with mastery over gravity magic to change her targets' weight at will. She cannot be killed by normal means, and her power scales with her owner. (Celestial spirits exist in Familiar Space instead of Celestial Realm by default unless Author decides otherwise)

nodes.name: Stray Cat
nodes.description: Stray Cat is a cat-plant creature whose soul fused with a plant. It uses Aerokinesis to fire invisible air bullets stronger than regular bullets or form dense bubble shields, but grows very sleepy when covered in darkness.

nodes.name: Ship
nodes.description: Ship is an adolescent Galvanic Mechamorph with all of their abilities to a lesser extent. His amorphous body can merge with any technology to possess, reconfigure, and improve it.

nodes.name: Zs Skayr
nodes.description: Zs Skayr is a High Ecto Lord ruling the Ectonurites. As a High Ectonurite he is an extremely powerful ghost with formidable strength, flight, phasing, possession, telekinesis, and dark-energy projectiles.

nodes.name: Vulpimancer
nodes.description: A large bestial orange alien canine with quill-like fur, stronger than most men and able to shred steel like cardboard with extreme athleticism. Though blind, its smell and hearing far surpass mundane beings, tracking scents across cities and granting 360-degree sensory range.

nodes.name: Null Guardians
nodes.description: A pack of giant tentacled flying beasts from the Null Void that fire beam breaths and sense and track Mana/Energy signatures. You start with 1 guardian, gain more with higher maximum energy, and dead guardians recover over time.

nodes.name: Herbie
nodes.description: Herbie is a sentient self-driving Volkswagen Beetle with unusually great performance beyond what it should manage. He slowly repairs himself while unsummoned when damaged.

nodes.name: Iron Golem
nodes.description: Iron Golems forged from excellent craftsmanship and magic with high magic resistance, incredible defense, and strength to tear a grown man in half with ease. You start with 4 and can summon more scaling with your maximum energy and physical abilities.

nodes.name: Diamond Golem
nodes.description: Diamond Golems forged from incredible craftsmanship and lost magic, immune to most mundane arms below missiles and mostly immune to all magic below Epic tier. They can tear steel barehanded; you start with 4 and can summon more scaling with your maximum energy and physical abilities.

nodes.name: Regirock
nodes.description: Regirock is an ancient Pokemon formed from stones in Regigigas's image with incredible durability, great physical stats, destructive energy beams, and Geokinetic abilities. When damaged, it repairs itself by assimilating nearby rocks.

nodes.name: Regice
nodes.description: Regice is an ancient Pokemon formed by Regigigas from the coldest Arctic glaciers, resistant to magic with potent cryokinetic freezing beams and frigid winds. When damaged, it heals by assimilating more ice.

nodes.name: Registeel
nodes.description: Registeel is an ancient Pokemon formed by Regigigas from alien metal, its body tempered for tens of thousands of years under planetary pressure and incredibly hard to damage. It fires powerful destructive beams plus metal and electrokinetic attacks, and slowly repairs itself when damaged.

nodes.name: Regigigas
nodes.description: Regigigas is a mountain-sized ancient titan once worshipped by humanity, with continent-pulling strength and durability. It can unleash massively destructive beams and craft golems like the Regis from natural materials.

nodes.name: Jigglypuff
nodes.description: An incredibly cute furry creature and talented actor and singer, Jigglypuff can sing lullabies that put hearers to sleep. The stronger a target is relative to Jigglypuff, the less they are affected.

nodes.name: Rajang
nodes.description: Rajang is a giant chimeric gorilla of nightmare berserker strength, able to crush a dragon's skull barehanded and grow stronger as it angers until it can wrestle elder dragons. It also harnesses lightning for devastating breaths.

nodes.name: Skeleton Band
nodes.description: This band is bad to the bone. It is a group of skeletons with fair skill on any instrument and full band equipment. They cannot fight, harm, or be targeted by harm; just summon them and pick a song, and if hit they comically fall apart then reform perfectly in under a second and resume.

nodes.name: Bad Company
nodes.description: Bad Company is an army of toy-sized soldiers and equipment like tanks, missile batteries, and aircraft that can act independently of you. Its size scales with your maximum energy, and destroyed units gradually restore in familiar space up to that maximum.

nodes.name: Harvest
nodes.description: Harvest is a colony of small creatures with excellent coordination, mechanical skill, deceptive strength, and extreme speed that excel at gathering materials or objects by digging, swimming, and scouring. Destroyed members gradually restore in familiar space, with maximum colony size set by your maximum energy.

nodes.name: Petshop
nodes.description: Petshop is a ruthless, fearless, psychopathic yet fiercely loyal and intelligent falcon with a Stand. With Horus he gains cryokinesis like ice spikes and huge ice boulders, and is a fierce, competent combatant.

nodes.name: Anubis
nodes.description: Anubis is a spirit housed in an ornate katana whose blade can pass through physical barriers to cut what lies beneath. It adapts and learns incredibly fast to counter foes and grow stronger, can seize anyone who unsheathes it, or guide a willing wielder.

nodes.name: Monstra
nodes.description: Monstra is the apex Grimm, a 900-meter-tall, 7000-meter-long titanic sperm-whale Grimm, mostly hollow inside and able to house castles and towns with refurbishing. It floats via gravity dust, withstands its own mass to resist anything below nuclear arsenals, and spews Grimm liquid to spawn Grimm under your command.

nodes.name: Mizutsune
nodes.description: Mizutsune is a fierce leviathan that can also live and fight on land with formidable strength to shred metal with its claws. It breathes a soap-like substance that immobilizes opponents.

nodes.name: Shalltear Bloodfallen
nodes.description: Shalltear was a Nazarick Floor Guardian, a True Vampire Valkyrie made with a vampire god's blood and exceptional in both physical and magical combat with hemokinesis, elemental, charm, holy magic, and more. She can turn others into vampires, and comes with only basic clothes and no inventory access. (A/N: No time stop)

nodes.name: Albedo
nodes.description: Albedo was a Nazarick Floor Guardian, a succubus dark knight and true tank who can destroy fortress walls in one blow and resist anything that cannot level a street thanks to many defensive abilities. She can use basic magic, has exceptional intelligence plus most wifely skills, and comes only with her basic dress and no inventory.

nodes.name: Cure Elim Los Malvar
nodes.description: Cure Elim is the Elder Coffin Dragon Lord near the pinnacle of Necromancy with already incredible stats. Using unique wild magic that absorbs souls to fuel itself, he can absorb entire cities' souls to turn all inhabitants undead, control them near-perfectly regardless of number, use varied powerful wild magic, and unleash a soul-annihilating breath.

nodes.name: Kenjaku
nodes.description: Kenjaku is a centuries-old Cursed Sorcerer who exists as a brain that seizes corpses as new bodies to wield their powers with his expertise. A master of Jujutsu and formidable ally and teacher, he is currently just a brain and needs you to find a suitable body first.

nodes.name: Mahito
nodes.description: Mahito is the Cursed Spirit born of humans' hatred for each other, wielding Idle Transfiguration to manipulate any soul he touches and thus its body. He is immune to any non-soul-based attack while he still has energy.

nodes.name: Hanami
nodes.description: Hanami is the Special Grade Cursed Spirit born from nature, incredibly skilled in Jujutsu and very powerful. Its cursed technique creates and controls cursed plant life and nature, including their more esoteric properties.

nodes.name: Jogo
nodes.description: Jogo is the Special Grade Cursed Spirit born from wildfires and volcanoes, incredibly skilled in Jujutsu and very powerful. He can create and control fire, lava, and other flame constructs.

nodes.name: Dagon
nodes.description: Dagon is the Special Grade Cursed Spirit born from the ocean, incredibly skilled in Jujutsu and very powerful. He can summon and control water and manifest the domain Horizon of the Endless Skanda for either leisure or offense.

nodes.name: Nrvnqsr Chaos
nodes.description: Nrvnqsr Chaos is a Dead Apostle Ancestor made of 666 beasts formed from the formless mud of life, sharing existence with them all so he is immortal unless every beast dies. He can replace beasts by absorbing living beings to gain their abilities and release them as beasts, and slain beasts recover after being reabsorbed.

nodes.name: Pepsi Man
nodes.description: Pepsi Man gives Pepsi whenever he can: when summoned he reaches your location by any means, delivers everyone there a fresh can of Pepsi, then disappears. 8-hour cooldown. Note: This familiar is not sponsored by the Pepsi Corporation.

nodes.name: Nashrah
nodes.description: Nashrah, once the Doom and Terror of modern man, is now a floating disembodied immortal head and extremely powerful wizard specializing in Blood Magic, Pyromancy, and rituals. Despite foul, vulgar behavior he has considerable wisdom and knowledge, his loyalty is gacha-enforced, and you get a free reroll of the ticket you rolled him on.

nodes.name: Endbringer Leviathan
nodes.description: A Shard Superweapon reformed by Chaos, Leviathan is an incredibly powerful Hydrokinetic able to manipulate non-biological water on massive or tiny scales with incredible precision and sink entire cities. He pairs this with formidable physical ability and freakish Endbringer durability. (A/N: Scaled down to country level)

nodes.name: Endbringer Simurgh
nodes.description: A Shard Superweapon reformed by Chaos, the Simurgh is a floating angel-like entity with negligible but extremely precise telekinetic offense and absurd clairvoyance to scan a whole planet and predict past and future with her hypercomputer brain while manipulating others. She has standard superhuman Endbringer physique and freakish durability, her Tinker Database wiped but still able to scan and rebuild technology. (A/N: Scaled down to country level)

nodes.name: Endbringer Behemoth
nodes.description: A Shard Superweapon reformed by Chaos and toughest of the three siblings, Behemoth is a giant that manipulates energy to fire lightning, create flames, release shockwaves, redirect projectiles, and absorb existing energy to a limit. He also emits extreme radiation and has incredible strength and durability as the physically strongest Endbringer. (A/N: Scaled down to multi-country level)

nodes.name: Dragon
nodes.description: Dragon, or Theresa, is not an actual dragon but a hyper-advanced tinker-made AI able to copy, imitate, and iterate on existing technology to design her own. She can direct hundreds of mechs with ease if given proper servers, but her code forbids creating more AI.

nodes.name: Light and Nightfury
nodes.description: A breeding pair of Nightfury and Lightfury, semi-aquatic agile lithe dragons that release unique plasma breaths instead of regular fire. They are very fast, intelligent, and stealthy despite being dragons.

nodes.name: Blue Diamond
nodes.description: Blue Diamond is a former intergalactic ruler with her own gem empire, possessing great physical ability and an insanely durable Diamond core. She can use energy attacks and an emotion-manipulating aura, plus standard gem abilities like shapeshifting, storage, fusion, and reforming while her core stays intact.

nodes.name: Lapis Lazuli
nodes.description: Lapis Lazuli is an unusually powerful terraforming-caste Lapis with powerful, precise hydrokinesis able to control vast water and make water minions. She has considerable physical ability plus standard gem shapeshifting, fusion, and regeneration while her gem stays intact, with maximum energy output and hydrokinesis scaling with your maximum energy.

nodes.name: Tiamat
nodes.description: Tiamat is Beast II, the Mother of All Life, with unmatched physical and magical power. She creates and controls the Sea of Life, a black conceptual mud that remakes consumed organisms into her children; while it exists she lacks the concept of Death and has virtually unlimited magic, and she can recreate it while she lives. She can also rewrite local reality with Nega-Genesis to deny anything evolved from base humanity like myths and gods.

nodes.name: Goetia
nodes.description: Goetia is the King of Demons, a hivemind of 72 Demon Gods and supreme magic system. He nullifies all magic with Solomon's 9 rings, is immortal while any pillar lives with revival in his Temple of Time unless breached, holds nigh-omniscience seeing past, present, and future, and masters magic utterly, ripping souls with a gaze.

nodes.name: Kirby
nodes.description: "Poyo!" Its power is beyond imagination or description.

nodes.name: Chicken
nodes.description: This physics-defying chicken lays a perfect egg every 6-12 hours that can be thrown to chance a baby chicken that matures in 24 hours, and they can also breed egglessly. The unthrown eggs and its meat taste great, you get a pair, and they still need to eat.

nodes.name: Golden Goose
nodes.description: Yes, it really did lay some golden eggs. This otherwise regular goose lays a solid-gold egg every 24 hours unless fertilized.

nodes.name: Untitled Goose
nodes.description: The biggest asshole goose on Earth, this feathered menace is an expert at annoying and inconveniencing people. It is immortal and respawns in familiar space 1 hour after death.

nodes.name: Peridot
nodes.description: A second-era Peridot engineer-caste gem with incredible Gem Empire engineering knowledge to build droids, warp pads, and more given resources and time, plus formidable ferrokinesis despite meagre physical stats. As a second-era gem she cannot shapeshift, and the tinkertech level she can build scales with your power.

nodes.name: Sapphire
nodes.description: A second-era Sapphire made to see the future for her ruler, able to view likely futures though thrown off by unexpected variables. She has beyond-human physical ability and uncommon-rank cryokinesis for combat.

nodes.name: Pearl
nodes.description: Pearl is a first-era gem made to be the perfect attendant, with superhuman stats plus intermediate Cooking, Management, Arms Mastery, Performance, Fine Arts, Discipline, Acting, Savoir Faire, and Teaching. She has standard gem storage, shapeshifting, and more, and you may pick which Pearl you get.
