nodes.name: Eliza & Sekhmet
nodes.description: Eliza is a former Egyptian empress fused with the Parasite skeleton Sekhmet. Sekhmet grants blood control, blood-body replacement for shapeshifting, superhuman stats, and internal blood storage for sustenance, plus excellent performance and combat skill.

nodes.name: Koro Sensei
nodes.description: Koro Sensei is a former top assassin and polymath genius turned Antimatter creature with an extremely strong, malleable body, extreme speed and perception that mimics cloning, plus flight, regeneration, mucus, and more. He is an excellent teacher in combat and all sciences.

nodes.name: Dreadon
nodes.description: Dreadon is a marvel of amoral devotion to science whose mind is uploaded into a decoy body. He can engineer machines rivaling and surpassing gods by harnessing souls, cosmos, void, and the multiverse's most exotic energies, with his full potential given time and resources left to speculation.

nodes.name: S-Snake
nodes.description: S-Snake is a Seraphim clone of Boa Hancock spliced with Lunarian DNA and Vegapunk augments. She has incredible physical ability, laser cannons and Lunarian traits, petrification of anyone charmed by her, and Observation and Armament Haki.

nodes.name: Meruem
nodes.description: Meruem is the Chimera Ant King with tremendous physical ability, genius-surpassing IQ, and immense mastery of his own Nen. He can consume others' flesh to gain their abilities and raise his stats (Does not work on Gacha wielder or Gacha Familiars), limited to your number of ability slots.

nodes.name: Godzilla
nodes.description: Godzilla is an ancient titanic beast with tremendous size, near-impregnable defense, and matching strength. He absorbs radiation for energy to fuel himself and his devastating atomic breath.

nodes.name: Ghidorah
nodes.description: Ghidorah is an ancient titanic flying beast with size-matched strength and near-invulnerable durability. It calls thunderstorms, absorbs energy to unleash lightning and devastating beams, and with enough energy regenerates near-instantly with seemingly endless stamina.

nodes.name: Mothra
nodes.description: Mothra is a Hollow Earth flying Titan with extreme size-matched stats, incredible flight speed, weather and planetary sensing, and hyper-durable silk that can restrain titans. When killed she cheats death by returning to familiar space as an egg that hatches in about a week.

nodes.name: Shimo
nodes.description: Shimo is the Titan who started the Ice Age, with incomparable strength and durability to shrug off humanity's strongest weapons and overpower Godzilla. Her presence freezes surroundings, her frost breath freezes titans in seconds or forms monolithic blizzards skyward, and given time she can trigger another Ice Age.

nodes.name: Parasite
nodes.description: A tiny parasitic organism that burrows into flesh to merge with it, with potent biokinesis over merged flesh down to cellular structures and fierce intelligence. It can seize a body by burrowing into the brain, but that is unreliable.

nodes.name: Excalibur
nodes.description: "From the United King~ I am looking for him~" Excalibur is a Great Old One in the form of the ultimate sword, granting extreme power, space-cutting, portals, and free teleportation plus the Madness Wavelength of Rage. Technically anyone can wield him, but he is so intolerably annoying almost no mortal can stand him, which demoted him from Mythical rarity.

nodes.name: Chauffeur
nodes.description: This familiar, when called, summons a luxurious limousine with a golem driver that drives you anywhere drivable before driving off and vanishing once out of sight. If the car or driver is destroyed, it enters a 24-hour cooldown.

nodes.name: Goons
nodes.description: 50 roughly 30-year-old mob-affiliated-looking Italian men with eerily similar appearances. Not the brightest, but each can rough up an average man and handle menial or moderately complex tasks like guarding or manning a shop.

nodes.name: Ddraig Y Goch
nodes.description: Ddraig is the Heavenly Dragon Emperor of Domination, surpassing all but the strongest gods in physical and magical power. His Boost raises his power each use (NOT DOUBLE) and can transfer power to others, he penetrates to ignore all magic defenses, and his Blazing Inferno of Scorching Flames burns anything, even the strongest gods.

nodes.name: Albion
nodes.description: Albion is the Heavenly Dragon Emperor of Supremacy, surpassing all but the strongest gods in physical and magical power. His Divide weakens enemies to restore himself to peak condition (NOT HALVED), can divide even space and objects and reflect attacks, and his venom Reduce erases victims' existence until they vanish.

nodes.name: Mewtwo
nodes.description: Mewtwo is an artificial Pokemon sharing Mew's DNA and a tremendously powerful Esper. He can read and control minds, create barriers, fire energy blasts, use telekinesis, project elemental abilities, and much more.

nodes.name: Remy
nodes.description: Remy is an unusually smart rat and very proficient chef.

nodes.name: Dialga
nodes.description: Dialga is the Pokemon God of Time created by Arceus at the universe's birth, physically underwhelming but undeniably masterful over time. It can distort, stop, speed up, reverse, loop, and travel time, though powerful foes partly resist, and can unleash powerful energy attacks.

nodes.name: Palkia
nodes.description: Palkia is the Pokemon God of Space involved in its universe's creation, physically underwhelming but undeniably masterful over space. It can warp space, teleport, create portals, destroy objects in space, travel dimensions, make pocket dimensions, and launch powerful energy attacks.

nodes.name: Giratina
nodes.description: Giratina is the Pokemon God of Antimatter balancing time and space, physically underwhelming but masterful over dark energy and the Reverse World. It can retreat into and manipulate the Reverse World to affect the material world with reflected damage, plus launch powerful energy attacks.

nodes.name: Khorne
nodes.description: It is Khorne, literally the Blood God, whose true form resides in your familiar space but cannot be fully taken out. You can receive his blessings, teachings, and lent power based on affinity earned through violence, rage, and Skull Throne sacrifices, with higher affinity granting greater blessings and a stronger Avatar familiar.

nodes.name: Slaanesh
nodes.description: It is Slaanesh, literally the Prince of Debauchery, whose true form resides in your familiar space but cannot be fully taken out. You can receive her blessings, teachings, and lent power based on affinity earned through debauchery, lust, obsession, suffering, and more, with higher affinity granting greater blessings and a stronger Avatar familiar.

nodes.name: Tzeentch
nodes.description: It is Tzeentch, literally the Changer of Ways, whose true form resides in your familiar space but cannot be fully taken out. You can receive their blessings, teachings, and lent power based on affinity earned through planning, outwitting, deception, and more, with higher affinity granting greater blessings and a stronger Avatar familiar.

nodes.name: Nurgle
nodes.description: It is Nurgle, literally the Plague Father, whose true form resides in your familiar space but cannot be fully taken out. You can receive their blessings, teachings, and lent power based on affinity earned through decay, poisoning, desperation, death, and more, with higher affinity granting greater blessings and a stronger Avatar familiar.

nodes.name: Puar
nodes.description: Puar is a weird floating cat creature with little to no combat ability, graduated from Transformation Academy to change form into anything from objects to people without changing stats. She can also teach transformation to others with the talent and time for it.

nodes.name: Acnologia
nodes.description: Acnologia became the mightiest Dragon King after bathing in countless dragons' blood as a Dragon Slayer. As the arcane dragonslayer he can eat all elements to empower and heal himself and is immune to all magic until his absorption is overwhelmed, pairing overwhelming physical and magical power with destructive beams, varied magic, and even time manipulation.

nodes.name: THWOMP
nodes.description: "URNGH." A giant sentient(?) angry boulder creature you can summon above targets to slam down or in front of you as a wall. Damage to it mends over time inside the gacha.

nodes.name: Kaguya Otsutsuki
nodes.description: Kaguya Otsutsuki is the Rabbit Goddess and Progenitor of Chakra who ate the Chakra Fruit for truly godlike power. She can manipulate all chakra natures, create Truth-seeking Balls, absorb energy including from living beings, use disintegrating All-Killing Ash Bones and the Rinne Sharingan, and warp space to create and travel pocket dimensions.

nodes.name: Renamon
nodes.description: Renamon is a strong beastman-like fox Digimon with formidable physical abilities focused on speed and agility. She is skilled in Ninjutsu, using flame-cloaked claw strikes or basic ninja spells. (evolution does not exist)

nodes.name: Taomon
nodes.description: Taomon is a fox-like wizard Digimon with formidable physical stats specializing in Onmyodo. She creates magical talismans for barriers and elemental attacks and draws constructs in the air with her paintbrush. (evolution does not exist)

nodes.name: Skullgreymon
nodes.description: Skullgreymon is a monstrous undead Digimon devolved into a being of pure combat with strong instincts and a formidable giant physique. It is a living missile silo launching normal, toxic, tracking, and stronger missiles from its back plus paralyzing toxic breath, but lacks higher intellect and cannot execute complex orders or act independently without supervision.

nodes.name: Golem Worker
nodes.description: This is a crew of tireless iron golem workers skilled in Intermediate Mechanics and labour who can work without breaks but cannot fight. The summonable number depends on your maximum energy, with a minimum of 10.

nodes.name: Lilithmon
nodes.description: Lilithmon was once revered as a Goddess of darkness but is now reduced to level 1 with considerable physical ability and darkness magic. She unleashes potent corroding darkness and charming magic, and devours the mana of fresh corpses to recover and increase her power.

nodes.name: Shademon
nodes.description: Shademon is a sentient living shadow with little combat ability that torments targets with illusions and possesses them. Possession enhances their stats and grants shadow-form attacks, and it grows stronger by devouring the mana of fresh corpses.

nodes.name: Eyesmon
nodes.description: Eyesmon is a shadow demon dragon Digimon with tremendous strength that burrows through shadows at will. Its many eyes grant incredible senses and cursed beams, it can split into scatter mode for scouting, spying, and shadow-binding, and it grows stronger by devouring the mana of fresh corpses.

nodes.name: Hydramon
nodes.description: Hydramon is a gigantic plantlike Digimon with great physical prowess befitting its size. It constantly secretes usable toxic acid, spews acid and beam attacks from its three maws, and stretches its tentacles to attack or dig and cause earthquakes.

nodes.name: Angewomon
nodes.description: Angewomon is an Angel Digimon with formidable physical abilities and Holy and Light magic. She unleashes holy lightning and tornadoes, heals allies health and status, and gains a small boost based on how evil her opponent is.

nodes.name: Ladydevimon
nodes.description: Ladydevimon is a Demon Digimon with formidable physical might and corrosive darkness manipulation. She shapes darkness into attack familiars, releases noxious darkness waves, and enhances her physical attacks with darkness, with poison stronger against higher-energy opponents but falling off after a tier.

nodes.name: Ariemon
nodes.description: Ariemon is an Ocean Spirit specializing in Hydrokinesis, healing, and support. She heals and cures with seawater, shapes it into spear attacks, prefers trapping foes in conjured seashells over harming them, and can sometimes foretell upcoming disasters.

nodes.name: Lamiamon
nodes.description: Lamiamon is a draconic snake-like Digimon specializing in poison mastery but weak in direct confrontation. She synthesizes varied poisons like lethal, melting, paralyzing, and vitality-sapping types where stronger poisons cost more energy and weaken against stronger targets, and can cure some ailments with specialized poisons.

nodes.name: Medusamon
nodes.description: Medusamon is a draconic gorgon-like Digimon with formidable physical abilities and hair of independent extending serpent dragons. Her eye petrifies enemies at a speed based on energy spent and the power gap, which strong enough targets can ignore.

nodes.name: The Lich
nodes.description: The Lich, last scholar of Golb, is a primordial undead embodying entropy and death. He is an absolute master of Death, Pyro, Mind, Necromancy, and other magic who imposes death and dominates nearby minds, and he is nigh impossible to kill permanently with incredible intelligence and insight.

nodes.name: Lil' Khorne
nodes.description: Lil Khorne is a Chaos God shrunk to Level 1 and an incredible warrior with immense physical power and mastery of all weapons and warfare. It has greater magic resistance in exchange for being unable to use magic, starts weak for an Epic familiar at roughly Rare power, and slowly levels back up through aligned actions without reaching original power anytime soon.

nodes.name: Lil' Slaanesh
nodes.description: Lil Slaanesh is a Chaos God shrunk to Level 1 and a mistress of debauchery and corruption specializing in charms and manipulating sensation and minds. She excels at understanding and corrupting people, starts weak for an Epic familiar at roughly Rare power, and slowly levels back up through aligned actions without reaching original power anytime soon.

nodes.name: Lil' Tzeentch
nodes.description: Lil Tzeentch is a Chaos God shrunk to Level 1 and an incredible magician who studies and learns all magic at incredible pace. It is also an excellent planner for business, ruling, warfare, and espionage, starts weak for an Epic familiar at roughly Rare power, and slowly levels back up through aligned actions without reaching original power anytime soon.

nodes.name: Lil' Nurgle
nodes.description: Lil Nurgle is a Chaos God shrunk to Level 1 and a master of poisons, decay, and toxicity who concocts foul cocktails. It can also creatively cure and create new life, starts weak for an Epic familiar at roughly Rare power, and slowly levels back up through aligned actions without reaching original power anytime soon.

nodes.name: Scion
nodes.description: Scion is the Avatar of the Warrior Entity holding its most essential abilities. He is physically strong with future sight, dimensional travel, powerful beams, Stilling to cancel wavelengths through golden light, and many other abilities, and will eventually reform in familiar space if he perishes.

nodes.name: Grand Guignol
nodes.description: Grand Guignol is the Theatre of Darkness and artificial Outer God woven from Mary Sue's Ability to Change. She can create her own garden reality, and her power of change can turn even simple iron bars into restraints other Outer Gods cannot break.

nodes.name: Majin Buu
nodes.description: Majin Buu is a primordial demon feared across the universe who can vanquish solar systems with ease while his screams tear dimensions. His malleable physiology makes him nearly unkillable, and he can absorb the bodies, powers, and energy of anything he grabs.

nodes.name: Anti Spiral
nodes.description: Anti-Spiral is the physical manifestation of the Anti-Spiral itself with unmatched power over reality. Nothing beyond the Outer Gods or the Spiral can match it.

nodes.name: Obelisk the Tormentor
nodes.description: Obelisk the Tormentor is an Egyptian God of overwhelming physical might whom no magic or ability below Legendary rank can directly affect. He unleashes destructive dark energy blasts and can be temporarily empowered further by sacrifices.

nodes.name: Winged Dragon of Ra
nodes.description: The Winged Dragon of Ra is an Egyptian Sun Dragon in the form of an imposing golden Phoenix whom no magic or ability below Legendary rank can directly affect. He unleashes sun-like divine flames that especially incinerate demonic and dark beings, can enter a Phoenix Form of pure flame for immense resistance and regeneration, and is further powered by sacrifices.

nodes.name: Dusknoir
nodes.description: Dusknoir is a hollow-bodied ghost Pokemon with great physical strength and extremely strong physical and magical durability. It attacks with shadow and darkness, senses souls, and grabs living and dead souls to store inside its body.

nodes.name: Lucario
nodes.description: Lucario is the Aura Pokemon with mighty physical abilities and martial arts mastery. It fires aura blasts, reinforces its body with aura, and senses others aura to read mood, intent, and location (You cannot be taught Aura by Lucario).

nodes.name: Yveltal
nodes.description: Yveltal is the Legendary Pokemon of Destruction with overwhelming magic and darkness manipulation. It fires pure destruction beams and life-draining waves that turn living beings to stone, and can drain an entire planet if given the opportunity.

nodes.name: Xerneas
nodes.description: Xerneas is the Legendary Pokemon of Life with overwhelming magic and light manipulation. It manipulates life to grow forests in deserts, heal grave injuries, and revive the dead at great cost, and can imbue chosen targets with immense energy.

nodes.name: Alcremie
nodes.description: Alcremie is the cream Pokemon with some fairy abilities who is not a fighter. She excels at making and cooking sweets and can freely change flavour and create delicious cream from her body.

nodes.name: Hoopa
nodes.description: Hoopa is the Djinn Pokemon with dark and psychic attacks and great physical might. Its rings serve as versatile portals that penetrate even dimensional boundaries between universes.

nodes.name: Frost Legion
nodes.description: This summons the Frost Legion, a horde of murder-happy gangster snowmen wielding hardened ice knives, tommy guns, ice grenades, and similar weapons. Summonable numbers depend on maximum energy with a minimum of 50, 1 killed snowman recovers every 1 hour, and frost or ice affinity strengthens them.

nodes.name: Salt Golem
nodes.description: A little 5cm tall salt golem made of condensed and distilled salty tears from wasted tickets.

nodes.name: D'vorah
nodes.description: Dvorah is a combat-skilled Kytinn with basic superhuman stats, natural weapons, and venom. She produces and controls insects for combat, poisoning, and espionage (Cannot reproduce to create more Kytinn larva or maggots).

nodes.name: Triborg
nodes.description: Triborg is a highly advanced cyborg fused with the skills and data of multiple master martial artists, assassins, and predecessors. Its robotic physique grants superhuman stats and reconfigurable forms like Smoke for close-range teleportation and Sub-Zero for cryo weaponry with only one form usable at a time, and it may be upgraded with Tinker abilities.

nodes.name: Azmuth
nodes.description: Azmuth the First Thinker is the smartest being across innumerable galaxies with no combat ability. He ranks among existence's greatest inventors of reality-warping creations like Ascalon and the Omnitrix, and given enough time and resources there is practically nothing he cannot create.

nodes.name: Mipha
nodes.description: Mipha is the Zora princess with superhuman physical abilities and considerable polearm skill. She uses water magic in combat and potent healing on herself and others.

nodes.name: Factory Core
nodes.description: "Time to industrialise" A modified golem core that builds itself into a factory by assimilating resources. More user-fed mechanics and technology information yields more assembly lines and items, while growth speed and maximum size depend on user abilities.

nodes.name: Mech Core
nodes.description: A modified Golem core that assimilates materials and electronics to build itself into a mech. Power, size, and durability depend on provided materials, it converts them into Mech technology at Epic tinker level, it shares the user knowledge base so more user knowledge and Tinker specialties improve it further, and it acts only at half power without the user piloting.

nodes.name: Connor
nodes.description: Connor is a near-human android with peak human physicals and notable combat skill. He can scan objects and humans to gather data, albeit with limited function.

nodes.name: HK 47
nodes.description: HK-47 is an experienced advanced Assassin Droid extremely skilled in all combat, weaponry, and assassination through his brilliant computational mind and engineering. He is also a skilled mechanic and comes equipped with standard droid gear including a blaster.

nodes.name: Magnaguard
nodes.description: Magnaguards are an elite Jedi-hunting droid caste with superhuman physical capabilities and advanced electrical-staff polearm skills. You start with 4 guards and gain more over time according to maximum stats.

nodes.name: B-1 Battle Droid
nodes.description: One singular B-1 Battle Droid equipped with a blaster whose skill and effectiveness are questionable.

nodes.name: B-2 Battle Droids
nodes.description: B-2 Battle Droids are tough heavy-duty units with built-in blasters. They are poor at fast combat but effective as walking blaster walls, starting with 4 and gaining more over time according to maximum stats.

nodes.name: KX Executor Droids
nodes.description: KX Executor Droids are tough, athletic, skilled, efficient, and powerful fighters able to wield most weaponry with superhuman strength enough to tear men in half. You start with 5 and gain more over time according to maximum stats.

nodes.name: IG-88
nodes.description: IG-88 is an advanced combat droid with expert marksmanship and advanced sensory capabilities. It has superhuman stats from its droid constitution and carries a wide variety of deadly weapons.

nodes.name: 2-1B surgical droid
nodes.description: The 2-1B surgical droid is an advanced medical droid with a vast database and droid-body precision. It surpasses any human surgeon and carries varied surgical implants.

nodes.name: Imp Midna
nodes.description: Imp Midna is the Twilight Princess suppressed into Imp form yet retaining potent magic including basic telekinesis, shapeshifting, cloud form, shadow merging, and time-consuming Twilight Portals for teleportation. A Legendary curse-breaking ability can restore her full form and drastically enhance her powers.

nodes.name: Midna
nodes.description: Midna is the Twilight Princess ruling potent Twilight and Darkness magic. She wields telekinesis, portals, shapeshifting, twilight-creature summoning, and general powerful magic.

nodes.name: Seth
nodes.description: Seth is a biogenetically engineered and cybernetically enhanced artificial being with a Tandem Engine and shapeshifting. Downloaded knowledge from numerous Martial Arts Masters grants vast martial mastery, the Tandem Engine supplies immense skillfully used Artificial Ki, and it can copy enemies martial arts and moves.

nodes.name: Horus
nodes.description: Horus is an autonomous soul-bound stand that can manifest as an ice bird. It spends your energy on cryokinesis like icicles, freezing, ice boulders, and constructs, acts without input, and scales in power with you as a stand.

nodes.name: The Fool
nodes.description: The Fool is a sand-formed stand that freely manipulates and shapes sand including texture and colour changes. It forms an automatic protective barrier, convincingly imitates people, and scales in power with you as a stand.

nodes.name: Cream
nodes.description: Cream is a large imposing stand that vanishes anything it eats into endless darkness and possesses considerable strength. It can harmlessly hide the user inside itself and eat itself to become a blind nothingness wrecking ball, but cannot leave a 5-meter range and spends your energy.

nodes.name: Hanged Man
nodes.description: Hanged Man is a sentient-light stand dwelling in reflective surfaces to harm the physical world without being hurt back. It is limited to athletic-human force, must escape as a light ray if its reflective space is covered, and needs your energy to stay active.

nodes.name: High Priestess
nodes.description: High Priestess is an amorphous tribal creature that merges with and controls minerals to reshape ground into cars, guns, giant faces, and more. Range and power depend on your power, and damage to the merged form reflects back to you.

nodes.name: Radiance
nodes.description: Radiance is a lesser moth deity of Light and Dreams firing light beams, swords, and searing orbs while teleporting with essence. She bends wills through dreams, though comparable or strong-minded targets can resist infection.

nodes.name: The Knight
nodes.description: The Knight is a perfect void vessel able to contain anything inside itself. It absorbs soul by injuring living beings to heal or cast Shaman spells, and fights with strength, nail, and phasing Shade Cloak as a 1.3-meter Pre-Radiance Fight Knight.

nodes.name: Tentacle Cleaner
nodes.description: A large tentacled ball coated in odorless residue-free incredible cleaning slime. It is dexterous enough to clean complex machinery without disturbing mechanisms with morphing tentacles, has no combat ability, and is very dedicated.

nodes.name: Troupe Master Grimm
nodes.description: Troupe Master Grimm, freed from the Nightmare Heart, is a fully matured Nightmare being. He shapeshifts, manipulates nightmare flames, performs short-range teleportation, and invades others dreams.

nodes.name: Tinker Bell
nodes.description: Tinker Bell is a Neverland fairy too small and weak for meaningful combat. She flies, grants temporary flight with regularly produced fairy dust, and produces a decent amount of it.

nodes.name: V1
nodes.description: V1 is a blood-fueled death machine with incredible speed and strength unfitting its frame but lesser durability. It self-repairs, runs on blood alone, and brings its full arsenal without the spawner arm as a one-robot army.

nodes.name: Isabelle
nodes.description: Isabelle is an anthropomorphic Shih Tzu with no more than average grown-woman combat ability. She is a skilled secretary and manager for law and assets.

nodes.name: Lucifer the CEO of Hell
nodes.description: Lucifer the CEO of Hell is the actual Lucifer and a powerful demon strong enough to rip steel like paper. She enslaves with a flesh-melting bone-demon kiss, holds Fiend Elite Trait abilities and basic demonic magic, and manages hundreds of businesses with minimal strain after millennia ruling Hell.

nodes.name: Radioactive Spider
nodes.description: A gamma-mutated spider granting Spider powers through its venom. Venom refills in around 18 - 3 days depending on feeding (No spider totems, basic Tobey Maguire movie Spider-Man ability set).

nodes.name: Big Gete Star
nodes.description: The Big Gete Star is a planet-sized intelligent computer that absorbs energy and assimilates anything to improve itself. It reproduces anything assimilated including cybernetic living clones and nearly any technology, needs powerful energy sources for some functions, handles interplanetary travel and shapeshifting, and does not include the Meta Cooler Core.

nodes.name: Ridley
nodes.description: Ridley is a fearsome cunning and powerful space pirate with metal-tearing physical might and hull-melting flame breath. He outpaces most planes in atmosphere and achieves solo interstellar travel outside it.

nodes.name: Venom
nodes.description: Venom is a Klyntar symbiote forming a symbiotic merger with its host. It repairs the host, grants superhuman physiology while attached plus a stronger shapeshifting suit form, requires human flesh for strength, can asexually produce another similar symbiote after enough time and feeding, and is highly vulnerable to loud noise and fire along with its host (A/N: CANNOT absorb abilities or replicate genetic material, strictly Sony Movies Venom).

nodes.name: Black Sabbath
nodes.description: Black Sabbath is an automatic stand that merges with shadows and binds inanimate objects to follow preset commands for conditional attacks, hunting, or protection when aware of fulfilled conditions. It draws power from shadows with metal-bending strength inside darkness but baseline-human strength outside, scales with you, and instantly re-emerges in Familiar Space when destroyed.

nodes.name: Silver Chariot
nodes.description: Silver Chariot is a soul-bound stand whose damage reflects back onto you. It is an expert swordsman of insane agility leaving clone-like afterimages rather than a brute, comes with a rapier but uses any user weapon, and scales with your energy while consuming energy to stay active and use superspeed.

nodes.name: Mineral Weaver
nodes.description: A large 5-meter-tall spider that consumes and digests any mineral and produces silk at supernatural rate. Its silk adopts the eaten material properties like iron durability with silk flexibility, and it fights as befits a bus-sized spider.

nodes.name: Hornet
nodes.description: Hornet, child of the Higher Being Pale King and Herrah the Beast Weaver and veteran of Hallownest and Pharloom, is an incredibly skilled claw-and-blade fighter. She naturally produces Soul-silk for attacks, restraints, mobility, and more (Does not have her tools).

nodes.name: Grand Mother Silk
nodes.description: Grand Mother Silk is a Higher Being of lesser divinity with power over silk and great size-appropriate physical abilities. She manipulates Silk massively with fine control, infests and controls thousands at once based on target strength, creates living silk entities, binds targets, floats, and exerts telekinetic force.

nodes.name: Death Angels
nodes.description: Death Angels are heavily armoured blind quadrupedal aliens with incredible strength, agility, and super hearing. One is immune to conventional firearms, lifts cars, exceeds 100 km/h, but needs active direction due to poor senses, starting with 4 and gaining more as maximum energy expands.

nodes.name: Architect
nodes.description: A 3-meter-tall 6-armed bronze automaton powered nebulously with incredibly fine movement control. It is a skilled builder able to design and build a house in a day when supplied materials, but lacks combat ability.

nodes.name: EVE
nodes.description: EVE is an advanced mass-produced probe robot built to find plant life. She hovers and moves fairly quickly and carries a defensive energy rifle despite not being combat-designed.

nodes.name: Bell Gargoyles
nodes.description: The Bell Gargoyles are a towering pair wielding supernaturally sturdy weapons, one breathing fire and the other lightning. Their superhuman blows shatter walls, and more gargoyles become summonable as your energy increases.

nodes.name: Black Knights
nodes.description: Black Knights are Gwyn the Lord of Sunlight's most elite knights with Kiln-charred armour and weapons. They hold superhuman physiques and great combat skill especially against demons and infernals, starting as 10 with chosen Black Knight weapons including greatbow and growing in number with your power.

nodes.name: Ravenous Crystal Lizard
nodes.description: The Ravenous Crystal Lizard is a man-eating large lizard that tears steel with ease. Its back grows titanite for enhancing existing metal, harvestable and regrown while sufficiently fed.

nodes.name: Terraformar
nodes.description: A giant 2-meter-tall 100 kg-plus humanoid cockroach with superhuman physique, flight, ruthlessness, and deceptive intelligence. It reproduces asexually with inherited genetic memory, adapts rapidly each generation with cockroach survivability, and one alone can seed a civilization few civilizations survive.

nodes.name: Made in Heaven
nodes.description: Made in Heaven is a soul-bound stand accelerating time on a universal scale with enhanced control from its pliable soul. It infinitely accelerates the user or any chosen target like a planet, apple, person, or universe, consuming your energy based only on acceleration amount rather than target size.

nodes.name: Goddess Amaterasu
nodes.description: Goddess Amaterasu is the Sun Goddess and potential Beast Candidate weakened without her Age of Gods pocket or Fate Concept boosts. She remains an incredibly mighty Divine Spirit with powerful Light and Fire magic plus all of Tamamo no Mae's abilities boosted enormously (Output reduced to Satellite Class).

nodes.name: Dwarf in the Flask
nodes.description: The Dwarf in the Flask is Hohenheim's first homunculus made from an eye shard with tank-shredding amorphous darkness and great might. Its true power is vast alchemy knowledge for circles, soul-derived philosopher stones, homunculi, chimeras, and teaching Alchemy (Note: Does not possess the power of Truth nor can it reach it due to it not existing in other worlds).

nodes.name: Vlov Arkangel
nodes.description: Vlov Arkangel is an Undead Apostle Ancestor in name only through immaturity with immense physical and magical abilities plus ghoul and Apostle conversion. His Idea Blood Freezin removes heat for near-instant city blizzards, thousands of ice lances, near-absolute-zero cold, and byproduct searing flames, but is hard to use easily and inferior to his peers.

nodes.name: Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast
nodes.description: A fully matured Fallingstar Beast has a body tougher than almost all mundane materials and incredible strength. It manipulates gravity for anti-gravity launches, hurled rocks, gravity bolts, crushing zones, and strength-paired charges.

nodes.name: Hound of Tindalos
nodes.description: "It's a good boy!" A Hound of Tindalos predating time and space with decent physical abilities. It emerges from any sharp corner across places and realities as easily as crossing rooms, and is unkillable because it re-emerges from another corner if killed.

nodes.name: Gugulanna
nodes.description: Gugulanna the Bull of Heaven is a giant divine bull embodying absolute physical might and devastation. Its presence brings controllable near-country-sized storms, its strength is untamable even by the strongest gods, and its hoof stomps hit like the strongest meteors to wipe out countries.

nodes.name: Brethren Moon
nodes.description: A Brethren Moon is a moon-sized near-godlike shapeshifting necromorph mass. It attacks with country-sized tendrils, uses interstellar telepathy, mind reading, and civilization-wide mind control, rewrites DNA, revives the dead as necromorphs, and achieves faster-than-light space travel, though powerful beings can resist.

nodes.name: Golem Keter Malkuth
nodes.description: Golem Keter Malkuth is a giant Adam-like living golem and living reality marble passively terraforming surroundings into Eden from dead ground into vital paradise. It gains nigh-unlimited mana, regenerative immortality, and immense might while grounded, starts at weaker 15 meters and grows with its owner to contend with the strongest heroes, boosts nearby vegetation and vitality as Eden, and leaves the created life behind when it departs.

nodes.name: Zeus Homie
nodes.description: Zeus is a living-cloud homie made from Big Mom Charlotte Linlin's soul piece. He generates and manipulates lightning able to vaporize castles or strike across islands, serves as a mount, hardens beyond steel, and resists most conventional attacks while sharing cloud vulnerabilities.

nodes.name: Prometheus Homie
nodes.description: Prometheus is a sun-shaped living-fireball homie made from Big Mom Charlotte Linlin's soul piece. He raises temperatures to melt steel at range and spits fireballs leveling multiple city blocks, and resists most conventional attacks while sharing flame vulnerabilities.

nodes.name: Terraprisma
nodes.description: The Terraprisma are the Empress of Light's autonomous prismatic-light sword array. They act intelligently to seek enemies, intercept attacks, or attach to non-you targets as willed, with power and numbers based on your power starting at 1 blade.

nodes.name: Gathering Swarm
nodes.description: The Gathering Swarm is a light-bug swarm that efficiently gathers whatever you envision from city-block change to lifted wallets, cleared trash, and stripped corpses. Each bug is weak but lifts 5kg, and more bugs deploy with more energy.

nodes.name: Toriel
nodes.description: Toriel is the former underground queen and goat monster with greatly superhuman strength able to lift dozens of tons. She uses fire magic for flame walls, explosive fireballs, and cooking plus somewhat potent healing, but is a poor combatant from kindness and an excellent cook.

nodes.name: Undyne
nodes.description: Undyne is a fish monster leading the underground royal guard. As a boss monster she can suplex large boulders and conjure magical spears from the ground or air as projectiles. She is a skilled combatant who can instruct in physical training and polearm mastery.

nodes.name: Junimo
nodes.description: Junimos are lesser forest spirits known as keepers of the forest. They excel at maintaining forests, wildlands, and farms, but have no offensive abilities. You get 50, increasing as you grow stronger.

nodes.name: Evil and Intimidating Horse
nodes.description: An incredibly healthy thoroughbred horse with great genetics that is very intimidating and evil.

nodes.name: Penny Polendina
nodes.description: "I'm combat ready!" Penny is an android with her own soul and aura, with aura-boosted robotic strength, a flight module, computational abilities, and remotely controlled Floating Array blades. She only dies if all her cores are destroyed. She cannot unlock others' Auras, comes with extra equipment to facilitate copulation, and is not the Winter Maiden.

nodes.name: Beowolf Pack
nodes.description: A pack of Beowolves, basic Grimm of black evil fluid sized like large bears with wolf traits. Each can flip cars and bisect a grown man, and can track strong negative emotions. You start with 10 and gain more as you grow stronger.

nodes.name: Centorea Shianus
nodes.description: Centorea is a Centaur trained in knighthood. She fights with formidable swordsmanship, archery, and jousting, runs faster than most horses, and is skilled at housework.

nodes.name: Yellow Chocobo
nodes.description: Chocobos are intelligent birds and excellent mounts, as fast as horses with great endurance. They can kick attackers with powerful legs. You get a breeding pair.

nodes.name: Holy Cow
nodes.description: "Holy Cow!" is a large, healthy female cow that always lactates 10 to 50 liters of milk per day depending on feeding. Her nutrient-dense milk has great health benefits and quality, and works as low-quality holy water against the unholy. Her children mostly inherit her genes and holy blessing.

nodes.name: Cathyl
nodes.description: Cathyl is a minotaur towering over humans, 10x stronger than a grown man with exceptional stamina. Experienced in farming and ranching, she suits heavy labour. She naturally lactates very nutritious, rich, tasty milk.

nodes.name: Dragonslayer Armor
nodes.description: A hulking magically animated iron armor tough enough to withstand dragons and warriors. It smashes boulders with surprising agility, and its weapon releases bolts and arcs of lightning with each swing.

nodes.name: The Doll
nodes.description: A simple lifelike doll animated by eldritch means with no powers or combat ability. She is fairly competent at caretaking. (No blood echoes or Bloodborne mechanics carry over)

nodes.name: Lady of Ariandel
nodes.description: A draconic child of the painted world of Ariandel trained in creating "Painted Worlds". Given sufficiently powerful catalysts made into paint, she can create self-contained pocket worlds entered only through their paintings, with size and quality depending on paint potency, but she has little to no combat ability. (Note: She is not immortal)

nodes.name: Royal Sentinels
nodes.description: Royal Sentinels are elite giant guards of the gods of Anor Londo, several times human height with proportionate strength. They wield armor, halberds, and wall-like shields, and can heal themselves. You start with 2 and gain more as you grow stronger.

nodes.name: Miriel the Pastor of Vows
nodes.description: "The best dog" Miriel is an ancient sentient turtle ordained as pastor. Beyond his sturdy shell he has no notable powers, but is a skilled compassionate teacher in spiritual, emotional, and magical matters. He brings no miracles or spells from his world, but can guide study of your world's magic or any Grimoires you receive.

nodes.name: Bucky
nodes.description: Bucky is the Chicken Devil who can form devil contracts and heal through blood. Due to lack of fear toward chickens, he is weaker than a cat with no special abilities beyond Devil Physiology. (Cannot do Heart replacement)

nodes.name: Earthmover
nodes.description: THR 1000 - Earthmover is a titanic Supreme Machine and moving military base that razes cities, with a Lightning Spear eclipsing most nuclear weapons and a forcefield that withstands its own spears. It also carries missile platforms, giant autocannons, laser cannons, a livable small city on its back, and repair drones. It requires sunlight and blood to function, with ammunition and blood reserves refueled every 24 hours.

nodes.name: Flesh Leviathan
nodes.description: The Leviathan is a Supreme Demon fused from flesh of the sullen at the bottom of the River Styx. Its huge body resists most conventional weapons except at its weak spot. It wields immense strength and Hell energy for explosive orbs and mouth lasers.

nodes.name: Swordsmachine
nodes.description: Swordsmachine is a greater machine that rebuilt itself from scrap, including its own sword. Renowned for fighting hell's denizens, it can build basic tech from scrap and fights with a durable body, shotgun arm, and motorized sword wielded with finesse. It is powered and fueled by blood.

nodes.name: Mindflayer
nodes.description: The Mindflayer is a Greater Machine well-adapted to hell's ecology. It harnesses Hell Energy for explosive orbs and laser beams, and can levitate and teleport short distances.

nodes.name: Geryon the Watcher of the Skies
nodes.description: Geryon, the Watcher of the Skies, is a Supreme Demon amalgam of numerous demons whose consciousnesses act in tandem. With great physical abilities, Hell Energy lasers and explosives, and a bow of flesh, he is an efficient hunter and combatant.

nodes.name: Hell
nodes.description: That's right, it's Hell itself, all of it, localized within your Familiar Space. Hell is a supermassive hyperintelligent sentient dimension and organism created by the Heavenly God, with 9 layers it freely shapes and controls, filled with sinners, demons, machines, and husks. It can open gates to drag beings in or release demons, and as an afterlife can pull in souls that died in the current dimension.

nodes.name: Puss
nodes.description: Puss is an anthropomorphic cat in his signature boots, belt, hat, and rapier. Agile, strong for his size, and skilled with blades, he is a formidable combatant. He has 9 lives, restoring to full condition upon a mortal wound at the cost of one life.

nodes.name: Noah's Menagerie
nodes.description: You gain one male and one female of every animal alive at the time of the Ark's construction. If any species drops below 2, another pair spawns.

nodes.name: Gore Magala
nodes.description: Gore Magala is a Demi Elder Dragon with six limbs and considerable strength. Blind, it senses via heat and scattered pollen-like scales that pollute the air. This pollen carries the Frenzy Virus, driving bestial beings berserk and blocking natural healing in humanoids for a time; fed enough high-quality prey, it metamorphoses into Shagaru Magala after some time.

nodes.name: Shagaru Magala
nodes.description: Shagaru Magala is the mature Elder Dragon form of Gore Magala, with immense strength and six limbs. It scatters pollen-like scales to perceive surroundings and inflict the Frenzy Virus via scales and breath, driving bestial creatures berserk and blocking natural healing in humanoids. Its scales can cover its roost mountain, and in compatible hosts act as eggs to spawn infants.

nodes.name: Nick O' Teen
nodes.description: The dastardly Nick O' Teen is a nicotine-addicted supervillain who pushes smoking on others. When summoned he arrives, hands everyone a pack of cigarettes, then leaves. 24-hour cooldown.

nodes.name: The Fallen Aces
nodes.description: Your own gang of Goons and Mooks, all roughly middle-aged Italian men with varying proficiencies in barehanded fighting, pipes, and ranged weapons. They are not very smart but very loyal. You start with 100 Goons/Mooks and gain more as you grow stronger. Reference: https://fallenaces.wiki.gg/wiki/Category:Enemies#Gangster_enemies-0

nodes.name: Rodent of Usual Size
nodes.description: An appropriately sized common rat.

nodes.name: Rodent of Unusual Size
nodes.description: An unusually large rat, strong enough to maim a grown man.

nodes.name: Cancerous Rodent
nodes.description: An otherwise normal gnarly glowing green rat constantly emitting harmful radiation surpassing radium or enriched uranium.

nodes.name: Mythra and Pyra
nodes.description: Mythra and Pyra are a Legendary Blade created from a Core Crystal, wielding the Aegis Blade with Light and Fire elements. Mythra offers short-range precognition, Light manipulation, and speed, while Pyra offers destructive firepower; they are alternate forms of one entity, only one out at once. As a Blade they grant their Driver a portion of abilities and armament when manifested, drain user energy to act, and scale with user strength and bond. (No core revival or Pneuma)

nodes.name: Aegaeon
nodes.description: Aegaeon is a Legendary Blade from a Core Crystal bound to their Driver, wielding a Chroma Katana with the Water Element. He excels in swordsmanship and physical ability. He grants his Driver a portion of abilities and armament when manifested, requires user energy, and scales with user strength and bond.

nodes.name: Brighid
nodes.description: Brighid is a Legendary Blade from a Core Crystal bound to their Driver, wielding twin Blade Whips with the Fire Element. Having lived countless years, she brings great wisdom, skill, and Fire mastery. She grants her Driver a portion of abilities and armament when manifested, requires user energy, and scales with user strength and bond.

nodes.name: Dromarch
nodes.description: Dromarch is a Blade from a Core Crystal bound to their Driver, wielding Twin Rings with the Water Element. He combines powerful physique, healing, and Water mastery, and can be ridden as a mount. He grants his Driver a portion of abilities and armament when manifested, requires user energy, and scales with user strength and bond.

nodes.name: Perdido
nodes.description: Perdido is a Special Blade from a Core Crystal bound to their Driver, wielding a Decimation Cannon with the Fire Element. He brings great physical ability, weapon mastery, and Fire control. He grants his Driver a portion of abilities and armament when manifested, requires user energy, and scales with user strength and bond.

nodes.name: Zenobia
nodes.description: Zenobia is a Rare Blade from a Core Crystal bound to their Driver, wielding a Greataxe with the Wind Element. She has great physical ability and wind use, and grows stronger the more wounded she is as a berserker. She grants her Driver a portion of abilities and armament when manifested, requires user energy, and scales with user strength and bond.

nodes.name: Nia
nodes.description: Nia is a Legendary Flesh Eater Blade, a living Gormotti-Blade hybrid with the water element and Catalyst Scimitar. She has enhanced physical ability, water control, and Biokinesis to regenerate, drain life, or invert regeneration on opponents. She acts independently or links with a Driver for shared power fueled by their energy.

nodes.name: Nosferatu Zod
nodes.description: Zod is an Apostle tied to the God Hand, with inhuman strength, agelessness, and regeneration. Long-lived and proficient in both "human" and "Apostle" forms, he tears steel easily and resists conventional weapons. In Apostle form he can also fly.

nodes.name: Mizune Family
nodes.description: The Mizune Family are 5 near-identical mice witches who shift freely between mice and human forms. They excel at stealth and espionage, firing straight lasers via Beam Whiskers. They can merge into stronger forms depending on how many combine.

nodes.name: Eruka Frog
nodes.description: Eruka is a Witch Frog shifting freely between frog and woman forms. She wields Tadpole Bombs for offense and masterful Calculation Magic rivaling supercomputers, enabling incredibly precise casting of other spells.

nodes.name: Chaomorph
nodes.description: The Greater Chaomorph is a formless information-based entity from an infinitesimal fragment of the Nuclear Chaos. It can take the form of any Uncommon-rank or lower familiar best suited to its duties, but has no abilities in base form. If it dies, it revives within 24 hours.

nodes.name: Greater Chaomorph
nodes.description: The Greater Chaomorph is a formless information-based entity from an infinitesimal fragment of the Nuclear Chaos. It can take the form of any Elite-rank or lower familiar best suited to its duties, but has no abilities in base form. If it dies, it revives within 24 hours.

nodes.name: Faceless One
nodes.description: A fragment of the Faceless God forged as a familiar. It can transform into any Legendary-rank or lower familiar at will, but has no abilities in base form. It revives 1 hour after death.

nodes.name: Investigator
nodes.description: This familiar manifests as a nondescript phone to call the Investigator. Describe a target whose appearance and face you know, and he will investigate with regular-human stats plus Expert Spycraft and Expert Stealth. You can request updates or give other orders via the phone.

nodes.name: Investinggator
nodes.description: No no, you read that right. This reptile masters the free market and stock speculation. Leave money with him and it is in the right hands... claws... maw?

nodes.name: Instiggator
nodes.description: No no, you read that right. This otherwise ordinary alligator masters provocation and conflict, easily enraging individuals or groups.

nodes.name: Interroggator
nodes.description: No no, you read that right. This otherwise ordinary alligator masters interrogation, coaxing truth from people by any means.

nodes.name: Litiggator
nodes.description: No no, you read that right. This reptile masters litigation and attorney work, well-read in your world's laws. It may struggle representing you in court as a regular reptile.

nodes.name: Naviggator
nodes.description: No no, you read that right. This regular alligator masters navigation with excellent direction. Give it a map and compass and it can almost certainly guide you where needed.

nodes.name: Carpenter Ants
nodes.description: This massive ant colony masters carpentry, skilled, hardworking, and talented. Given wood and materials, they can build a house in a day and expand by recycling wood waste. Large enough, they can build a town in a day.

nodes.name: Hubert Jura Hound
nodes.description: Otherwise known as a Bloodhound, it is a regular purebred St. Hubert Jura Hound known for exceptional smell.

nodes.name: Four Dark Devas of Destruction
nodes.description: Despite their grandiose name, the Four Dark Devas of Destruction are 4 quirky, well-trained hamsters with unique personalities.

nodes.name: Patrasche
nodes.description: Patrasche is an unusually intelligent, emotionally aware Ground Dragon, a bipedal lizard akin to a horse. Strong enough to bite off a man's head, she runs horse-fast even pulling a carriage via Divine Protection of Wind Evasion, nullifying wind resistance for her and what touches her.

nodes.name: Piercing Ox
nodes.description: An Ox Shikigami of great physical power that grows stronger the longer it moves in a straight line. Its power scales with your energy levels.

nodes.name: Tiger Funeral
nodes.description: A humanoid tiger shikigami with great strength and claws that shred metal. It can temporarily revive your familiars/summons as shadow forms, even multiples at once if you supply the energy. Its power scales with your energy levels.

nodes.name: Beldia
nodes.description: Beldia is a Dullahan and former general of the Demon King. Despite flippancy, he is a powerful skilled knight with incredible strength and nigh unlimited, paired with swordsmanship. He can cast powerful curses and summon Death Knights.

nodes.name: Hans
nodes.description: Hans is a massive Dead Poison Slime and former general of the Demon King. His body is deadly poison that melts regular humans on contact, and he can detach parts to poison things. He is nigh immune to physical attacks and resistant to magical attacks.

nodes.name: Echidna
nodes.description: A small, spiny, cute mammal. Utterly useless as a familiar, but pretty cute.

nodes.name: Krombopulous Michael
nodes.description: "Oh boy, here I go killin' again." Michael is a top Gromflomite assassin. He masters killing, infiltration, espionage, and all weapons, with zero morals or standards.

nodes.name: Merged Beast Agito
nodes.description: Agito is a powerful Merged Shikigami with extremely strong physical abilities. It manipulates and emits electricity, and uses Reverse Cursed Energy to heal and disrupt negative energies.

nodes.name: Vernum Carnis
nodes.description: Vernum Carnis, or Singularity, is an unknown extraterrestrial floating matte orb. It interferes with electromagnetic signals and turns dead flesh into Scandere Carnis, or crawl, which expands by consuming nutrients to create varied flesh monsters over time.

nodes.name: Raccoon
nodes.description: A regular raccoon, very good at scrounging through and eating trash.

nodes.name: A Tanuki
nodes.description: A regular tanuki, the Japanese Raccoon Dog, not the yokai. It does little, but is pretty cute.

nodes.name: Arvak
nodes.description: Arvak is an undead skeleton horse, fairly strong with infinite stamina for near-endless riding. Even if killed, he respawns within 10 seconds.

nodes.name: Appa
nodes.description: Appa is a massive Sky Bison, naturally capable of airbending. Larger than an elephant and able to fight with his bulk, he flies long distances via airbending even with passengers.

nodes.name: Hamsuke
nodes.description: Hamsuke, the Wise King of the Forest, is a gigantic hamster-like creature with a long prehensile snake-like tail. She is very strong, with steel-durable fur and a tail that can rip off a knight's head. She can also cast basic low-tier magic via body sigils.

nodes.name: Militech Chimera
nodes.description: The Militech Chimera is a state-of-the-art autonomous tank with considerable mobility, self-repair, and many weapons: flechette cannons, plasma cannons, machine guns, poison gas, explosives, and repair bots. It may be vulnerable from above, and is piloted by smart AI.

nodes.name: Butter Passing Robot
nodes.description: A small sentient treaded robot built by a great mind to pass butter. It can also do other inconsequential menial tasks like pulling a lever or passing margarine.

nodes.name: Magnamalo
nodes.description: Magnamalo is a Fanged Wyvern with fearsome strength, agility, predator instincts, steel-tough hide, and bladed limbs. It expels volatile purple 'Hellfire' from several body points, and quickly regenerates non-severe wounds via incredible metabolism.

nodes.name: Lunagaron
nodes.description: Lunagaron is a powerful frozen werewolf-like Fanged Wyvern and born apex predator. It crushes armored foes like tin cans and runs on walls with extreme agility. It supercools air via a special organ, expelling supercooled mist and coating itself in heat-resistant ice, and can enter a stronger bipedal berserk form by halting thermoregulation.

nodes.name: Shogun Ceanataur
nodes.description: The Shogun Ceanataur is a massive lobster-crab creature with giant blade-like limbs. Despite its size it swings those blades with great speed, strength, and agility. It can also shoot pressurized water from its shells at range.

nodes.name: Zinogore
nodes.description: Zinogore is a large bestial quadrupedal Fanged Wyvern with considerable power and hunter instincts. Its fur hosts Thunderbugs (included) that imbue its attacks with lightning or attack directly.

nodes.name: Voljang
nodes.description: Voljang is a Rajang relative, a massive towering gorilla-like monster with immense strength and temper. It breathes flames and coats its body in them to aid attacks. It can enter a berserk state strengthening its body and flames.

nodes.name: Nakarkos
nodes.description: Nakarkos is an Elder Dragon-like giant bone-covered cephalopod with two dragon tentacles. It moves easily on land despite aquatic nature, with immense strength. It expels sticky viscous fluid to trap prey and add bones to strengthen itself, and condenses dragon energy in limbs for beam attacks.

nodes.name: Amatsu
nodes.description: Amatsu is an Elder Dragon known as the Calamity of the Skies. Manipulating Water and Wind, it creates hurricanes, controls weather over a massive area, fires pressured water breaths, and rains lightning while flying effortlessly.

nodes.name: Garangolm
nodes.description: Garangolm is a massive gorilla-like Fanged Beast of immense might. It releases sap-like fluid that feeds plant life, letting plants grow on it. It can armor itself in hardened earth or coat hands in earth then melt it into lava gauntlets.

nodes.name: Velkhana
nodes.description: Velkhana is a majestic Elder Dragon with power over ice. Fast-flying and physically powerful, it breathes supercooled liquid to flash-freeze objects, and manipulates ice to create icebergs and armor itself.

nodes.name: Elderfrost Gammoth
nodes.description: The Elderfrost Gammoth is a massive mammoth-like Fanged Beast larger than a siege machine. With great size, strength, and durability, she charges through castle walls with ease. She also breathes ice and snow from her trunk.

nodes.name: Goss Harag
nodes.description: Goss Harag is a large Yeti/Bear/Demon-like Fanged Beast of great stature and might. It spits supercooled fluid that forms ice, freezing opponents or shaping ice bludgeons and blades on its arms.

nodes.name: Malzeno
nodes.description: The Malzeno is an Elder Dragon known as the Scarlet Feast, wielding Dragon Energy for breaths and attacks. It hosts symbiotic Qurio parasites as a nest in its body. They drain vitality and blood while poisoning targets, returning it to heal, strengthen, and trigger Malzeno's stronger Bloodening form.

nodes.name: Ruiner Nergigante
nodes.description: The Ruiner Nergigante is a mature Elder Dragon with immense strength, agility, and hyper-tough body spikes to crush, shred, and impale. When fed it regrows spikes in seconds and heals even lethal wounds, growing stronger with every survived fight. With large excess nutrients and bio energy, it reproduces asexually by laying spike-eggs.

nodes.name: Qurio Swarm
nodes.description: The Qurio are flying parasitic leeches that latch onto targets to drain vitality and blood for their host. They carry diseases that drive targets berserk or slowly kill them. They cannot reproduce but replenish over time if killed, starting with 10 and gaining more as you grow stronger.

nodes.name: Canyne Pack
nodes.description: A pack of well-trained Canynes, smart loyal canine-like Fanged Beasts. They run fast even carrying armored riders, scale walls, use tools, and aid companions. You start with 5 and get more as you grow stronger.

nodes.name: Fatalis Trio
nodes.description: A trio of Fatalis, apex Elder Dragons able to raze castles and ruin countries overnight, all with immense power and regeneration. Regular Fatalis vaporizes steel with firepower; Crimson Fatalis is stronger but unstable, wielding magma and meteors; eldest White Fatalis is strongest, wielding Red Lightning infused with Dragon Energy and energy beams. Reproduction unknown, but you can probably figure it out.

nodes.name: Lil' Entity
nodes.description: Just a lil' multidimensional guy the size of a country, made of countless shards contained in Familiar Space. This baby Entity analyzes and replicates its user's abilities and traits, taking longer for stronger and more esoteric ones. Once analyzed, it distributes shards letting targets use copies of your abilities through it as liaison.

nodes.name: Common Blade Core
nodes.description: A Common Blade Core that when imbued with energy forms a Common Blade with compatible weapon and element, bonding the imbuer as its driver.

nodes.name: Rare Blade Core
nodes.description: The core of an unidentified Rare Blade. Imbuing it with energy bonds it to you, forming one of the compatible Rare Blades.

nodes.name: Investiggator
nodes.description: No no, you read that right. This otherwise regular alligator masters detective work, with Expert Spycraft, Expert Stealth, Expert Interfacing, and Expert Savoir Faire.

nodes.name: Coco Jumbo
nodes.description: A seemingly regular turtle with a stand letting others use the key on its back to enter and leave a room inside it at will.

nodes.name: Hollow Army
nodes.description: A small army of Hollows wielding swords, shields, spears, and crossbows. Not very smart or strong, but weapon-trained. You start with 50 and gain more as you grow stronger.

nodes.name: Lopunny
nodes.description: "There are no laws against the Pokemon Batman!" Lopunny is a bunny-like Pokemon with great agility and leg strength, delivering devastating kicks and moving rapidly.

nodes.name: Lamball
nodes.description: A round woolly starter Pal whose fluffy body makes a perfect shield and pillow.

nodes.name: Chikipi
nodes.description: A cheerful chicken Pal that lays eggs wherever it wanders.

nodes.name: Lifmunk
nodes.description: A gliding squirrel Pal that mans a submachine gun from your shoulder.

nodes.name: Foxparks
nodes.description: A fox Pal that transforms into a living flamethrower when you hug it. Huggy Fire.

nodes.name: Pengullet
nodes.description: A penguin Pal that loads itself into a launcher as living ammunition.

nodes.name: Tocotoco
nodes.description: A dapper bird Pal that fires explosive eggs from its Eggbomb Launcher.

nodes.name: Tanzee
nodes.description: A monkey Pal wielding an assault rifle with its Cheery Rifle partner skill.

nodes.name: Leezpunk
nodes.description: A sneaky lizard Pal whose Sixth Sense sniffs out nearby dungeons.

nodes.name: Lunaris
nodes.description: An antlered Pal whose Antigravity lets you carry far more than you should.

nodes.name: Bushi
nodes.description: A ronin Pal that answers threats with its Brandish Blade iaido draw.

nodes.name: Grizzbolt
nodes.description: An electric bear Pal that shoulders a minigun as its Yellow Tank partner skill.

nodes.name: Palworld Anubis
nodes.description: A jackal martial-artist Pal, Guardian of the Desert, who empowers your strikes.

nodes.name: Strider
nodes.description: An overridden horse-like machine that serves as a fast, loyal mount.

nodes.name: Broadhead
nodes.description: A bull-like machine mount that gores whatever charges you.

nodes.name: Sawtooth
nodes.description: An overridden predator machine that hunts at your side.

nodes.name: Stalker
nodes.description: An overridden stealth machine that cloaks beside you until it strikes.

nodes.name: Pink Slime
nodes.description: The friendliest slime: eats anything, loves everything, wiggles constantly.

nodes.name: Tabby Slime
nodes.description: A catlike slime that steals food, knocks things over, and purrs about it.

nodes.name: Phosphor Slime
nodes.description: A nocturnal glow slime, harmless by day and radiant by night.

nodes.name: Hunter Slime
nodes.description: A feral-eyed predator slime that turns invisible before it pounces.

nodes.name: Honey Slime
nodes.description: A sweet slime oozing minty honey; nearby slimes agitate from the smell.

nodes.name: Puddle Slime
nodes.description: A shy water slime that only thrives in ponds and evaporates on dry land.

nodes.name: Quantum Slime
nodes.description: A paradox slime that exists in multiple places until observed.

nodes.name: Lucky Slime
nodes.description: An impossibly rare coin-faced slime that bursts into newbucks when fed meat.

nodes.name: Gold Slime
nodes.description: The rarest slime: appears anywhere, eats anything, and pops into plorts of pure gold.

nodes.name: Tiyanki Matriarch
nodes.description: An ancient space-whale matriarch leading her pod across the stars beside you.

nodes.name: Space Amoeba
nodes.description: A docile void amoeba the size of a frigate, trailing your fleet like a puppy.

nodes.name: War Dog
nodes.description: A trained wardog that hunts and holds the line beside its handler.

nodes.name: Barn Cat
nodes.description: Vermin control with whiskers; will adopt you and explode in population.

nodes.name: Grizzly Bear
nodes.description: A war-trained grizzly that mauls sieges on command.

nodes.name: Cuddlefish
nodes.description: An endearing deep-sea pet that plays fetch and follows you home.

nodes.name: Lizard Doggo
nodes.description: A loyal alien pup that follows you around and occasionally digs up surprises.

nodes.name: Chirpy
nodes.description: The relentlessly cheerful seagull mascot, narrating your city one chirp at a time.

nodes.name: Shivan Dragon
nodes.description: The iconic 5/5 flying dragon that pumps +1/+0 for a single red mana.

nodes.name: Captain Boomer
nodes.description: A 3-ton whale with a day job who competes in the coin-flipping esport beside you.

nodes.name: Peska the Troll
nodes.description: A trash-talking troll hero whose jeers tilt opponents right off the ladder.

nodes.name: HyperQbe the Streamer
nodes.description: An always-live streamer hero narrating your flips to an audience of thousands.

nodes.name: Mercury
nodes.description: A skilled program ally who fights beside you in the Game Grid and knows its back doors.

nodes.name: Data Wraith
nodes.description: A viral hunter prowling the system for programs to derez, currently pointed at your enemies.

nodes.name: Spirit Doe
nodes.description: A luminous doe that appears at turning points, watching over your choices.

nodes.name: Spidertron
nodes.description: A spider-legged combat mech with rocket launchers that follows your remote orders.

nodes.name: Little Scout
nodes.description: A reusable camera probe that photographs the unknown and always comes back.

nodes.name: Automaton
nodes.description: A steam-powered automaton worker that labors through deadly frost without complaint.

nodes.name: Duplicant
nodes.description: A cheerful cloning-vat colonist who digs, builds, and stresses about everything.

nodes.name: Tamed Wolf
nodes.description: A once-wild wolf, now loyal, that hunts and guards beside you.

nodes.name: Molly
nodes.description: The team's beloved M.U.L.E. robot that hauls minerals and headbutts glyphids.

nodes.name: Beaver
nodes.description: An industrious beaver that dams rivers and drags logs all day long.

nodes.name: Golem
nodes.description: A mechanical beaver golem that works around the clock without food or rest.

nodes.name: Gae Bolg
nodes.description: Cu Chulainn - Cursed demonic spear crafted from a great beast's skull. Wounds it inflicts never heal except via Legendary rank healing. With Master rank Polearm mastery and practice, unlock its noble phantasms.

nodes.name: Excalibur the Sword of Promised Victory
nodes.description: Artoria - Sword of Promised Victory crafted by the fae as humanity's ultimate hope. One of the strongest weapons, bound by 12 restraints that limit its true power.

nodes.name: Laevatein
nodes.description: Surtr - Sun-like sword of calamity that incinerates all things, prioritizing life above all else. Capable of wiping out all planetary life; even gods are reduced to ashes.

nodes.name: Deep Sea Knight Anchor
nodes.description: Anchor of the Knight of the Deep Seas, blessed by the Secret Princess. Wielding it doubles strength and boosts all water-based abilities.

nodes.name: Vorpal Blade
nodes.description: Sword of the Evil Dragon Slaying Rabbit. Against dragons, enhances the wielder's physical stats and ignores a portion of their durability.

nodes.name: Demon Catalyst
nodes.description: Staff carved from a great demon's bones and soul. Amplifies all spells cast through it by 2x but also doubles their mana consumption.

nodes.name: Astral Injection
nodes.description: Injection of starborn astral blight essence. Massively increases energy regeneration for 10 minutes while tearing and rotting your insides. Restock Timer: 120 hours.

nodes.name: Yharim Stimulants
nodes.description: Injection crafted by Dreadon granting immense might. Greatly boosts physical ability and regeneration for 30 minutes, followed by weakness and exhaustion. Restock Timer: 120 hours.

nodes.name: Ring of Invisibility
nodes.description: Ornate platinum ring that constantly bends light around the wearer, rendering them invisible.

nodes.name: Master Key
nodes.description: Opens any physical lock, barrier, or ward by inserting and twisting it.

nodes.name: Spear of Longinus X
nodes.description: Large red spear that resizes to its user and reshapes to their needs, tearing through even the strongest barriers. When stabbed into a god, it locks their soul and paralyzes them until removed.

nodes.name: Invisible Air
nodes.description: Artoria - Barrier of the Wind King of layered, extremely compressed air the user controls at will.

nodes.name: Gae Buidhe
nodes.description: Diarmuid - Legendary spear of Diarmuid whose cursed wounds never close via traditional healing or magic below Legendary Level. Curse lifts if the owner dies or the spear breaks, though a skilled blacksmith or crafter can reforge it.

nodes.name: Gae Dearg
nodes.description: Diarmuid - Legendary spear of Diarmuid that severs and nullifies magic, rendering magical protection almost useless. It bypasses protections rather than dispelling active spells.

nodes.name: Gram
nodes.description: Strongest Demonic Sword, on par with Durandal and nigh unbreakable. Can emit destructive aura by expending the user's energy and deals massively increased damage to all Dragons.

nodes.name: Durandal
nodes.description: One of the strongest Holy Swords, unbreakable and capable of severing anything. Can release destructive aura by expending the user's energy, but is extremely difficult for inexperienced users.

nodes.name: Sword Birth
nodes.description: Sacred Gear created by God that conjures demonic sword constructs with properties based on the user's capability and skill. Cannot create a sword that does something the user cannot do.

nodes.name: A skeleton
nodes.description: Ordinary human skeleton from a completely ordinary person.

nodes.name: Auric Tesla Armor
nodes.description: Power armor modeled on the God Slaying Tyrant's. Grants extreme physical boost, Rare rank regeneration, hovering, and an extremely fast dash every 10 seconds. Managed by a virtual intelligence controlling its systems.

nodes.name: Enuma Elish
nodes.description: Gilgamesh - Sword of Rupture, Ea, granted by the gods and forged before swords existed. Releases red winds that shred spacetime without expending user energy, and at full power fires a beam that strips the world's texture, annihilating everything in its path.

nodes.name: Pokeball Set
nodes.description: Set of 6 regular Pokeballs that capture and store creatures, which register as familiars. Restock Timer: 24 hours.

nodes.name: Inverted Spear of Heaven
nodes.description: Dispels any active ability effect it touches, such as fireballs or barriers, but not basic energy or magic. Cannot dispel effects beyond its rank.

nodes.name: Cornucopia
nodes.description: Horn containing unlimited fresh mundane vegetables, fruits, etc. Think of the desired ingredient, then pull it out.

nodes.name: Tome of the Erdtree
nodes.description: Teaches Erdtree incantations such as healing and blessings. https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Erdtree+Incantations

nodes.name: Tome of the Grand Rizzard
nodes.description: Tome of vast erotic magical arts knowledge, teaching Eromancy.

nodes.name: Tricksters Book of Illusions
nodes.description: Teaches DnD illusion spells of tricks and illusions. https://dnd5e.wikidot.com/spells:illusion

nodes.name: Dragon Ball
nodes.description: Single Dragon Ball. Gather all 7 to summon Shenron for a wish within his power, or gain any ability below 6.9 rating.

nodes.name: Stone Mask
nodes.description: Stone mask crafted by the Pillar Men. Wearing it while blood is dripped on it transforms the wearer into a vampire.

nodes.name: Stone of Aja
nodes.description: Legendary jewel amplifying hamon and light to extreme levels; worn as a pendant, it strengthens light abilities. Combined with the Stone Mask, it can create a perfect lifeform.

nodes.name: Grimoire of the Twice Dead Death Mage
nodes.description: Grimoire of a twice-died death magician. Teaches death-attribute magic. https://death-mage.fandom.com/wiki/Death-attribute_magic

nodes.name: Grimoire of the White Mage
nodes.description: Teaches White Magic such as healing, curing, buffs, and warding.

nodes.name: Grimoire of the Pyromancer
nodes.description: Teaches Fire Magic of fire and flame.

nodes.name: Grimoire of the Cryomancer
nodes.description: Teaches Ice Magic of ice and cold.

nodes.name: Grimoire of the Aeromancer
nodes.description: Teaches Air Magic of wind and lightning.

nodes.name: Alchemilia
nodes.description: Guide to brewing many minor useful potions like healing and energy recovery from mundane ingredients. Only those who have physically read it can craft its potions.

nodes.name: The Assembly
nodes.description: Room-sized machine that disassembles any item into its most basic components, down to snowflake size. Can reassemble them into ingots, materials, or finished items given a blueprint.

nodes.name: Bar of Vibranium
nodes.description: Bar of pure refined Wakandan Vibranium, ready to process. Absorbs kinetic energy and vibrations, making it nigh unbreakable conventionally. Restock Timer: 168 hours.

nodes.name: Angel Ring
nodes.description: Ornate gold ring granting flight at the wearer's running speed.

nodes.name: Black Barrel
nodes.description: Gun imposing limited life on anything it hits; even absolute immortals become mortal.

nodes.name: Black Key Rites
nodes.description: Holy rite to create Black Keys by expending energy and praying per the rites.

nodes.name: Shroud of Martin
nodes.description: Holy shroud once worn by a saint. When wrapped around an object, suppresses its state to keep it "normal".

nodes.name: Enkidu
nodes.description: Chains of Heaven that suppress even gods, manifested anytime and controlled mentally. Stronger against holier or more divine targets.

nodes.name: A pair of very comfortable socks
nodes.description: Very comfortable socks. Rolling this from the multiverse's treasures deserves pity.

nodes.name: Character Card Destiny's Child
nodes.description: Legendary Mechanic - Predicts a future 'opportunity' like a mission, item, or person's action with accurate detail. Has 5 uses, then fades.

nodes.name: HF Murasama
nodes.description: Crimson expert High Frequency blade, best of its kind, cutting practically any physical material. Includes a gunslash for Iai moves; sheath has infinite charge.

nodes.name: Playful Cloud
nodes.description: Cursed three-section staff growing more destructive the stronger its user.

nodes.name: Pokedex
nodes.description: Smart handheld device that scans, identifies, and analyzes any creature's race or species in under 10 seconds.

nodes.name: The Infinite Magazine
nodes.description: Magazine that morphs to fit any projectile weapon and supplies infinite ammo while attached.

nodes.name: Ticket to Belethor's General Goods
nodes.description: Teleports you to Belethor's General Goods in Skyrim, Tamriel for 1 hour. Cannot leave a 10-meter circle from arrival; can buy native goods like Soul Gems and Magic Books. Cooldown: 720 hours.

nodes.name: Hito Hito no Mi
nodes.description: Devil Fruit letting an object or animal assume human or hybrid form, at the cost of being unable to swim.

nodes.name: Triactis True Paladinian Mage-Hammer of Might
nodes.description: Hammer of the greatest Paladin, with mountain-flattening might. Greatly amplifies magical and physical abilities and spells cast through it. Returns to the user when thrown, like Mjolnir.

nodes.name: Ticket to the ITOPOD
nodes.description: Sends you to the ITOPOD, the Infinite Tower of Pissed Off Dudes. Fight random enemies floor-by-floor in gauntlet format, each as strong as its floor; earn an item equal to your final floor, but death is permanent. One time use. (A/N: Each floor corresponds to a familiar whose rarity equals Floor Number divided by 10. Floor 1 is a 0.1 rarity familiar while floor 32 is a 3.2 familiar.)

nodes.name: Tome of Hands
nodes.description: Love Advice From the Great Duke of hell - While held, lets you create and control hands from any surface like your own limbs. With practice and study, usable without the tome.

nodes.name: Furniture Catalog
nodes.description: Instantly buys and teleports any mundane furniture from your current world to you at manufacturing cost. Unusable in combat or hostile territory.

nodes.name: Abyssal Diving Suit
nodes.description: Extremely tough power armor for deep-sea exploration down to 3,000 km. Adapts flawlessly to poison, corrosion, and pressure, letting you move and live underwater with ease.

nodes.name: Grand Gelatin
nodes.description: Rainbow gel in an ornate bottle. Consuming it grants Advanced Poison Resistance plus sizeable vitality and agility boosts.

nodes.name: Ring of Swiftness
nodes.description: Magical ornate silver ring improving agility, reflexes, and balance.

nodes.name: Sand Cloak
nodes.description: Dusty brown cloak hiding your presence. Once every 8 hours, shroud yourself in a violent localized sandstorm to retreat or hide.

nodes.name: Ambrosial Ampule
nodes.description: Ambrosia of the gods. Drinking it massively boosts vitality to near-regeneration and cures all illnesses and ailments.

nodes.name: Bloom Stone
nodes.description: Ancient green-gem necklace granting sunlight-based regeneration: Uncommon in morning, Rare at noon, Uncommon in afternoon, Common in evening, none at night.

nodes.name: Butcher's Bag of Infinite Meat
nodes.description: Bag of limitless fresh mundane Earth animal meat in all cuts. Withdraw up to 100 kg every 24 hours by reaching in and thinking of the cut. Clean, not ethically sourced; ignore the implications.

nodes.name: Living Dew
nodes.description: Living dew from the ancient jungle's depths. Consuming it significantly increases vitality and lifespan, granting strong ailment resistance and faster healing, amplified in jungles or forests.

nodes.name: Permafrost's Concoction
nodes.description: Culmination of Archmage Permafrost's work. Greatly increases energy/mana reserves and regeneration, massively buffs frost abilities at reduced cost, and grants strong cold and flame resistance.

nodes.name: THE Stop Sign
nodes.description: Indestructible stop sign. Whatever its head contacts instantly loses all momentum.

nodes.name: Trinket of Chi
nodes.description: Trinket of a monk who stood still until becoming a statue. Standing still over 3 seconds speeds energy/mana and health recovery.

nodes.name: Evasion Scarf
