nodes.description: Scarf of a shadow-swift rogue. Activate to gain a large speed boost and intangibility while moving straight for 1 second, slipping through attacks or walls. 30 second cooldown.

nodes.name: Grimoire of Hemomancy
nodes.description: Teaches Blood Magic of the Clover Kingdom. Spell List: https://blackclover.fandom.com/wiki/Blood_Magic

nodes.name: Grimoire of Pyromancy
nodes.description: Teaches Fire Magic of the Clover Kingdom. Spell List: https://blackclover.fandom.com/wiki/Fire_Magic

nodes.name: Tome of Vector Magic
nodes.description: Medusa Gorgon's tome teaching her signature Vector Magic. Spell List: https://souleater.fandom.com/wiki/Vector_Magic

nodes.name: Boar Vessel 600-500 BC Etruscan ceramic
nodes.description: Boar Vessel, 600-500 BC Etruscan ceramic. No further explanation needed.

nodes.name: Shitty Copper
nodes.description: Bag of infinite shitty copper from EA Nasir. Holds up to 1000 tons at a time, replenishing every 24 hours.

nodes.name: Belt of Giant Strength
nodes.description: Large crude brown belt raising physical strength to giant level, acting as Rare rank strength. Only works if weaker than a giant.

nodes.name: Blackrazor
nodes.description: Legendary sentient greatsword devouring souls for health and invigoration lasting 24 hours, or stores them in the blade. While wielded, senses souls within 100 meters. Starving it too long makes it restless.

nodes.name: Verminshroud
nodes.description: Filthy patchwork cloak of rat and mouse hide that can never be cleaned. Lets you transform into mundane vermin at will, control sensed vermin, and gain Elite rank illness and poison resistance.

nodes.name: Topaz Annihilator
nodes.description: Magic musket holding a glowing yellow topaz dragon scale instead of ammo. Shots rot living creatures and disintegrate objects in addition to impact.

nodes.name: Hypnos' Mask
nodes.description: Sleeping mask blessed by Hypnos, god of sleep. Wearing it makes sleep perfectly restful, fully recovering energy after 8 uninterrupted hours.

nodes.name: Blade Smith
nodes.description: Sacred Gear created by God that creates holy blade constructs with attributes based on user ability and skill, such as flame-absorbing or poisoning swords.

nodes.name: Dimension Lost
nodes.description: Longinus created by God, world-destroying with a skilled user. Creates mist serving as inviolable barriers or portals to self-made pocket dimensions, allowing free teleportation of self and others.

nodes.name: Sephiroth Graal
nodes.description: Longinus created by God granting god-level knowledge of Soul, Death, and Life, allowing manipulation of souls and life if the user withstands its mind-crushing information.

nodes.name: Alchemist's Cauldron
nodes.description: Large cauldron filling itself with a chosen basic potion once daily: Enhanced Strength, Enhanced Agility, Waterbreathing, Healing, Minor Regeneration, Stone Skin, etc. Must know the potion (No Elixirs), Rare rank or below.

nodes.name: Dragon Vessel Intermediate
nodes.description: Large cauldron filling itself with a chosen intermediate potion once daily: Strength, Agility, Waterbreathing, Healing, Regeneration, Iron Skin, energy recovery, fertility, vitality, etc. Must know the potion (No Elixirs), Elite rank or below.

nodes.name: Dragon Vessel Major
nodes.description: Large cauldron filling itself with a chosen major potion once daily: Enhanced Strength, Enhanced Agility, Waterbreathing, greater Healing, greater Regeneration, Iron Skin, dragon breath, etc. Must know the potion (No Elixirs), Epic rank or below.

nodes.name: Absorption Line
nodes.description: Sacred Gear created by God. It allows the user to conjure energy lines that attach to targets to siphon energy. Can also bind opponents or swing like Spider-Man.

nodes.name: Dreadon's Gaming Chair
nodes.description: Incredibly powerful floating chair with more compute than the strongest supercomputers. Flies at supersonic speeds with powerful protective forcefields. The ultimate gaming chair.

nodes.name: Returner's Clock
nodes.description: Ornate antique hand clock with 3 unrefillable charges. Spend a charge to return to the morning of the current day. Turns to dust after all 3 are spent.

nodes.name: Havel's Greatshield
nodes.description: Magical stone shield of Havel the Rock. Grants enhanced durability and can expend energy to coat the body in stone for further reinforcement.

nodes.name: Sanctus - Dark souls
nodes.description: Legendary Way of White weapon once blessed with white-flame protection. Its power has faded, now granting only slight regeneration.

nodes.name: Altar of Earth
nodes.description: Altar of fire collecting nature's mana to birth earth spirits naturally loyal to the altar's owner.

nodes.name: Ring of Favor and Protection
nodes.description: Ring of goddess Fina's favor and protection, famed for "fateful beauty". Boosts Health, Stamina, and Endurance, but breaks if removed.

nodes.name: Covetous Gold Serpent Ring
nodes.description: Gold ring engraved with the gluttonous serpent, imperfect dragon and symbol of the Undead. Boosts wearer luck so more items are amassed.

nodes.name: Ring of the Sun Princess
nodes.description: Warm ring of Gwynevere, princess of sunlight and Gwyn's eldest daughter. Grants regeneration and restoration, amplified by sunlight.

nodes.name: Slumbering Dragoncrest Ring
nodes.description: Ring secretly worn by a surreptitious Vinheim Dragon School sorcerer, engraved with a slumbering everlasting dragon. Masks all sound from the wearer.

nodes.name: Cloranthy Ring
nodes.description: Ancient ring of unknown origin engraved with a large green flower. Hastens stamina regeneration and exhaustion recovery.

nodes.name: Red Stoneplate Ring
nodes.description: True knight's stoneplate for facing hardship. Red stoneplate symbolizes fire, boosting flame and heat defense.

nodes.name: Blue Stoneplate Ring
nodes.description: True knight's stoneplate for facing hardship. Cyan stoneplate symbolizes ice, boosting ice and cold defense.

nodes.name: Yellow Stoneplate Ring
nodes.description: True knight's stoneplate for facing hardship. Yellow stoneplate symbolizes lightning and storms, boosting lightning and wind defense.

nodes.name: Speckled Stoneplate Ring
nodes.description: True knight's stoneplate for facing hardship. Precious rare speckled stoneplate grants small defense boost against all elemental effects.

nodes.name: Ring of Steel Protection
nodes.description: Ring of Knight King Rendal boosting defense against physical attacks.

nodes.name: Energy Drink
nodes.description: Can of 330ml green juice. Drinking it all recovers 30% energy/mana; more than 3 cans daily causes instant stroke and heart attack. Restock Timer: 24 hours.

nodes.name: Cloak of Billowing
nodes.description: Fancy embroidered red cloak that billows majestically even without wind.

nodes.name: Wardrobe of Mending
nodes.description: Wardrobe of fancy clothes suited to your tastes. When unworn over 24 hours, they mend to mint condition.

nodes.name: Sakuya Fumo
nodes.description: Fumo of a great maid. Any house holding it is maintained as if by 10 maids cleaning 24/7.

nodes.name: Dread Helm
nodes.description: Durable black metal helmet whose visor eye holes glow intimidating red.

nodes.name: Cleaning Stone
nodes.description: Small blue bead slowly cleaning filth from everything within 10 meters.

nodes.name: All-purpose tool
nodes.description: Screwdriver reshaping into any mundane tool such as hammers, knives, or chisels.

nodes.name: Amulet of Health
nodes.description: Gold amulet with red gem slightly increasing wearer vitality.

nodes.name: Magical Beans
nodes.description: Pouch of magical bean seeds. Planted, they grow over 24 hours into a 50-meter-thick stem extending into space.

nodes.name: Special Tattoo Kit
nodes.description: Tattoo kit creating and inscribing magical tattoos with effects based on user abilities. Only one tattoo per individual; effects capped at Common Rarity Trait potency.

nodes.name: The Collar of Obedience
nodes.description: Collar compelling whoever wears it to obey its owner. Cannot be placed on someone capable of resisting.

nodes.name: Unbreakable Shield
nodes.description: Completely unbreakable heater shield, slightly larger than a torso. Still transfers impact energy like a normal shield, but never breaks or deforms.

nodes.name: Mystery of the Night Sky
nodes.description: Panties of the omnipresent Outer One beyond the stars. Holding them speeds energy and health recovery and reduces ability cooldowns by 33%.

nodes.name: Can of Febreze
nodes.description: Infinitely spraying can of Febreze. From Walmart.

nodes.name: Meeseeks Box
nodes.description: Button-activated box summoning a very competent Mr. Meeseeks who obeys your order then disappears. Orders it cannot complete or taking over 7 days make it hostile and violent.

nodes.name: Monstergirls and You
nodes.description: Monster-girl book turning any monster it touches into an attractive female version for the user. Strength and abilities unchanged; target sees the change as natural.

nodes.name: Magic Scroll Blizzard
nodes.description: Magical scroll invoking a fierce 1 km blizzard centered on the user, harmless to them, lasting 30 minutes. Restock Timer: 8 hours.

nodes.name: Exorcist's Gloves
nodes.description: Magical white gloves letting you touch spiritual beings as if solid.

nodes.name: Tome of Rennala
nodes.description: Contains Carian Royal family research, teaching Carian Sorceries. Spell List: https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Carian+Sorceries

nodes.name: Tome of Deathblight
nodes.description: Records of Those Who Live in Death worshipping Godwyn, Prince of Death, teaching Death Sorceries. Spell List: https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Death+Sorceries

nodes.name: Perfect Decoy
nodes.description: Exact replica of your body down to minute detail, but damage reveals DNA-less flesh puppetry mimicking you.

nodes.name: Tome of Raya Lucaria
nodes.description: Teaches Raya Lucaria Academy's Glintstone magic. Spell List: https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Glintstone+Sorceries

nodes.name: Tome of the Starscourge
nodes.description: Contains Radahn the Starscourge's studies, teaching his gravity magic. Spell List: https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Gravity+Sorceries

nodes.name: Cruise Ship
nodes.description: A 350m long, 80m wide luxury cruise ship with infinite fuel. It is crewed by automatons that can only perform their assigned ship duties.

nodes.name: Tank
nodes.description: A large military tank with infinite fuel and shells. Fuel and shells cannot be removed from the vehicle.

nodes.name: Pocket Armory
nodes.description: A large grey duffel bag holding a copy of every cold weapon in high-quality steel. Only one weapon can be taken out at a time, and returning it restores it to perfect condition when next drawn.

nodes.name: Servant Voucher
nodes.description: A coupon to summon your own Heroic Spirit based on you as a person. Bound in standard Grail War style with mana transfer via coitus and 3 command seals for absolute orders. Cannot summon Divine Servants (Divinity above C or explicitly a god) or Grand candidates, and the Servant cannot exceed Elite rank familiar performance.

nodes.name: Stimpack
nodes.description: A syringe pack of modified stem cells and healing agents that drives the body's regeneration into overdrive. WARNING: Use without sufficient nutrients or minerals in the body can cause more harm than good. Restock Timer: 24 hours.

nodes.name: Staff of the Phoenix
nodes.description: An ornate pure-ruby staff with gold engravings. Using it as a focus increases fire abilities' and spells' power while reducing their cost.

nodes.name: Moonlight Greatsword
nodes.description: A moonlight sword crafted from Seath the Scaleless's severed tail. Wielding it strengthens your spells and lets you unleash blasts of magical power from the blade.

nodes.name: Super Crown - Mario
nodes.description: A magical crown that turns its wearer into a pretty girl.

nodes.name: Crate of Explosives
nodes.description: A crate of 64 sticks of dynamite that restocks itself every 24 hours.

nodes.name: Gold Apple
nodes.description: A gold-skinned magical apple. Eating it grants uncommon level regeneration for one hour. Restock Timer: 120 hours.

nodes.name: Enchanted Golden Apple
nodes.description: An enchanted gold-skinned magical apple. Eating it grants rare level regeneration for one hour and bolsters vitality. Restock Timer: 210 hours.

nodes.name: Grimoire of Wind Magic
nodes.description: A book of Wind Magic secrets from the Clover Kingdom for learning and using Aeromancy. Spell List: https://blackclover.fandom.com/wiki/Wind_Magic

nodes.name: Lightsaber
nodes.description: A classic Kyber Crystal lightsaber projecting an energy blade. No Force powers needed to use it.

nodes.name: Wand of the Ice Fairy
nodes.description: A wand of blue ice crystals that feels pleasantly cool to the touch. Using it as a focus increases cold and ice abilities' and spells' potency while reducing their cost.

nodes.name: Divine Shotgun
nodes.description: "Faith in the form of bullets." An unremarkable two-barrel shotgun that consumes your energy/mana to condense holy light bullets per trigger pull. These bullets are lethal to all unholy beings, who cannot heal wounds inflicted by it.

nodes.name: Druid's Living Wand
nodes.description: A wand crafted from still-living wood. Channeling nature and healing abilities and spells through it increases their power and reduces their cost.

nodes.name: Movement Ring
nodes.description: This ring holds 3 charges and recovers 1 charge every hour. Spend a charge for a 10-meter blink, 10 seconds of flight, or 10 seconds of Haste.

nodes.name: Pitcher of Eternal water
nodes.description: A water pitcher that pours endless refreshing clean water when tipped.

nodes.name: Skin Care Hot Springs
nodes.description: Grants ownership of a fully functional hot spring onsen that magically maintains itself. When taken out of storage, it places itself appropriately in your current city with proper paperwork and history, so no one finds its appearance strange.

nodes.name: Apartment in Between
nodes.description: You own a modern one-bedroom apartment floating in stasis between eternity and infinity, with working electricity, heating, wifi, and gas.

nodes.name: Liquor Spring
nodes.description: An ornate fountain flowing perpetually with water. Water taken out transforms after an hour into a high-quality alcoholic drink of the user's choice, and returning it to the spring reverts it to water.

nodes.name: Mystery Pond
nodes.description: A large mysterious pond where freshwater and saltwater fish can all live together. Release one fish into it and another of the same type appears the next day.

nodes.name: Golden Scales
nodes.description: When faced with two choices, these scales tell the user which will be better for the future. Useful for tough decisions like whether to run or fight, take a job offer, or trust someone newly met.

nodes.name: Angel's Breath
nodes.description: A golden card that cures all injuries and illnesses below Mythical rank. Single use only.

nodes.name: Poltergeist's Pillow
nodes.description: Sleep on this card to send your spirit exploring at will, unseen and able to pass through solid objects. Ideal for spying or exploration, but you become a real ghost if you fail to return within 24 hours.

nodes.name: X-ray Goggles
nodes.description: X-ray goggles for seeing through any wall or object, with a dial to adjust vision depth.

nodes.name: Book of VIP Passes
nodes.description: A book containing 1000 V.I.P. Passes. Each pass lets you enter anywhere as a 'Very Important Person', transforming to match the event's requirements, and is destroyed after use. The book is destroyed when no passes remain.

nodes.name: Hormone Cookies
nodes.description: Cookies that temporarily change the eater's gender to the opposite sex for 24 hours. Comes as 10 boxes of 20 cookies; eating 20 in one day makes the change permanent. Restock Timer: 48 hours.

nodes.name: Recycling Can
nodes.description: A person-sized metal can that perfectly breaks down any item placed inside into its basic physical materials.

nodes.name: Hideout Realtor
nodes.description: Create an essentials-stocked secret hideout in a location of your choosing, accessible only through the door you create.

nodes.name: Long Lost Delivery
nodes.description: A cell phone with a single number. Call it and describe a lost item or object to have it returned within a week. Cooldown: 168 hours.

nodes.name: Witch's Rejuvenation Potion
nodes.description: A bottle of 100 pills, each making you physically one year younger when consumed. Restock Timer: 168 hours.

nodes.name: Doyen's Growth Pills
nodes.description: A vial of 100 pills, each growing you by 1cm. Not advised for those under 20. Restock Timer: 168 hours.

nodes.name: Doyen's Virility Pills
nodes.description: A vial of 100 pills granting endurance and fertility in bed. Taking more than one at a time may have unintended effects. Restock Timer: 168 hours.

nodes.name: Doyen's Hair Cream
nodes.description: A tub of cream that permanently grows luxurious, quality hair wherever applied. Use gloves when handling. Restock Timer: 168 hours.

nodes.name: Mad Scientist's Steroids
nodes.description: A box of seven 1-liter vials. Drink 1 liter daily for a full week to gain the Uncommon Trait Enhanced Strength. Restock Timer: 168 hours.

nodes.name: Levitation Necklace
nodes.description: A necklace that lets the wearer slowly fly at 10 km/h.

nodes.name: Hero's Bandages
nodes.description: Sentient bandages that automatically wrap wounds, stopping bleeding and stabilizing broken bones. With training, you can manipulate them yourself.

nodes.name: Fairy Powder
nodes.description: A bag of Lost Empire fairy powder. Inhaled, it instantly puts victims into deep sleep until injury wakes them. Does not work on people over a tier stronger than you. Restock Timer: 48 hours.

nodes.name: Scrap Iron Candy
nodes.description: "Tastes like its name." Consuming it bolsters defense for 30 minutes. Restock Timer: 8 hours.

nodes.name: Hlanith Wine
nodes.description: An indescribably tasting wine favored by the ones beyond the stars. Drinking it makes you tipsy while granting mental clarity and insight. Restock Timer: 24 hours.

nodes.name: Star Fluid
nodes.description: A refined drug harvested from star pests beyond the cosmos. Drinking it grants 30 seconds of death-avoiding immortality, but taking more than 2 in a week turns you into a Ghoul. Restock Timer: 480 hours.

nodes.name: Phantom Thief's Mantle
nodes.description: A crimson mantle of a famous death-defying thief executed by the tyrant. Wearing it grants basic danger sense and enhanced reflexes.

nodes.name: Evil Eye Ring
nodes.description: "Did the eye just move?" A gold ring with an eye-shaped ruby that grants minor regeneration when worn.

nodes.name: Hydrogen Bomb
nodes.description: A hydrogen bomb with a remote detonator. Try not to end up in the blast zone.

nodes.name: Cheshire Cat's ring
nodes.description: A gold ring engraved with a suspiciously smug cat. While worn, you are immune to falling damage even from 100,000 kilometers.

nodes.name: Wind Gods Ring
nodes.description: An ornate silver Wonderland ring blessed by an unnamed wind god. Wearing it boosts agility and reflexes to superhuman levels.

nodes.name: Thief's Ring
nodes.description: A magical ring of a famous whimsical, mischievous thief. Holds 3 charges and recovers 1 every hour. Spend a charge to steal a carried item to your hands (better items have lower success), muffle all your noises for a minute, or boost dexterity and agility for a minute.

nodes.name: Windless Wrap
nodes.description: A blue cloak that lets the wearer disturb not even the wind. While worn, gain enhanced agility and reflexes, muffled sounds, and no air disturbance as you move.

nodes.name: 0 - The Fool
nodes.description: Tarot Card - Temporarily grants a skill or minor ability best suited to the situation, rated no higher than the Fool. 168-hour cooldown.

nodes.name: I - The Magician
nodes.description: Tarot Card - Temporarily increases an ability's rarity for one hour. 240 hour cooldown.

nodes.name: II - The High Priestess
nodes.description: Tarot Card - Speeds up perception for a bullet-time effect and grants Precognition for 30 minutes. 120 hour cooldown.

nodes.name: III - The Empress
nodes.description: Tarot Card - Creates a user-centered aura boosting defense and recovery for 30 minutes. 120 hour cooldown.

nodes.name: IV - The Emperor
nodes.description: Tarot Card - Projects immense mental pressure to dominate or crush a target's mind. 72 hour cooldown.

nodes.name: V - The Hierophant
nodes.description: Tarot Card - Dispels any illusions in your line of sight. 72 hour cooldown.

nodes.name: VI - The Lovers
nodes.description: Tarot Card - Copies an ability from anyone within 100 meters into your ability slot for 1 hour. 120 hour cooldown.

nodes.name: VII - The Chariot
nodes.description: Tarot Card - Teleports you to any location in your perception range, even through a camera. 120 hour cooldown.

nodes.name: VIII - Strength
nodes.description: Tarot Card - Boosts all physical abilities and dulls pain for 30 minutes. 120 hour cooldown.

nodes.name: IX - The Hermit
nodes.description: Tarot Card - Lets you read minds and thoughts for 1 hour. 120 hour cooldown.

nodes.name: X - Wheel of Fortune
nodes.description: Tarot Card - Temporarily swaps all active powers with random powers of the same rarity for 1 hour (For writing: done by rolling the gacha that corresponds with said rarity). 120 hour cooldown.

nodes.name: XI - Justice
nodes.description: Tarot Card - Clears all abnormal status effects like disease, poison, curses, and charms of Epic rank and below in a 10-meter radius. Cooldown: 120 hours.

nodes.name: XII - The Hanged Man
nodes.description: Tarot Card - Absorbs all of a target's wounds and ailments while lessening their intensity by 20%. 120 hour cooldown.

nodes.name: XIII - Death
nodes.description: Tarot Card - On contact, destroys any active effect, from an object's speed to a mythical ritual or an undead-animating spell. 240-hour cooldown.

nodes.name: XIV - Temperance
nodes.description: Tarot Card - Grants complete mental clarity and focus, dispelling all negative mental conditions. 48 hour cooldown.

nodes.name: XV - The Devil
nodes.description: Tarot Card - Summons infernal chains that restrain and weaken a target, though strong enough targets can break free. 48 hour cooldown.

nodes.name: XVI - The Tower
nodes.description: Tarot Card - Releases uncontrollable ruinous energy that can destroy entire city blocks, partially ignores durability, and disorients enemies. 120 hour cooldown.

nodes.name: XVII - The Star
nodes.description: Tarot Card - Restores all energy and stamina and resets all Ability Cooldowns. 240 hour cooldown.

nodes.name: XVIII - The Moon
nodes.description: Tarot Card - Constructs a convincing illusionary world of your choosing that fools all 5 senses for 1 hour. 120 hour cooldown.

nodes.name: XIX - The Sun
nodes.description: Tarot Card - Instantly recovers all health and resets all Item Cooldowns. 240 hour cooldown.

nodes.name: XX - Judgement
nodes.description: Tarot Card - Compels someone to tell what they believe is the truth without intending to trick you. 120 hour cooldown.

nodes.name: XXI - The World
nodes.description: Tarot Card - Permanently fuses two abilities of the same rank into an ability of higher rank. 240 hour cooldown.

nodes.name: Volcano
nodes.description: A flame sword forged from hell-depth ore. Amplifies Fire-based abilities when used as a focus.

nodes.name: Starlight
nodes.description: A light rapier forged from the Empress of Light's wing. Deals light damage and amplifies Light-based abilities when used as a focus.

nodes.name: Ghastly Glaive
nodes.description: A foreign-world glaive that summons wraith projections using the wielder's life energy. Amplifies Soul-based abilities when used as a focus.

nodes.name: North Pole
nodes.description: A crystalline spear forged from the shattered Ice Queen's remains. Lets the wielder fire frigid blasts with their own energy and amplifies Ice-based abilities when used as a focus.

nodes.name: Daybreak
nodes.description: A pure-energy spear from fallen-star shards. Lets the user hurl copy projections like javelins and amplifies Fire and Light-based abilities when used as a focus.

nodes.name: Sunfury
nodes.description: A flame flail from the underworld's depths. Creates an explosion on every impact.

nodes.name: Blue Moon
nodes.description: A flail from the cursed dungeon made of incredibly durable material, with a chain stretching up to 50 meters.

nodes.name: Ice Blade
nodes.description: A magically enchanted solid-ice saber that holds its sharpness. Releases frigid energy with your own energy and boosts ice abilities when used as a focus.

nodes.name: Space Dolphin Machine Gun
nodes.description: A space dolphin crafted into a futuristic machine gun that shreds any mundane material. Its fire rate makes ammo consumption hard to keep up with.

nodes.name: Onyx Blaster
nodes.description: A shotgun crafted from pure-darkness shards. Converts energy/mana into dark onyx bullets dealing unholy damage instead of consuming bullets.

nodes.name: Death's Sickle
nodes.description: A sickle from the Reaper's cold dead hands. Releases necrotic projections with your own energy and boosts Dark and Necrotic abilities when used as a focus.

nodes.name: Inferno Fork
nodes.description: A crimson trident from the cursed dungeon's depths. Fires flame blasts with your energy/mana and boosts Fire and Unholy abilities when used as a focus.

nodes.name: Last Prism
nodes.description: A moon prism. Infusing energy/mana releases incinerating light rays converging into one large laser, or greatly boosts light-based abilities when used as a focus.

nodes.name: Holy Water
nodes.description: A large glass vial of 500ml high-quality holy water for rituals or dealing with the unholy. Restock Timer: 4 hours.

nodes.name: Golden Cross
nodes.description: A golden cross blessed by a powerful angel. Worn around the neck, it wards off evil and curses and burns nearby demonic entities.

nodes.name: Super Absorbent Sponge
nodes.description: A sponge holding approximately 1,000,000,000 liters of water without changing size or weight.

nodes.name: Heavy Blade
nodes.description: A very durable longsword with controllable weight from 5 kg to 50,000 kg.

nodes.name: Metal Gear Excelsus
nodes.description: A gigantic multi-city-block-sized arachnid mech with retractable blades, giant plasma cannons, and uncanny mobility and dexterity. Built to withstand advanced nuclear weaponry, constantly repaired by nanomachines, with living quarters.

nodes.name: The Straw Hat
nodes.description: Holds great sentimental value to a certain sun god, but little material value.

nodes.name: Modified Compound V
nodes.description: Drinking it grants a random Gold Gacha ability usable even in ability storage.

nodes.name: Sharingan Jar
nodes.description: A pair of freshly unlocked Sharingan from Sasuke Uchiha, stored in preservative fluid. Can be implanted by a skilled enough doctor.

nodes.name: Byakugan Jar
nodes.description: A pair of freshly unlocked Byakugan from Neji Hyuga, stored in preservative fluid. Can be implanted by a skilled enough doctor.

nodes.name: Iron Man Armor Mark III
nodes.description: Iron Man's iconic armored suit. Useful but not particularly powerful, and very hard to repair if broken.

nodes.name: Infinity Gauntlet
nodes.description: The gauntlet itself, very durable, but stones not included.

nodes.name: Durable Baseball Bat
nodes.description: An extremely durable baseball bat that takes at least a nuclear bomb to deform.

nodes.name: Combat Armor
nodes.description: A tailored basic Combat Armor set. Place 10 kilograms of any ore inside, and after 24 hours the armor's composition changes to that ore or metal.

nodes.name: Kamui Senketsu
nodes.description: Sentient clothing made exclusively of liber that synchronizes with its wearer, extremely augmenting physical abilities while draining vitality. More durable than any manmade material, it can act independently and shapeshift into various forms.

nodes.name: Goku Uniform 1star
nodes.description: A school uniform of 10% Life Fibers granting superhuman strength to break walls and flip cars. Extremely durable beyond carbon fiber. Choose colors before taking it out.

nodes.name: Goku Uniform 2star
nodes.description: A uniform of 20% Life Fibers granting superhuman strength to punch through solid metal and throw cars. Extremely durable beyond carbon fiber. Choose colors and design before taking it out.

nodes.name: Goku Uniform 3star
nodes.description: A uniform of 30% Life Fibers granting superhuman strength to demolish buildings. Extremely durable beyond carbon fiber; choose colors and design before taking it out. Consuming your vitality unlocks a second form that further increases its abilities.

nodes.name: Your Laptop
nodes.description: Your laptop or computer from back on Earth, still connected to your Earth internet.

nodes.name: Infinite Bowl of Spaghetti
nodes.description: An infinite spaghetti bowl that cannot be poured out, but servings can be taken infinitely. The spaghetti is always comfortably warm and tastes pretty good.

nodes.name: Kanaedas Bike
nodes.description: A very fancy, fast, iconic sci-fi-ish bike.

nodes.name: Any Vehicle Voucher
nodes.description: Exchangeable anytime for any Mundane Vehicle in your world, from supercar to cruise ship. The vehicle teleports in front of you with all legal work handled.

nodes.name: Refined Heart-Shaped Herb
nodes.description: A Wakandan herb blessed by Bast, refined to remove side effects and mystical strings for safe consumption. Grants enhanced strength, speed, stamina, durability, reflexes, agility, and instincts. Restock Timer: 240 hours.

nodes.name: Senzu Bean
nodes.description: A mystical bean cultivated by Earth's guardian. Eating it instantly restores physical condition to peak, fully restores energy, and satiates for 10 days. Restock Timer: 720 hours.

nodes.name: Unknown Mask
nodes.description: A white featureless full-face mask removable only at the wearer's will or by breaking it. Opaque and resistant to thinker abilities, yet the wearer sees through it without issue.

nodes.name: Monster Cell
nodes.description: A hand-sized virus-like cell. Eating it makes you unbelievably stronger and transforms you into a monstrous creature with extended lifespan, at the cost of never developing further by natural means.

nodes.name: Uroboros Virus
nodes.description: A powerful transforming virus. Mismatched hosts become an anomalous mass of blackened matter with incredible regeneration; matched hosts gain enhanced stats and bio-immortality with commandable viral healing. Or pour the vial into the ocean and watch the apocalypse.

nodes.name: Tvirus
nodes.description: A highly viral super-virus mutating victims into enhanced zombie-like creatures with little brain activity. Rare compatible hosts gain only superhuman capabilities and regeneration without mutation, and a scientist might refine it. Or pour the vial into the ocean and watch the apocalypse.

nodes.name: Modified Tvirus
nodes.description: A modified T-Virus syringe granting all T-virus benefits with none of the downsides: superhuman physical abilities, regeneration, and telekinesis.

nodes.name: The Beherit
nodes.description: A red face-like egg that can call down the God Hand. Sacrificing your everything in the Eclipse lets you join the Godhand as an Apostle. ...If you're considering using this, something is truly wrong with you.

nodes.name: Chekhov's Box
nodes.description: A wrapped-gift box that gives precisely the item you need for the situation, as long as it is Rare rank or below. Vanishes once used.

nodes.name: Cloak of Levitation
nodes.description: A Sorcerer Supreme relic allowing free flight. Self-aware, it can pull its wearer from danger and hinder opponents on its own.

nodes.name: Plague Canister
nodes.description: A canister of the Plague, a self-replicating nanomachine virus devouring biomass and turning living things into mindless biomechanically enhanced zombies for its hivemind. Releasing it without sufficient biokinetic or techno mastery dooms the world, though without a core they lack a hivemind command center.

nodes.name: Mehrunes Razor
nodes.description: Mehrunes Dagon's dagger. Capable of cutting anything the user can interact with — space, time, soul, connections, etc. The only limit is the user, not the dagger.

nodes.name: Skeleton Key
nodes.description: Magical key of Nocturnal that can unlock anything the user perceives, from locks and walls to inner potential and portals to other worlds. Its only limit is the user, not the key.

nodes.name: Cloak of Elvenkind
nodes.description: A hooded elven cloak woven from shadow that renders the wearer invisible while the hood is raised and resistant to divination and scrying. Nearly undetectable while motionless.

nodes.name: Annihilation Maker
nodes.description: One of the strongest Longinus crafted by God that creates shadow monsters from the user's shadow by expending mana, with abilities based on the user's imagination and abilities. When removed from inventory, it is a small marble that fuses with whoever swallows it.

nodes.name: Unknown Dictator
nodes.description: Unknown Dictator, one of the modern Longinus, manipulates metal and technology on a massive scale and constructs advanced tech like ion cannons and aura engines at will without detailed input. Stronger users create stronger creations. When removed from inventory, it is a small marble that fuses with whoever swallows it.

nodes.name: Zenith Tempest
nodes.description: Zenith Tempest, one of the mightiest Longinus, controls weather, atmosphere, and natural elements like fire, wind, lightning, and water to call down lightning, country-wiping storms, and more. A powerful enough user can shred the planet's surface with violent storms. When removed from inventory, it is a small marble that fuses with whoever swallows it.

nodes.name: Star Buster Blaster
nodes.description: A highest-order Longinus built for simplicity whose sword can cut gods and whose gun can annihilate islands even in basic form. It is incredibly difficult to control, and a misfire may destroy the landmass the user stands on. When removed from inventory, it is a small marble that fuses with whoever swallows it.

nodes.name: Canis Lycaon
nodes.description: Canis Lycaon, one of the Longinus created by God, manifests an extremely powerful black wolf avatar wielding a cursed blade and lets the user sprout cursed blades from their body as weapons. With training, the user can wield cursed flames that prevent healing and sprout blades from any shadow in perception range. When removed from inventory, it is a small marble that fuses with whoever swallows it.

nodes.name: True Longinus
nodes.description: The greatest holy spear, containing a piece of God, bears a tremendous holy aura that can utterly annihilate any demonic being weaker than a god. With training, the user can access its variety of forms.

nodes.name: Telos Karma
nodes.description: Telos Karma, God's treasure, twists causality and fate to affirm the effect the user wants by altering history. Larger effects and stronger targets consume more energy. When removed from inventory, it is a small marble that fuses with whoever swallows it.

nodes.name: Regulus Nemea
nodes.description: Battle Axe of the Nemean, one of the Longinus crafted by God, is a large golden battle axe that protects its wielder from projectiles and can become an independent projection of the original Nemean Lion with invincible skin. With training, the user can unlock its Balance Breaker forms. When removed from inventory, it is a small marble that fuses with whoever swallows it.

nodes.name: Nereid Kyre
nodes.description: One of the newly manifested Longinus that controls the ocean and charms dragons through singing, limited by the user's singing and magical power. A powerful enough user can sink continents and tame the grandest dragons. When removed from inventory, it is a small marble that fuses with whoever swallows it.

nodes.name: Can of Pain
nodes.description: A simple cola-tasting canned drink that causes immense agony lasting up to several minutes. Restock Timer: 24 hours.

nodes.name: Nights Edge
nodes.description: A sword of night formed from the world's essences with exceptional durability and sharpness that enhances all darkness abilities when used as a focus. Under certain conditions, it can unlock true power comparable to Excalibur itself.

nodes.name: Moonveil
nodes.description: A glintstone masterpiece katana that projects the user's slashes as blue blades of light and amplifies spells when used as a focus.

nodes.name: Malikeths Black Blade
nodes.description: A sword carrying traces of Destined Death that unleashes black flames by expending energy/mana to permanently harm lifeforce. Wounds it inflicts cannot be healed by anything less than divine intervention.

nodes.name: Beginners Guide to Runecraft
nodes.description: A beginner's guide to basic Nordic/Scandinavian runecraft written personally by Allfather Odin. Studying it teaches the art of Runecraft.

nodes.name: Grow Your Own Golem Kit
nodes.description: A beginner-friendly golem-growing kit even a child can use, containing a person-sized pot, watering can, pack of cores, and notebook. Place a core, desired golem materials, and a specification note in the pot, bury it in any dirt in a sunny spot, and water twice morning and night for 7 days before digging up the finished golem. Energy-rich soil speeds the process.

nodes.name: Cape of Rebellion
nodes.description: A blood-red stained cape that proportionally augments the wearer's Physical Abilities and Regeneration for every negative status effect borne while wearing it, such as burning, poison, curse, freezing, bleeding, or blindness. (A/N: Gacha curses do not count).

nodes.name: Halo of Light
nodes.description: An angel's Halo worn like a hat that does not fall off unless removed. While worn, it grants resistance to all ailments, especially Dark and Infernal attacks and effects, greatly boosts Light and Holy abilities, and constantly applies slight healing to the wearer.

nodes.name: Devil Horns
nodes.description: A headband shaped as cartoonish devil horns that substantially boosts all Darkness and Infernal abilities and traits while worn.

nodes.name: Blade of Hatred
nodes.description: An old, worn, rusty blade covered in dried blood that is only as strong as it looks unless brandished against a target that has inflicted suffering on the user. Against such targets, it powers up proportionally to all damage they have ever inflicted, reaching legendary strength against a mortal enemy but remaining trash against a first-time opponent.

nodes.name: Brass Knuckles
nodes.description: A pair of simple but sturdy brass knuckles.

nodes.name: Ring of the Paladin
nodes.description: An enchanted ring of a legendary paladin infused with his prayers that holds 3 charges and recovers 1 charge every hour. Spend a charge to cast a Rare tier Heal, grant one Uncommon tier blessing like strength or agility, or bless an object with holy energy to create holy water or a temporarily blessed weapon effective against the unholy.

nodes.name: Earplugs
nodes.description: A pair of simple earplugs that completely blocks the wearer's hearing while worn.

nodes.name: Second Face
nodes.description: A simple white mask that makes the wearer appear as a completely different, always identical person, serving as a second identity.

nodes.name: Mirror Blade
nodes.description: A sword embodying envy that alone is only as strong as a sharp iron sword. It can temporarily become the strongest weapon within a 1 km radius for 1 hour, then enters a 24 hour cooldown.

nodes.name: Amulet of Imitation
nodes.description: An amulet that transforms you into the shape of any creature you touch while holding it until you dispel the transformation. Cooldown: 8 hours.

nodes.name: Light Sword
nodes.description: Not a lightsaber, this sword is crafted purely from solid light and is incredibly light and sharp but somewhat fragile. If broken, leaving it where it receives light gradually repairs it.

nodes.name: Private Jet
nodes.description: A luxury private jet with its own Golem Pilot and Golem Server that requires no fuel. Snacks and amenities inside replenish over time.

nodes.name: Charismatic Sunglasses
nodes.description: A pair of really cool-looking sunglasses that make you seem more charismatic.

nodes.name: Sword of Judgement
nodes.description: A divinely blessed sword that imbues great might and magical power and boosts holy and light abilities when used as a focus. It also fills the user with righteous rage, driving them berserk against unholy and undead beings unless tamed.

nodes.name: The Armageddon Blade
nodes.description: The mythical Blade of Armageddon that imbues great power but burns to touch and boosts fire and unholy abilities when used as a focus. The user can expend energy to call down Armageddon, raining hellfire from the skies onto the mortal world.

nodes.name: Sword of Hellfire
nodes.description: A sword forged and bathed in hellfire whose blade can be wreathed in violent flames by expending energy. It boosts fire abilities when used as a focus.

nodes.name: Angellic Alliance
nodes.description: A divine heavenly sword that greatly increases the wielder's physical and magical abilities, strengthens and inspires any army or allies under their command, and boosts holy and light abilities when used as a focus. The user can also expend energy to grant any blessing of Rare tier or below.

nodes.name: Titans Thunder
nodes.description: A thunder sword granting the power and might of giants, including extreme physical strength and the ability to rain down thunder by expending energy. It enhances lightning-based abilities when used as a focus.

nodes.name: Armor of the Dammed
nodes.description: Pitch-black armor with a demonic visage worn by the most wicked conquerors that augments physical abilities and amplifies darkness-based abilities when used as a focus. With training, it can unleash massive-scale curses like slow, misfortune, and weakness to debilitate entire armies.

nodes.name: Power of the Dragon Father
nodes.description: Armor crafted from a mighty dragon's corpse that imbues great physical might and extreme magic resistance through its scales.

nodes.name: Spellbinders Hat
nodes.description: A legendary archwizard's hat containing echoes of his spells that grants Dimensional Door (100 km portal), Fly (fly at land speed), Magic Mirror (reflect magic back), Implosion (severe explosive damage), and Summon Elemental (summon a chosen elemental roughly as strong as you for 30 minutes). This artifact holds 3 charges at a time and recovers 1 charge every 8 hours.

nodes.name: Admirals Hat
nodes.description: A legendary admiral's hat that conjures any mundane seabound vessel, from destroyer-class warships to cruise ships, manned by a spirit crew. You can summon a vessel every 720 hours, and wearing the hat grants Master rank Riding on any seabound vessel.

nodes.name: Cloak of Silence
nodes.description: While worn, this cloak prevents the user from using any magic below Epic rank and prevents any magic below Epic rank from affecting them.

nodes.name: Cape of Velocity
nodes.description: A cape that makes the wearer faster while worn.

nodes.name: Cloak of the Undead King
nodes.description: The legendary undead king's cloak that boosts all necromancy and soul-based abilities and removes the limit on undead controlled at once while worn.

nodes.name: Charm of Eclipse
nodes.description: A mystical charm emitting an aura that inflicts magical interference on those around the user, reducing their magical capabilities.

nodes.name: Wizards Well
nodes.description: A large cauldron filled to the brim with magical power equal to the user's maximum. It instantly refills to the brim at 8 am every morning.

nodes.name: Orb of Silt
nodes.description: An orb of raw ancient magical power that boosts earth-based abilities and magic for its holder.

nodes.name: Orb of Firmament
nodes.description: An orb of raw ancient magical power that boosts wind and lightning-based abilities and magic for its holder.

nodes.name: Orb of Driving Rain
nodes.description: An orb of raw ancient magical power that boosts water and ice-based abilities and magic for its holder.

nodes.name: Orb of Tempestuous Fire
nodes.description: An orb of raw ancient magical power that boosts fire-based abilities and magic for its holder.

nodes.name: Tome of Air
nodes.description: A legendary imbued tome from an ancient kingdom that lets its holder cast its contained spells even without training. Spells can also be learned through study to cast without the book. Spell List: https://heroes.thelazy.net/index.php/School_of_Air_Magic

nodes.name: Tome of Earth
nodes.description: A legendary imbued tome from an ancient kingdom that lets its holder cast its contained spells even without training. Spells can also be learned through study to cast without the book. Spell List: https://heroes.thelazy.net/index.php/School_of_Earth_Magic

nodes.name: Tome of Water
nodes.description: A legendary imbued tome from an ancient kingdom that lets its holder cast its contained spells even without training. Spells can also be learned through study to cast without the book. Spell List: https://heroes.thelazy.net/index.php/School_of_Water_Magic

nodes.name: Tome of Fire
nodes.description: A legendary imbued tome from an ancient kingdom that lets its holder cast its contained spells even without training. Spells can also be learned through study to cast without the book. Spell List: https://heroes.thelazy.net/index.php/School_of_Fire_Magic

nodes.name: Sphere of Permanence
nodes.description: A magical orb that prevents magic removal on a target, granting immunity to dispelling spells or abilities.

nodes.name: Orb of Vulnerability
nodes.description: A magical orb that lets its holder bypass immunities and resistances, such as harming living fire or poisoning a hydra.

nodes.name: Angel Feather Arrows
nodes.description: A quiver of infinite angel-feather-fletched arrows that retain maximum speed in flight until hitting a target.

nodes.name: Vial of Lifeblood
nodes.description: A vial of condensed vitality in blood form that grants enhanced vitality, minor healing, and increased lifespan when drunk.

nodes.name: Elixir of Life
nodes.description: The legendary Elixir of Life that grants boundless vitality, immunity to most poisons and illnesses, and a hundredfold lifespan increase when drunk.

nodes.name: Endless Purse of Gold
nodes.description: A purse of endless riches that fills with 500 200-gram pure gold coins every 24 hours and can hold an infinite amount.

nodes.name: Horn of the Abyss
nodes.description: An eldritch horn from the abyssal depths that raises the dead as shoggoths, fangarms, or other loyal deep creatures.

nodes.name: Archmages Robes
nodes.description: Suspiciously comfortable archmage robes that let you learn magic much quicker and amplify spells you cast.

nodes.name: Altar of Fire
nodes.description: An altar of fire that collects natural mana to birth fire spirits loyal to you as its owner.

nodes.name: Altar of Air
nodes.description: An altar that collects natural mana to birth air and lightning spirits loyal to you as its owner.

nodes.name: Altar of Water
nodes.description: An altar that collects natural mana to birth water and ice spirits loyal to you as its owner.

nodes.name: Elemental Conflux
nodes.description: An altar converging natural elements and collecting natural mana to birth spirits of all elements loyal to you as its owner.

nodes.name: Pyre
nodes.description: An ash altar that births firebirds and phoenixes loyal to you as its owner when given enough wealth and energy sacrifices.

nodes.name: Dragon's Hoard
nodes.description: - A cave with ideal dragon living conditions and plenty of treasure. Take its gold and gems for yourself or use it as storage for your valuables, which none can enter without your permission.

nodes.name: Dragon Utopia
nodes.description: A gigantic castle with ideal living conditions for practically any dragon, housing a horde of various loyal dragons. You can admit other dragons in exchange for servitude.

nodes.name: Hydra Pond
nodes.description: A large, incredibly poisonous swampy pond populated by Hydra loyal to you as its owner.

nodes.name: Nymph Waterfall
nodes.description: A magical waterfall where lesser water-spirit Nymphs are naturally born and remain loyal to you as its owner.

nodes.name: Maelstrom
nodes.description: A large water whirlpool containing many dangerous seabound creatures, including the sea serpent Haspid, under your command.

nodes.name: Magic Forest
nodes.description: A large forest with high magical concentration and unique herbs, populated by ents, treants, and even legendary unicorns under your command. It slowly replenishes itself over time.

nodes.name: Crystal Cave
nodes.description: A large cavern of unique red crystals holding potent magical power and energy, with crystal dragons under your command. Crystals replenish over time.

nodes.name: Frozen Cliffs
nodes.description: A gigantic frozen mountain range taller than Everest with extreme magical energy, housing many powerful dragons and the legendary azure dragon to serve under your command.

nodes.name: Cloud Temple
nodes.description: A gigantic temple over a kilometer tall and several wide that summons absolutely loyal stone Giants and Titans to serve you in exchange for wealth sacrifices like gold and gems. Beware, summoning costs are rather expensive.

nodes.name: Experimental Shop
nodes.description: A giant experimental workshop manned by talented loyal gremlin master artisans who craft items with provided resources. They can also build animated legendary stone giants and various golems to serve you.

nodes.name: Portal of Glory
nodes.description: A divine gate that produces angels to serve you over time when given enough energy and resources such as gold.

nodes.name: Garden of Revelations
nodes.description: A beautiful flower garden with a mystical aura where studying and learning magic is easier.

nodes.name: Fountain of Youth
nodes.description: A large ornate fountain whose waters reverse aging while bathing, rewinding one year of biological age per hour spent inside.

nodes.name: Magic Spring
nodes.description: A large spring of rapidly replenishing mana-rich water where bathing very quickly replenishes magical power.

nodes.name: Marika's Hammer
nodes.description: A partially broken yet supernaturally durable stone hammer that boosts holy abilities and spells.

nodes.name: Sacrificial Doll
nodes.description: A simple straw-and-twine doll vaguely resembling the user that can substitute for any sacrifice, including human, vitality, body part, or soul part, then vanishes. Only usable by the one who rolled it.

nodes.name: Relic Gold
nodes.description: A gold coin with no real use that all who see it perceive as incredibly valuable. You could trade it for a real artifact and the recipient would still consider it fair.

nodes.name: Stack of Gold Bars
nodes.description: A stack of ordinary gold bars totaling 33 kilograms.

nodes.name: Greedy Ring
nodes.description: An ornate red-and-gold ring that attracts wealth, making it easier to make money and find treasures.

nodes.name: Gold Ring Gift
nodes.description: A gold ring to gift a loved one whose patterns customize themselves to the recipient. Restock Timer: 48 hours.

nodes.name: Chlorophyte Bar
nodes.description: A refined Chlorophyte bar from the deep ancient jungles, far more flexible and durable than mundane metal, capable of converting sunlight into energy. Synergizes very well with bio and nature abilities. Restock Timer: 8 hours.

nodes.name: Aerolite Bar
nodes.description: A refined Aerolite bar from the sky islands infused with sky energy that releases wind and can emulate weather under special conditions when infused with energy. Synergizes very well with lightning and air. Restock Timer: 8 hours.

nodes.name: Astral Bar
nodes.description: A refined, nigh-unbreakable bar from the Astral Infection containing refined cosmic energy that releases cosmic energies when infused with energy. Restock Timer: 8 hours.

nodes.name: Broken Biome Blade
nodes.description: A broken sword handle that produces a blade with the properties of whatever element it is infused with when given energy.

nodes.name: Roxcalibur
nodes.description: The legendary sword in the stone that you could not pull out; wield it stone and all as a bludgeoning weapon. Meeting all original Excalibur conditions lets you draw it to gain both Excalibur and an unbreakable rock.

nodes.name: Sahara Slicers
nodes.description: A pair of arid daggers that manifests 10 arid shivs every 30 seconds to launch as a volley at opponents.

nodes.name: Unbreakable Blade
nodes.description: A simple sharp steel longsword that is completely unbreakable and undamageable.

nodes.name: Bag of Endless Coins
nodes.description: A bag that produces 1000 gold coins every day.

nodes.name: Endless Bag of Ninja Supplies
nodes.description: A satchel-sized bag holding 100 shurikens, 100 kunai, 100 caltrops, 50 explosive tags, and a katana, all high-quality steel. Contents replenish every 24 hours.

nodes.name: Portable Supercomputer
nodes.description: A laptop with power on par with humanity's strongest supercomputers that stays connected to the native internet regardless of location.

nodes.name: Bag of Ore
nodes.description: A torso-sized duffel bag yielding 33 kilograms of any mundane ore every 24 hours.

nodes.name: Portable Pharmacy
nodes.description: A simple satchel yielding any item found in an average pharmacy.

nodes.name: Droid Factory
nodes.description: An autonomous factory producing droids under your command when supplied with appropriate materials.

nodes.name: Flowing Water Crushing Rock Fist Manual
nodes.description: Bang's manual with detailed training in Flowing Water Crushing Rock Fist. Those without it cannot replicate the art.

nodes.name: Grimoire of Izalith
nodes.description: A grimoire teaching the Pyromancies of the Great Swamp and Izalith. Spell List: https://darksouls.fandom.com/wiki/Pyromancy_(Dark_Souls)

nodes.name: Tome of the Way of the White
nodes.description: Rhea of Thorolund's tome teaching all her Way of the White miracles. | Spell List: https://darksouls.fandom.com/wiki/Rhea_of_Thorolund#Miracles

nodes.name: Tome of Orbeck
nodes.description: Orbeck of Vinheim's tome of research and anecdotes teaching all his spells. | Spell List: https://darksouls.fandom.com/wiki/Orbeck_of_Vinheim#Wares

nodes.name: Rites of the Dragon Communion
nodes.description: Church rites for communing with great dragons to borrow their powers for miracles. Spell List: https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Dragon+Communion+Incantations

nodes.name: Rites of the Dragon Cult
nodes.description: Dragon Cult rites teaching miracles that imitate the great dragons' power. Spell List: https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Dragon+Cult+Incantations

nodes.name: Capsule Case
nodes.description: A case of 20 Capsule Corp capsules holding a house, fridge, oven, large preserved food stores, boat, high-tech motorcycle, etc. Any slightly upgraded mundane appliance or vehicle counts as a capsule here. Restock Timer: 48 hours.

nodes.name: Rites of the Erdtree
nodes.description: Rites of the ancient Erdtree worshippers teaching its miracles. Spell List: https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Erdtree+Incantations

nodes.name: Grimoire of Spatial Magic
nodes.description: A book of Clover Kingdom Spatial Magic secrets teaching its contained spells. Spell List: https://blackclover.fandom.com/wiki/Spatial_Magic

nodes.name: Grimoire of Lightning Magic
nodes.description: A book of Clover Kingdom Lightning Magic secrets teaching its contained spells. Spell List: https://blackclover.fandom.com/wiki/Lightning_Magic

nodes.name: Grimoire of Water Magic
nodes.description: A book of Clover Kingdom Water Magic secrets teaching its contained spells. Spell List: https://blackclover.fandom.com/wiki/Water_Magic

nodes.name: Grimoire of Ice Magic
nodes.description: A book of Clover Kingdom Ice Magic secrets teaching its contained spells. Spell List: https://blackclover.fandom.com/wiki/Ice_Magic

nodes.name: Grimoire of Darkness Magic
nodes.description: A book of Clover Kingdom Darkness Magic secrets teaching its contained spells. Spell List: https://blackclover.fandom.com/wiki/Dark_Magic

nodes.name: Grimoire of Light Magic
nodes.description: A book of Clover Kingdom Light Magic secrets teaching its contained spells. Spell List: https://blackclover.fandom.com/wiki/Light_Magic

nodes.name: Familiar Contract
nodes.description: A contract registering willing, informed signers in your gacha as familiars treatable like any other familiar. It fails if signed without knowing its function.

nodes.name: Master Blacksmith Commission
nodes.description: Rip this ticket to visit a master blacksmith's forge and commission any equipment by providing materials, then return and receive the item within 7 days at latest. The blacksmith is not a god, so limits apply. Restock Timer: 360 hours.

nodes.name: Giant Ominous Floating Obsidian Sphere
nodes.description: A gigantic pure obsidian ball, 5 km in radius, always floating 100 meters above ground. It constantly emits a humming pitch audible from over 50 km away. That's all.

nodes.name: Beauty Perfume
nodes.description: A bottle of pink perfume amplifying your attractiveness to the opposite gender.

nodes.name: Bellowing Dragoncrest Ring
nodes.description: A special everlasting-dragon-engraved ring for only the most accomplished Vinheim Dragon School sorcerers that boosts the wearer's magic strength.

nodes.name: Dusk Crown Ring
nodes.description: Princess Dusk of Oolacile's birth-gifted crown-shaped ring that converts a portion of vitality into energy/mana, increasing ability and spell potency.

nodes.name: Great Swamp Ring
nodes.description: A ring chiseled from flame-salamander bone by Great Swamp blighted Pyromancers that bolsters its wearer's flames, increasing fire ability and spell potency.

nodes.name: Chaos Witch's Ring
nodes.description: The Witch of Izalith and her daughters, scorched by the Flame of Chaos, offered this pyromancy-teaching ring to humans. It greatly bolsters its wearer's flames, increasing fire ability and spell potency.

nodes.name: Sage's Ring
nodes.description: A ring from a preacher twin, the Crystal Sages, to Farron's Undead Legion that eases learning and casting while worn, reducing spell energy costs.

nodes.name: Sahelanthropus
nodes.description: A nuclear-armed bipedal tank modified for a human operator, armed with a high-power railgun, guided missile launchers, retractable flexible nanofiber HF blades, and independent sensory drones deploying explosives, flamethrowers, and high-caliber machine guns. Its depleted uranium armor can be enriched by its internal reactor and detonated as a nuclear explosion. Ammo and missiles restock every 24 hours, and it self-repairs via nanomachines.

nodes.name: Twilight Healing
nodes.description: A Sacred Gear created by God manifesting as ornate rings that convert your energy into neutral healing energy for yourself or others, with potency scaling to energy expended.

nodes.name: Gravity Jail
nodes.description: A Sacred Gear created by God manifesting as glowing Magical Eyes that expend energy to increase gravity on any location or target in your line of sight. When taken from inventory, it appears as a marble that fuses with whoever swallows it.

nodes.name: Boosted Gear
nodes.description: One of the Longinus created by God housing Ddraig's soul, the Heavenly Dragon of Domination. This gauntlet amplifies your stats by expending stamina, with higher boosts costing more stamina.

nodes.name: Divine Dividing
nodes.description: One of the Longinus created by God housing Albion's soul, the Heavenly Dragon of Supremacy. These wings grant flight and divide enemies' magical power to replenish your own reserves, venting excess through the wings.

nodes.name: Holy Collider
nodes.description: A sword carved from the profaned god's corpse that emits divine flame explosions on contact and releases holy flames by expending your energy. Holy and fire abilities are amplified when using it as a focus.

nodes.name: Jackal & Casull
nodes.description: An unwieldy pair of hand-cannon pistols wielded by a certain vampire: white Casull and black Jackal. Each holds 6 rounds of 13mm blessed silver exploding rounds and requires supernatural strength to wield and fire without tearing your arms off. You receive 2 magazines every 24 hours.

nodes.name: Dragon Slayer
nodes.description: A massive dull unwieldy sword larger than a man and supernaturally durable. Having bathed in the blood of countless spirits and astral beings, it can harm and kill the immaterial.

nodes.name: Wastelanders Survival Kit
nodes.description: A true courier's loadout containing Elite Riot Gear, a fully modified Anti-Material Sniper Rifle, Riot Shotgun, .44 Magnum revolver, bowie knife, 5 repair kits, 10 stim packs, 5 doctor's bags, and 200 ammo for each weapon.

nodes.name: The Courier's Stash
nodes.description: A large briefcase containing lightweight metal armour, a double-barrel shotgun with 20 packs of 20 shells, 4 basic repair kits, and 5 stim packs.

nodes.name: Hei Gui Stealth Suit
nodes.description: Chinese special-unit armour for infiltration and stealth with dense armour and mesh. It emits a light-bending forcefield that renders the user invisible.

nodes.name: Feng Shui Engine
nodes.description: An advanced prosthetic eye housing a miniature Tandem Engine that generates extreme artificial Qi to massively enhance all physical abilities. Overuse may cause strain.

nodes.name: Enma
nodes.description: A masterpiece sword once wielded by Kozuki Oden with a will of its own that releases the wielder's energy in bursts. Until tamed, it forcefully drains and constantly releases the user's energy.

nodes.name: Shusui
nodes.description: A masterpiece sword once wielded by Ryuma, its blade permanently blackened from absorbing his hardening. It is nigh unbreakable, razor-sharp, and an excellent conductor of energy.

nodes.name: Pip-Boy 3000
nodes.description: A wrist-worn Personal Information Processor powered by an internal fission battery. It autonomously monitors your health, connects to networks, maps areas, shines light, and more.

nodes.name: Power Fist
nodes.description: A pneumatic power fist that boosts punches to superhuman level. It offers little benefit to those already superhuman.

nodes.name: Rasaka's Fang
nodes.description: A dagger carved from Rasaka's venomous fang, perpetually imbued with venom that paralyzes those it cuts and makes their wounds harder to heal.

nodes.name: Rasaka's Venom
nodes.description: A pouch of refined Rasaka venom; ingesting it fully grants increased physical resistance at the cost of weakened muscles, which poison resistance can negate.

nodes.name: Knight Killer
nodes.description: A large dagger built for heavily armoured opponents, dealing more damage against stronger armour.

nodes.name: Baruka's Dagger
nodes.description: An extremely durable, sharp large dagger wielded by a frost elf chieftain. It increases the potency of ice and cold abilities using it as a focus.

nodes.name: Demon King's Daggers
nodes.description: A pair of daggers forged from the demon king's corpse that synchronize with your strength, growing stronger proportionally. They increase the potency of unholy abilities using them as a focus.

nodes.name: Demon King's Longsword
nodes.description: A giant sword wielded by the demon king that summons devastating thunderstorms with each swing, growing stronger with its user.

nodes.name: Kamish's Wrath
nodes.description: A pair of daggers made from the dragon Kamish, nigh unbreakable and sharper than any manmade blade. They synchronize with your mana to adjust strength, and you can increase their weight at will.

nodes.name: Teleportation Amulet
nodes.description: An ornate platinum amulet that teleports the wearer anywhere they can see, with a 1-minute cooldown.

nodes.name: Divine Crucifix
nodes.description: A holy crucifix blessed by a divine spirit whose presence immensely weakens unholy and dark beings and instantly kills weaker ones. Holy or light abilities channelled through it gain potency.

nodes.name: Telepathic Implant
nodes.description: A neural implant for two-way communication with one target at a time within your perception. It manifests as a ticket that automatically installs itself when torn.

nodes.name: Ripperdoc Ticket
nodes.description: A ticket that transfers you to a mechanical Ripperdoc's clinic to install Cyberpunk 2077 implants or ones you bring, for the right price. His top-quality wares are expensive and may require bartering. You return upon leaving, can spend only 24 hours inside, and Restock Timer: 15 Days.

nodes.name: Clover Amulet
nodes.description: A golden amulet with jade engraved as a 4-leaf clover that grants good luck.

nodes.name: Holy Antidote
nodes.description: A vial of powerful holy antidote that cures all diseases and ailments below Legendary rank. Restock Timer: 7 Days.

nodes.name: Sandevistan
nodes.description: A cybernetic spine replacement that massively heightens time perception, slowing time around you while taxing your brain; overuse may cause brain damage. It manifests as a ticket installed instantly on whoever rips it.

nodes.name: Omni Phone
nodes.description: A mobile phone that connects to networks regardless of distance, with vast storage, an aeon-grade firewall, and supercomputer-surpassing processing power.

nodes.name: Ender Pearl
nodes.description: A round crystalline pearl of spatial energy that teleports the thrower to where it breaks. Restock Timer: 8 hours.

nodes.name: Character Card Wolverine
nodes.description: A character card granting yourself or another Wolverine's full healing factor for 10 minutes. 3 uses.

nodes.name: Bronze Heart Ticket
nodes.description: Think of the person you want to affect and rip the ticket to make them like you slightly more. It is not mind control but retroactive reality and probability bending, with no unwanted side effects.

nodes.name: Silver Heart Ticket
nodes.description: Think of the person you want to affect and rip the ticket to make them like you more. It is not mind control but retroactive reality and probability bending, with no unwanted side effects.

nodes.name: Gold Heart Ticket
nodes.description: Think of the person you want to affect and rip the ticket to make them like you a lot more. It is not mind control but retroactive reality and probability bending, with no unwanted side effects.

nodes.name: Royal Heart Ticket
nodes.description: Think of the person you want to affect and rip the ticket to make them like you considerably more. It is not mind control but retroactive reality and probability bending, with no unwanted side effects.

nodes.name: Cupid's Ticket
nodes.description: Think of the person you want to affect and rip the ticket to make them fall in love with you. It is not mind control but retroactive reality and probability bending, with no unwanted side effects.

nodes.name: Auto Doc
nodes.description: An autonomous advanced doctor station from Big MT. created by Doctor Mobius. This large capsule performs even the most complicated procedures with near-perfect expertise from simple instructions when hooked to sufficient power.

nodes.name: Blight Spewer
nodes.description: An advanced flamethrower spewing Plague Nanomachine clouds that seek flesh and devour it from the inside out. The nanomachines disintegrate after a few seconds as a safety precaution.

nodes.name: Shadethrower
nodes.description: A modified flamethrower converting regular burnable fuel into corrupted flames that rapidly rot whatever they burn.

nodes.name: Heavenly Gale
nodes.description: A divine bow crafted from earth and cosmos essences that converts any nocked arrow into exotic resonance crystals. They summon resonant lightning where they strike, powerful enough to flay gods alive and rend the surface world.

nodes.name: Telluric Gale
nodes.description: A bow crafted from the profaned goddess's remains that converts any nocked arrow into powerful scorching bolts of divine holy flame powered by your energy.

nodes.name: The Storm
nodes.description: A bow carved from the storm weaver's remains that converts any nocked arrow into a lightning bolt scaling with its wielder's power.

nodes.name: Hoarfrost Bow
nodes.description: A mystical bow made from the frozen castle's essence that turns any nocked arrow into freezing mist scaling with its wielder's power.

nodes.name: Lunarian Bow
nodes.description: A bow crafted from the natural world's elements that converts your energy into energy arrows to fire.

nodes.name: Phoenix Feather
nodes.description: Placing this feather on a corpse whose soul still exists and is not blocked by Legendary rank or higher resurrection prevention revives them, consuming the feather. Restock Timer: 720 hours.

nodes.name: Grimm Pool
nodes.description: A large jar of evil black goop that summons loyal lesser Grimm once it lands on a stable surface.

nodes.name: The Stand Arrow
nodes.description: An ornate meteorite arrow from outer space; those stabbed either slowly succumb to severe fever or, with enough willpower and potential, awaken a Stand (Roll a Platinum Ticket to decide which Stand gets awakened in the target.).

nodes.name: Wolverine's Skeleton
nodes.description: Wolverine's Adamantium-bonded skeleton, virtually unbreakable albeit short, with all genetic material scrubbed so no Wolverine will regenerate from it.

nodes.name: Nano Machine Heart
nodes.description: Senator Armstrong's high-tech nanomachine heart. Implanted, it massively enhances your physiology, absorbs other nanomachines, drains electricity to charge, and hardens against physical trauma or on command.

nodes.name: Danzo's Right Arm
nodes.description: Danzo's right arm in mint condition, made of Hashirama cells and implanted with 10 Sharingans. Implant it for Sharingan and Hashirama cell benefits, or dismantle it to use all parts separately.

nodes.name: Hashirama Cells
nodes.description: A vial of Hashirama Senju's living cells; if successfully implanted, they considerably increase vitality and energy reserves and grant considerable passive regeneration that consumes energy.

nodes.name: Rinnegan Jar
nodes.description: A pair of Rinnegan plucked from Nagato in preserving fluid, surgically implantable in yourself or others to gain their abilities. They require vast energy to handle.

nodes.name: Fire Release Jutsu Scroll
nodes.description: A large scroll recording all Fire Release Jutsu up to A rank for study and training. Those without the user's permission cannot understand its contents.

nodes.name: Water Release Jutsu Scroll
nodes.description: A large scroll recording all Water Release Jutsu up to A rank for study and training. Those without the user's permission cannot understand its contents.

nodes.name: Wind Release Jutsu Scroll
nodes.description: A large scroll recording all Wind Release Jutsu up to A rank for study and training. Those without the user's permission cannot understand its contents.

nodes.name: Earth Release Jutsu Scroll
nodes.description: A large scroll recording all Earth Release Jutsu up to A rank for study and training. Those without the user's permission cannot understand its contents.

nodes.name: Lightning Release Jutsu Scroll
nodes.description: A large scroll recording all Lightning Release Jutsu up to A rank for study and training. Those without the user's permission cannot understand its contents.

nodes.name: T-51b Power Armor
nodes.description: Pre-Great War mass-produced power armour that shrugs off low-calibre bullets and lets an average man lift a car overhead. Powered by a fusion core replaced with a new one every 24 hours.

nodes.name: Gene Seed Ticket
nodes.description: A ticket transporting you to robotic surgeons for a perfected Transhuman Astartes creation procedure, granting Astartes augments without downsides. It will not affect your looks or body shape.

nodes.name: Justice's Shades
nodes.description: The blind demon's cool shades that let you tell when someone speaking to you thinks they are lying.

nodes.name: E-11 medium blaster rifle
nodes.description: A standard Stormtrooper rifle firing high-heat bolts that kill average light-armoured targets in one shot and blast concrete. It has Lethal, Stun, and Sting settings with a 500-shot cartridge, replaced daily.

nodes.name: Soul Solid
nodes.description: Brook's cane sword, extremely sharp, durable, and undulled after years of use. It is also extremely dapper.

nodes.name: Wado Ichimonji
nodes.description: A Wano master-crafted great-grade katana, extremely sharp and absurdly durable. Excellent at channelling energy, making abilities channelled through it cost slightly less.

nodes.name: Tozama
nodes.description: A basic cursed short-sword tool, sharp and durable, able to interact with and harm spiritual beings.

nodes.name: Split Soul Katana
nodes.description: A powerful cursed large broadsword that ignores durability to cut physical matter and strike the soul directly, inflicting wounds unhealable by normal means.

nodes.name: Repair Powder
nodes.description: Enchanted golden powder; spreading the entire bag over a weapon restores durability and repairs damage if still in one piece. Stronger or more magical items need more powder. Restock Timer: 12 hours.

nodes.name: Threaded Cane
nodes.description: A workshop hunter weapon with a cane form sharp enough to hurt beasts. Its trick form splits into numerous blades forming a whip that rends and shreds flesh at range.

nodes.name: Chikage
nodes.description: An exceptional, incredibly durable katana wielded by Annalise's royal Vileblood guards. Its engraved runes let you sink the blade into your flesh to imbue it with vital essence and amplify its power. While wielding it, all Necromancy and Blood-based abilities are amplified.

nodes.name: Holy Moonlight Sword
nodes.description: An ancient sword wielded by Ludwig that expends your energy to channel the abyssal cosmos and wreathe itself in moonlight for amplified power. You can expel the moonlight for stronger strikes, release energy bursts, or channel your own powers through it for boosted power.

nodes.name: Reiterpallasch
nodes.description: A refined Cainhurst knight weapon combining rapier and gun without compromise. It transforms into a bayonet to amplify the gun, and you can convert your blood into quicksilver bullets to feed it.

nodes.name: Saw Cleaver
nodes.description: An iconic hunter weapon transforming between long cleaver and serrated saw. It grows stronger against more beastlike opponents.

nodes.name: Bottle of Infinite Lotion
nodes.description: A simple bottle containing infinite slimy lotion, squeezable manually. Tampering with the bottle breaks it.

nodes.name: Power Pole
nodes.description: Son Goku the Saiyan's incredibly durable Bo Staff, freely extendable in length by expending your energy.

nodes.name: Kubikiribocho
nodes.description: An oversized cleaver curved sword of the Seven Swordsmen of the Mist, incredibly durable and energy-conductive. However damaged, it repairs itself by absorbing blood.

nodes.name: Malorian Overture
nodes.description: A heavy-duty powerful Malorian Arms double-action revolver that punches through half-borgs with each bullet. You get 30 bullets daily.

nodes.name: Deed to Land
nodes.description: A land deed; rip it in half to have always owned land in a location favourable to you.

nodes.name: Deed to Mansion
nodes.description: A mansion deed; rip it in half to have always owned a lavish mansion maintained by an unseen, uninteractable Schrödinger crew.

nodes.name: Door to Jail
nodes.description: Opens a door to an automaton-maintained jail block where occupants cannot use abilities or a portion thereof unless allowed by you or your appointed warden, reduced to mundane human output unless specified otherwise. Occupants heal slowly and receive 3 meals daily from automatons.

nodes.name: Five Hundred Cigarettes
nodes.description: 500 generic non-brand cigarettes for taking the edge off.

nodes.name: Rust Bucket
nodes.description: Maxwell Tennyson's large cozy RV repeatedly upgraded with Plumber Technology. An effective mobile home that flies and carries numerous offense and defense systems.

nodes.name: Transformer Spark
nodes.description: A Transformer's being; imbue it into any sufficiently large technology to turn it into a Transformer registered as a familiar.

nodes.name: ColorS
nodes.description: A small book-like magic item that changes your clothing's color scheme by sliding your finger over it.

nodes.name: Gale Force Reading Glasses
nodes.description: Magical spectacles letting you read any held book 64x faster without losing comprehension.

nodes.name: Music Player
nodes.description: An indestructible music player with excellent sound, built-in speakers and headphones. It plays any song the holder has heard and archives it.

nodes.name: Archenemy
nodes.description: A sealed sword imbued with extremely uncontrollable magical power that unleashes a slash cutting several city blocks at minimum when unsheathed. Keep it sheathed.

nodes.name: Magic Ticket
nodes.description: A magical ticket granting a grimoire of a chosen Fairy Tail magic branch upon ripping. Excludes Lost, Ancient, Time, Space, Dragonslayer, Archive, or any magic above Elite tier; the chosen category becomes a studyable Grimoire.

nodes.name: FEV Vat
nodes.description: An industrial vat of Forced Evolutionary Virus turning any dropped-in human into a Super Mutant. Dropped-in animals gain increased abilities or die.

nodes.name: Null Void Projector
nodes.description: A handheld projector opening portals to the Null Void or banishing whatever it hits there, requiring recharge between shots. Incapacitating someone via the Null Void grants no feat.

nodes.name: Tome of Destruction
nodes.description: A tome compiling Skyrim's destruction spells for training and learning. Spell List: https://elderscrolls.fandom.com/wiki/Destruction_(Skyrim)

nodes.name: Tome of Restoration
nodes.description: A tome compiling Skyrim's restoration spells for training and learning. Spell List: https://elderscrolls.fandom.com/wiki/Restoration_(Skyrim)

nodes.name: Tome of Conjuration
nodes.description: A tome compiling Skyrim's conjuration spells for training and learning. Spell List: https://elderscrolls.fandom.com/wiki/Conjuration_(Skyrim)

nodes.name: Tome of Alteration
nodes.description: A tome compiling Skyrim's alteration spells for training and learning. Spell List: https://elderscrolls.fandom.com/wiki/Alteration_(Skyrim)

nodes.name: Tome of Illusion
nodes.description: A tome compiling Skyrim's illusion spells for training and learning. Spell List: https://elderscrolls.fandom.com/wiki/Illusion_(Skyrim)

nodes.name: Potara Earrings
nodes.description: A pair of magical earrings worn one each by two beings to permanently fuse them into one entity with the sum of their powers and abilities.
