nodes.description: Dubbed "Demon Armor", Incursio is a shortsword "Key" Teigu that forms incredibly durable armor massively enhancing physical abilities, with camouflage invisibility and semi-living adaptation that evolves with user compatibility at massive stamina cost. A highly compatible user can further evolve and fuse with it into its original beast's full dragon form. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master, can only be used by compatible people, and may kill an incompatible activator outright.

nodes.name: Demon's Extract
nodes.description: Dubbed "Demon God Manifestation", Demon's Extract is a chalice Teigu of super-class Danger Beast lifeblood granting those who fully drink and survive it telekinetic ice creation and freezing, including independent ice soldiers and functional ice arms. Surviving the drink requires inhuman willpower and a monstrous mindset. (A/N: No time stop trump card).

nodes.name: Perfector
nodes.description: Dubbed "Glorious Hands of God", Perfector is a glove Teigu that, when donned, grants finger dexterity and precision beyond any machine or tool. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.

nodes.name: Shitoukazer
nodes.description: Dubbed "National Defense Machine God", Shitoukazer is a massive pilotable mech Teigu entered via its chest core, with insane durability, physical strength, mortar barrages, homing missiles, and giant laser cannons. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it. (A/N: No Purge Mode).

nodes.name: Heavy Pressure
nodes.description: Dubbed "Great Tremor", Heavy Pressure is a microphone Teigu turning your voice into stone-shattering shockwaves and amplifying sound-based abilities. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by compatible people, usually cheerful young women for some reason.

nodes.name: Scream
nodes.description: Dubbed "Military Music Dream", Scream is a flute-like Teigu whose songs manipulate listeners' emotions toward anger, calm, courage, joy, or sorrow. Effects are resisted by strong willpower or dispelled by pain. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by compatible people with sufficient musical talent.

nodes.name: Shamshir
nodes.description: Dubbed "Moonlight Sword Dance", Shamshir is a durable sharp curved-sword Teigu firing flying slashes with your energy. Its power increases depending on the night's moon phase. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.

nodes.name: Murasame
nodes.description: Dubbed "One-Cut Killer", Murasame is a durable sharp sword Teigu that kills any living being with even a shallow cut via a heart-seeking poisonous curse, though stronger targets resist slightly. Experiencing great loss unlocks its trump card, briefly massively boosting speed and strength. As this item is a Teigu, it can only be used by compatible true killers who find it beautiful.

nodes.name: Balzac
nodes.description: Dubbed "Power Surging", Balzac is a strange-mask Teigu that, while fully worn, unleashes your full mental and physical potential past all limits while heavily straining mind and body. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.

nodes.name: Gaea Foundation
nodes.description: Dubbed "Phantasmagoria", Gaea Foundation is a large makeup-kit Teigu letting you disguise as any living being you have seen, with stamina drain rising as the form diverges from your body. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.

nodes.name: Rongo Rongo
nodes.description: Dubbed "Complete Book of the World", Rongo Rongo is a book Teigu containing a detailed map and encyclopedia of your entire world with locations plus future natural disasters like earthquakes, tsunamis, storms, and rains. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.

nodes.name: Mastema
nodes.description: Dubbed "Thousand Mile Flight", Mastema is a disk Teigu forming wings for flight and volleys of sharp durable feather projectiles. Skilled users unlock the "Gods Wings" trump card, turning wings ethereal to reflect projectiles at large stamina cost. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.

nodes.name: Adramelech
nodes.description: Dubbed "Thunder God's Rage", Adramelech is a gauntlet Teigu conjuring and sky-summoning electricity like lightning orbs, beams, and direct strikes by expending energy. Power scales with energy expended. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.

nodes.name: Extase
nodes.description: Dubbed "Cutter of Creation", Extase is a large-scissor Teigu with incredibly durable sharp blades that cut metal like ribbon. Its Trump Card emits blinding light from the blade. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.

nodes.name: Belvaac
nodes.description: Aptly dubbed "Double Bladed Axe", Belvaac is a dense short double-bladed axe Teigu landing devastating blows. It can split in two and be thrown to track opponents staying in range. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master, can only be used by compatible people, and prefers the very strong.

nodes.name: Black Marlin
nodes.description: Dubbed "Water Dragon Possession", Black Marlin is an ornate ring Teigu letting the wearer telekinetically control nearby water and water-based liquids with energy and stamina. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.

nodes.name: Big Leaguer
nodes.description: Dubbed "Chaos Throw", Big Leaguer is a Teigu of 6 throwable elemental orbs: Storm for whirlwinds, Explosion for blasts, Fire for searing flames, Ice for freezing, Lightning for electric bolts, and Rot for eroding mist. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.

nodes.name: Lionel
nodes.description: Dubbed "King of Beasts Transformation", Lionel is a belt Teigu transforming you into a half-beast lion with increased physical abilities and sharp senses. It grants exceptional vitality and regeneration, regrowing eyes and reattaching limbs while you have stamina. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master, can only be used by compatible people, and Lionel prefers free-spirited busty women.

nodes.name: Hekatonkheires
nodes.description: Dubbed "Magical Beast Transformation", Hekatonkheires is an ugly unlikeable dog-like Teigu that transforms into a larger form with great strength, blade-like teeth, and limb-regrowing regeneration unless its core breaks. Berserker mode further boosts it but leaves the Teigu unusable for a few days. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by compatible people; this overgrown rat has terrible taste. (A/N: Stylish modifications not included).

nodes.name: Horse Electrolytes
nodes.description: A full container of powdered horse electrolytes. Drink it. Restock Timer: 1 hour.

nodes.name: Apple
nodes.description: A regular juicy shiny red apple that repels registered practicing doctors within 25 meters while you eat it. Restock Timer: 24 hours.

nodes.name: Blood Vial
nodes.description: A Healing Church Blood Vial of diluted Blood Saint blood curing many ailments. Used moderately it considerably heals wounds and disease, but it is addictive and abuse can turn the susceptible into beasts.

nodes.name: Saint Blood Vial
nodes.description: A Healing Church vial of pure Blood Saint blood with potent Old One traces, powerfully healing even severe injuries and illnesses. Yharnam blood is addictive, and overuse can turn the susceptible into beasts.

nodes.name: Surströmming
nodes.description: A can of fermented Baltic Sea Herring that smells and tastes foul. Only a disturbed mind enjoys it. Restock Timer: 30 minutes.

nodes.name: Magician's Hat
nodes.description: A classic showman magician's hat that produces a rabbit or dove whenever you reach inside. Only one at a time, and you must reach in.

nodes.name: Artoria Fumo
nodes.description: A Fumo of Britain's true king that, when shaken violently, temporarily enacts Avalon as a nigh-absolute barrier on the shaker. You cannot move or use abilities while it is active.

nodes.name: Node Fumo
nodes.description: A Fumo of the White Queen, Node, that makes all cooldowns and restock timers pass 5x faster while you sleep in the same building or room as it.

nodes.name: Reimu Fumo
nodes.description: A Fumo of a certain destitute Shrine Maiden that, when shaken violently, erects a spiritual barrier against Unholy/Dark beings around a location. Only one barrier at a time.

nodes.name: Cirno Fumo
nodes.description: A Fumo of a certain Genius Ice Fairy that freezes a target when smacked with it while imbued with your energy. Potency scales with energy expended and impact force.

nodes.name: Remilia Fumo
nodes.description: A Fumo of the Scarlet Devil Mansion's mistress that, when shaken violently, grants you [Rabbit's Foot (Rare Trait)] luck for 24 hours, or inflicts [Jinx (Rare Ability)] for 24 hours when smacked on a target. Cooldown: 72 hours.

nodes.name: Flandre Fumo
nodes.description: A Fumo of a certain Destructive Vampire that, while held, lets you bypass all of a target's immunities and resistances like barriers, elemental immunity, magic resistance, and scrying resistance. (Does not bypass regular durability or magical toughness, etc.).

nodes.name: Patchouli Fumo
nodes.description: A Fumo of a certain lazy magician that boosts all comprehension and learning speed for everyone in the same room, especially magic study in libraries.

nodes.name: Eirin Fumo
nodes.description: A Fumo of a certain pharmacist granting temporary Adept Medicine skill and increased Healing ability and spell potency while held or worn on the head.

nodes.name: Suika Fumo
nodes.description: A Fumo of a certain drunk Oni that is exceptionally durable and can absorb your energy to temporarily increase density, making a fearsome bludgeon.

nodes.name: Youmu Fumo
nodes.description: A Fumo of a certain half-phantom sword master that, when vigorously rubbed on a sword, temporarily blesses it with greater sharpness and the power to hit spiritual entities.

nodes.name: Ran Fumo
nodes.description: A Fumo of a certain fox shikigami possessing Master level Mathematics that will tackle any posed question if given a way to write calculations. Shaking speeds the process.

nodes.name: Suwako Fumo
nodes.description: A Fumo of a certain Mountain God letting you terraform surroundings with energy by diverting rivers, raising mountains, moving forests, creating caves, and more. Cannot be used for combat.

nodes.name: Koishi Fumo
nodes.description: A Fumo of a certain easily overlooked yokai that boosts Stranger abilities and Traits while held or worn on the head. Left in a building or area, it makes that place easier to overlook and harder to perceive for newcomers.

nodes.name: Kaguya Fumo
nodes.description: A Fumo of a certain Lunar Princess that is eternal, returning to perfect condition almost instantly no matter the damage, tearing, smacking, milk-soaking, or wall-throwing.

nodes.name: Yuyuko Fumo
nodes.description: A Fumo of a certain Ghost Princess that passively attracts and pacifies departed souls. Affected ghosts and dead instinctively protect it and are far more agreeable to its holder.

nodes.name: Yuugi Fumo
nodes.description: A Fumo of the Strongest Oni granting the holder passive [Strength (Rare)] without using an ability slot while held or worn on the head.

nodes.name: Utsuho Fumo
nodes.description: A Fumo of a certain Nuclear Bird that, when shaken vigorously or bonked on the head, starts a 10-second countdown to a 50-megaton nuclear explosion it ignores. Cooldown: 240 hours.

nodes.name: Kanako Fumo
nodes.description: A Fumo of a certain Sky God letting you alter surrounding weather and climate with energy like seasons, rain, and clouds. Cannot be used to hurt others or for combat.

nodes.name: Mokou Fumo
nodes.description: A Fumo of a certain Burning Immortal Girl that is immortal, returning to perfect condition almost instantly no matter the tearing, smacking, milk-soaking, or wall-throwing. Any surface rubbed with it spontaneously catches fire.

nodes.name: Junko Fumo
nodes.description: A Fumo of a certain Grieving Woman that slowly purifies what it touches or maintains contact with, restoring rusted metal, curing disease, and clearing polluted rivers. Stronger Impurity or Corruption takes longer.

nodes.name: Tewi Fumo
nodes.description: A Fumo of a certain Rabbit Yokai granting temporary [Rabbit's Foot (Rare Trait)] good luck while held or worn on the head.

nodes.name: Meiling Fumo
nodes.description: A Fumo of a certain Lazy Gatekeeper that accelerates physical and martial development when training in the same room. Sleeping while hugging it greatly accelerates physical recovery.

nodes.name: Utsuho Deka Fumo
nodes.description: A Deka Fumo of a certain Nuclear Bird that passively produces up to 100 Terawatts of energy per second when hooked to something needing or transferring energy. While held, imbuing energy fires 50-megaton nuclear beams from its eyes.

nodes.name: Reimu Deka Fumo
nodes.description: A Deka Fumo of a certain Floating Shrine Maiden that, where placed, erects a Holy Spiritual Barrier sanctifying the area. All Unholy/Dark beings below Elite rank are repelled, and breach survivors are weakened.

nodes.name: The Table
nodes.description: A large, sturdy, high-quality oak table stolen from Ashford High School after Nina Einstein violated it.

nodes.name: The Chair
nodes.description: Vergil Sparda's iconic cheap plastic chair, rumored to greatly increase the motivation of anyone sitting in it.

nodes.name: The Master Sword
nodes.description: The Master Sword, Blade that Vanquishes Evil and former sword of Goddess Hylia bathed in Sacred Flames, is nigh unbreakable. It deals extreme damage ignoring resistances to ALL Unholy and Darkness targets, fires light slashes when imbued, and grows permanently stronger by absorbing Holy energy while housing blessings. Only a worthy Hero of proven Pure Heart, Courage, Wisdom, and Power can wield it.

nodes.name: Hylian Shield
nodes.description: The Legendary Hero of Hyrule's shield, tempered many times for the Knights of Hyrule. Besides absurd durability, it has great magic resistance and extreme resiliency to all Unholy or Darkness attacks.

nodes.name: Mirror Shield
nodes.description: An exceptional magical mirror-surfaced shield, only decent against physical attacks. It reflects all Light-based and Magical attacks hitting its mirror surface.

nodes.name: Bottle of Milk
nodes.description: A bottle of incredibly high-quality milk from Malon that restores some vitality and vigor when drunk. Restock Timer: 12 hours.

nodes.name: Earth Key
nodes.description: An ornate key that, turned in a sufficiently large space, opens a portal to a 20,000 km x 20,000 km x 20,000 km pocket dimension containing planet Earth. It holds a human-free version of Earth as untamed wilds. The exit gate stays open and leads to where the entrance was last opened.

nodes.name: Bathhouse Key
nodes.description: An ornate key that, turned in a sufficiently large space, opens a portal to a 250x250x250m pocket dimension holding a luxurious opulent bathhouse. Homunculi attendants staff, maintain, and serve entrants, and its water excellently restores Health and Energy. The exit gate stays open and leads to where the entrance was last opened.

nodes.name: A chocolate chip cookie but with the chips picked off for some reason
nodes.description: The saddest cookie you have ever seen. Giving it a restock timer would be an insult.

nodes.name: A handful of chocolate chips
nodes.description: Recently plucked off a cookie, still slightly warm with crumbs attached.

nodes.name: Space Stone
nodes.description: One of the Infinity Stones with power to change the universe, letting the user manipulate space, open portals, siphon energy from space, and more. A strong user is needed to unleash it without devastating consequences.

nodes.name: Dojo Key
nodes.description: An ornate key that, turned in a sufficiently large space, opens a portal to a 1 km x 1 km x 1 km pocket dimension containing a large dojo with a moderate garden. It holds training dummies, sparring weapons, running water, uniforms, towels, and more, all restocked and repaired within 24 hours with debris removed. Nothing originating from the dojo can be taken out. The exit gate stays open and leads to where the entrance was last opened.

nodes.name: Flynn's Ring
nodes.description: Flynn's ring of the fabled thief slightly increases the wearer's physical strength the less they carry.

nodes.name: Witch Ring
nodes.description: Rings bestowed by the Witch of Izalith and her daughter on pyromancy successors, thrumming with strange warmth. When equipped, they increase fire ability and spell potency while reducing costs.

nodes.name: Father Garcia's Trenchcoat
nodes.description: "True faith looks forward, not back." Father Garcia's iconic fairly durable black trench coat that wards curses and negative energy from the wearer.

nodes.name: Father Garcia's Shotgun
nodes.description: "You shall drink the wrath of the Almighty." Father Garcia's shotgun for fighting demons and evil spirits, whose bullets hit intangible entities and are more effective against Unholy beings.

nodes.name: Big Hat Logan's Big Hat
nodes.description: Big Hat Logan's titular uncomfortably large hat of the legendary sorcerer that makes studying magic slightly easier when worn.

nodes.name: Bold & Brash
nodes.description: Squidward Quincy Tentacles's Bikini Bottom masterpiece that refreshes to perfect condition every 24 hours to protect the canvas.

nodes.name: Monster Fucker Permit
nodes.description: "Officially Sanctioned by the Goat herself." Pointed at a monster or creature, this permit turns them into a more humanoid attractive member of your attracted gender and grants baseline intelligence if lacking. Authority figures accept it as legitimate proof you are qualified for monster-girl cases.

nodes.name: Berserker Armor
nodes.description: A Dwarven Blacksmith's exceptionally durable magical armor that fits the wearer perfectly. It boosts performance by suppressing pain and mental limiters, impales you to pin your body together when damaged, and self-repairs over time. It amplifies negative emotions, requiring careful moderation.

nodes.name: Metal Gear
nodes.description: A rather ordinary, if extraordinarily solid, iron gear.

nodes.name: Taimanin Changing Booth
nodes.description: A changing booth giving anyone a tailored Taimanin Suit for their abilities. Always skintight yet lightweight, mobile, bulletproof, exceptionally durable, and receptive to reinforcement abilities and spells. Only one outfit per person; re-entering repairs it.

nodes.name: Claidheamh Mor
nodes.description: "Don't even try to pronounce it" A very durable sharp zweihander that steals a portion of a beheaded victim's energy to refuel your own.

nodes.name: One Thousand Bottles of Baby Oil
nodes.description: Confiscated from a certain mansion. One thousand unbranded bottles of standard baby oil.

nodes.name: Soylent Green
nodes.description: A tin of Soylent Green that is unappetizing but nutritious enough to prevent starvation, with taste varying by person. Restock Timer: 1 hour.

nodes.name: Prismatic Cloak
nodes.description: A white cloak that turns the user invisible by bending light when exposed to natural sunlight. It also reflects all light-based attacks below Epic rank.

nodes.name: Truants Stopwatch
nodes.description: A silver stopwatch that, when started, speeds up the starter's perception. The longer it stays active, the more its energy drain grows exponentially.

nodes.name: Heavenly Tribulation Ticket
nodes.description: "Pissing off the Heavens has never been easier." When ripped, it summons a Heavenly Tribulation of sky-aimed energized lightning equal to an Epic rank attack meant to kill you. Withstanding and tempering with it considerably improves physical abilities.

nodes.name: Gravitational Beam Emitter
nodes.description: A super high-tech pistol-shaped device firing Condensed Graviton Energy Beams that rip through anything, with outputs from anti-personnel to anti-spacecraft. It draws energy from the user instead of ammo. Beware intense recoil.

nodes.name: The City
nodes.description: The City is a Dyson-sphere-origin megastructure of hyper-compressed defensive and computational layers, factories, cities, and terminals holding millions of impossibly advanced technologies and blueprints. Your key opens portals to any part and gives absolute command authority. For size it lives in a pocket universe but can open portals into your reality.

nodes.name: Erdtree Seed
nodes.description: A seed that sprouts a small ineffectual Erdtree, grown larger by supplying energy or ritually burying corpses beneath it. When strong enough it blesses those under its light, warding disease and curses, nourishing land, and boosting recovery and healing.

nodes.name: Undo Stone
nodes.description: Single use. Crush the stone to lock one of your unlocked nodes and refund its core and points.

nodes.name: Tree Graft
nodes.description: Three uses. Add a connection between two close, unconnected nodes.

nodes.name: Chaos Die
nodes.description: Single use. Roll to unlock a random locked node with rarity 5 or below for free.

nodes.name: Greater Wild Roll
nodes.description: Single use. Roll to unlock a random locked node with rarity between 5 and 7 for free.

nodes.name: Duplicate
nodes.description: Single use. Unlock a random locked node that shares a source with one of your unlocked nodes (source not Generic), with rarity 5 or below.

nodes.name: Lifeline
nodes.description: Single use. Unlock any node adjacent to an unlocked node for free.

nodes.name: Recall
nodes.description: Single use. Undo your most recent unlock: the node is locked again and its core and points refunded.

nodes.name: Shuffle
nodes.description: Single use. Exchange the location and connections of a visible locked node with a random not-visible locked node of similar rarity (±0.2). If no not-visible candidate exists, a visible one is chosen.

nodes.name: Node Swap
nodes.description: Single use. Exchange the location and connections of two visible locked nodes of your choice.

nodes.name: Reshuffle
nodes.description: Unlimited use. Like Shuffle, but costs a quarter of the chosen node's points cost each time.

nodes.name: Pal Sphere
nodes.description: The basic sphere for catching weakened Pals; it shakes three times, then clicks.

nodes.name: Mega Sphere
nodes.description: Improved catch rate over the basic sphere, for Pals past the early zones.

nodes.name: Giga Sphere
nodes.description: High-grade sphere that holds even sturdy mid-game Pals.

nodes.name: Hyper Sphere
nodes.description: Advanced sphere for powerful Pals; rarely fails on anything but bosses.

nodes.name: Ultra Sphere
nodes.description: Near-top-tier sphere with a catch rate worthy of endgame hunts.

nodes.name: Legendary Sphere
nodes.description: The ultimate sphere, forged for Legends; even a Jetragon can end up inside.

nodes.name: Portable Miner
nodes.description: Plop it on any resource node and it mines hands-free into its own little inventory.

nodes.name: Chainsaw
nodes.description: Clears whole forests in seconds and mulches wood and leaves into biomass.

nodes.name: Xeno-Zapper
nodes.description: Standard-issue electric prod; stings alien wildlife and gets stingers moving.

nodes.name: Rebar Gun
nodes.description: Fires sharpened rebar spikes; silent, cheap, and surprisingly lethal.

nodes.name: Nobelisk Detonator
nodes.description: Remote-detonated explosive charges for clearing rock, trees, and hogs.

nodes.name: Object Scanner
nodes.description: Pings the direction of selected resources, crash sites, and power slugs.

nodes.name: Blade Runners
nodes.description: Exoskeleton legs that boost sprint speed and let you powerslide under everything.

nodes.name: Jetpack
nodes.description: Packaged-fuel flight with a satisfying roar; keep an eye on the fuel gauge.

nodes.name: Gas Mask
nodes.description: Breathe easy in poison-pillared zones while the filter holds out.

nodes.name: Mercer Sphere
nodes.description: A humming alien artifact of unknown purpose that the hub desperately wants scanned.

nodes.name: Somersloop
nodes.description: An impossible looping doodad that overclocks any machine it touches.

nodes.name: Analysis Visor
nodes.description: Tag flora, fauna, and minerals through your visor; uploads pay out in Nanites.

nodes.name: Terrain Manipulator
nodes.description: Reshape whole landscapes, mine underfoot, and flatten base sites with multitool modes.

nodes.name: Boltcaster
nodes.description: The trusty starting multitool weapon; rapid plasma bolts with endless upgrades.

nodes.name: Blaze Javelin
nodes.description: A charged railbeam that pierces rock and sentinels alike.

nodes.name: Hyperdrive
nodes.description: Fold space between stars on warp cells; the whole galaxy opens up.

nodes.name: Minotaur Exocraft
nodes.description: A piloted mech suit with mining laser, stomp jets, and a cockpit with a view.

nodes.name: Living Ship
nodes.description: A grown void-egg starship that is alive: it gestates its own upgrades, bleeds, and sings in transit.

nodes.name: Foundation
nodes.description: Pave any terrain flat for building; the entire factory stands on these.

nodes.name: Solar Sail
nodes.description: Paper-thin orbital mirrors, launched by the thousand to begin the swarm.

nodes.name: Proliferator
nodes.description: A spray that overclocks production lines and multiplies their output.

nodes.name: Strange Matter
nodes.description: Exotic late-game material for the strangest recipes in the tech tree.

nodes.name: Antimatter Fuel Rod
nodes.description: Dense annihilation fuel that keeps Icarus flying between stars.

nodes.name: EM Rail Ejector
nodes.description: A mass driver that hurls solar sails and small carriers into orbit.

nodes.name: Gravity Gloves
nodes.description: Flick your wrists to snatch distant objects and ammo straight into your hands. Everyone calls them the Russells.

nodes.name: Combine Pistol
nodes.description: Standard Combine sidearm with reflex sight and resin upgrades.

nodes.name: Combine Shotgun
nodes.description: Double-barrel burst cannon that deletes headcrabs up close.

nodes.name: Combine SMG
nodes.description: Rapid-fire Combine automatic with an energy-ball secondary fire.

nodes.name: Xen Grenade
nodes.description: Volatile Xen flora that detonates seconds after you grab it. Throw fast.

nodes.name: Climbing Axe
nodes.description: Lara's iconic axe: climbs ice walls, pries doors, and ends fights.

nodes.name: Recurve Bow
nodes.description: Silent with retrievable arrows; rope, fire, and poison upgrades with tinkering.

nodes.name: Heavy Pistol
nodes.description: Hard-hitting sidearm for when stealth stops being an option.

nodes.name: Rope Ascender
nodes.description: Motorized ascender that zips you up ropes and rappels you down cliffs.

nodes.name: Seaglide
nodes.description: Handheld underwater scooter with light and sonar map; every diver's first love.

nodes.name: Seamoth
nodes.description: Nippy one-person sub with crush-depth upgrades and a perimeter defense zapper.

nodes.name: Prawn Suit
nodes.description: Powered exosuit with drill and grapple arms, for punching leviathans in the face.

nodes.name: Cyclops
nodes.description: A full submarine base with silent running, decoys, and room for a Seamoth in the belly.

nodes.name: Habitat Builder
nodes.description: Prints seabase modules from titanium anywhere with a flat-ish seabed.

nodes.name: Stasis Rifle
nodes.description: Freezes anything in a time bubble, up to and including Reapers. Briefly.

nodes.name: Thermoblade
nodes.description: Superheated survival knife that cooks fish as it cuts them.

nodes.name: Ultra Glide Fins
nodes.description: Slick fins that make you properly fast underwater.

nodes.name: Focus
nodes.description: Ear-mounted AR that scans machines, tags weak points, and replays echoes of the past.

nodes.name: Shield-Weaver
nodes.description: Ancient power armor projecting a rechargeable energy shield around its wearer.

nodes.name: Ropecaster
nodes.description: Pins machines down with tethers; enough ropes will tie down a Thunderjaw.

nodes.name: Tripcaster
nodes.description: Lays shock, fire, and explosive tripwires for the ambush engineer.

nodes.name: Blast Sling
nodes.description: Lobs proximity bombs in a satisfying arc with a bigger boom.

nodes.name: Tearblaster
nodes.description: Close-range cannon blast that rips armor plates and components clean off.

nodes.name: Black Lotus
nodes.description: Sacrifice it for three mana of any color. The most famous cardboard on Earth.

nodes.name: Mox Pearl
nodes.description: Zero-mana artifact that taps for white. Power Nine fast mana.

nodes.name: Mox Ruby
nodes.description: Zero-mana artifact that taps for red. Power Nine fast mana.

nodes.name: Mox Sapphire
nodes.description: Zero-mana artifact that taps for blue; the priciest of the five Moxen.

nodes.name: Mox Jet
nodes.description: Zero-mana artifact that taps for black. Power Nine fast mana.

nodes.name: Mox Emerald
nodes.description: Zero-mana artifact that taps for green. Power Nine fast mana.

nodes.name: Charge Rifle
nodes.description: Spacer-tech pulse rifle that outshoots anything short of a charge lance.

nodes.name: Charge Lance
nodes.description: Long-range armor-melting spacer rifle; one shot can delete a torso.

nodes.name: Healer Mech Serum
nodes.description: Glitterworld nanomachines that regenerate scars, missing organs, and chronic ills.

nodes.name: Resurrector Mech Serum
nodes.description: Brings back the recently dead, full resurrection psychosis side effects included.

nodes.name: Tranquilizer Rifle
nodes.description: Long-range nonlethal takedowns; one dart naps a guard for minutes.

nodes.name: Zenith 10mm Pistol
nodes.description: Custom compact pistol, whisper-quiet with a suppressor and laser sight.

nodes.name: Nanoceramic Blade
nodes.description: Monomolecular sword that cuts through armor, bots, and bad decisions.

nodes.name: Service Weapon
nodes.description: The Director's shapeshifting gun: Spin, Grip, Shatter, Pierce, and Charge forms in one impossible object.

nodes.name: Hotline
nodes.description: A red Bakelite phone that calls the Board directly, geometry optional.

nodes.name: Hedron Resonance Amplifier
nodes.description: Wearable Hedron tech that shields the mind from Hiss resonance.

nodes.name: Vacpack
nodes.description: Vacuum, shoot, and store slimes, food, and plorts with four color-coded tanks.

nodes.name: Slime Key
nodes.description: A statue-shaped key that opens Slime Gates into new ranch zones.

nodes.name: Flak Cannon
nodes.description: Blast Shotgun crossed with more shotgun: the all-powerful flak answer to everything.

nodes.name: Blast Shotgun
nodes.description: Bomb plus shotgun: spread explosives that clear whole microbe waves.

nodes.name: Dice Turret
nodes.description: A gambling turret whose wild random shots somehow always pay off.

nodes.name: Idol of Rebirth
nodes.description: A full idol that automatically resurrects its bearer once, then crumbles.

nodes.name: Resurrection Scroll
nodes.description: Bring an ally back mid-fight; every tactician carries a stack.

nodes.name: Q-Up Coin
nodes.description: The perfectly fair coin at the heart of the coin-flipping esport. Fifty-fifty. Totally fair.

nodes.name: Identity Disc
nodes.description: A program's everything on a glowing disc: memory, weapon, and backup, worn on the back.

nodes.name: Impossible Shard
nodes.description: A shard of Impossible rarity; slotting it multiplies everything your build does.

nodes.name: Passenger Blimp
nodes.description: A lumbering passenger blimp that ferries citizens across your skyline in style.

nodes.name: Space Elevator
nodes.description: A unique-building space elevator that fires tourists and freight straight into orbit.

nodes.name: Instant Camera
nodes.description: An instant camera for capturing the moments that matter, before you rewind them.

nodes.name: Planetary Shield
nodes.description: A planet-wide shield generator that shrugs off anything short of a star going out.

nodes.name: Vertical Launching Silo
nodes.description: A silo that launches rockets, warpers, and sphere components straight into orbit.

nodes.name: Power Armor
nodes.description: Modular power armor with room for exoskeletons, shields, batteries, and a personal fusion reactor.

nodes.name: Personal Roboport
nodes.description: A wearable roboport that deploys your own construction robots wherever you stand.

nodes.name: Blueprint Book
nodes.description: A book of stamped-down factory blueprints; plop down entire production blocks at once.

nodes.name: Scout Launcher
nodes.description: A wrist-mounted launcher firing a reusable camera probe that photographs the unknown.

nodes.name: Signalscope
nodes.description: A zoomable signal-finder that tunes into quantum fluctuations, distress calls, and music.

nodes.name: Ash Twin Project
nodes.description: The Nomai station at the heart of the 22-minute loop; knowing it exists changes everything.

nodes.name: The Generator
nodes.description: A towering coal-fired Generator, the last source of heat on Earth; the city lives or dies with it.

nodes.name: Steam Hub
nodes.description: A portable steam hub extending the Generator's warmth to distant districts.

nodes.name: Atmo Suit
nodes.description: A sealed suit with its own oxygen supply for space, magma, and chlorine zones alike.

nodes.name: Super Computer
nodes.description: A humming research station that turns raw data and power into steady research progress.

nodes.name: Drakkar
nodes.description: A clinker-built Viking longship that outruns sea serpents with the wind behind it.

nodes.name: Megingjord
nodes.description: Thor's strength belt, granting the bearer the carrying might of a giant.

nodes.name: Wishbone
nodes.description: A dowsing wishbone that tugs toward buried silver and hidden treasure.

nodes.name: Pickaxe
nodes.description: A tempered pickaxe for rock, dirt, and the occasional glyphid skull.

nodes.name: Flare Gun
nodes.description: Fires a burning flare that sticks where it lands and lights up the whole cave.

nodes.name: Terrain Tool
nodes.description: A deformable-terrain multitool for digging, flattening, and analyzing alien soil.

nodes.name: Shuttle
nodes.description: A single-seat interplanetary shuttle; pack solid fuel and pick a landing zone.

nodes.name: RTG
nodes.description: A radioisotope thermoelectric generator delivering endless quiet power.

nodes.name: Spiked Baseball Bat
nodes.description: A Louisville classic wrapped in nails; quiet, reliable, and permanently bloody.

nodes.name: Sledgehammer
nodes.description: Destroys walls, doors, and skulls with equal enthusiasm. Heavy, though.

nodes.name: Generator
nodes.description: A portable gas generator that keeps the lights and freezers on after the grid dies.

nodes.name: Galaxy Sword
nodes.description: A sword forged from a galaxy soul; the finest blade the Adventurer's Guild has ever seen.

nodes.name: Junimo Hut
nodes.description: A hut housing Junimos who emerge each morning to harvest your crops for you.

nodes.name: Tinder
nodes.description: Produce and control weak flames about as strong as matchsticks or bonfires.

nodes.name: Ember
nodes.description: Produce and control moderate flames that can be shaped into attacks like fireballs and fire arrows.

nodes.name: Blaze
nodes.description: Produce and control flames to unleash streams, arrows, whips, walls of fire, and similar attacks.

nodes.name: Pyrokinesis
nodes.description: Produce and control your own or natural flames with fine control, shaping them into arrows, blades, walls, projectiles, and similar forms.

nodes.name: Hellflames
nodes.description: Emit and control powerful flames on a large scale, unleashing giant flamethrowers or compressing flames into laser-like points, with extreme flame resistance. Overuse causes overheating, lowering your maximum energy output.

nodes.name: Micro Pyrokinesis
nodes.description: Control heat and flames on a small scale with atomic precision, though weak in power and temperature.

nodes.name: Disaster Flames
nodes.description: Embody humanity's fear of wildfires, eruptions, and flames, granting very potent pyrokinesis plus lava generation and manipulation. Your conceptual flames are far less restrained by ordinary limitations.

nodes.name: Amaterasu
nodes.description: Ignite an object in your line of sight with Amaterasu flames that can burn anything and cannot be extinguished by normal means. Repeated use strains your eye, causing bleeding or blindness.

nodes.name: Frenzied Flame
nodes.description: Wield and manipulate the Frenzied Flame, a cosmic fire that can burn minds, souls, and space. Increased use causes mental instability and obsession with destruction.

nodes.name: Ignite
nodes.description: Instantly set any object you touch aflame; stronger targets are harder to ignite. With training, you can ignite adjacent objects.

nodes.name: Conflagration
nodes.description: Instantly set any target or area you touch aflame; stronger targets are harder to ignite. One touch can burn entire buildings, and with training, entire cities.

nodes.name: Mystic Eyes of Flame
nodes.description: Raise the temperature of and spontaneously combust any target in your line of sight; stronger targets cost more energy. While active, your eye turns red with three overlapping triangles.

nodes.name: Fire Cloak
nodes.description: Cloak yourself and your surroundings in flame that ignites nearby non-friendly targets, though it may fail on stronger opponents. While active, all fire-based abilities are slightly more potent.

nodes.name: Fireball
nodes.description: Form and launch fireballs from your hands or other appendages; size and potency depend on energy expended.

nodes.name: Flame Weaponry
nodes.description: Emit fire shaped into any cold weaponry such as swords, axes, hammers, bows, and crossbows. The flames mimic the weapon's properties, staying sharp as a sword or heavy as a hammer.

nodes.name: Frostflare
nodes.description: Emit and control incredibly powerful Frostflare, flames that freeze instead of burning. While using it, you gain incredible ice and cold resistance in exchange for vulnerability to flame.

nodes.name: Fire Absorption
nodes.description: Absorb fire into your body to release later as your own flames or convert into energy. Strong flames may be impossible or painful to absorb, and absorbing too much without releasing causes internal burning.

nodes.name: Pyromaster
nodes.description: Control flames and ignition on the level of a Level 5 Esper from Toaru, with unmatched precision, range, and control.

nodes.name: Unholy Flames
nodes.description: Wield Hell flames so potent even you are not fully immune, suffering burns from overuse. They deal severe damage to Holy and Light-based beings.

nodes.name: Profaned Flames
nodes.description: Channel and control Providence's Profaned Flames, which are incomparably hot, turn all to impartial ash, and ignore all fire resistance.

nodes.name: Profaned Guardian Transformation
nodes.description: Temporarily take the form of one of Providence's guardians, massively boosting physical stats and granting flame wings and Profaned Flame manipulation. Maintaining it slowly burns you from the inside until released, mitigated only by fire resistance.

nodes.name: Shadowflames
nodes.description: Emit and control Shadowflame, soundless flames with no energy signature that burn away light, making them extremely hard to perceive. An experienced user can hide them from all senses.

nodes.name: Fire Fist
nodes.description: Coat your fists in flames that enhance strike power while burning the target. You can release the fire while punching to launch a burning fist projectile.

nodes.name: Fire Logia
nodes.description: Emit, create, shape, control, and turn into fire and flame at will, becoming living fire.

nodes.name: Coat Flames
nodes.description: Coat any object you touch in a layer of flames that does not harm the object's integrity.

nodes.name: Enflame
nodes.description: Coat a held object or your own body in flames that reinforce it and mimic its properties. Coated fists gain blunt force, while coated blades gain cutting ability plus flames.

nodes.name: Heat Object
nodes.description: Heat any object by touching it; more energy makes it hotter and faster.

nodes.name: Heat Metal
nodes.description: Raise the temperature of any metal in sensory range; more energy makes it hotter and faster.

nodes.name: Heatwave
nodes.description: Unleash waves of pure heat from your body as directed waves or omnidirectional heat.

nodes.name: Sunny Day
nodes.description: Change the weather to harsh sunlight, weakening nearby water-based abilities while boosting fire-based abilities.

nodes.name: Desolate Land
nodes.description: Transform weather and land into Desolate Land, with burning sunlight, scorched land, lava rivers, raised temperature, and no moisture. It largely amplifies Fire and Earth abilities, nullifies Water abilities below Epic rank, and weakens those above.

nodes.name: Kamino
nodes.description: Chant "Kamino" to manifest an immensely powerful, hot fire arrow. Its wind-up is slow, but its destructive power compensates.

nodes.name: Blazing Courage
nodes.description: Coat an object in flames that imitate its aspects, such as sharp or blunt flames.

nodes.name: Dark Flames
nodes.description: Emit and control humanity's Black Flames, which do not burn or emit heat but have mass greater than most metals, shredding what they touch instead of burning it.

nodes.name: Extinguish Flames
nodes.description: Remotely extinguish any fire or flame in sensory range; stronger flames cost more energy.

nodes.name: Godslayer Apostle Flames
nodes.description: Wield and control the Godskin Apostles' Godslayer Flames, already strong but significantly hotter and more potent against the divine. The more divine the enemy, the more potent the flames.

nodes.name: Blood Flames
nodes.description: Wield and control Blood Flames, which cost vitality and health instead of energy. They are much more potent than regular flames, lacerate on contact, and are extremely hard to heal.

nodes.name: Bloodflame Talons
nodes.description: Conjure talons of bloodflame that burn and lacerate. They cost health and vitality instead of energy, with more vitality producing stronger claws.

nodes.name: Heat Vision
nodes.description: Emit laser beams of extreme heat from your eyes, concentrating them for more power over less area or spreading them for less power over more area. Beams weaken over distance.

nodes.name: Flame Burst
nodes.description: Unleash a concentrated burst of flame like a beam from your hands, or a continuous but less powerful beam of fire.

nodes.name: Fire Claws
nodes.description: Grow very durable, sharp fingernail claws that can be covered in very hot flames. They can carve apart and melt metal.

nodes.name: Flamethrower
nodes.description: Unleash a constant stream of fire from anywhere on your body; more energy makes it hotter and more potent.

nodes.name: Combustion
nodes.description: Create explosions of flame from anywhere on your body.

nodes.name: Fire Breath
nodes.description: Unleash a dragon-like breath attack of very powerful flame; charging longer and expending more energy increases power.

nodes.name: Explosive Sweat
nodes.description: Sweat a highly explosive compound on demand and detonate it at any time to unleash powerful explosions.

nodes.name: Explosion
nodes.description: Create and project flame explosions at will as condensed glowing-bullet projectiles that explode on contact. With mastery, you can send streams of explosive energy from fingers and palms.

nodes.name: Detonation
nodes.description: Charge any held item with explosive energy to detonate at any time like a time bomb; the energy fades over time. More energy means a stronger explosion.

nodes.name: Explosion!
nodes.description: Call down an incredibly powerful sky explosion like divine wrath or a thermonuclear warhead. Longer charging and more energy make it stronger.

nodes.name: Heat Palm
nodes.description: Heat your palms to red-hot levels, palms only.

nodes.name: Magma Logia
nodes.description: Create, control, and transform into lava and magma at will, becoming a living eruption.

nodes.name: Eruption
nodes.description: Slam the ground to make magma/lava erupt like a volcano. With training, you can unleash it from any sufficiently large surface.

nodes.name: Lava
nodes.description: Create and control magma/lava at will, such as volcanic rocks, lava whips, lava lakes, magma bullets, and similar forms.

nodes.name: Match
nodes.description: Light a small flame on your fingers, barely qualifying as a lighter.

nodes.name: Droplet
nodes.description: Conjure small streams of water dripping from your fingers, barely enough to wash your hands.

nodes.name: Spray Water
nodes.description: Unleash a spray of water from your hands like a showerhead or hose, useful for dousing people and putting out fires.

nodes.name: Sprinkle
nodes.description: Telekinetically control water to a minor degree, too weak to injure but able to douse targets or remove moisture from inanimate objects.

nodes.name: Create Water
nodes.description: Create large volumes of fresh water from your hands without controlling it; the stream is strong enough to seriously hurt someone.

nodes.name: Flood
nodes.description: Create and release extreme volumes of water from your body without controlling it, enough to flood a building at base level and streets or towns with training.

nodes.name: Geyser
nodes.description: Create geysers of water erupting from the ground around you; more energy makes them more powerful.

nodes.name: Mist
nodes.description: Create and control mist to obscure, hinder, and smother flames. With training, you can make freezing ice mist or condense mist into physical obstacles and attacks.

nodes.name: Lesser Hydrokinesis
nodes.description: Telekinetically create and control water around yourself; not particularly powerful but versatile and precise.

nodes.name: Hydrosmith
nodes.description: Control and shape any water you physically touch, with no control once untouched. While maintaining contact you can freely morph and move it; more energy controls larger quantities with more power.

nodes.name: Micro Hydrokinesis
nodes.description: Control water on a small scale with atomic precision, though power and range are negligible.

nodes.name: Hydro Pump
nodes.description: Create and emit high-volume, high-pressure water streams from your body strong enough to tear through concrete like paper.

nodes.name: Sponge
nodes.description: Absorb and store vast quantities of water in your body by touch, releasing it at any time.

nodes.name: Dehydration
nodes.description: Evaporate moisture inside an object or target through contact, turning trees to dust and crumbling most rocks. Living targets resist more strongly and are much harder to affect.

nodes.name: Drought
nodes.description: Remotely evaporate water in sensory range by expending energy; larger quantities cost more. With training, you can evaporate water inside objects in range, though magical waters and water in more powerful objects cost more energy.

nodes.name: Water Manipulation
nodes.description: Create and control water; more energy controls larger quantities with more force.

nodes.name: Hydrokinesis
nodes.description: Telekinetically control Water (H2O), freely controlling, moving, shaping it and other water-based targets.

nodes.name: Razorblade Typhoon
nodes.description: Create miniature typhoons like disks of whirling water razor-saw blades to deal devastating damage. They can lock onto and home in on targets.

nodes.name: Whirlpool
nodes.description: Create and control water whirlpools for use as barriers, projectiles, or hindrances.

nodes.name: Rain
nodes.description: Make it rain from the sky; more energy increases scale. It slightly boosts water-based abilities and slightly weakens fire-based ones.

nodes.name: Torrent
nodes.description: Change local weather to heavy rain, boosting water-based abilities while weakening fire-based abilities.

nodes.name: Primordial Sea
nodes.description: Call down the primordial sea as torrential downpour and mighty land-swallowing waves. It greatly boosts water-based abilities, snuffs out fire-based abilities below Epic rank, and greatly weakens those above.

nodes.name: Dampen
nodes.description: Dampen any touched object by making it more moist.

nodes.name: Dry
nodes.description: Dry any touched object, removing only abnormal moisture rather than all internal water particles.

nodes.name: Aquamaster
nodes.description: Create and control Water (H2O) on the scale of a Level 5 Esper from Toaru, with incredible range, power, and unmatched precision.

nodes.name: Holy Water Tap
nodes.description: Create and control holy water, very effective against unholy beings. More energy creates more water or more potent holy water.

nodes.name: Hydrofreeze
nodes.description: Create, control, and turn into water and ice, allowing water-form escapes, dodges, icicles, freezing, and similar tricks. Water or ice form shares water's vulnerabilities.

nodes.name: Water Bubbles
nodes.description: Blow harmless water bubbles from your body.

nodes.name: Hydrification
nodes.description: Turn your body into water at will to slip away, ignore physical attacks, and gain mobility. Water form shares water's vulnerabilities.

nodes.name: Aquatic
nodes.description: Breathe underwater as on land and move through water as on land.

nodes.name: Steam Emission
nodes.description: Conjure, control, and emit blasts of hot steam from your body.

nodes.name: Ink Manipulation
nodes.description: Create and telekinetically control ink. With training, you can condense ink into hardened constructs.

nodes.name: Cool
nodes.description: Lower an object's temperature through touch, slowly and insufficiently to freeze. It can keep drinks or ice cream cool.

nodes.name: Chill
nodes.description: Create and control ice to a minor degree, better for ice cubes or ice knives than icicle attacks.

nodes.name: Frostbite
nodes.description: Rapidly freeze touched targets, expanding with training to freeze a whole body from a hand grab or an entire street floor.

nodes.name: Ice Spike
nodes.description: Conjure and launch ice spikes or erupt them from the ground. More energy makes larger, stronger icicles.

nodes.name: Ice Creation
nodes.description: Create but not control ice, still able to conjure walls, spikes, weapons, and similar forms without telekinetic control afterward.

nodes.name: Iceberg
nodes.description: Freeze objects and create massive ice volumes, freezing streets, encasing buildings, and with training turning city blocks into icebergs.

nodes.name: Ice Age
nodes.description: Freeze objects and create incredible ice volumes at will, freezing cities and buildings, launching thousand-ton ice boulders, and impaling with ice pillars. With training, entire cities can become mountains of ice.

nodes.name: Frost
nodes.description: Create and control ice you created, with no control over ice you did not create.

nodes.name: Ice Manipulation
nodes.description: Sense and telekinetically control all ice in range with very potent control, but without creating ice yourself.

nodes.name: Half Hot Half Cold
nodes.description: Create and emit both ice and fire from either side of your body, with resistance to both elements. With training, both aspects can combine to unleash Frostflare.

nodes.name: Frozen Heart
nodes.description: Heavily boost ice-ability power while keeping your mind calm, sharp, and resistant to mental influences. You are also immune to all frost effects below Epic rank.

nodes.name: Cryokinesis
nodes.description: Telekinetically create and control ice and cold, making ice constructs, remotely freezing objects, and similar effects.

nodes.name: White Album
nodes.description: Freeze objects with extreme temperatures and form a dispellable cold-ice armor around yourself. With training, you can plunge objects to near sub-zero temperatures.

nodes.name: Cold Wave
nodes.description: Unleash debilitating cold waves from your body that boost Ice-based abilities and spells while active. Those exposed slowly lose stamina in the harsh cold.

nodes.name: Frigid Winds
nodes.description: Create and control icy winds for freezing wind blades, ice tornadoes, and other wind-manipulation effects with an icy twist.

nodes.name: Cryomaster
nodes.description: Control cold and ice on the level of a Level 5 Esper from Toaru, with unmatched range, power, and control.

nodes.name: Snow Warning
nodes.description: Summon a snowstorm on your location that slightly boosts ice-based abilities.

nodes.name: Blizzard
nodes.description: Summon a fierce blizzard that boosts ice-based ability power.

nodes.name: Snow Manipulation
nodes.description: Create and control snow, with amount and power equal to energy expended.

nodes.name: Snow Logia
nodes.description: Create, control, and turn into snow, becoming a living entity of snow.

nodes.name: Ice Logia
nodes.description: Create, control, and turn into ice, becoming a living entity of ice.

nodes.name: Freezing Breath
nodes.description: Charge and unleash a freezing breath of frigid winds that freezes what it hits. Longer charging and more energy increase power.

nodes.name: Ice Sprout
nodes.description: Sprout ice constructs like walls and pillars from the ground and other surfaces to barrier, hinder, crush, or block enemies.

nodes.name: Black Ice
nodes.description: Create and control black ice, an incredibly durable ice highly resistant to heat and fire.

nodes.name: Ice Formation
nodes.description: Manifest extreme cold and ice at will under telekinetic control.

nodes.name: Absolute Zero
nodes.description: Drop temperatures to absolute zero on a touched target or in an area, though not instantly. More energy reaches Absolute Zero faster.

nodes.name: Divinity Water & Ice
nodes.description: You are a god of water and ice, holding domain over both with all that entails.

nodes.name: Typhoon
nodes.description: Manifest and control typhoons at will, from miniature direct attacks to area-wide devastation.

nodes.name: Breeze
nodes.description: Conjure a light breeze from your body, far too weak to knock a grown man down.

nodes.name: Gust
nodes.description: Conjure and control winds strong enough to injure people and knock grown men off their feet.

nodes.name: Wind
nodes.description: Conjure and control winds and air with decent power and precision, strong enough to kill with wind lashes or throw people with gusts.

nodes.name: Gale
nodes.description: Conjure, shape and control powerful gales of wind and air.

nodes.name: Hurricane
nodes.description: Conjure and command mighty winds and hurricanes with great power. With training, you can devastate several cities with hurricanes and storms.

nodes.name: Tempest
nodes.description: Upgrade of Hurricane. Create mighty storms and hurricanes for massive devastation. With training, you can unleash grand tempests that devastate cities.

nodes.name: Aerokinesis
nodes.description: Sense and telekinetically control wind, granting precise and powerful control over surrounding air.

nodes.name: Wind Blade
nodes.description: Conjure and launch razor-sharp crescent-shaped slashes of wind.

nodes.name: Wind Edge
nodes.description: Cloak a held item in razor-sharp winds to boost its cutting ability. You can launch the cloak as a projectile to extend the effect.

nodes.name: Delta Stream
nodes.description: Call forth winds that make the surrounding area very windy, enhancing the power and efficiency of all wind-based abilities.

nodes.name: Floating
nodes.description: Cloak yourself in winds that carry you, allowing you to fly.

nodes.name: Wind Flight
nodes.description: Push off the surrounding air to fly with precision and power.

nodes.name: Air Jet
nodes.description: Create air jets of powerful air currents.

nodes.name: Wind Cloak
nodes.description: Cloak yourself in powerful winds that assist movement, letting you move faster, dash and float.

nodes.name: Whirlwind
nodes.description: Create and control powerful whirlwinds and air currents, though control is imprecise.

nodes.name: Vacuum
nodes.description: Create and control vacuums in your sensory range to pull things in and cause implosions. Stronger vacuums expend more energy.

nodes.name: Louden
nodes.description: Increase noises to obnoxiously loud but non-destructive levels that cause no damage.

nodes.name: Megaphone
nodes.description: Amplify noises you create loudly enough to disorient and temporarily deafen opponents.

nodes.name: Sonic Blast
nodes.description: Amplify noises you create loudly enough to crack objects, rupture eardrums and deafen opponents.

nodes.name: View Air
nodes.description: Share your senses with surrounding air to map the world through wind. Base range is 1km, improvable with training and base stats.

nodes.name: Boomburst
nodes.description: Amplify noises you create to cause physical destruction, internal damage and deafness.

nodes.name: Airlock
nodes.description: Increase air resistance in an area to feel like wading through mud and make flight near impossible. With training, you can increase it until movement causes things to burst into flame from friction.

nodes.name: Storm Blade
nodes.description: Conjure a blade of compressed air, most commonly a sword, whose size and shape you can manipulate. You can release wind slash projectiles from it.

nodes.name: Wind Barrier
nodes.description: Conjure a barrier of violent air streams around yourself that excels at deflecting projectiles and elements, but less so physical force.

nodes.name: Heavy Wind
nodes.description: Create and control winds whose virtual density you can manipulate, affecting how they impact the world without changing how they move. You can unleash tungsten-dense wind blades, iron-weight storms, mountain-weight wind whips and more. Denser winds exhaust more energy.

nodes.name: Weather Manipulation
nodes.description: Manipulate weather conditions over an area. Despite massive range it consumes very little energy, but is weak offensively.

nodes.name: Wind Alteration
nodes.description: Alter air's chemical composition and properties, such as raising oxygen concentration to make it more flammable and poisonous, or making it dense enough to feel like steel.

nodes.name: Oxidiser
nodes.description: Create and control clouds of pure oxygen to intensify flames, trigger detonations with slight sparks, suffocate or poison targets, or use them as compressed wind attacks.

nodes.name: Aeromaster
nodes.description: Control wind, air and its composition at the level of a Level 5 Esper from Toaru, with unmatched range, power and control.

nodes.name: Atmospheric Pressure Manipulation
nodes.description: Control atmospheric pressure in zones you can raise or lower.

nodes.name: Air Whips
nodes.description: Create and control whips of compressed air to lash out or grab with. Longer, stronger whips expend more energy.

nodes.name: Spark
nodes.description: Create small sparks of electricity from your body, too weak to work as a taser.

nodes.name: Taser
nodes.description: Channel electricity through your body and discharge it, strong enough to seriously hurt someone.

nodes.name: Arc
nodes.description: Channel electricity through your body and discharge it. With training, you can direct where it goes to aim more precisely.

nodes.name: Electric Discharge
nodes.description: Channel potent electricity through your body and discharge it. With training, you can direct where it goes to aim more precisely.

nodes.name: Lightning Channel
nodes.description: Channel lightning through a held object to reinforce and empower it. The lightning imitates the object, becoming sharp with a sword and heavy with a hammer.

nodes.name: Lightning Absorption
nodes.description: Absorb electricity and lightning into your body for storage. You can convert it into energy to refill reserves, boost your power, or fire it as an attack.

nodes.name: Call Lightning
nodes.description: Call down lightning from the sky onto any location in sensory range. Not very effective indoors.

nodes.name: Call Thunder
nodes.description: Call down powerful thunder from the sky onto any location in sensory range. Not very effective indoors.

nodes.name: Call Greater Thunder
nodes.description: Call down very powerful thunder from the sky onto any location in sensory range. Not very effective indoors. With training, you can call multiple at once or charge it into a concentrated spear of thunder.

nodes.name: Storm Call
nodes.description: Freely call thunder and lightning from the skies to strike the ground with little energy consumption. You can charge it to smite with concentrated lightning.

nodes.name: Lightning Form
nodes.description: Turn into a living bolt of lightning to travel extremely quickly while ignoring most conventional attacks. You are extremely vulnerable to grounding, which ejects and injures you.

nodes.name: Radio Waves
nodes.description: Emit electromagnetic waves that disable and cripple all technology with an interface. With training, you can fine-tune them to activate or control electronics instead.

nodes.name: Impulse
nodes.description: Quicken your body's electrical signals to proportionally increase reflexes and speed. Overuse may cause nerve damage.

nodes.name: Godspeed
nodes.description: Overhaul your nervous system with your own lightning for near-instant reflexes and extreme speed. It damages your body over time, so extended use is not recommended.

nodes.name: Electrokinesis
nodes.description: Create and control electricity at will, from shooting lightning bolts to tweaking your own bioelectricity. You cannot control electromagnetic waves.

nodes.name: Electromagnetokinesis
nodes.description: Sense, interact with and control electromagnetism, a fundamental force of the universe, letting you control magnetic objects, create railguns, shoot lightning, tweak bioelectricity and more.

nodes.name: Assign
nodes.description: Assign polarity to objects by touch so they attract or repel each other. More energy expended means stronger polarity.

nodes.name: Electromaster
nodes.description: Hold complete control over Electromagnetism, a fundamental force of the universe, with unmatched range, power and precision.

nodes.name: Stun Shock
nodes.description: Disrupt someone's bioelectricity by touch to stun or paralyze them; with training you can manipulate their bodies further. Stronger opponents are harder to affect.

nodes.name: Lightning Breath
nodes.description: Charge and unleash a breath of devastating lightning waves. Longer charging and more energy mean a stronger breath.

nodes.name: Railgun
nodes.description: Turn any magnetic object in your grasp into a railgun projectile. Higher mass costs more, and you must aim it.

nodes.name: Frozen Lightning
nodes.description: Wield and control frozen lightning. Unlike incredibly hot regular lightning, it is proportionally colder, freezing whatever it electrocutes or passes through.

nodes.name: Lightning Spear
nodes.description: Conjure a throwable spear of lightning (does not travel at lightning speed) with penetrative power that deals increased damage against draconic entities.

nodes.name: Great Lightning Spear
nodes.description: Conjure a throwable spear of lightning (does not travel at lightning speed) with penetrative power that deals increased damage against draconic entities, rending their scales and hides and nulling their defence.

nodes.name: Sunlight Spear
nodes.description: Conjure a throwable spear of sun-imbued lightning with penetrative power that deals increased damage against draconic entities and unholy beings.

nodes.name: Thunder Cloak
nodes.description: Cloak your body in thunder to increase speed, power and reflexes while imbuing electricity into your attacks.

nodes.name: Chidori
nodes.description: Cloak your hands in violent sharp electricity that boosts piercing and cutting, turning them into lightning blades.

nodes.name: Lightning Bolt
nodes.description: Release a bolt of lightning from your hands at a target that travels at the speed of lightning.

nodes.name: Electromagnetic Sight
nodes.description: Shift your vision to see electromagnetism and electricity even through walls, instinctively distinguishing and understanding them.

nodes.name: Electricity
nodes.description: Create and control electricity (not kinesis) and use it to slightly enhance your stats. You can sense and see nearby currents even through walls, and ground opponents' lightning with your body.

nodes.name: Attention
nodes.description: Manifest a very eye-catching, distracting aura centered on yourself, making you incredibly noticeable in whatever you do.

nodes.name: Lightning Claws
nodes.description: Create claws of violent lightning over your hands to sever and electrocute enemies simultaneously.

nodes.name: Pebble Sling
nodes.description: Conjure pebbles and small rocks to sling at enemies, minorly inconveniencing them or hurting them if they hit eyes.

nodes.name: Rock Throw
nodes.description: Conjure rocks and small stones to launch as projectiles. Not very powerful, but a rock to the head always hurts.

nodes.name: Stone Bullet
nodes.description: Conjure rocks and small stones to shoot like bullets with lethal power, making you a living stone gun.

nodes.name: Boulder Hurl
nodes.description: Conjure and hurl a large boulder at enemies. Regardless of your strength, its weight does not affect your throwing, whether person-sized or house-sized.

nodes.name: Rock Shotgun
nodes.description: Conjure multiple small rocks and launch them at lethal speeds.

nodes.name: Bullet
nodes.description: Conjure lead or other metal bullets from small to high calibre and launch them at supersonic to hypersonic speeds. More energy means higher calibre and speed.

nodes.name: Move Earth
nodes.description: Telekinetically move earth in your sensory range. It has little lethal power.

nodes.name: Quicksand
nodes.description: Turn ground into quicksand that grabs and pulls anyone who steps on it.

nodes.name: Earth Spikes
nodes.description: Create, control and launch spikes of earth and rock, including erupting them from the ground in sensory range.

nodes.name: Meteor Strike
nodes.description: Call down meteors from the sky. Size and speed depend on energy expended.

nodes.name: Chain & Shackle
nodes.description: Create metal chains and shackles that erupt from the earth to bind enemies. They track and chase opponents, making them very hard to dodge.

nodes.name: Catapult
nodes.description: Create and launch giant boulders at enemies. Regardless of your strength, their weight does not affect your throwing, whether person-sized or house-sized.

nodes.name: Stonesprout
nodes.description: Sprout rock and stone constructs such as walls and pillars from surfaces for defense, terrain or smashing enemies.

nodes.name: Micro Ferrokinesis
nodes.description: Manipulate metals on a small but extremely precise scale. You cannot hurl cars, but you could shape gold into an ornate ring with microscopic carvings.

nodes.name: Earth Armor
nodes.description: Create earth armour around your body to absorb blows and attacks without impeding mobility or speed.

nodes.name: Earthquake
nodes.description: Create earthquakes causing massive environmental destruction.

nodes.name: Fissure
nodes.description: Create fissures in objects to shatter or split them. Harder objects need more energy to fissure.

nodes.name: Ferrokinesis
nodes.description: Telekinetically control and shape metal in sensory range, such as ripping it from buildings into spears, flying on metal bands, or controlling iron-rich blood.

nodes.name: Terrakinesis
nodes.description: Telekinetically control earth and rock in your sensory range.

nodes.name: Armor
nodes.description: Create very durable reinforced metal armour on your body that enhances endurance. Stronger users form stronger metal, and you can reshape it with concentration.

nodes.name: Metal Kaiser
nodes.description: Create metal such as giant blades, walls and pillars from any non-organic surface. More energy creates more metal.

nodes.name: Iron Manipulation
nodes.description: Telekinetically control iron and iron-based objects in your perception. Control and strength depend on focus and mana spent.

nodes.name: Extinction Meteors
nodes.description: Bring down giant meteors for massive devastation and damage. Mass, power and speed depend on energy expended. Quite expensive to use.

nodes.name: Pocket Sand
nodes.description: Conjure and launch a handful of sand from your hands. Shouting "pocket sand!" while doing so might make it stronger.

nodes.name: Sandshot
nodes.description: Conjure and launch sand from your fingers at non-lethal but painful speeds.

nodes.name: Sandstream
nodes.description: Launch powerful sand streams from your body to hinder vision and injure enemies like sandblasting.

nodes.name: Sandblast
nodes.description: Launch blasts of high-velocity sand clouds that rend and shred metals and especially flesh.

nodes.name: Death Valley Duster
nodes.description: Conjure violent sand and dust clouds to launch in immensely powerful sandblast-like bursts that shred targets.

nodes.name: Primordial Earth
nodes.description: Control earth, dust and sand in sensory range to unleash giant sand blasts, launch jagged boulders and erupt stalagmites.

nodes.name: Primordial Ancient
nodes.description: Control earth, dust and sand to extreme levels. It lacks precision but holds unbelievable destructive power.

nodes.name: Karura's Blessing
nodes.description: Karura's blessing is an autonomous sand shield that protects from danger automatically without consuming mana.

nodes.name: Burial
nodes.description: Instantly bury any ground-touching target underground, suffocating and crushing them. Burying a corpse prevents necromancy and revival on them.

nodes.name: Conjure Lesser Earth Elemental
nodes.description: Conjure and command Lesser Earth Elementals from your energy, such as Mudmen, Stone Golems, Sand and Claymen, for earth-based magic and similar effects. You can only conjure elementals at or below Uncommon familiar power, with power, shape and ability set by your expertise and level. They drain your energy to persist and act and vanish if supply stops, though sufficient time, energy and skills can make them permanent; elementals do not count as Familiars.

nodes.name: Conjure Earth Elemental
nodes.description: Conjure and command Earth Elementals from your energy, such as Earth Sprites, Iron Golems and Stone Atronachs, for earth-based magic and similar effects. You can only conjure elementals at or below Rare Familiar power, with power, shape and ability set by your expertise and level. They drain your energy to persist and act and vanish if supply stops, though sufficient time, energy and skills can make them permanent; elementals do not count as Familiars.

nodes.name: Conjure Greater Earth Elemental
nodes.description: Conjure and command powerful Greater Earth Elementals from your energy, such as Diamond Golems, Regirocks and Elder Magma Elementals (DnD), for earth-based magic and other abilities. You can only conjure elementals at or below Elite Familiar power, with power, shape and ability set by your expertise and level. They drain your energy to persist and act and vanish if supply stops, though sufficient time, energy and skills can make them permanent; elementals do not count as Familiars.

nodes.name: Golem Creation
nodes.description: Animate and command golems of earth, mud, sand or metal. More durable, powerful golems cost more. Make them temporary for less energy or permanent for very high cost.

nodes.name: Titan Armor
nodes.description: Fuse with earth to form gigantic kaiju-proportioned armour around yourself. Bigger armour expends more energy.

nodes.name: Golem Armor
nodes.description: Create a golem around yourself from ground beneath your feet or materials you touch, acting as armour that enhances physical stats.

nodes.name: Stalagmite Burst
nodes.description: Unleash stalagmite blades that erupt from the ground to impale enemies.

nodes.name: Thousand Arrows
nodes.description: Create and launch spears or arrows of surrounding ground as artillery, traps or projectile bombardment.

nodes.name: Metal Manipulation
nodes.description: Control the shape and form of all metals you touch.

nodes.name: Mud Manipulation
nodes.description: Conjure and control mud to create swamps underfoot or bombard opponents.

nodes.name: Crystal Shower
nodes.description: Create crystals to shoot as projectiles. Larger, faster crystals expend more energy.

nodes.name: Crystal Spikes
nodes.description: Create durable but brittle crystal spikes from the ground or any touched surface to impale opponents or serve as barriers.

nodes.name: Diamond Skin
nodes.description: Cover your body in diamond-like texture, massively boosting durability and mass against all damage. Even as a base human you shrug off high-calibre bullets, tank shells, car impacts and fire unfelt, and even a missile cannot kill you though it hurts.

nodes.name: Crystal Creation
nodes.description: Create crystals on your body or touched surfaces, controlling shape and size during creation but unable to alter them afterward.

nodes.name: Crystals
nodes.description: Create and sprout crystals from your body as spikes, skin armour, or cash to sell. (AUTHOR NOTE: Crystal refers to a nebulous crystalline structure that is durable, not allowing you to make ANY type of crystalline structure.)

nodes.name: Gem Creation
nodes.description: Create precious gems that hold much energy or mana. Larger, more valuable gems cost more energy.

nodes.name: Pure Gem Creation
nodes.description: Create pure precious gems that hold immense energy and serve as vessels. Purer, more potent gems cost more energy.

nodes.name: Sand Veil
nodes.description: Create a small localized sandstorm on your location that hides your presence inside it while you see through it freely.

nodes.name: Fool Sand
nodes.description: Conjure autonomous sand that shapeshifts, attacks and defends without input to protect you, eliminate enemies or provide utility.

nodes.name: Desert Weaponry
nodes.description: Create sand-and-wind weapons and attacks such as giant sand blades, spears and hammers to unleash as projectiles.

nodes.name: Sandstorm Body
nodes.description: Turn your body into a living sand cloud and reform at will. Damage to the sand reflects onto you.

nodes.name: Dig
nodes.description: Dig and move underground incredibly fast like a mole, breathing underground too. You dig faster than you sprint.

nodes.name: Dowsing
nodes.description: Detect metals around you like mental radar. More valuable metals register more distinctly.

nodes.name: View Earth
nodes.description: Share vision with earth to feel it and locate everything inside it. Default range 5km, increasable with training.

nodes.name: Wire
nodes.description: Create and control metal wires; control ends once a wire separates from your body. You can reinforce wires with energy for extra durability.

nodes.name: Pika
nodes.description: Fuse with earth for complete terrain control: shape, move, and reform it, or form a giant golem around yourself.

nodes.name: Desert Logia
nodes.description: Create, control, and turn into sand. You can also drain moisture to dry objects and turn stone into sand.

nodes.name: Blackout
nodes.description: Banish all light from an area, making mundane sight nigh impossible. Larger areas cost more energy.

nodes.name: Shadow Travel
nodes.description: Sink into shadows and travel within them like Black Sabbath from JoJo. Sunlight while inside burns you and deals damage.

nodes.name: Shadow Hands
nodes.description: Manifest controllable floating hands of shadow. They can grip, crush, slash, and combine into larger, stronger forms.

nodes.name: Sethan
nodes.description: Move your shadow as a living, attacking creature. Those who step on it rapidly de-age until you are unconscious or deactivate it; stronger opponents de-age slower.

nodes.name: Shadow Puppeteer
nodes.description: Extend your shadow; when it touches a target's shadow, their movements mimic yours until dispelled.

nodes.name: Shadow Tag
nodes.description: Treat people's shadows as tangible; step on or pin them to stop escape, or grab and pull targets toward you.

nodes.name: Shadow Dart
nodes.description: Conjure and launch silent shadow darts made of energy.

nodes.name: Shadow Cloak
nodes.description: Cloak yourself in shadows to blur perception and muffle sound, enhancing stealth.

nodes.name: Shadow Stalker
nodes.description: Enter a shadow state with your equipment to phase through solid matter. With training, unphase bolts inside targets to bypass durability. Shadow form is highly vulnerable to electricity and aerosols.

nodes.name: Shadow Ball
nodes.description: Conjure and launch a fast, destructive shadow orb that deals extra damage to spirits.

nodes.name: Shadow Blade
nodes.description: Conjure a lightweight, very sharp shadow blade with adjustable size and shape. It ignores around 10% of target durability, always dealing some damage.

nodes.name: Shadow Scythe
nodes.description: Conjure a shadow scythe with adjustable size and shape. It cuts only what you will it to and ignores a portion of target durability.

nodes.name: Reaper's Scythe
nodes.description: Conjure a pure-darkness scythe with adjustable size and shape. It fully ignores physical objects and barriers and blocks regeneration and resurrection from its wounds, but drains your energy in proportion to what you cut.

nodes.name: Death's Instrument
nodes.description: Call forth death's instrument, a pitch-black scythe ignoring all physical and magical durability. Its wounds strike body and soul and cannot be healed by mundane means.

nodes.name: Bottomless Swamp
nodes.description: Turn surrounding ground into a bottomless swamp that traps and sinks steppers. Fully submerged targets are incapacitated in a stasis-like state.

nodes.name: Dark Spear
nodes.description: Conjure and launch dark-energy spears that deal extra damage to holy and divine beings.

nodes.name: Shadow Storage
nodes.description: Extend your shadow across 2D surfaces to sink objects into stasis storage. No weight limit; stored objects can be ejected anytime.

nodes.name: Shadow Claws
nodes.description: Conjure sharp, lightweight Shadow Claws over your hands for slashing. Training extends their length and sharpness.

nodes.name: Shadow Chains
nodes.description: Create and control chains woven from your shadow. Snared enemies rapidly lose energy.

nodes.name: Blind
nodes.description: Curse opponents to block sight via touch or a thrown rune-like hex, a moderately fast projectile. Duration depends on magic resistance; irresistible targets can be blinded permanently.

nodes.name: Grue
