nodes.description: Create a darkness cloud that blots out the senses of those inside, making perception extremely difficult. Strong targets partially resist.

nodes.name: Deafness
nodes.description: Curse opponents to block hearing via touch or a thrown rune-like hex, a moderately fast projectile. Duration depends on magic resistance; irresistible targets can be deafened permanently.

nodes.name: Numbness
nodes.description: Curse opponents to block touch via touch or a thrown rune-like hex, a moderately fast projectile. Duration depends on magic resistance; irresistible targets can be numbed permanently.

nodes.name: Mute
nodes.description: Curse opponents to block speech via touch or a thrown rune-like hex, a moderately fast projectile. Duration depends on magic resistance; irresistible targets can be muted permanently.

nodes.name: Conjure Shadowbeast
nodes.description: Conjure a temporary autonomous shadow familiar. Its power scales with energy spent.

nodes.name: Gate of Nightmares
nodes.description: Summon a gigantic 10-meter darkness gate to unleash a controlled horde of shadow beasts. More energy yields more beasts.

nodes.name: Dark Lance
nodes.description: Conjure and unleash dark-energy lances, exceptionally lethal to holy beings. Their wounds are difficult to heal.

nodes.name: Abyss
nodes.description: Reality Marble - Pull targets into the Abyss, which rapidly drains their energy and vitality. All dark abilities are boosted inside.

nodes.name: Void Tendril
nodes.description: Conjure and control void tendrils to grapple, crush, whip, and pierce. You can share sensation with them.

nodes.name: Shade Cloak
nodes.description: Briefly shift into shadow to phase through attacks and magic. Weak only to light and holy magic; limited to 1 second at a time with a 3-second cooldown.

nodes.name: Cursecraft
nodes.description: Create and apply curses based on your abilities. E.g. light becomes blinding, strength becomes weakness, etc.

nodes.name: Darkness Devil
nodes.description: As the fear of darkness incarnate, hold authority over all darkness and shadows to control them at will.

nodes.name: Black Hole
nodes.description: Conjure and control weaker small-scale virtual black holes. With training, you can conjure real black holes.

nodes.name: Void Dragon's Breath
nodes.description: Charge and unleash erosive void breath that drains the energy of what it touches. Longer charge and more energy mean a stronger breath.

nodes.name: Void Mirror Image
nodes.description: Legendary Mechanic - Conjure controlled clones of yourself that cannot interact with the world and serve as distractions.

nodes.name: Void Travel
nodes.description: Legendary Mechanic - Slip into the void dimension to traverse space without interacting with the real world; time flows slower there. Distance covered equals real distance for short-range teleportation. 30-second stay, increasable with training. 5 Minute cooldown.

nodes.name: Chaos Entity Release
nodes.description: Legendary Mechanic - Release physical form to become a Void Observer, a sentient grey energy cloud that slips into the void at will, intangible yet able to observe reality. Staying inside slowly drains energy and grants near-immunity to physical force, but damage taken reflects onto your real body.

nodes.name: Void Path
nodes.description: Legendary Mechanic - Open gates to the Void Dimension to traverse it, banish entities inside, or bring entities out. Use with caution.

nodes.name: Void Distorter Form
nodes.description: Legendary Mechanic - Transform into a Void Distorter, a Void-native being that distorts and shapes void to ravage the natural world with spatial distortions. Can also use Void Travel.

nodes.name: Abyssal Jail
nodes.description: Manifest Abyss in the natural world to trap entities in a localized Abyss that isolates and drains their energy and vitality. Breaking out by force is possible but incredibly difficult.

nodes.name: Abyss Skin
nodes.description: Cover your skin in Abyss for potent defense with no offensive benefit. It dissipates contacted energy, including kinetic and heat, but sudden powerful attacks can bypass absorption.

nodes.name: Yami
nodes.description: Shroud surroundings in ominous darkness with rouge clouds, boosting dark abilities and infernal beings while weakening all Holy beings and abilities.

nodes.name: Darkness Logia
nodes.description: Create, control, and turn into Darkness at will. It can absorb and store anything but amplifies your sense of pain.

nodes.name: Shadow Eyes
nodes.description: Conjure small eye-shaped shadow familiars that autonomously observe and relay information. They have no combat ability but hide potently.

nodes.name: Shadow Beast Form
nodes.description: Turn into a giant amorphous shadow monster like Dark Shadow from MHA. Greatly vulnerable to holy and light effects.

nodes.name: Shadow Armor
nodes.description: Create lightweight, very durable shadow armor with freely alterable shape. While active, it boosts physical abilities and darkness abilities.

nodes.name: Umbrakinesis
nodes.description: Weave shadow and darkness into physical form and control it, such as shadow chains, spikes from a target's shadow, or darkness lances.

nodes.name: Abyss Barrier
nodes.description: Weave Abyss into a physical barrier that absorbs and dissipates energy. Nigh unbreakable without overwhelming force, except against holy attacks.

nodes.name: Shadow Monarch
nodes.description: Extract shadows from corpses as commanded minions, immortal while restored by your mana. Raisable level and stored count depend on your energy.

nodes.name: Flashlight
nodes.description: Emit a moderate-intensity light beam from your hands. A handy flashlight replacement with little other use.

nodes.name: Flash
nodes.description: Emit bright blinding light from your hands, or dimmer light for utility. Ineffective beyond close range.

nodes.name: Illumination
nodes.description: Conjure telekinetically controlled points of bright light. Extra energy makes them semi-permanent.

nodes.name: Exorcist's Light
nodes.description: Conjure and emit exorcising light, useless against normal beings but highly effective against dark or unholy beings.

nodes.name: Invisibility
nodes.description: Bend light around yourself or a touched object to render it invisible.

nodes.name: Flash Grenade
nodes.description: Conjure a light ball that bursts into blinding flash and noise, disorienting enemies and heavily harming dark enemies.

nodes.name: Light of Glory
nodes.description: Call victorious light from the heavens to bolster allies. Those touched gain slightly increased physical stats, mental resistance, vigor, and courage.

nodes.name: Light Grenade
nodes.description: Conjure and launch a fast, powerful grenade of exploding light energy.

nodes.name: Beam
nodes.description: Shoot a near-instant beam of concentrated light and heat from your fingers.

nodes.name: Lesser Blessing
nodes.description: Grant a minor blessing of Holy Energy that slightly augments one chosen physical stat: Vitality, Strength, Resilience, Agility, stamina. Lasts one hour; only one blessing per target.

nodes.name: Blessing
nodes.description: Grant a Holy Energy blessing: Augmentation (augments a chosen stat like strength, resilience, vitality, etc.), Might (slightly augments all attributes), or Mind (slightly augments Energy Regeneration and Output). Lasts one to three hours by energy spent; only one per target.

nodes.name: Greater Blessing
nodes.description: Grant a greater Holy Energy blessing: Augmentation (significantly augments a chosen stat like strength, resiliency, vitality, regeneration, etc.), Boost (augments all attributes for more energy), or Mind (slightly augments Energy Regeneration and Output). Lasts one to three hours by energy spent; only one per target.

nodes.name: Divine Blessing
nodes.description: Bestow blessings once an hour for one hour: Recovery (Rare Rank Regeneration plus cure of all non-inborn ailments), Might (increases all attributes), or Warding (cleanses curses and raises resistances). Blessings can also mimic abilities, e.g. Ignite grants fire resistance and affinity.

nodes.name: Law of Regression
nodes.description: Regress causality to return something to its original or intended form while dispelling all negative status. Greater regression costs more energy.

nodes.name: Disc of Light
nodes.description: Conjure and launch a sharp searing light disc that returns in an arc.

nodes.name: Guidance of Grace
nodes.description: Grace light creates a visible-only-to-you path toward your objective or something aiding it.

nodes.name: Barrier of Light
nodes.description: Create an easily deployed light-magic barrier. Less sturdy, but strong against curses, spirits, and negative status.

nodes.name: Hardlight Weaponry
nodes.description: Create strong, lightweight hard-light weapons that deal extra damage to dark-aligned foes. They lack durability and fade when damaged.

nodes.name: Sky Fracture
nodes.description: Rain holy-light weapons from the sky, from swords and glaives to skyscraper-sized lances, scaling with energy spent.

nodes.name: Confessor's Light
nodes.description: Create a sky spotlight compelling anyone caught to truthfully answer questions asked. You are immune.

nodes.name: Purification
nodes.description: Bathe a target in purifying light to cleanse negative effects and foreign substances. Potency scales with energy.

nodes.name: Greater Purification
nodes.description: Bathe a target in powerful purifying light to cleanse negative effects and foreign substances. Potency scales with energy.

nodes.name: Holy Weapon
nodes.description: Coat your armament in holy light, enhancing its power and quality and dealing extra damage to dark-aligned beings.

nodes.name: Blessing of Arms
nodes.description: Bless an armament to upgrade it by half a stage (+) and grant its wielder a matching bonus intermediate skill, e.g. an Uncommon sword becomes Uncommon+ and grants Intermediate Swordsmanship while held. Only one at a time.

nodes.name: Smite
nodes.description: Suffuse your next attack with divine power, amplifying it and dealing severe damage to unholy beings.

nodes.name: Golden Fist
nodes.description: Cover your fists in deadly golden light that strengthens punches, punishes evil, and deals severe damage to unholy and spirit beings.

nodes.name: Exorcism
nodes.description: Bathe a target in golden light to exorcise negative effects, curses, and possessions. Against spirits or unholy beings, it burns like holy flame.

nodes.name: Blade of Light
nodes.description: Infuse your blade with reinforcing light mimicking its properties; e.g. swords launch light slashes, hammers emit golden shockwaves, etc.

nodes.name: Resuscitation
nodes.description: Revive the dead within 10 minutes or restore vitality to fighting condition. Training extends the timeframe.

nodes.name: Swords of Revealing Light
nodes.description: Create and control light swords that seal a target's energy when impaled. Stronger targets can resist.

nodes.name: Minor Healing Light
nodes.description: Bathe a target in healing light to restore some health and vigour. Scales with power; stronger targets cost more.

nodes.name: Healing Light
nodes.description: Bathe a target in healing light to heal even severe wounds. Scales with power; stronger targets cost more.

nodes.name: Greater Healing Light
nodes.description: Bathe a target in healing light to heal even grievous wounds and lethal damage. Scales with power; stronger targets cost more.

nodes.name: Divine Healing Light
nodes.description: Bathe a target in healing light to restore them from even lethal damage; any wound short of death can be healed. Scales with power; stronger targets cost more.

nodes.name: Pillar of Light
nodes.description: Call down a pillar of searing light anywhere in sensory range. Deals extra damage to unholy beings.

nodes.name: Judgement Call
nodes.description: Summon an erupting fountain of pure divine light dealing massive pillar-like destruction, lethal to Unholy beings, plus purification. Drains most energy; stronger than some Epic abilities but held back by cost and charge time.

nodes.name: Genesis
nodes.description: "May there be mercy on man and machine for their sins." Call a gigantic crucifix of absolute holy light dealing country-erasing judgment; no Unholy being survives, while allies caught are healed of all conditions. Spends all energy; 30-day cooldown.

nodes.name: Light Trick
nodes.description: Bend light into sight-deceiving optical illusions. Light can be solidified for disguise, but touch reveals the trick.

nodes.name: Light Speed
nodes.description: Briefly become a ray of light to travel at lightspeed in a straight line before reforming.

nodes.name: Sanctuary
nodes.description: Create a large overhead light beam granting allies healing, regeneration, and cleansing. Maintenance costs energy.

nodes.name: Light Logia
nodes.description: Create, manipulate, and transform into light energy at will.

nodes.name: Claws
nodes.description: Grow durable, sharp claws on your fingertips.

nodes.name: Horns
nodes.description: Grow sturdy, pointy horns on your head.

nodes.name: Tail
nodes.description: Grow a strong, dexterously controlled tail.

nodes.name: Jaw
nodes.description: Turn your teeth into very sharp, durable fangs.

nodes.name: Natural Weapons
nodes.description: Weaponize attached biological body parts, e.g. nails into claws, teeth into fangs.

nodes.name: Razor Claws
nodes.description: Turn nails into non-dulling razor claws that tear flesh and metal with ease.

nodes.name: Carapace
nodes.description: Grow tough armor-like carapace over flesh for defense. Toughness scales with physical stats.

nodes.name: Exoskeleton
nodes.description: Grow very sturdy exoskeleton armor granting endurance and protection. Power and durability scale with physical stats.

nodes.name: Scales
nodes.description: Grow damage-resistant scales serving as flexible skin armor. Toughness scales with physical stats.

nodes.name: Dragon Scales
nodes.description: Grow incredibly tough dragon scales, more durable than any human material, also reducing elemental damage taken. Toughness scales with physical stats.

nodes.name: Powerful Wings
nodes.description: Grow powerful wings that lift you regardless of weight. Stronger than your base physicality, they can shatter bones as weapons.

nodes.name: Immunity System
nodes.description: While Immutable is in an active ability slot, you are immune to poisons, diseases, and negative biological effects.

nodes.name: Monomolecular Claws
nodes.description: Transform nails into sleek black claws with molecule-thin edges and undiminished durability. Adjustable up to 1 meter long.

nodes.name: Bone Manipulation
nodes.description: Freely manipulate your bones and any bones in sensory range; reshape and alter your own bones' size, shape, and properties. Bones regenerate quickly while active.

nodes.name: Organ Spikes
nodes.description: Sprout biological-matter spikes from anywhere on your body without pain in creation or use.

nodes.name: Ukaku
nodes.description: Manifest wing-like RC-Cell appendages shifting from fluid-like to steel-tough. Release precise high-speed armor-piercing feather barrages or slash like a steel whip.

nodes.name: Koukaku
nodes.description: Manifest a morphing arm-like RC-Cell appendage from the shoulder blade, tougher and denser than steel. Shape it into spears, claws, shields, etc.

nodes.name: Rinkaku
nodes.description: Manifest multiple flexible Rinkaku tentacles of RC Cells from the lower back, shifting from fluid-like to steel-tough. Use them to pierce, whip, grab, or maneuver.

nodes.name: Bikaku
nodes.description: Manifest a tail-like Bikaku RC-Cell appendage at the tailbone, shifting from fluid-like to steel-tough. Defend, whip, and pierce like a giant flesh tail.

nodes.name: Kakuja
nodes.description: Manifest armor-like Kakuja RC Cells shifting from fluid-like to steel-tough, massively boosting stats. Form depends on the user, from building-sized wings to 16 pillar-thick tentacles tougher than titanium and faster than bullets.

nodes.name: Ghoul Physiology
nodes.description: Transform into a flesh-eating ghoul superhuman with a Special RC-Cell limb, gaining a random Kagune of the 4 types and near-immunity to conventional weapons below 9mm. You suffer ravenous hunger for human flesh and cannot eat other food; lingering hunger persists after deactivation until fed, but feeding slightly strengthens you.

nodes.name: hybrid Ghoul Physiology
nodes.description: Transform into a hybrid ghoul, far stronger than average ghouls with none of their weaknesses. Massively amplifies physical attributes, grants powerful regeneration and a random Kagune, and removes the need to eat human flesh while retaining its benefits.

nodes.name: Dragon Kakuja
nodes.description: "Become a true biological terror." Take the form of a Dragon Kakuja, an over 10km centipede-like dragon of RC cells stronger than any man-made material. Passively emit high-density RC clouds that turn nearby things into flesh-eating superhuman monsters under your telepathic control, and morph your body into tentacles or flesh monsters.

nodes.name: Keratin Manipulation
nodes.description: Generate and control keratin to form constructs like horns, armour, and shields, or fire scales and needles.

nodes.name: Fierce Wings
nodes.description: Grow wings whose feathers you telekinetically control as projectiles, extra limbs, or weapon enhancements. Feather power scales with your physical stats.

nodes.name: Stim
nodes.description: Flood your body with natural stem cells to rebuild it, at high stamina and resource cost. Requires available nutrients to work or it harms you instead; can be transferred to others via fluid exchange.

nodes.name: Conditioning
nodes.description: While in an active slot, your body continuously conditions itself as if working out and recovering simultaneously. Slowly approach your biological peak over time and gain increased workout efficiency.

nodes.name: Bio Armor
nodes.description: Manifest and wear bio armour that shapeshifts and autonomously adapts to your body. Can form blades, spikes, shields, and similar structures.

nodes.name: Body Refinement
nodes.description: Refine bodies into a more ideal state: build muscle, remove impurities, and adjust size. Cannot alter genetics; stronger targets cost more energy.

nodes.name: Absolute Control
nodes.description: Gain complete instinctual control over your body and brain, down to hormones and blood flow. Operates on intent and prevents accidental self-harm.

nodes.name: Shape Altering
nodes.description: Alter your body's shape, but cannot create biological impossibilities like turning your head into tentacle whips. Larger alterations cost more energy.

nodes.name: Shapeshifting
nodes.description: Freely morph your body without breaking conservation of mass or altering genetics. You are protected from harm caused by your own shapeshifting.

nodes.name: Gene Refinement
nodes.description: Alter and improve genetic structures by reinforcing, cutting, or overhauling them. Thereby improves the target's body and any biologically-based abilities.

nodes.name: Minor Regeneration
nodes.description: Gain a minor healing factor that closes lacerations and stabs during a fight, but won't fully recover you mid-fight. Expend energy to heal faster.

nodes.name: Regeneration
nodes.description: Gain a healing factor that closes wounds at speeds visible to the naked eye, often by the fight's end. Survive non-lethal wounds while you have energy; expend energy to heal faster.

nodes.name: High Speed Regeneration
nodes.description: Gain rapid healing that closes bullet holes and stabs in seconds. Expend energy to heal even faster.

nodes.name: Super Regeneration
nodes.description: Gain a Wolverine-level healing factor without immortality; survive anything that doesn't instantly kill you while you have energy. Expend energy to heal even faster.

nodes.name: Regenerative Immortality
nodes.description: Gain regenerative immortality against mundane wounds; regenerate from the largest remaining living piece, even if split vertically. You can still be incapacitated, and fully running out of energy causes true death.

nodes.name: Redundant Physiology
nodes.description: Survive like a cockroach: when wounded, your body adapts to keep you alive without blood, lungs, or even a heart by repurposing other parts as substitutes.

nodes.name: Biological Adaptation
nodes.description: Your body constantly rebuilds itself to counter stimuli, such as fire-resistant skin against fire, plating against cuts, or sharper claws. Adaptations are strictly biological and fade over time or when dispelled.

nodes.name: Vampire Physique
nodes.description: Become a classic vampire with superhuman physical abilities, bat transformation, and bloodsucking. Retain all traditional weaknesses: crucifixes, garlic, wooden stakes, sunlight, and holy water.

nodes.name: Animorph
nodes.description: Freely morph into any mundane animal you know. Retain all your abilities while gaining the animal's physical traits.

nodes.name: Gills
nodes.description: You have gills for breathing underwater, though they are inconvenient.

nodes.name: Hormone Manipulation
nodes.description: Freely create, control, and design custom hormones. Inject them into others via bloodstream exposure or fluid exchange.

nodes.name: Tentacles
nodes.description: Manifest controllable biological tentacles that act as extra limbs to smash, grab, whip, molest, and manipulate.

nodes.name: Four Arms
nodes.description: Manifest an extra set of arms that are as easy to control as your first pair.

nodes.name: Venom Injection
nodes.description: Become venomous, injecting venom through bites or claws, or spraying it orally or via powers. Venom potency scales with your physical stats.

nodes.name: Poisoned Flesh
nodes.description: Turn your flesh and blood into potent poison by expending energy; potency scales with energy spent and vitality. Poison becomes inert once the ability is cancelled or swapped out.

nodes.name: Poison Factory
nodes.description: Design, concoct, and expel any poison from your body while gaining poison resistance. Can combine with other abilities for esoteric poisons; overuse causes nausea and sickness.

nodes.name: Poison Breath
nodes.description: Exhale a cloud of poisonous gas that also erodes physical matter.

nodes.name: Doku
nodes.description: Freely create and manipulate poisonous substances, with potency scaling with energy expended.

nodes.name: Paralysis
nodes.description: Create a paralytic agent in your body to expel through pores or spray orally as gas.

nodes.name: Blood Manipulation
nodes.description: Telekinetically control your own blood. You cannot generate extra blood without regeneration, so spend it wisely.

nodes.name: Hemokinesis
nodes.description: Telekinetically control blood within your sensory range, but not in quantities smaller than you can perceive. Controlling blood inside someone requires being stronger than them.

nodes.name: Greater Hemokinesis
nodes.description: Sense and telekinetically control all blood within your sensory range, your own or an enemy's. Meaningful control of blood inside a target requires being stronger than them.

nodes.name: Teleportation
nodes.description: Teleport to any location you have visited or seen with your own eyes. Longer range increases energy consumption and cooldown.

nodes.name: Blink
nodes.description: Instantly teleport up to 10 meters to a normally accessible spot in line of sight, excluding through glass; range improves with training. Has a slight cooldown, and overuse causes intense vertigo.

nodes.name: Instant Transmission
nodes.description: Instantly teleport to any sensed or previously visited location, bringing passengers along. Energy cost scales slightly with distance and passenger count; requires mental focus.

nodes.name: Rewind
nodes.description: While in an active slot, build an energy stockpile by diverting a portion of your natural regeneration, manifesting by default as a horn. Spend the stockpile to rewind time's effects on a target, costing more for stronger or resisting targets and less for weaker ones. Cannot affect immaterial things such as soul, energy, or mind.

nodes.name: Haste
nodes.description: Accelerate your own time and that of anything you touch. Greater acceleration causes more strain and energy cost.

nodes.name: Apport
nodes.description: Swap the locations of two items of approximately equal worth, within 10% price variation. You must touch at least one object, with both in your sensory range.

nodes.name: Swap
nodes.description: Instantly swap the locations of any targets in your line of sight. More powerful targets cost more energy and strong enough ones can resist.

nodes.name: Boogie Woogie
nodes.description: Swap the locations of two energy-possessing targets within your sensory range by clapping. Clapping is required to activate.

nodes.name: Dismantle
nodes.description: Send invisible slashes directed by hand motions. Stronger slashes cost more energy.

nodes.name: Cleave
nodes.description: Instantly cut any object you touch with no cues. Energy cost scales with durability; high enough magic resistance grants immunity.

nodes.name: Reality Slash
nodes.description: Create and launch a flying slash that severs spacetime, ignoring all conventional durability and barriers.

nodes.name: Dimensional Lock
nodes.description: Dimensionally lock an area to block spacetime abilities like teleportation, portals, and time travel inside it. Larger areas cost more energy; strong enough targets can break the lock.

nodes.name: Stillness
nodes.description: Freeze an object's time, rendering it inviolable and locked to its current speed and state; even a thrown pebble becomes unstoppable and immovable. Can be used on yourself for invulnerability, but strains the heart immensely and lasts only a few seconds.

nodes.name: Infinity
nodes.description: Infinitely divide the space between you and a target, making it impossible for them to reach you. Requires constant mental calculation, strains the brain immensely, and can liquify it with overuse.

nodes.name: Limitless
nodes.description: Distort space via three applications: Blue creates a powerful attracting force, Red a powerful repelling force, and Neutral infinitely divides space to prevent approach. These can be combined and expanded with experience, but cost much energy with effectiveness scaling with calculation ability.

nodes.name: Distortion
nodes.description: Distort and warp space to deal massive damage.

nodes.name: Clockblocker
nodes.description: Freeze an object in spacetime, rendering it completely inviolable and invulnerable. Duration and cost scale with energy spent and target strength; strong enough targets are immune.

nodes.name: The Hand
nodes.description: Scrape away space with either hand, pulling the remaining space together to fill it. Ignores conventional durability but has short range and high energy cost.

nodes.name: Time Manipulation
nodes.description: Manipulate time in a select area or target by speeding up, slowing down, stopping, or reversing it. Sufficiently strong targets can resist.

nodes.name: Slow Down
nodes.description: Slow down time for everything except yourself. More energy expended yields slower time.

nodes.name: Superhot
nodes.description: Time moves relative to you: it slows as you slow and speeds as you speed, stopping if you stand still. Strong enough targets may resist or ignore it.

nodes.name: Doppelganger
nodes.description: Produce a seamless doppelganger you control mentally, though it has none of your abilities. You may maintain a number equal to your ability slot count.

nodes.name: Clone Split
nodes.description: Split into several bodies, halving your stats per clone. Each clone needs one of your ability slots to use abilities, excluding Clone Split; if a clone dies, its stats return over 8 hours.

nodes.name: Divergent Avatars
nodes.description: Split into multiple directly-controlled bodies, freely distributing ability slots and energy among them. Each avatar needs at least 5% of your stats; a dead avatar's stats return after 24 hours.

nodes.name: King Crimson
nodes.description: Skip time, becoming absolutely intangible by separating from causality; actions against you during the skip are negated while yours persist. For example, after a 10-second skip trading blows, you return unharmed while your opponent keeps their wounds; can also phase through objects and reposition.

nodes.name: Gold Experience
nodes.description: Imbue objects with life energy to turn them into autonomous living beings or constructs of your choice. Creations must be of roughly similar mass.

nodes.name: Anti Gravity
nodes.description: Remove gravity's influence from a target or area in your vision, creating zero-gravity, or invert and amplify gravity to hurl targets skyward.

nodes.name: Zero Gravity
nodes.description: Your body moves as if in zero gravity, letting you float freely though with little control.

nodes.name: Low Gravity
nodes.description: Create low-gravity zones in your line of sight, reducing the weight and falling speed of objects inside.

nodes.name: Burden Breaker
nodes.description: "More speed" While active, your speed ignores physics including air resistance, gravity, and friction. You gain momentum indefinitely until deactivated, making it incredibly uncontrollable and potentially stranding you at the universe's edge.

nodes.name: Nuclear
nodes.description: Create and control localized nuclear reactions with your energy, becoming a living nuclear weapon platform. Increased use causes radiation poisoning that fades over time.

nodes.name: Radiation Absorption
nodes.description: Absorb radiation to convert into energy, permanently increasing your reserves by absorbing large amounts over time.

nodes.name: Shrug It Off
nodes.description: Shrug off ailments and negative status effects like blindness, bleeding, or curses as a cure scaling with physical stats.

nodes.name: Vermin Lord
nodes.description: Sense and telepathically command vermin such as insects and mice within your sensory range.

nodes.name: Mandom
nodes.description: Rewind time by 6 seconds in a localized 50-meter area. Those in range remain aware of the rewound 6 seconds.

nodes.name: Resurrection
nodes.description: Revive an entity dead no longer than you have been alive. Requires sacrifices like money, valuables, or artefacts scaling with target strength, doubled for unwilling targets.

nodes.name: Blast Mark
nodes.description: Mark objects with a rune you can charge with energy to detonate at any time. Explosion power scales with energy spent; stored energy fades over time.

nodes.name: Carbon Manipulation
nodes.description: Legendary Mechanic - Telekinetically sense and control carbon down to a molecular level. Controlling carbon inside living creatures is harder based on their power relative to yours.

nodes.name: Soul Read
nodes.description: Ask a soul yes-or-no questions it must answer truthfully. Cannot be used on targets stronger than you.

nodes.name: Emergency Exit
nodes.description: Passive: when lethally injured, automatically teleport to the safest area within a 1000-meter radius. Has a 30-minute cooldown.

nodes.name: Protean
nodes.description: Your body adapts to make your abilities more efficient and stronger, fading when disabled. For example, claws boost overall strength while fire manipulation grants heat tolerance.

nodes.name: Sunshine
nodes.description: Blessed by the sun: under sunlight, massively increase stats and energy and create intense flames. At noon for one minute, enter "The One" for even greater stats, flames, and near-invulnerability.

nodes.name: Draconic Escalation
nodes.description: Under danger or combat, assume a draconic form that strengthens with time and danger, and recedes without it. Higher escalation grants basic pyrokinesis, regeneration, and enhanced physical stats.

nodes.name: Revengence
nodes.description: Build up energy as you are hurt, then charge any ability or spell with it for a devastating effect. Each 10% health lost adds 2x power, reaching 10x at 10% health remaining; 8-hour cooldown.

nodes.name: Metallica
nodes.description: Precisely manipulate and sense all iron in a 10-meter radius, forming elaborate constructs or blades from a target's blood. Can control blood inside living beings.

nodes.name: Glass Manipulation
nodes.description: Telekinetically control glass and glass-based objects within your sensory range.

nodes.name: Oil Manipulation
nodes.description: Telekinetically control oil and oil-based substances such as petrol, fuel, asphalt, crude oil, and plastic within your sensory range.

nodes.name: Silicon Manipulation
nodes.description: Telekinetically shape and control silicon down to an atomic level, including glass, sand, quartz, silicone, and most electronics within your sensory range.

nodes.name: Plastic Manipulation
nodes.description: Telekinetically control plastic and plastic-based substances and objects within your sensory range.

nodes.name: Fabric Manipulation
nodes.description: Telekinetically control fabric within your sensory range, including cotton, silk, wool, and kevlar. Can create your own clothes or turn enemies' clothes against them.

nodes.name: String Manipulation
nodes.description: Generate and manipulate supernaturally durable strings with supernatural precision. You lose control if they lose contact with your body.

nodes.name: Copper Manipulation
nodes.description: Telekinetically control copper and copper-based constructs within your sensory range.

nodes.name: Rust Inducement
nodes.description: Induce rust in metals through physical contact.

nodes.name: Gold Manipulation
nodes.description: Telekinetically control gold and gold-based constructs within your sensory range.

nodes.name: Gearbox
nodes.description: Manipulate the output of machines you own, lowering output to preserve durability or pushing them to their very limits even without the means to do so.

nodes.name: Mystic Eyes of Enchantment
nodes.description: Hypnotise and mind-control those who make eye contact with you. High-willpower or stronger targets can break out.

nodes.name: Conjure Vines
nodes.description: Conjure energy-construct vines you control. Once they leave your body you lose control and they fade over time.

nodes.name: Hookwolf
nodes.description: Assume the form of a large shifting mass of metal needles, hooks, and blades, altering shape and size at energy cost. Damage to the metal doesn't harm you, but your body inside remains vulnerable.

nodes.name: Mystic Eyes of Death Perception
nodes.description: See lines of death as cracks along objects or people; destroying a line instantly and absolutely kills or destroys the target. Only works where the concept of death applies; overuse causes severe brain damage.

nodes.name: Superpower
nodes.description: Gain superhuman power: run faster than a train, punch harder than a missile, and shrug off tank shells, all scaling with physical stats. Training results are considerably enhanced.

nodes.name: Haki
nodes.description: Harness willpower physically to reinforce things, gain extrasensory perception, and exert spiritual pressure. Can train in all Haki types.

nodes.name: Conqueror's Haki
nodes.description: Exert your willpower as a wave of power that knocks unconscious those with weaker willpower.

nodes.name: Armament Haki
nodes.description: Reinforce your body or a held object with an invisible hardening forcefield that can touch the intangible. At higher mastery it can be projected.

nodes.name: Observation Haki
nodes.description: Expand a sensory field to detect movements and objects inside. At higher mastery, distinguish targets, energy, and even emotions.

nodes.name: Elemental Lungs
nodes.description: Charge your lungs with any elemental energy to unleash breath attacks such as acid, darkness, fire, ice, and light.

nodes.name: Vitality Drain
nodes.description: Drain a target's vitality on touch to heal yourself. Stronger targets yield less drain.

nodes.name: Blood Tax
nodes.description: Whenever someone injures you, they lose a portion of energy or stamina to you, letting you recover even while damaged.

nodes.name: Hook & Line
nodes.description: Conjure an energy hook-and-line usable as a weapon. Wounding someone with the hook lets you reel them to you, one target at a time.

nodes.name: Minefield
nodes.description: Conjure a grid pattern along terrain and detonate sections of it through the grid.

nodes.name: Density Manipulation
nodes.description: Increase or decrease your own density or that of wielded objects. Greater changes cost more energy to maintain.

nodes.name: Star Rage
nodes.description: Increase your mass without penalties to speed or stature, making physical attacks unimaginably stronger and potentially collapsing into a black hole. Higher mass costs more energy to maintain.

nodes.name: Lock On
nodes.description: Lock onto targets so thrown projectiles home in and become nigh impossible to dodge unless they leave range.

nodes.name: Absolute Accuracy
nodes.description: Any projectile you throw will hit if physically possible, such as threading a human hair through a 1mm hole 10 kilometres away.

nodes.name: Energy Emission
nodes.description: Emit energy as beams or pulses using your own energy. More energy spent and longer charging yield stronger emissions.

nodes.name: Kinetic Energy Absorption
nodes.description: Absorb and store kinetic energy in your body to enhance your blows when released. Stored energy fades if unused.

nodes.name: Kinetic Energy Manipulation
nodes.description: Manipulate kinetic energy in your sensory range by negating, applying, changing, or redirecting it. Cannot control more than your body can exert.

nodes.name: Vector Manipulation
nodes.description: Create and control vectors at Level 5 Esper level, controlling the movement of basically anything: teleporting, stopping, accelerating, and more.

nodes.name: Halt
nodes.description: Stop all kinetic energy of a target, even a meteor. Larger forces cost more energy; has a 1-second cooldown.

nodes.name: Lockdown
nodes.description: Lock down an area centred on you so nobody can enter or leave and spacetime abilities are disabled. Absolute enough that even a god cannot breach it; requires energy and cannot be maintained indefinitely.

nodes.name: Stick
nodes.description: Stick to objects like super glue.

nodes.name: Fear Gaze
nodes.description: Gaze into someone's eyes to make them recall their greatest fear. Stronger targets cost more energy, and strong-willed ones are less affected.

nodes.name: Glide
nodes.description: Lets you glide 1cm above the ground without friction, moving as if skating.

nodes.name: Absolute Gateway
nodes.description: Creates a door that breaches any barrier or defense it is placed on, letting you bypass it without teleporting.

nodes.name: Pacifists Domain
nodes.description: Erects a domain centered on yourself where no one, including you, can commit violence.

nodes.name: Quake
nodes.description: Conjures massive vibrations, tremors, and quakes through any medium like air, water, or ground, strong enough to devastate landmasses. Can shatter objects like glass and partially bypass durability.

nodes.name: Adamantine Skin
nodes.description: Your skin is nigh-invulnerable to all harm without durability negation at similar power. You also resist durability negation, reducing its efficiency so it cannot fully pierce you.

nodes.name: Phoenix Zoan
nodes.description: Lets you transform into a Blue Phoenix or hybrid at will. Grants increased physical abilities, flight, extreme regeneration, and healing flames.

nodes.name: Hydra Form
nodes.description: Lets you transform into a Hydra or hybrid at will. Grants massively increased physical abilities, high-tier poison immunity, poison breath, extreme limb-regrowing regeneration, and survival of up to 9 beheadings.

nodes.name: Thunderbird Form
nodes.description: Lets you transform into a thunderbird or hybrid at will. Grants increased physical abilities, flight, lightning emission, and weather manipulation.

nodes.name: Portal Creation
nodes.description: Creates resizable portals to anywhere in sensory range or anywhere you have visited. A portal cannot close while something is inside it.

nodes.name: Doormaker
nodes.description: Creates portals that can cross even dimensions, placed anywhere you can perceive or have visited.

nodes.name: Clairvoyance
nodes.description: Extends your sight beyond your eyes, controllable like a free spectator camera.

nodes.name: Super Jump
nodes.description: Lets you leap great distances, such as over a building for a regular person. Also grants immunity to falling damage.

nodes.name: Shaper
nodes.description: Freely manipulates flesh and biomaterials by contact with perfect cellular precision. Larger power gaps let targets resist your changes more.

nodes.name: Tool Manipulation
nodes.description: Assigns an object under your lifting strength as a target to telekinetically control with extreme limb-like precision.

nodes.name: Energy Drain
nodes.description: Drains energy from living targets via contact. Larger power gaps reduce how much you can drain at once.

nodes.name: Double Jump
nodes.description: Lets you jump once off thin air as if it were solid.

nodes.name: Sky Jumper
nodes.description: Lets you treat air as jumpable platforms anytime, but you cannot stand on it for more than a second without falling.

nodes.name: Clothes Beam
nodes.description: Fires a laser beam that dresses anyone in any mundane clothing of your choice.

nodes.name: Spirit Gathering
nodes.description: Channels and uses as your own the energy of anyone willing to share it, regardless of distance.

nodes.name: Power of Destruction
nodes.description: Conjures and controls pure destructive energy that can annihilate anything with enough magical power.

nodes.name: Full Counter
nodes.description: With precise timing, counters any attack thrown at you and returns it with double power.

nodes.name: Destruction Incarnate
nodes.description: You are Destruction Incarnate, turning your body into a vessel for nigh-endless destructive energy that can wipe almost anything from existence.

nodes.name: Ice Man
nodes.description: You are everything ice: plunge worlds into an ice age, rebuild your body from ice, or unleash absolute-zero temperatures at will.

nodes.name: Phoenix Force
nodes.description: Hosts the Phoenix Force, source of all life and fire in the universe, but it exerts no control or influence over you; you simply channel its abilities.

nodes.name: Stinger
nodes.description: Imbues any attack with absolute inviolability, unstoppable even by dimensional boundaries or reality-warping.

nodes.name: Rally
nodes.description: Emits a rousing cry that bolsters allies with lion-like courage and endless motivation, turning even a chef into a warrior able to fell a soldier.

nodes.name: Cybele
nodes.description: Medusa - Your unimaginably beautiful eyes petrify anything in your gaze or anything that meets your eyes. Larger power gaps slow the petrification.

nodes.name: Third Person
nodes.description: Shifts your perspective from first-person to an orbiting third-person camera around you, as in Dark Souls.

nodes.name: Seek Guidance
nodes.description: While active, shows commentary from those who were, could have been, or would have been, helpful or deceitful. Includes trapped-treasure warnings, hidden-wall locations, or trap prompts, like messages in Eldensoulsborne Games.

nodes.name: Immune
nodes.description: While in an active slot, grants immunity to poison, illness, curses, debuffs, and all negative status effects.

nodes.name: Gunpowder Manipulation
nodes.description: Conjures and telekinetically manipulates gunpowder, shaping constructs or detonating it on command. Larger volumes cost more energy.

nodes.name: Vita Telum
nodes.description: Converts your life into supernaturally durable weapons of solidified blood emerging from an open wound. Greater vitality or sacrificed lifespan makes them stronger, with lifespan sacrifice also granting powerful effects based on your abilities and traits. Created weapons fade in power over time until returning to normal blood.

nodes.name: Authority of Lust
nodes.description: When activated, everyone who can see you treats you as an object of affection, platonic or romantic, with stronger effect at larger power gaps in your favor. Mundanes may surrender life savings or spouse, while equals may only treat you as an ordinary friend.

nodes.name: Steal
nodes.description: Remotely steals an unbound target's possession within 10 meters without them noticing. More valuable objects cost more energy.

nodes.name: Grand Theft
nodes.description: Steals ALL unbound possessions from a target within 5 meters into your subspace inventory. You can narrow the range to steal specific targets more easily.

nodes.name: Record
nodes.description: Trash Count - Records your sight into memory in perfect detail, recallable anytime as if constantly in mind, surpassing photographic memory.

nodes.name: Audacity
nodes.description: Lets you go unnoticed as people ignore you to their utmost, allowing theft, break-ins, or kills without comment. Stronger targets resist more, noticing drastic acts; upkeep costs energy and stamina.

nodes.name: Mind Reading
nodes.description: Reads a focused target's surface thoughts, emotions, or deeper thoughts and opinions. Stronger targets drain more energy.

nodes.name: Telepathy
nodes.description: Exchanges thoughts with others within energy-dependent range, reading surface thoughts or communicating one- or two-way. Multiple targets heavily strain your mind.

nodes.name: Crimson Fucker
nodes.description: You are a descendant of Alucard, the Crimson Fucker himself, sharing all his natural abilities.

nodes.name: Basilisk Form
nodes.description: Transforms into a basilisk at will, partially or fully. Your gaze petrifies and paralyzes, your scales grant natural armor, and you highly resist curses.

nodes.name: Wendigo
nodes.description: Transforms into a Wendigo partially or fully. Grants increased ice affinity, enhanced physical stats, blizzard summoning, and supernatural tracking, but may instill human-flesh appetite.

nodes.name: Oni
nodes.description: Transforms into an Oni partially or fully. Grants enhanced physical stats and minor healing, but vulnerability to holy.

nodes.name: Phoenix Form
nodes.description: Transforms into a Phoenix partially or fully. Grants enhanced physical stats, major fire affinity, incredible regeneration, and revival from death once every 30 days.

nodes.name: Tinker - Redundant
nodes.description: Modifies existing technology in purposeless ways granting no tangible benefit, like yellowing a phone screen, adding useless car wheels, or fitting a car with a propeller too weak to lift it.

nodes.name: Mirror Force
nodes.description: Reflects magical attacks back with a large forcefield.

nodes.name: Disguise
nodes.description: Alters an object's color and texture by touch until its structural integrity is compromised.

nodes.name: Fishman Form
nodes.description: Transforms into a fishman, an amphibious humanoid-fish race. Grants greatly increased physical abilities over humans, further empowered when submerged.

nodes.name: Lock
nodes.description: Places locks on entities that block interaction until unlocked by condition, key, or brute force. Cannot lock resisting living beings.

nodes.name: Unlock
nodes.description: Conceptually unlocks entities, from locks to inner potential. More abstract or difficult targets cost more energy; imagination and energy are your limits.

nodes.name: Dragon Form
nodes.description: Transforms into a western dragon partially or fully, granting enhanced stats and energy plus the ability to use other abilities as breath attacks.

nodes.name: Energization
nodes.description: Converts flesh into energy to become an energy being. More flesh yields more energy but greater vulnerability to energy attacks.

nodes.name: Everlasting Dragon Form
nodes.description: Transforms into a giant everlasting dragon partially or fully. With intact stone scales of immortality, needs no sustenance and gains regeneration, powerful breath, and extreme damage resistance, but loses immortality if scales break and stays vulnerable to lightning.

nodes.name: Lunarian Form
nodes.description: "No, it doesn't give you the pass" Temporarily transforms into a Lunarian, an extinct sky-faring race, with free winged flight and bodily fire manipulation for attacks and more. Intact flame grants extreme durability; lost flame removes it but grants slight speed instead.

nodes.name: Soul Window
nodes.description: When activated, lets you see and interact with souls and spirits, and grasp general intent by looking into eyes.

nodes.name: Sharingan
nodes.description: Transforms your eyes into the one-tomoe Sharingan of the Uchiha Clan, evolvable through training and severe mental trauma. Grants greatly enhanced vision, memorization of seen Martial Moves and Spells you can replicate, and hypnosis scaling with power gap, breakable by strong shock.

nodes.name: Byakugan
nodes.description: Transforms your eyes into the Hyuga Clan's Byakugan. Grants massively enhanced, near-omnidirectional vision that pierces obstacles and clearly sees and tracks energy.

nodes.name: Nine Eyes
nodes.description: When activated, differentiates objects into nine titular colors with distinct meanings, such as threat levels and glimpses of fate and destiny. Ununlocked colors appear colorless, and divinely empowered objects or people cannot be perceived. For more info: https://the-second-coming-of-gluttony.fandom.com/wiki/Nine_Eyes

nodes.name: Strength
nodes.description: Grants super strength to lift cars, punch through reinforced concrete, and bend metal like rubber. Scales with base strength, costs energy to maintain, and can be further augmented with more energy.

nodes.name: Speed
nodes.description: Grants supernatural speed to outrun cars and outpace dragonflies. Scales with base speed, costs energy to maintain, and can be further augmented with more energy.

nodes.name: Toughness
nodes.description: Grants supernatural durability, ignoring low-caliber bullets and damaging cars that hit you. Scales with base durability, costs energy to maintain, and can be further augmented with more energy.

nodes.name: False Master
nodes.description: While active, instinctively reveals any held weapon's full capabilities and grants temporary Adept Rank Mastery in its category.

nodes.name: Atlas
nodes.description: "The Giant held up the very skies" Grants immense strength to carve mountains and move cities with bare hands given enough energy, plus shockwave release. Consumes energy when active.

nodes.name: Star Toss
nodes.description: Grants ultimate strength to pluck stars and shatter planets. Immeasurably strong and augmentable without limits.

nodes.name: Extreme Speed
nodes.description: Lets you move at extreme, hard-to-control speeds. Further augmentation is possible, but greater speed burns more energy.

nodes.name: Godlike Speed
nodes.description: Grants ultimate speed where sound is a statue and light a turtle. Augmentable without limits with enough energy.

nodes.name: Invincible
nodes.description: Makes you "Title Card" extremely durable, with nuclear weapons barely causing a first-degree burn. Augmentable to extreme levels.

nodes.name: No Friction
nodes.description: Eliminates friction of a target you are touching.

nodes.name: Phase Shift
nodes.description: Switches between offensive form with enhanced speed and strength, and defensive form with enhanced durability and resistance.

nodes.name: Hunter
nodes.description: Greatly augments physical stats, especially hearing and focus to lock onto a heartbeat a street away. Scales with basic stats.

nodes.name: Quiet
nodes.description: Creates a zone silencing all sound inside or blocking its escape, or mutes specific targets by touch. Can silence your abilities at increased energy cost.

nodes.name: Widen
nodes.description: Extends an ability's area of effect without reducing power, such as doubling or tripling it, at higher energy cost.

nodes.name: Penetrate
nodes.description: Augments abilities with penetration to better ignore resistances and bypass immunities, letting even a lich be cursed or a fire dragon burnt.

nodes.name: Boost
nodes.description: Raises a targeted ability below Legendary by a full stage.

nodes.name: Delay
nodes.description: Casts an ability with delayed effect, such as a fireball firing 1 minute later in place, or healing held until needed.

nodes.name: Permeation
nodes.description: Phases through objects and attacks non-selectively, so you can fall through ground and go blind phasing your head. Disabling inside solid matter ejects you headfirst at high speed.

nodes.name: Dress Break
nodes.description: Destroys a touched target's clothing or armor by touch, delayable up to an hour.

nodes.name: Multiplicity
nodes.description: Uses multiple instances of an ability at once, like triple fireball or tenfold lightning strike, each costing appropriate energy.

nodes.name: Deduction
nodes.description: Deduces information from targets via enhanced observation, matching a genius detective like Sherlock Holmes given detailed observation.

nodes.name: Condemnation
nodes.description: "Let there be judgment." Casts judgment based on target karma; against irredeemable evil by a positive-karma user, victim power drops 10x while your power rises 10x against them. 8-hour cooldown.

nodes.name: Salt King
nodes.description: Turns you into the Salt King, creating, controlling, and transmuting targets into supernaturally powerful salt within eyesight range. Targets need at least your parity to resist transmutation.

nodes.name: Gravity
nodes.description: Creates and controls gravitational fields.

nodes.name: Gravity Manipulation
nodes.description: Accurately controls gravity on a massive scale: invert gravity to hurl islands skyward, craft imitation black holes, or crush with extreme gravity. Limited by imagination and gravity's power, with training able to remove a planet's gravity.

nodes.name: Optimization
nodes.description: Optimizes targets, cutting electronics' energy use or maximizing your spells' and abilities' efficiency.

nodes.name: Perfect Unknowable
nodes.description: Temporarily erases all evidence of existence: no energy signature, scent, sight, sound, or perception until you attack.

nodes.name: Life Share
nodes.description: Shares your life force to heal others via touch, remotely with further mastery.

nodes.name: Wheel of Mahoraga
nodes.description: Manifests a wheel behind you that spins upon encountering an insurmountable phenomenon, adapting you to resist damage or harm previously unhittable foes. Adaptation fades when canceled, but gained knowledge and techniques remain.

nodes.name: Decay
nodes.description: Destroys touched objects by spreading decay to dust, expandable with training. Strong targets partially resist.

nodes.name: Wither
nodes.description: Emits a withering aura that drains vitality, breaks targets down internally, and disables regeneration, lingering like poison. With training, grows more potent and usable as a tangible attack.

nodes.name: Sublimate Presence
nodes.description: Melds your presence with the environment while still, making you nigh-impossible to discern from foliage or dirt.

nodes.name: Mark
nodes.description: Marks targets by touch, keeping perfect awareness of their location and distance while active.

nodes.name: Future Sight
nodes.description: Sees several seconds into the future that would occur without intervention. Extendable with training.

nodes.name: Precognition
nodes.description: Peers into the near future for energy, from moments when inexperienced to several seconds when skilled. May trigger automatically before a lethal blow.

nodes.name: Diagnosis
nodes.description: Touching a target reveals a detailed diagnosis of their health.

nodes.name: Date Scouter
nodes.description: Brings up a target's status page showing likes, dislikes, and kinks.

nodes.name: Absolute Territory
nodes.description: Creates a 100-meter zone ranking up all abilities by one stage and boosting physical abilities, while barring others' authority inside. You cannot leave while active, and upkeep costs large energy.

nodes.name: Branding
nodes.description: Brands unresisting targets as yours, revealing their location and condition. Lets you summon yourself to them or them to you with a 24-hour cooldown.

nodes.name: Soul Marriage
nodes.description: Soul-marries a willing target with a kiss, granting a soul ring. Share energy freely, teleport to each other with an 8-hour cooldown, track state and location, and bestow or reclaim your abilities without penalty.

nodes.name: Mirror
nodes.description: Copies a touched Legendary-or-below power for 1 hour in place of this ability, replaceable anytime with no cooldown. 2-hour cooldown.

nodes.name: Power Mimicry
nodes.description: Adds a touched target's ability to storage by touch. Can switch to any stored power at any time, but mimics only one ability at once.

nodes.name: Ability Drain
nodes.description: Forcefully absorbs a touched target's biology-based ability. Fails on blessings, curses, authorities, and similar.

nodes.name: Beast Mimicry
nodes.description: Mimics or manifests aspects of any beast consumed within 24 hours, like crab-shell armor or hydra regeneration.

nodes.name: Overhaul
nodes.description: Deconstructs and reconstructs matter at will, down to molecular levels with training.

nodes.name: Pocket Dimension
nodes.description: Grants a 1km x 1km pocket dimension for storing almost anything, expanding as you grow stronger. Access requires physical portals, so beware.

nodes.name: Inventory
nodes.description: Grants an inventory subspace preserving inanimate targets in stasis, holding 100 tons by default and scaling with physical stats. Stores by willing touch and withdraws within 1 meter of your body.

nodes.name: Synthesis
nodes.description: Combines two objects into one with their desired traits, such as merging pebbles toward adamantite or iron swords into an unbreakable sword.

nodes.name: Sonar
nodes.description: Provides a sonar to detect your surroundings.

nodes.name: Life Radar
nodes.description: Detects all lifeforms and shapes within a 100-meter radius, expandable with training.

nodes.name: Devil Control
nodes.description: Completely and absolutely controls any lesser being, but you must first prove they are lesser.

nodes.name: Arbor
nodes.description: Creates and extends controllable, reinforceable wood constructs from your body.

nodes.name: Contractual Recreation
nodes.description: Invokes any owned legally binding receipt for its effect, like a hot-spring receipt to refresh yourself or a house receipt to summon a controllable copy.

nodes.name: Trajectory Manipulation
nodes.description: Manipulates trajectories of perceived projectiles: curve bullets around you, sharply turn thrown spears without losing momentum, or reverse fireballs. Stronger projectiles resist more.

nodes.name: Hermit Purple
nodes.description: Summons Hermit Purple as manipulable translucent purple vines that divine the future, with accuracy improvable through training.

nodes.name: Somnabulist
nodes.description: Emits very powerful sleeping gas from your skin as purple mist.

nodes.name: Phantom Touch
nodes.description: Lets you touch a target at range, making them feel your hands or mouth on a spot of your choosing. These are phantom sensations only and cannot physically affect them.

nodes.name: Collaring
nodes.description: Lets you collar a defeated or submitting target, preventing them from moving to harm you and forcing them to obey your orders. Manifests as a translucent, hideable collar and chain around their neck.

nodes.name: Material Swim
nodes.description: Lets you pass through physical objects as if they were water, without affecting their state or structural integrity.

nodes.name: Kaleidoscope
nodes.description: A True Magic that lets you manipulate parallel worlds.

nodes.name: Heaven's Feel
nodes.description: A True Magic that turns your soul into an immortal, high-dimensional entity generating infinite energy.

nodes.name: Denial of Nothingness
nodes.description: A True Magic that lets you create anything creatable, given enough energy.

nodes.name: Lycanthropy
nodes.description: Lets you transform into a werewolf with enhanced physical abilities and common werewolf traits. You can spread it to turn others into werewolves.

nodes.name: Despair Aura I
nodes.description: Lets you emit an aura of despair that makes people uneasy and weaker targets fearful.

nodes.name: Despair Aura II
nodes.description: Lets you emit an aura of despair that causes unease and fear toward you, overwhelming weaker-willed targets with unbearable fear and panic.

nodes.name: Despair Aura III
nodes.description: Lets you emit an aura of despair causing deep unease and fear, crushing weaker targets' morale and leaving them in despair, unable to retaliate.

nodes.name: Despair Aura IV
nodes.description: Lets you emit an aura of despair causing unease, fear, and terror. You can drive weaker targets to insanity by focusing on them, and make armies of weaker foes kneel in hopelessness.

nodes.name: Despair Aura V
nodes.description: Lets you emit an aura of death and despair commanding fear, terror, and hopelessness. It can physically crush opponents to their knees, affects weaker opponents more, and can kill significantly weaker targets outright.

nodes.name: Rubber Body
nodes.description: Your body stretches and compresses like rubber, scaling with your physical stats.

nodes.name: Magic Jammer
nodes.description: Lets you destroy or disable magical constructs, costing more energy against stronger constructs.

nodes.name: Contract Creation
nodes.description: Lets you enforce the clauses and conditions of any contract you make. Conditions must be set while enforcement is active, and enforcement binds both you and your target.

nodes.name: Binding Vow
nodes.description: Lets you create binding vows, promises with reality itself. Breaking a vow between parties inflicts the penalty regardless of strength. You can also make self-vows, sacrificing something to boost energy output, such as being weaker at night to be stronger by day.

nodes.name: Chop Chop
nodes.description: Lets you split your body apart and telekinetically float the parts around with your feet as the anchor. You are immune to slashing attacks while active, but limbs too far from your feet go inactive.

nodes.name: Lord of Shades
nodes.description: You are the embodiment of the Void, a vast devouring abyssal fluid that seeks to consume. You can shape it into tendrils, barbs, blades, fangs, mouths and more, defaulting to barbed tendrils; you can turn into void, shapeshift, corrupt living creatures to strengthen and control them though it can be resisted, and subsume beings to store them or drain their energy without gaining it.

nodes.name: Almighty Push
nodes.description: Lets you exert incredible repulsive force, enough to wipe out entire streets as a normal human. Has a 5-second cooldown.

nodes.name: Universal Pull
nodes.description: Lets you exert incredible attractive force to pull distant targets or bury a target under surrounding objects. Has a 5-second cooldown.

nodes.name: Operation
nodes.description: Lets you create a circular zone where you control space like an operating table, swapping objects, amputating without harm, removing hearts, teleporting, and more with training. Maintaining the zone and using the power costs immense energy.

nodes.name: Azure Dragon Form
nodes.description: Lets you transform into a giant Eastern Azure Dragon or hybrid at will, massively boosting physical abilities. Grants elemental breath attacks like fire, lightning, and air, plus fire clouds to lift things or fly.

nodes.name: Buddha Form
nodes.description: Lets you transform into a giant golden Buddha statue, massively boosting physical abilities. Grants golden shockwaves and near-invulnerability to most damage in this form.

nodes.name: Cow Form
nodes.description: Lets you transform into a cow or cow hybrid at will, boosting physical abilities, vitality, and stamina. Grants bovine traits while transformed.

nodes.name: Sea Snake Form
nodes.description: Lets you transform into a sea snake or sea snake hybrid at will, greatly boosting physical abilities. Grants minor regeneration, water breathing and mobility, plus lethal poison breath.

nodes.name: Assembly
nodes.description: Lets you automatically assemble accessible parts into any item you have built before or know how to make. Subpar materials produce lesser versions.

nodes.name: Pearl Jam
nodes.description: Lets you imbue Pearl Jam into your cooking to drastically improve it. Based on food quality, ingredients, and your power, it gains effects like healing and curing illness.

nodes.name: Trace On
nodes.description: Lets you create weapons from magical energy as long as you know their construction. Stronger weapons cost more energy.

nodes.name: Structural Analysis
nodes.description: Lets you run energy through an object or construct to build a detailed mental blueprint, revealing weaknesses and flaws.

nodes.name: Hound Nose
nodes.description: Passively boosts your smell to supernatural levels, letting you pick out one scent in a hundred and track week-old scents across a city. Can be further augmented with energy.

nodes.name: Hawk Eyes
nodes.description: Passively boosts your sight to supernatural levels, letting you see accurately from a hundred kilometers away. Can be further augmented with energy.

nodes.name: Bat Ears
nodes.description: Passively boosts your hearing to supernatural levels, letting you hear from kilometers away and pick out a coin drop in a busy mall. Can be further augmented with energy.

nodes.name: Usurper
nodes.description: "Complete Victory" If you make an opponent recognize their complete and utter defeat to you, you permanently take one of their abilities. Works only once per target.

nodes.name: Exchange
nodes.description: Lets you swap one of your powers with another person's power with their consent, as long as both abilities share the same rank.

nodes.name: Finger Gun
nodes.description: "Bang" Lets you point your index finger, say bang, and blast the target with telekinetic energy.

nodes.name: Telekinesis
nodes.description: Lets you grab and manipulate objects in sensory range with energy, shaping telekinesis like an invisible forcefield. Greater applied force costs more energy.

nodes.name: Greater Telekinesis
nodes.description: Lets you manipulate objects directly with willpower rather than outside force. Strong enough to throw skyscrapers and tear up streets at base level, improvable with training.

nodes.name: True Telekinesis
nodes.description: Your telekinesis is second to none, usable as forcefield, invisible force, or direct object manipulation, limited only by training. Rivals or exceeds Tatsumaki from One Punch Man.

nodes.name: Daily Grind
nodes.description: Once this ability has spent 24 total hours in an active slot, permanently add a regular grown man's strength and endurance to your stats. Repeatable.

nodes.name: Training Booster
nodes.description: While active, all training is twice as effective, doubling for each empty ability slot: 1 empty slot = 2x, 2 = 4x, 3 = 8x, etc.

nodes.name: Scouter
nodes.description: Lets you accurately gauge an opponent's abilities and power level even if they try to hide them.

nodes.name: Danger Rating
nodes.description: Lets you view a target's danger to you as safe, moderate, dangerous, lethal, or certain death.

nodes.name: Lifeblood
nodes.description: Lets you imbue your blood with vitality so drinkers are healed, with more vitality giving more healing. Moderate imbuing is harmless but leaves you weakened and exhausted.

nodes.name: Strength Sap
nodes.description: Lets you drain an opponent's strength through touch and temporarily add it to your own, with victims slowly recovering. Killing with it permanently grants 10% of their physical abilities. Stronger opponents drain slower.

nodes.name: Devil Trigger
nodes.description: Lets you tap inner demonic power to transform into a Devil form, greatly enhancing physical abilities and power. As a normal human you could tear tanks apart barehanded, scaling with your abilities.

nodes.name: Sin Devil Trigger
nodes.description: Lets you ascend your Devil form to its apotheosis, massively boosting power and physical abilities and wielding pure demonic power to boost existing abilities. Burns stamina and health extremely quickly; a wall-breaking fireball could annihilate city blocks.

nodes.name: Angel Form
nodes.description: Lets you transform into an angel or angel hybrid, boosting physical stats and energy. Lets you infuse abilities and items with holy energy and fly with wings.

nodes.name: Archangel Form
nodes.description: Lets you transform into an archangel or archangel hybrid, massively boosting physical stats. Lets you infuse abilities and items with pure holy energy and intuitively use blessings, healing, protection, and all Holy Abilities below Elite Rank.

nodes.name: New Order
nodes.description: Lets you place RULES on the world or objects, only as strong as you are. Examples include strengthening an object or granting yourself "Can grab lightning." Requires knowing a target's self-associated name, except for objects. Limited to 2 orders at once, increasable with training; stronger orders cost more energy.

nodes.name: Word Magic
nodes.description: Lets you actualize words written in the air, such as FREEZE to freeze, IMMOVABLE to pin mid-air, and BURN to ignite. Words too strong for your level fail.

nodes.name: Life Fiber Creation
nodes.description: Lets you convert lifeforce into Life Fibers, stronger than any manmade material yet more elastic than silk. You can freely control them and surround yourself to significantly boost physical abilities.

nodes.name: Life Fiber hybrid
nodes.description: Your body is infused with Life Fibers, granting massively superhuman physical abilities, incredible healing, and immense vitality. Wounds pull back together, even rejoining halves split apart.

nodes.name: Infernal Chains
nodes.description: Lets you conjure infernal barbed chains to bind foes or wield as weapons.

nodes.name: Angel Style
nodes.description: One Punch Man, Puri Puri Prisoner - For each % of skin uncovered, energy output and physical abilities rise by the same %, reaching 2x when fully naked.

nodes.name: Heavenly Restriction
nodes.description: While active, you cannot use energy or mana in any way. In exchange, physical abilities rise with your energy reserves, you are immune to spells cast directly on you, and you cannot be detected or directly targeted by magical means.

nodes.name: White Tiger Form
nodes.description: Lets you transform into a snow tiger or hybrid, gaining enhanced senses, predatory instincts, natural weapons, increased physical stats, and tiger traits.

nodes.name: Swamp Logia
nodes.description: Lets you generate, control, create, and turn into mud or bottomless swamp. You can drag objects or people inside to store them in stasis.

nodes.name: Idle Death Gamble
nodes.description: See https://jujutsu-kaisen.fandom.com/wiki/Idle_Death_Gamble

nodes.name: Susanoo
nodes.description: Lets you form a humanoid energy construct around your body with exceptional defense for attack and defense, while retaining selective intangibility to act from inside. Starts skeletal, growing stronger and more complete with training.

nodes.name: Perfect Mangekyo Sharingan - Sasuke
nodes.description: Grants Sasuke Uchiha's Mangekyo Sharingan plus enhanced normal Sharingan abilities. Lets you summon and control Amaterasu and summon a Susanoo.

nodes.name: Susanoo Ribs
nodes.description: Lets you form Susanoo's ribs from your energy as durable, selectively intangible defense you can attack from inside.

nodes.name: Barrier
nodes.description: Lets you form an adjustable, incredibly durable circular or dome barrier. Damaging it reflects lacerations onto attackers, but cracking it causes internal damage and coughing blood, with breaking causing worse backlash. Training can alter shape, size, and number.

nodes.name: Spider Man
nodes.description: "Don't forget the hyphen!" Bitten by a radioactive spider, you gain enhanced physical abilities, wall-climbing, natural web production, and precognition, without spider-totem hassle.

nodes.name: Bloodlust
nodes.description: Cloaks you in a killer's aura, boosting instincts into a sixth sense for striking, weak spots, and anticipating movements. Grants the senses of a veteran killer.

nodes.name: Phasing
nodes.description: Lets you phase through objects and let objects phase through others. Unphasing inside another object causes massive damage ignoring conventional durability.

nodes.name: The Absorber
nodes.description: Lets you absorb contacting energy of all kinds - kinetic, thermal, radiation, etc. - and convert it to your own. Absorbing strains the body and overuse causes damage.

nodes.name: Magic Arrow
nodes.description: Conjures a simple attributeless energy arrow projectile whose direction you can curve.

nodes.name: Momentum
nodes.description: The longer you keep moving, the faster you go, up to 500%. Limit expandable with training.

nodes.name: Fa Jin
nodes.description: Lets you build kinetic energy in limbs through repeated movement, then release it for bursts of power and speed. Stockpiled energy slowly fades if unused.

nodes.name: Glowing Eyes
nodes.description: Your eyes can glow. Provides no tangible advantage but looks cool.

nodes.name: Slipper
nodes.description: Your skin is slippery like oiled ice, making grappling you extremely annoying.

nodes.name: Waypoint
nodes.description: Lets you leave waypoints to warp to at any time. Setting or traveling takes 10 seconds. Max waypoints equal ability slot count x 3.

nodes.name: Wood Release
nodes.description: Wood Release lets you create, shape, and control wood and plant life. Roots you create can absorb and suppress energy/mana.

nodes.name: Dust Release
nodes.description: Lets you form three-dimensional translucent constructs like spheres and cubes that, once launched, reduce anything passing through to dust on a molecular level.

nodes.name: Skill Drain
nodes.description: Lets you drain others' skills through touch to worsen theirs and improve yours, e.g. swordsmanship. Cannot exceed the victim's level, so draining 1000 novices will not make you a sword god.

nodes.name: Velocity
nodes.description: You move 10x faster but influence the world 10x less. Punches hit 10x weaker and air resistance hits 10x stronger, etc.

nodes.name: Chameleon Hide
nodes.description: While standing still, you turn invisible by bending light around yourself.

nodes.name: Rinnegan
nodes.description: Grants the Six Paths Technique: Deva for attraction and repulsion, Asura for body alteration, Human for soul extraction, Animal for summons, Preta for chakra absorption, and Naraka via the King of Hell, plus the Outer Path over life and death to revive the dead. Also grants energy-flow sight and unparalleled sensory abilities.

nodes.name: Object Attraction
nodes.description: Lets you slowly draw small objects toward you, handy for grabbing the remote without leaving bed.

nodes.name: Rad Child
nodes.description: Lets you absorb radiation for regeneration and boosted physical abilities while irradiated. Absorbed radiation can permanently improve physical abilities and energy reserves.

nodes.name: Weather
nodes.description: Lets you accurately predict a given area's weather for a week.

nodes.name: Weather Report
nodes.description: Lets you control weather and atmosphere passively or actively, including lightning, water conjuring, past phenomena, storms, air composition, and wind. Can act autonomously to defend you or follow intent.

nodes.name: Hurting
nodes.description: Lets you directly damage a target by pointing, causing lacerations.

nodes.name: Dark Orb
nodes.description: Lets you conjure a dark-energy orb to hurl as a projectile.

nodes.name: Internet Access
nodes.description: Lets you access your local world's internet through your mind to instantly look up information.

nodes.name: Frisk
nodes.description: Lets you see a viewed target's full inventory, clothing, carried items, and a quick summary.

nodes.name: Ripen
nodes.description: Lets you ripen and mature organic objects that cannot resist.

nodes.name: Forced Activation
nodes.description: Lets you forcefully activate and use a touched target's ability while they are willing or unable to resist.

nodes.name: Tactile Telekinesis
nodes.description: Lets you telekinetically manipulate objects you touch, such as crumpling a car. Less effective on stronger targets.

nodes.name: Tinker - Bombs
nodes.description: Lets you build explosion-related technology and operate it, from simple explosives to time-freezing, glass-transmuting, or teleporting bombs, drawing on your abilities for inspiration.

nodes.name: Tinker - Efficiency
nodes.description: Lets you build efficiency-related technology and streamlined versions of existing tech.

nodes.name: Tinker - Drones
nodes.description: Lets you build drone-related technology, such as surveillance, turret, or building drones.

nodes.name: Tinker - Blasto
nodes.description: Lets you build biology and minion-creation tech, including custom plants, drugs, clones, and homunculi from available materials. Can draw inspiration from your abilities and traits.

nodes.name: Tinker - Prosthetics
nodes.description: Lets you build prosthetic and limb-replacement tech like bionic arms, mecha legs, and weaponized arms with hidden guns and blades. Can draw inspiration from your abilities and traits.

nodes.name: Tinker - Cryogenics
nodes.description: Lets you build cryonics-related tech like stasis chambers, frost grenades, ice guns, and fridges. You'd make Doctor Freeze proud.

nodes.name: Tinker - Pyrotechnics
nodes.description: Lets you build pyrotechnics-related tech like flamethrowers, super napalm, and missiles. You'd make Firefly proud.

nodes.name: Tinker - Hacking
nodes.description: Lets you build hacking-related tech for hijacking and interfacing with other technology.

nodes.name: Tinker - Ai
nodes.description: Lets you build AI-related tech, from smart assistants and sentient companions to full Ultron.

nodes.name: Tinker - Bio
nodes.description: Lets you build biology-related tech for living organisms, including diseases, elixirs, clones, healing pods, and custom races.

nodes.name: Tinker - Vehicles
nodes.description: Lets you build vehicle and transportation tech, like laser-cannon cloaked cars or supersonic wave-immune ships. If it is a vehicle, you can build it.

nodes.name: Tinker - Repair
nodes.description: Lets you build maintenance and repair tech. You can also spot flaws and fix almost any technology.

nodes.name: Tinker - Travel
nodes.description: Lets you build transportation and travel tech like teleportation pods, hypersonic cars, and wingsuits. If it gets you from A to B, you can probably build it.

nodes.name: Tinker - Teleportation
nodes.description: Lets you build teleportation tech like telepads and teleportation pods.

nodes.name: Tinker - Melee Weapons
