nodes.description: Lets you build melee-weapon tech like fire swords, vibration blades, and grenade hammers. If it is a non-magical melee weapon, you can probably build it.

nodes.name: Tinker - Ranged Weapons
nodes.description: Lets you build ranged-weapon tech like laser cannons, revolvers, and missile batteries.

nodes.name: Tinker - Capture and Restraint
nodes.description: Lets you build capture and restraint tech such as power-suppressing cuffs, containment foam, and durable cells.

nodes.name: Tinker - Construction
nodes.description: Lets you build construction tech such as super cement, reinforced steel, and highly efficient schematics.

nodes.name: Tinker - Cloaking
nodes.description: Lets you build cloaking tech like invisibility fields, anti-radars, and sound suppression.

nodes.name: Tinker - Analysis
nodes.description: Lets you build data-analysis tech like scouters, observation drones, and predictive programs.

nodes.name: Tinker - Mecha
nodes.description: Lets you build giant mechs like Evangelion, Code Geass, or Gundam.

nodes.name: Tinker - Cyberpunk 2077
nodes.description: Lets you build technology from the Cyberpunk 2077 universe.

nodes.name: Tinker - Metal Gear
nodes.description: Lets you build technology from the Metal Gear universe.

nodes.name: Tinker - Androids
nodes.description: Lets you build android and artificial-lifeform construction tech.

nodes.name: Tinker - RWBY
nodes.description: Lets you build technology from the RWBY Universe, including Dust synthesis.

nodes.name: Tinker - Code Geass
nodes.description: Build technological constructs or contraptions from the Code Geass universe.

nodes.name: Tinker - Computers
nodes.description: Build tech related to personal computers, such as small supercomputers, etc.

nodes.name: Tinker - Games
nodes.description: Build tech related to games or entertainment programs. You are over 100x more efficient than an average experienced full dev team at making them.

nodes.name: Tinker - Dreadon
nodes.description: Build tech emulating Dreadon from Calamity Mod, harnessing practically any energy. Includes hyper light chainsaws, black hole bombs, cosmic-energy godslaying mechs, a godslaying sword of damned souls, and an instant universe-range sniper; limits are creativity, resources, and time.

nodes.name: Tinker - Sensors
nodes.description: Build tech related to sensors, sensing, and tracking like radars, sonars, magic sensors, trackers, etc.

nodes.name: Tinker - Star Wars
nodes.description: Build technological constructs or contraptions from the Star Wars universe, including Kyber Crystal synthesis.

nodes.name: Tinker - Defense
nodes.description: Build tech related to defense or securement, like barrier projectors, reinforced chassis, turrets, etc.

nodes.name: Tinker - Armor
nodes.description: Build armored suits or power armor such as Iron Man Suit or Fallout Power Armor. Any powered suit up to 5x your size; larger counts as a mech.

nodes.name: Tinker - Fallout
nodes.description: Build constructs from the Fallout universe, such as Fusion Batteries, Chems, Power Armor, Stealth Boys, etc. Excludes Big MT Technology.

nodes.name: Toggle
nodes.description: Toggle objects or targets on and off; does not work on living beings. Applies to radios and even your own abilities.

nodes.name: Technopathy
nodes.description: "Talk to the power" to communicate with and command machines with code or interfaces. Resistance equals firewall strength.

nodes.name: Dark Hand
nodes.description: Drain lifeforce from grabbed people into yourself if they cannot resist. You can also coat your hand for extra damage or spread it as a medium-sized shield.

nodes.name: Polymerization
nodes.description: Temporarily fuse your familiars together or with yourself. Stronger fusions cost more energy, and maintaining fusion drains energy over time.

nodes.name: Viltrumite Physiology
nodes.description: You are a pure-blooded Viltrumite with insane durability, space flight, incredible physical and sensory abilities, and a highly adaptable body.

nodes.name: Kryptonian Physiology
nodes.description: You are a pure-blood Kryptonian; yellow sun supercharges your cells, granting heat vision, ice breath, tactile telekinesis, flight, super physique, and all other Kryptonian abilities. Longer sunlight soak strengthens these abilities and permanently improves energy reserves.

nodes.name: Saiyan Physiology
nodes.description: You are a pure-blooded Saiyan with superhuman physique, rapid improvement, and abnormal energy. Your tail paralyzes you when grabbed, full moon turns you into a mindless Oozaru with massively enhanced stats, and near-death recovery makes you significantly stronger.

nodes.name: Soft & Wet
nodes.description: Release soap bubbles that plunder a property from touched targets, like floor friction to make it slippery or hydration to cause thirst.

nodes.name: Soften
nodes.description: Soften touched objects while retaining other properties; steel becomes dough-like but stays as heavy and durable. Shapes stay changed while hardness slowly returns after release.

nodes.name: Harden
nodes.description: Harden touched objects while retaining properties, like fire into a hot barrier or water into a platform. Consistency slowly returns after release.

nodes.name: Clone
nodes.description: Clone yourself with a hive mind; you can use abilities through any body. Creating and maintaining clones costs energy rising exponentially per clone, and a portion of a clone's death damage reflects onto you.

nodes.name: Multiply
nodes.description: Create physical-body clones that cannot use abilities but carry your physical traits at formation; forming during active abilities is more taxing. You share one hive mind, clones need no upkeep, and you can hold 10 at a time, increasable with training.

nodes.name: Avatar Creation
nodes.description: Turn abilities into avatars by giving each at least 10% of max energy storage. Avatars can act independently or under your control, use only the given ability plus your basic stats, and return energy and ability on dispel or after 1 hour if destroyed.

nodes.name: Twice
nodes.description: Clone yourself and others, but clones have independent minds and massively reduced durability. You can clone only two targets at a time, clones can clone with even lower durability, and after 10 iterations clones cannot retain form.

nodes.name: Clay Bombs
nodes.description: Form clay constructs that move independently and explode on command. More infused energy means stronger explosions.

nodes.name: Dark Matter
nodes.description: Generate and control nonexistent Dark Matter, which can take any property: combustible, ashifying organics, new matter states, elements, life, clones, powers, etc. Only limit is computational power.

nodes.name: Nilbog
nodes.description: Recycle biomass into customized self-aware minions; required biomass must equal result biomass. Minions can take any biologically possible form, like fire-breathing horses with graphene scales with practice, and are unconditionally loyal.

nodes.name: World Painting
nodes.description: Bring paintings to life as enterable pocket dimensions or worlds depending on power; even minimally, a small forest with inhabitants. With training, create your own mini-world.

nodes.name: Wonder of U
nodes.description: Protected by Calamity itself: pursuers or those aware of you suffer escalating calamities until they stop or die. Closer proximity escalates from falling trees up to their own abilities killing them; calamity kills grant no tickets.

nodes.name: Bloody Imitation
nodes.description: Transform appearance to match someone whose blood you consumed, down to minute details. Disguise duration equals ml consumed x 1 minute.

nodes.name: Bloody Replication
nodes.description: Transform into someone by consuming their blood, exactly copying physical abilities, their ability and usage, plus basic info. Duration equals ml consumed x 1 minute.

nodes.name: Tetramand Transformation
nodes.description: Take Tetramand or Tetramand-hybrid form, among the galaxy's mightiest warriors with durable red skin, four eyes, four arms, and second-to-none strength.

nodes.name: Cement Manipulation
nodes.description: Conjure and manipulate cement into constructs, walls, weapons, and back into less solid form.

nodes.name: Slime Physique
nodes.description: Transform fully or partially into slime, mostly negating physical damage and exploiting a slimy physique.

nodes.name: Cursed Flames
nodes.description: Throw green fireballs that cannot burn inanimates, bouncing off them like rubber, but devour living flesh and stick like glue.

nodes.name: Burning Sea
nodes.description: Throw crimson flame balls strengthened by water; dousing with water is like throwing crude oil on fire.

nodes.name: Brimstone
nodes.description: Conjure and wield Brimstone Crag flames tempered by tortured souls' agony. Incomparably hot, incinerating everything and burning intangibles like souls.

nodes.name: Ranchor
nodes.description: Wield Ranchor, ultimate brimstone flames of malice and revenge. Burns anything including souls, energy, and flesh, but also burns the user to a lesser extent with more use.

nodes.name: Banishing Fire
nodes.description: Holy fire gifted to clerics by angels as blessings, harmless to regular living creatures like humans and animals. Deals extreme damage to unholy or darkness beings and blocks their healing.

nodes.name: Holy Flame
nodes.description: Wield angels' holy flames, no stronger than normal fire against regular living creatures like humans and animals. Deals extreme damage to unholy or darkness beings, blocks healing, and can burn away afflictions if skilled.

nodes.name: Star of Comprehension
nodes.description: While in an active slot, massively boost comprehension: learn a book from one read and imitate martial arts from video or live exchange. Learn and master skills at supernatural rates.

nodes.name: Divinity Fire
nodes.description: You are a God of Fire with domain over all fire, creating and controlling any type and shaping its temperature and effect.

nodes.name: Rabbit Form
nodes.description: Partially or fully transform into a rabbit or hybrid, gaining enhanced physicality focused on leg jumping and kicking, plus a substantial libido boost.

nodes.name: Ifrit
nodes.description: Transform into an Ifrit, a fire-born spirit. Cannot use water or water-based abilities as one, but fire abilities are much stronger with natural flame generation.

nodes.name: Ifrit Sultan
nodes.description: Transform into an Ifrit Sultan, ancient flame spirit ruling fire spirits with ancient-dragon-level power. Strengthens all fire abilities, disables cryo/hydrokinesis, and grants natural pyrokinesis plus fire immunity.

nodes.name: More Eyes
nodes.description: Manifest eyes anywhere on your body without disorientation from multiple vision.

nodes.name: Extension
nodes.description: Extend durations beyond norm by consuming energy, such as blessings, lifespans, expiry dates, or burning flames. Must interact with the target.

nodes.name: Size Manipulation
nodes.description: Manipulate size and mass of a touched target; each doubling or halving doubles the cost. Changes revert after a set time.

nodes.name: Shrink
nodes.description: Shrink yourself to 20x smaller with proportionally reduced power; unshrink anytime. Limit increasable with training.

nodes.name: Minimize Me
nodes.description: Shrink yourself up to 20x smaller without losing power; hits equally hard at 180cm or 18cm. Limit increasable with training.

nodes.name: Gigantism
nodes.description: Increase size and mass up to 10x; holding it drains stamina and burns energy faster. Can grow larger with training.

nodes.name: Titanic
nodes.description: Increase size and mass up to 100x; holding it drains stamina and burns energy faster. Can grow larger with training.

nodes.name: Enlarge
nodes.description: Enlarge touched targets permanently or temporarily, with permanence costing far more. More energetic objects are harder and costlier to enhance.

nodes.name: Message
nodes.description: Send one-way telepathic messages to anyone in sensory range.

nodes.name: Induce Baldness
nodes.description: "A power so cruel" induces baldness on contact, gradually or instantly removing all hair. May make you the mortal enemy of most.

nodes.name: Dream Mirror
nodes.description: View dreams of anyone in sensory range like a livestream. Can likely influence dreams by whispering in their ears.

nodes.name: Share Sense
nodes.description: Link senses with willing others via touch, seeing from each other's perspective. Too many links cause disorientation.

nodes.name: Sleep Talk
nodes.description: Talk to sleepers to influence them, shaping dreams or opinions like hypnosis.

nodes.name: Probability Estimation
nodes.description: View probabilities of any questioned outcome, like dying tomorrow or finding something somewhere. Always accurate except around blind spots.

nodes.name: Adhesion
nodes.description: Turn skin incredibly sticky to cling to walls or hold ordinary people. You feel no difference and control which parts stick.

nodes.name: Lion Form
nodes.description: Turn into a proud lion or hybrid at will, gaining enhanced physicality, paralyzing roar, and natural weapons. Mundane animals defer to you as king unless you harm them.

nodes.name: Fake Weapon
nodes.description: Create illusionary weapons in hands for intimidation.

nodes.name: Bear Manipulation
nodes.description: Take control of all bears within 50 meters. Good luck finding that many bears.

nodes.name: Healing Kiss
nodes.description: Heal by kissing, supercharging the target's natural regeneration with your energy.

nodes.name: VATS
nodes.description: "Vault-Tec Assisted Targeting System" puts your body on autopilot to aim attacks or aids melee as a helpful Intermediate-level combat AI.

nodes.name: Warp Mist
nodes.description: Create and control portal-like dark mists shapable to your liking, reaching anywhere visited or seen. With training, use coordinates and images for unvisited places plus more mist.

nodes.name: Phenex
nodes.description: You are the Phenex, immortal through flames that near-instantly regenerate you from a single shred. Also wield powerful flames and winds with ease.

nodes.name: Crack
nodes.description: Create tears in things in range, neutralizing attacks or directly ravaging targets for massive damage. Tears resist healing, taking hours even for Epic-ranked healing.

nodes.name: Number Man
nodes.description: You possess nigh-infinite computational power for numbers and calculations, shaming even the strongest sci-fi supercomputers in math.

nodes.name: Route
nodes.description: See a guiding line to any location you precisely know.

nodes.name: Stockpile
nodes.description: Stockpile energy while in an active slot, holding up to 3x your storage but taking 24 hours to fill completely.

nodes.name: Cockroach Physique
nodes.description: Turn into a humanoid cockroach or hybrid at will, gaining extreme resilience, increased physicality, and mundane cockroach traits.

nodes.name: Candy Paramecia
nodes.description: Create and control candy as viscous syrup that hardens under your control; control ends after separation. With training, make it steel-hard and manipulate it off-body.

nodes.name: Bronze Creation
nodes.description: Create and shape bronze, the superior metal and alloy, into weapons, armor, or constructs. Can reinforce it with your energy.

nodes.name: Blood Burn
nodes.description: Significantly enhance physical stats by burning blood, losing 1ml per second. Can raise to 10ml per second for up to 5x strength.

nodes.name: Devil Regeneration
nodes.description: Gain extreme regeneration regrowing limbs in seconds, fueled by others' blood rather than energy. More blood means more regeneration; a large cup restores near-death to peak.

nodes.name: Tower of Babel
nodes.description: Scramble senses of everyone within 500 meters, causing extreme disorientation like falling sensation, nausea, vertigo, tinnitus, deafness, etc.

nodes.name: Reactive Activation
nodes.description: Set conditions on abilities for auto-activation, e.g. barrier on high-speed projectile or healing on foreign substance entry.

nodes.name: The Camper
nodes.description: "I can stay here all day" - Standing still over 10 seconds boosts energy, stamina, and health regen plus durability and resistance. Moving feet over 10cm from start ends it.

nodes.name: Energy Regeneration
nodes.description: Regenerate energy/mana by consuming stamina instead.

nodes.name: Bloody Carthus
nodes.description: Sacrifice health to instantly recover energy; more energy recovered means more damage taken.

nodes.name: Monarch's Indifference
nodes.description: Author's PoV - Fully suppress emotions to act with complete indifference toward your goal. Also fully counters mind manipulation or telepathy aimed at you.

nodes.name: Emotion Spectrum
nodes.description: See emotions as colored auras, e.g. yellow happiness, green envy, black despair, red anger, etc.

nodes.name: Sugar Rush
nodes.description: Consume sugar for temporary super strength scaled to amount consumed, followed by a massive sugar crash.

nodes.name: Scarlet Rot
nodes.description: Create, control, and inflict Scarlet Rot, a deadly foreign-god infection eroding mind and body into mindless savagery.

nodes.name: Path to Love
nodes.description: View how to romance people and unlock their romance questlines. If you still fail with this, there is probably no path to love for you.

nodes.name: Path to Victory
nodes.description: Create a path to any mechanically possible goal, even one-in-googol odds, with impossibly precise execution and nigh-omniscient calculation except blind spots. Can use paths as guidelines only.

nodes.name: Spectral Claw
nodes.description: Manifest a large demon-like clawed arm over your own with superhuman strength and grip to crush steel and lift cars, extendable and slightly growable. Damage to it reflects onto your real arm.

nodes.name: Shield
nodes.description: Create translucent dome or wall barriers acting as physical defenses.

nodes.name: Absolute Barrier
nodes.description: Cross fingers to create one transparent barrier with controllable shape and size. Completely invulnerable to mundane damage like physical force, thermal, lightning, etc.

nodes.name: Shock Absorption
nodes.description: Body absorbs kinetic energy like a sponge, reducing physical attack effectiveness.

nodes.name: Hydrogen Manipulation
nodes.description: Sense and telekinetically control hydrogen with perfect precision, the universe's most abundant element. Use it to manipulate air and water, create explosions, or freeze with liquid hydrogen.

nodes.name: Oxygen Manipulation
nodes.description: Sense and telekinetically control oxygen atoms with perfect precision to control air, drive combustion, corrode via oxidation, rip oxygen from objects, or poison with pure oxygen clouds.

nodes.name: Sharpen
nodes.description: Sharpen touched objects, from monomolecular blades to swung air forming razor winds.

nodes.name: Dragon Projection
nodes.description: Create translucent dragon-limb projections for varied uses: arms to cut, smash, or protect, head to bite or breathe flames, wings to fly or glide.

nodes.name: Hydra Projection
nodes.description: Unleash hydra-head projections from body or back to crush, bite, smash, or constrict with the neck. A severed head needs time to resummon.

nodes.name: Natural Armory
nodes.description: Turn touched objects into stable cold weapons regardless of matter, like water scythe, stone spear, air sword, or fire whip. The world is your armory.

nodes.name: Unlimited Bladeworks
nodes.description: {Reality Marble} scan and understand any weapon encountered to store in a mental armory, then project it with identical attributes for energy. With practice, pull others into your sword-filled mental world. Excludes Alien, Fae, and Divine weapons by default.

nodes.name: Reinforcement
nodes.description: Reinforce structure and quality of touched objects or yourself. More energy means stronger but harder-to-maintain reinforcement.

nodes.name: Alteration
nodes.description: Alter shape and structure of touched objects, e.g. sharper, blunter, longer. Can turn a sword into a polearm while retaining abilities.

nodes.name: Makeover
nodes.description: Change anything purely cosmetic about yourself, like ability color, hair color, pupil shape, skin color, etc.

nodes.name: Power to Reject Death
nodes.description: On death resurrect as undead scaled to slot count, then after 24 hours revive as original self. 1=Skeleton, 2=Skeleton Warrior/Mage, 3=Dullahan/Necromancer, 4=Death Knight/Lich, 5+=Dread Knight/Elder Lich. 10-day cooldown.

nodes.name: Dead Apostle Ancestor Form
nodes.description: Temporarily become a Dead Apostle Ancestor, strongest Vampire rank, with incredible physical/magical prowess, mist transformation, and time-reversal regeneration consuming your blood while heart remains and blood exists. Forms a Legendary-ranked Idea Blood from your life/experiences and can create full undead apostles.

nodes.name: Crush
nodes.description: Remotely crush objects in line of sight, increasing pressure with energy output. Stronger targets are harder to crush.

nodes.name: Schrodinger
nodes.description: You are everywhere and nowhere at once; close eyes to appear anywhere you know. Costs no energy/mana and may not be true teleportation.

nodes.name: Catch the Rainbow
nodes.description: Under rainfall, stand on raindrops, teleport through them, or wield them as knives. Works only in actual rain, not falling water.

nodes.name: Ratio Technique
nodes.description: Split targets into imaginary lines creating a weak spot at the seven-to-three ratio point. Hitting it deals critical damage.

nodes.name: Killer Queen
nodes.description: Turn touched things into bombs detonable anytime, either catching the object or leaving it unscathed; contact-spread bypasses durability. Can also weak-explode via Killer Queen to disintegrate; strong targets partly resist.

nodes.name: Diver Down
nodes.description: Dive into objects to restructure from inside, healing innards or fusing objects. Can also hide inside people or objects.

nodes.name: Berserk
nodes.description: "Power at what cost?" Gain extreme strength, endurance, and near pain immunity for lost inhibitions and trance. Even ordinary men can throw trucks, tear tanks, and eat missiles.

nodes.name: Move Mimicry
nodes.description: Mimic any one displayed opponent move or ability into Mimic and unleash the identical effect. Cannot copy above Epic, single stored ability, single use, then resets. 8-hour cooldown.

nodes.name: Clockwork
nodes.description: Rewind time with 1-minute charges; spending one returns you 1 minute back. Gain a charge every 24 hours, hold up to 30.

nodes.name: Luck Aura
nodes.description: Store and unleash luck, gaining a charge every 24 hours for extreme luck like surviving lethal attacks or finding exactly what is needed. Excludes gacha tickets; hold up to 7.

nodes.name: Lucky Strike
nodes.description: Turn luck your way for 1 hour of extraordinary fortune of all kinds. Cooldown: 7 days 7 hours 7 minutes.

nodes.name: Eye of Discernment
nodes.description: {Mystic Eyes} See through all illusions and deceit; illusions reveal true forms and you sense deceptive intent and which words are true.

nodes.name: Enchanting
nodes.description: Enchant items from your abilities and traits, e.g. pyrokinesis grants fire enchantments, or imbue the power itself as limited-use consumables. Strength depends on item and power level.

nodes.name: Greater Enchanting
nodes.description: Lets you enchant items based on your abilities and traits, granting related effects or imbuing the ability itself as limited uses. Enchantment strength scales with the item and your power level.

nodes.name: Esper Silence
nodes.description: Legendary Mechanic - Lets you disable a target's ability by touching them. Duration scales with power difference, minimum 3 seconds. 5-minute cooldown.

nodes.name: Flawed Return
nodes.description: Lets you rewind time up to 5 minutes with a 10-minute cooldown. Your body rewinds too, so injuries and exhaustion carry over.

nodes.name: Save & Load
nodes.description: Gives you 12 manual save files you can save and load at any time. No quicksaves or autosaves.

nodes.name: Xavier
nodes.description: Makes you an extremely powerful telepath able to communicate tens of kilometers away and mold human minds like clay.

nodes.name: We Are Network
nodes.description: Lets you borrow processing power from objects by touch, slowing them while massively speeding yourself up. Overuse can cause brain damage to both parties.

nodes.name: Gallant
nodes.description: Lets you sense emotions and fire projectiles that deal no damage but temporarily alter the target's emotions, such as euphoria or depression.

nodes.name: Emotion Sense
nodes.description: Lets you sense people's emotions, with training discerning their causes and finer details.

nodes.name: Heartbreaker
nodes.description: Lets you manipulate emotions of people within 50 meters, subtly tweaking or overwhelming them with anything from adoration to suicidal urges. Effectiveness scales with power difference.

nodes.name: Piloting
nodes.description: Lets you pilot people's bodies by eye contact, suppressing their minds or with their permission. Your body falls unconscious while piloting; stronger will or power can resist. Training can let you pilot multiple people.

nodes.name: Snap Out of It!
nodes.description: Lets you clear negative mental conditions like fear, panic, or mind control with a firm slap. Effectiveness scales with your physical stats.

nodes.name: Force of Will
nodes.description: While active, makes you immune to status effects like fear, panic, sadness, and despair, leaving you highly motivated and determined.

nodes.name: Frenzy
nodes.description: Makes you immune to negative mental effects while blood-drunk, trading most inhibitions for a large instinct boost.

nodes.name: Trance
nodes.description: Lets you snap your fingers to entrance anyone focused on you, letting you subtly influence them until harm snaps them out. Fails on the strongly strong-willed or stronger than you.

nodes.name: Suggestion
nodes.description: Lets you plant mental suggestions that targets mistake for their own ideas, steering or conditioning them.

nodes.name: Hypnosis
nodes.description: Lets you hypnotize off-guard targets to subtly or directly influence them. Higher willpower resists more strongly.

nodes.name: King of the Castle
nodes.description: Lets you transmute the ground into a castle shaped by your mental state, plus soldiers and beasts made from it. You can reshape it at will, including weaponry like cannons or guns. Constructs deactivate if you leave the castle.

nodes.name: Memory Reading
nodes.description: Lets you read the memories of an unresisting target by placing your palm on their forehead. Stronger resistance makes reading harder.

nodes.name: Graviton Tyrant
nodes.description: Lets you manipulate gravity on a massive scale with immense power but little precision. Minimum 100-meter area at 50x gravity; you can rip up city blocks, but cannot handle small or delicate targets without crushing them.

nodes.name: Fast Travel
nodes.description: Lets you instantly travel to anywhere you have been while out of danger. Cost scales with distance.

nodes.name: Gaster Blaster
nodes.description: Lets you conjure floating dragon-skull projections that fire energy lasers or bite, and can carry you or block attacks.

nodes.name: Kingdom Soul
nodes.description: Makes your soul a shapeable kingdom that absorbs souls of those you kill or wayward souls you find. You can house them, manifest them as physical soldiers, sacrifice them for power, or burn them to recover energy.

nodes.name: Pixie Power
nodes.description: Lets you transform into a pixie at will, gaining flight, energy reserves, and agility at the cost of size and physical power.

nodes.name: Ajin Form
nodes.description: Makes you an Ajin with biological immortality, resurrecting at peak condition from your largest remaining flesh via Invisible Black Matter at no energy cost. You can summon IBM shadows to fight, defend, or scout on your orders.

nodes.name: Measure King
nodes.description: Lets you know the exact dimensions and measurements of anything at a glance.

nodes.name: Slip In
nodes.description: Lets you squeeze your body through any opening wider than 5 centimeters.

nodes.name: Normal World
nodes.description: Lets you erect a field around yourself where no supernatural effects function except your dismissal of the field, leaving even gods to their physical bodies.

nodes.name: Nice Guy
nodes.description: Makes people incapable of perceiving you as a threat, even while harming them, granting immunity to hostility. Fails against far superior mental abilities or divine-level beings stronger than you.

nodes.name: The Imp
nodes.description: Makes you unperceivable while active, wiping you from minds and recordings the moment you are noticed. People can still deduce your existence and counter you without remembering you.

nodes.name: Majin Physique
nodes.description: Gives you a boneless, organless Majin body that freely morphs and regenerates from any piece larger than a walnut while you have energy. You gain greatly enhanced stats and can absorb others for a portion of their strength.

nodes.name: Disaster nature
nodes.description: Grants Hanami-level plant control, creating energy plants, binding roots, and energy-draining cursed buds. You can draw energy from existing nature to recharge.

nodes.name: Shark Physique
nodes.description: Lets you turn into a shark or shark hybrid at will, gaining enhanced stats boosted further underwater, razor teeth able to tear metal, water affinity, and other shark traits.

nodes.name: Octopus Physique
nodes.description: Lets you transform into an octopus or octopus hybrid at will, gaining enhanced stats boosted underwater, independent body control, slow limb and organ regeneration, and other octopus traits.

nodes.name: Minotaur
nodes.description: Lets you fully or partially transform into a minotaur, gaining massively enhanced strength, stamina, durability, and regeneration at the cost of inhibitions. Training improves control.

nodes.name: Outgun
nodes.description: Lets you transmute touched material into any known gun plus bullets. Gun power scales with material quality.

nodes.name: Capture Token
nodes.description: Lets you seal anything you defeat into 5x5 capture tokens where they cannot escape or use abilities, or instantly capture instead of killing. Targets must be unable to resist. Tokens can also transport people.

nodes.name: Crystalline
nodes.description: Lets you create and telekinetically control gem-like crystals, with durability scaling with energy spent. You can spread them over touched surfaces.

nodes.name: Crystal Caesar
nodes.description: Lets you create and finely control gem-like crystals, even as powder. You can make semi-autonomous crystal golems that crumble when disabled and slowly drain energy.

nodes.name: Weaver
nodes.description: Lets you conjure energy threads you control like limbs, with strength and number scaling with energy spent. Threads dissipate once detached from you.

nodes.name: Kirin Physique
nodes.description: Lets you transform into a Kirin or Kirin hybrid, gaining enhanced stats, speed, and lightning affinity, plus the ability to call down powerful lightning bolts.

nodes.name: Remember Me?
nodes.description: While active, makes everyone who knows you temporarily forget you and prevents anyone met from recalling your features.

nodes.name: Sprout
nodes.description: Lets you minorly communicate with and control nearby plants, accelerating their growth, further boosting it with energy, and slightly altering their shape.

nodes.name: Sapling
nodes.description: Lets you create, communicate with, and control nearby plants, growing grass, ripening crops, shaping them slightly, driving roots through concrete, and raising trees into barriers.

nodes.name: Bloom
nodes.description: Makes you a chlorokinetic able to create and control plants in sensory range, snaring foes with branches, breaking concrete with trees, wielding vines as whips, or growing fruit on demand.

nodes.name: Verdance
nodes.description: Gives you formidable chlorokinesis over plants in sensory range, growing them from soil and boosting them supernaturally, such as steel-hard wood and razor leaves. Requires a plant in range or growing one first.

nodes.name: Overgrowth
nodes.description: Makes you a powerful chlorokinetic able to create, reinforce, and control plants in sensory range, raising forests, swallowing foes with roots, and hardening branches to cut titanium. Requires a plant in range or growing one first.

nodes.name: Flora
nodes.description: Makes you a master of plants able to create, reinforce, and control all plant life in sensory range, erupting forests, growing metal-strong trees, and fusing trees into treant golems, limited only by energy.

nodes.name: Gaia
nodes.description: Makes you one with nature able to create, reinforce, and control all plant life, erupting world-swallowing jungles, treant armies, and kilometer-long root spears, limited only by energy.

nodes.name: Spiritual Interaction
nodes.description: Lets you and your abilities interact with the spiritual world, extending your perception to souls and spirits.

nodes.name: Bow and Arrow
nodes.description: Lets you conjure an energy bow and arrow, with arrow strength scaling with energy invested.

nodes.name: Sharpshooter
nodes.description: Lets you conjure an energy bow and arrow with boosted marksmanship and sharpened senses while aiming. Arrow strength scales with energy, and you can alter its shape and size.

nodes.name: Odysseus Draw
nodes.description: Lets you conjure a great energy bow whose arrows pierce most metals, growing stronger with energy invested. Aiming boosts marksmanship and senses, and you can alter arrow shape and size.

nodes.name: Hou Yi's Bow
nodes.description: Lets you conjure an imitation of Hou Yi's bow firing destructive arrows that strengthen with energy invested. Aiming boosts marksmanship and senses, and you can alter arrow shape and size.

nodes.name: Artemis' Might
nodes.description: Lets you conjure an energy bow blessed by Artemis, firing arrows that pierce the toughest foes and strengthen with energy invested. Aiming boosts marksmanship, sharpens senses, and guides your shot, and you can alter arrow shape and size.

nodes.name: Bountiful Harvest
nodes.description: Lets you create ripe, tasty fruits and vegetables with your own energy.

nodes.name: Orchard
nodes.description: Lets you create extremely refreshing fruits and vegetables from energy, which can gain unique properties from your abilities.

nodes.name: Bone Baron
nodes.description: Lets you create and control bones, erupting them from surfaces in sight and raising semi-autonomous skeleton soldiers. Soldiers vanish if cancelled or swapped, and more soldiers drain more energy.

nodes.name: Summon Item
nodes.description: Lets you mark up to 10 items within your lifting strength to summon to you at will and return to where you summoned them from.

nodes.name: Silk Weaver
nodes.description: Lets you produce and control body-spun silk for grappling, restraining, and fastening. Output and durability scale with physical stats.

nodes.name: Lesser Physical Enhancement
nodes.description: Lets you modestly boost all physical capabilities equally with energy. Boost scales with base stats and energy spent.

nodes.name: Physical Enhancement
nodes.description: Lets you boost all physical capabilities equally with energy. Boost scales with base stats and energy spent.

nodes.name: Iron Skin
nodes.description: Reinforces your skin to metal-like toughness and mass, letting even a base human shrug off bats, small-caliber bullets, and survive car crashes. It can slow your movement.

nodes.name: Aura
nodes.description: Covers you in a soul barrier that boosts physical capabilities and absorbs attacks, letting you survive at least one hit before breaking.

nodes.name: Alexandria
nodes.description: Grants super strength able to lift millions of tons, high-speed flight, enhanced intellect, and a time-locked body immune to all non-spacetime effects. You can still suffocate.

nodes.name: Super
nodes.description: Grants average super speed, strength, durability, and flight, excelling in none but above average in all.

nodes.name: Stone Skin
nodes.description: Lets you cover your skin in a stone-like layer that boosts durability and mass.

nodes.name: Overheat
nodes.description: Lets you burn energy to greatly boost attack power, speed, and fire abilities at the cost of defense and recovery. Longer burning means more heat and power, until your organs begin to melt.

nodes.name: Frozen Soul
nodes.description: Freezes your soul, dulling emotions while boosting defense and cryokinetic potency at the cost of speed and offense. The colder you grow, the tougher and more frigid you become.

nodes.name: Certainty of Steel
nodes.description: Lets you transform your body into any technology you understand, such as nanofiber muscles, weaponized prosthetics, or scanner eyes. Training can negate mass differences.

nodes.name: Invulnerable
nodes.description: Makes you invulnerable to anything below reality manipulation while you wish to be unharmed, even surviving multiverse collapse unscathed.

nodes.name: Immortal
nodes.description: Makes you truly immortal, with reality restoring you moments after death even from total erasure, plus regeneration fast enough to reform mid-step. Each death permanently increases all your stats.

nodes.name: Exclusion
nodes.description: Lets you exclude yourself from anything that can interact with you, such as time, physics, harm, targeting, or perception.

nodes.name: All Fiction
nodes.description: Lets you deny the existence of anything to reality, which obeys, treating reality like clay.

nodes.name: Desperation
nodes.description: Boosts all physical stats based on danger at no energy cost: none when safe, scaling from Common when mildly endangered up to Epic when facing certain death.

nodes.name: Masochistic Soul
nodes.description: The more negative effects you suffer, the faster you regenerate health and energy. Curses, poison, illness, and bleeding only fuel you.

nodes.name: Sadism
nodes.description: Refunds a portion of attack energy proportional to damage dealt, but doubles the cost of attacks that deal no damage.

nodes.name: Level Up!
nodes.description: Permanently absorbs 10% of anything you kill's stats into your own.

nodes.name: Ogre Form
nodes.description: Lets you turn into an ogre or ogre hybrid at will, gaining increased stats, regeneration, and other ogre traits.

nodes.name: Bear Form
nodes.description: Lets you turn into a bear or bear hybrid at will, gaining enhanced stats, fangs, claws, thick hide, and other bear traits.

nodes.name: Threshold Clause
nodes.description: Caps damage taken at 25% of total health per 5 seconds, regardless of attacker or attack strength.

nodes.name: Bloody Survival
nodes.description: Lets you sacrifice 33% of your health to gain 10 seconds of invincibility. The sacrificed health cannot be healed, recovering over 1 hour.

nodes.name: Cat Form
nodes.description: Lets you turn into a cat or cat hybrid at will, gaining enhanced agility, senses, reflexes, claws, teeth, and other cat traits.

nodes.name: Bat Form
nodes.description: Lets you turn into a bat or bat hybrid at will, gaining agility, senses, sonar, flight, claws, teeth, and other bat traits.

nodes.name: Wolf Form
nodes.description: Lets you turn into a wolf or wolf hybrid at will, gaining enhanced stats, claws, fangs, night vision, senses, and other wolf traits.

nodes.name: Idle Transfiguration
nodes.description: Lets you shape souls by touch, reshaping bodies through them, with cost scaling against stronger targets. You can shapeshift yourself, but larger mass changes reduce energy output.

nodes.name: Fist Projection
nodes.description: Lets you launch fist projections by punching, with size and power scaling with energy spent. Base power equals your physical strength, usable to boost melee or strike at range.

nodes.name: Combo
nodes.description: Boosts each physical hit by 10% more if landed within 3 seconds of the last, stacking up to 999%. Missing the window resets the combo.

nodes.name: Overdraw
nodes.description: Lets you equip abilities beyond your slots, doubling total energy consumption for each extra ability.

nodes.name: Mystic Eyes of Flaw Perception
nodes.description: {Mystic Eyes} Lets you see weaknesses in objects and creatures highlighted in red, and with training understand them and strike break points to cripple creatures, collapse structures, or dispel spells.

nodes.name: Enhanced Senses
nodes.description: Lets you enhance all five senses with energy, such as cross-country sight, months-old scent tracking, or city-wide hearing.

nodes.name: Sixth Sense
nodes.description: Lets you sense hostile or killing intent directed at you and its source, though trained killers are harder to read.

nodes.name: Dangersense
nodes.description: Lets you sense incoming danger, with stronger threats producing stronger sensations.

nodes.name: Bungee Gum
nodes.description: Lets you conjure and manipulate Bungee Gum, a substance with the properties of both rubber and gum.

nodes.name: Material Absorption
nodes.description: Lets you absorb a touched material to coat or transform your body and gain its properties, including esoteric ones like vibranium. Steel grants resilience and conductivity, uranium radioactivity, glass brittleness.

nodes.name: Greater Material Absorption
nodes.description: Lets you absorb a touched material to coat or transform your body and gain its properties, including esoteric ones like vibranium. You can also shape your body into weapons and create more of the material with energy.

nodes.name: Galvanic Mechamorph Form
nodes.description: Lets you transform into a Galvanic Mechamorph that fuses with and upgrades technology proportional to your power.

nodes.name: Greater Throw
nodes.description: Lets you imbue thrown objects with speed proportional to energy spent, reaching Mach speeds with enough energy.

nodes.name: Launch
nodes.description: Lets you launch touched objects with speed scaling with energy spent, sending cars to a hundred times the speed of sound with enough energy. Larger masses cost more, and living beings can resist.

nodes.name: Reflection
nodes.description: Lets you create invisible forcefields that reflect kinetic attacks back at double strength, up to your power limit. Maintaining and reflecting costs energy; training improves size and shaping.

nodes.name: Blademaster
nodes.description: Lets you create varied energy blades, from throwing knives to greatswords, while gaining a minor strength boost.

nodes.name: Spear of Justice
nodes.description: Lets you summon energy spears you telekinetically control, conjuring them from any solid surface.

nodes.name: Ripper Mode
nodes.description: Lets you enter a battle trance unleashing all rage, drastically slowing your perception and unlocking 100% power regardless of bodily harm. It drains energy and overuse damages you.

nodes.name: Atomic Manipulation
nodes.description: Lets you manipulate atoms with great precision to transmute matter and control elements, up to transforming bodies or crafting superior matter. Requires extensive training to use well.

nodes.name: Time Stop
nodes.description: Lets you stop time at great energy cost. Far superior beings can resist the freeze.

nodes.name: Time Calibration
nodes.description: Lets you calibrate time on your body, slowing the world, hastening yourself or only your perception, stalling wounds, or slowing incoming objects. Larger effects cost more energy.

nodes.name: Space Manipulation
nodes.description: Lets you manipulate space to move things telekinetically, teleport, tear space, create pocket dimensions, warp objects, harden targets, and with training invade other worlds.

nodes.name: Adventure Awaits!
nodes.description: Lets you leave to a random world on a mission, returning once completed, and revisit it later via spatial travel or vehicles. Cooldown: 1 Month.

nodes.name: Time God
nodes.description: Lets you freely rewind, fast-forward, travel through, and stop time while you have energy.

nodes.name: Luck Manipulation
nodes.description: Lets you raise or lower any target's luck, given enough energy.

nodes.name: Wrath
nodes.description: Makes you grow stronger with anger and conflict without limit, potentially reaching universe-ending power. Escalating too far destroys your reason, leaving a mindless beast until death or extinction.

nodes.name: Sage
nodes.description: Massively boosts thought speed, comprehension, and reasoning beyond computer level.

nodes.name: Great Sage
nodes.description: Lets you accelerate thoughts, instantly analyze objects, and gather detailed target information from basic knowledge. It acts automatically and helps manage your abilities.

nodes.name: Magic Dominion
nodes.description: You are the true user of magic in this world. You dominate mana and all magic around you, rendering magic inert and uncastable, instantly learning any spell in sensory range, casting spells instantly and instinctively, and absorbing magical energy from people and the environment.

nodes.name: The Void
nodes.description: You are the Void. You can suck in almost any kind of energy almost limitlessly — mana, energy, stamina, kinetic, electricity, Telesma, psionic, etc. Even as a base human, you could detonate a hydrogen bomb next to your face and barely feel warm.

nodes.name: Nihil
nodes.description: The Grand Nullifier. You can dispel anything you can interact with — motion in an area, all mana in an area, an individual's abilities, and their minds. You cannot dispel or nullify a lack of something.

nodes.name: Open Frenzy
nodes.description: "Shed all worldly concerns and embrace slaughter." When activated, you lose all inhibitions, pain turns to pleasure, and all stats are massively enhanced. But its energy slowly tears your body apart as you fight, and its sense of limitless power may make you unwilling to turn it off.

nodes.name: Karmic Enforcement
nodes.description: "Tit for Tat" Allows you to enforce karma. Every exchange accrues karma, and if unfulfilled you can enforce it — if you saved someone's life and they have not repaid you, you can force them to perform any action or actions equal to the karmic value of their life.

nodes.name: Fire Dragon Slayer
nodes.description: Allows you to transform into and wield the powers of a fire dragon. You generate fire from your body, control it, alter its properties such as blunt or sharp, devour flames, and are immune to all fire below your level. Eating flames recovers vitality and energy, and consuming other magic lets you temporarily incorporate it into your flames.

nodes.name: Water Dragon Slayer
nodes.description: Allows you to transform into and wield the powers of a water dragon. You generate, control, alter its properties such as blunt or sharp, devour water, and are immune to water-based attacks below your level. Drinking water recovers vitality and energy, though polluted water can harm you, and consuming other magic lets you temporarily incorporate it into your water.

nodes.name: Sky Dragon Slayer
nodes.description: Allows you to transform into and wield the powers of a sky dragon. You generate, control, alter your winds such as blunt or sharp, devour wind, heal others with your winds, and are immune to wind-based attacks below your level. Breathing air recovers vitality and energy, though polluted air harms you, and consuming other magic lets you temporarily incorporate it into your wind attacks.

nodes.name: Poison Dragon Slayer
nodes.description: Allows you to transform into and wield the powers of a poison dragon. You generate, control, and alter potent poison such as corrosive, sickening, or boiling, devour poison, and are immune to all poison below your level. Consuming poison recovers vitality and energy, and consuming other magic lets you temporarily incorporate it into your poison.

nodes.name: Lightning Dragon Slayer
nodes.description: Allows you to transform into and wield the powers of a lightning dragon. You generate lightning from your body, control it, alter its properties such as blunt or sharp, devour lightning, and are immune to all lightning below your level. Eating lightning recovers vitality and energy, and consuming other magic lets you temporarily incorporate it into your lightning.

nodes.name: Shadow Dragon Slayer
nodes.description: Allows you to transform into and wield the powers of a dark dragon. You generate shadows from your body, control them, turn into a shadow and merge with them, alter their properties such as blunt or sharp, and are immune to all dark attributes below your level. Eating shadows recovers vitality and energy, and consuming other magic lets you temporarily incorporate it into your shadows.

nodes.name: White Dragon Slayer
nodes.description: Allows you to transform into and wield the powers of a white dragon. You generate and control Holy Light from your body, alter its properties such as blunt or sharp, and are immune to all Light and Holy attributes below your level. Eating light energy and holy objects recovers vitality and energy, and consuming other magic lets you temporarily incorporate it into your light.

nodes.name: Earth Dragon Slayer
nodes.description: Allows you to transform into and wield the powers of an earth dragon. You generate, control, alter earth such as denser, tougher, and heavier, devour earth, and are immune to earth-based attacks below your level. Devouring earth and rocks recovers vitality and energy based on rock quality, and consuming other magic lets you temporarily incorporate it into your earth.

nodes.name: Spirit Dragon Slayer
nodes.description: Allows you to transform into and wield the powers of a spirit dragon. You emit and control spiritual energy, alter your soul constructs such as blunt or sharp, shift into spirit form, possess people, and persist as a spirit after death. Devouring souls strengthens and rejuvenates you.

nodes.name: Muscular
nodes.description: You can freely increase the density and mass of your muscle fibers, massively increasing explosive power and durability. If fibers exceed what fits under your skin, they cover your body like a second set of muscles. More fibers burn stamina faster.

nodes.name: Rejuvenation
nodes.description: You can rejuvenate yourself and targets, restoring virility and health. It does not heal injuries, but cures illnesses and ailments, reverses aging, restores sacrificed lifespan, and restores rotten or ill vegetation. Stronger targets cost more energy.

nodes.name: Rise Again
nodes.description: Nothing keeps you down. While in your active slot, at the moment of death you revive 10 seconds later with health and energy restored to 50%. 7 day cooldown.

nodes.name: Tinker - The Baker
nodes.description: You can build the technology of THE BAKERY. With enough time and resources, you can make assembly lines that compress universes into little balls for bowling, then turn every atom inside them into cookies for shipment across the multiverse.

nodes.name: Militia
nodes.description: You can summon a projection of any mundane weapon into your hands. It must not be tinkertech, must not exceed your current world's technology, and must not surpass Elite rank in power. You also control its ammunition, such as a beanbag shotgun, nuclear bomb launcher, automatic rifle, sword, or crossbow.

nodes.name: Light Step
nodes.description: You can step and walk on anything — water, air, space, even nothing as a solid surface.

nodes.name: Perfection
nodes.description: Your abilities scale with your health. At 100% health all stats increase by +100%, at 90% by +90%, etc.

nodes.name: No Guard
nodes.description: "Offence is the best defence" All physical stats except durability rise proportionally as you lower your defence. You can drop durability to -500% to raise strength to +500%.

nodes.name: Battle Growth
nodes.description: You are an eternal engine for battle, growing in power every time you fight. Harder battles cause stronger, faster mid-battle growth, letting you adapt and surpass opponents. This growth is permanent.

nodes.name: Blood Portals
nodes.description: You create portals by sacrificing health — a two-way portal costs 10% of maximum health. While portals remain open, you lose access to that 10% of maximum health and it cannot heal.

nodes.name: Shadowverse
nodes.description: You can access the shadow-verse by sinking into shadows. Inside you can jump from shadow to shadow, bring people in and trap them with its monsters, or bring monsters out.

nodes.name: Bloody Escalation
nodes.description: "Power for Pain" With Blood Escalation active, every 1% of health lost increases all stats by 1%. The increase resets when you leave combat.

nodes.name: D4C
nodes.description: You can open doors to parallel worlds by trapping yourself between two objects to travel infinite parallel worlds. You can pull people and selves from parallel worlds into your own, including selves who know you are the original and accept it. If you die, all abilities and the gacha transfer to a random you across the multiverse.

nodes.name: Obito's Mangekyo Sharingan Right
nodes.description: You possess Obito Uchiha's right eye, granting half of Kamui plus full Sharingan benefits such as incredible visual prowess and instant memorization. With the left eye, you access a short-range Kamui to an endless pocket dimension in your left eye. You can fully enter Kamui to reposition in the real world, semi-enter to turn intangible at stamina cost, or send touched objects into Kamui.

nodes.name: Obito's Mangekyo Sharingan Left
nodes.description: You possess Obito Uchiha's left eye, granting half of Kamui plus full Sharingan benefits such as incredible visual prowess and instant memorization. With the right eye, you access long-range Kamui to an endless pocket dimension in your left eye. You can create ranged barrier spaces to suck objects and people into Kamui or close the door halfway to kill them, including around yourself. Larger barriers cost more energy.

nodes.name: Obito's Mangekyo Sharingan
nodes.description: You possess Obito Uchiha's Eternal Mangekyo Sharingan plus all regular Sharingan benefits, with full access to Kamui. You access an endless pocket dimension called Kamui, letting you create barriers that pull people in, freely teleport within it, teleport by exiting elsewhere, turn temporarily intangible, and open portals in space to breach other dimensions.

nodes.name: Physical Therapy
nodes.description: You convert physical force you exert into positive energy, healing people by hitting them with your body. Greater strength means greater healing. Health healed equals damage that attack would otherwise have inflicted.

nodes.name: Tiamat's Gift
nodes.description: "Mother of All Dragons" You can transform yourself and any biological structure you touch into a dragon, and spawn temporary dragon projections from your body. Dragon power and shape depend on skill and energy expended, with greater violations of mass conservation costing more energy. Sentient beings can resist conversion based on strength.

nodes.name: Hands of Time
nodes.description: You can reverse or accelerate an object's time by touch, withering a tree or turning it into a sapling. Stronger targets have their time altered more slowly.

nodes.name: Shadows of Time
nodes.description: Your shadow is a temporal anomaly. It can stretch, move independently, leave 2D space to physically interact and attack, and alter the time of whatever it touches — rapidly aging or rejuvenating it. Stronger targets have their time altered more slowly.

nodes.name: Bloody Lust
nodes.description: "You are enjoying this far too much" Your lust for violence is insatiable. When hurt, you recover energy proportional to damage taken, and recover health proportional to damage you deal. You are an eternal engine of battle.

nodes.name: Infernal Engine
nodes.description: Your heart is an Infernal Engine. When activated, regeneration increases and you can wield Hellflames. But it heats your body the longer it runs, and greater heat makes it more effective. Beware overheating and burning yourself with your own Hellflames.

nodes.name: Blacklight
nodes.description: Your body is entirely the Blacklight Virus. You can freely shapeshift down to the cellular level, absorb biological matter to grow stronger and analyze and replicate its composition, and gain all memories of targets whose brains you consume.

nodes.name: Rule Breaker
nodes.description: The rules no longer matter to you. You can expend energy to remove rules affecting you or a touched target — remove gravity on yourself, magic on a target, being targetable by magic, etc. Vaguer and more impactful rules cost more energy. A broken rule slowly restores itself, but its effects do not.

nodes.name: Chainsaw Man
nodes.description: You are the Chainsaw hybrid. Pulling the ripcord on your chest turns you into hybrid form, replacing your head with a chainsaw and sprouting chainsaws on your arms and optionally legs. In this form you gain enhanced physical stats and blood-fueled extreme regeneration. You are immortal in hybrid state — as long as your heart remains, pulling your ripcord revives you.

nodes.name: Bang!
nodes.description: Simply point your index finger and say "Bang!" to unleash immense telekinetic force that tears apart anything in your way.

nodes.name: Spatial Displacement
nodes.description: You can freely teleport within a 50-meter range around yourself with complete spatial awareness of it. Teleportation there is instant, but repeated teleports cause increasing vertigo.

nodes.name: Warp Drive
nodes.description: You can warp space around yourself to move at absurd speeds. Warping accelerates you more and faster than otherwise possible, reaching extreme speeds but making precise movement difficult.

nodes.name: Form Change
nodes.description: You can freely change attributes through forms. Offensive Form trades defence for energy output and speed, Defensive Form raises defense and resilience while lowering speed, Recovery Form trades strength for regeneration and recovery, and Speed Form drastically raises speed while sacrificing attack and defence. You can also create your own forms.

nodes.name: Murder Swarm
nodes.description: You can transform into a murder of 100 crows at will. You perfectly control each crow and are equally each crow, take 1% damage per crow killed, can partially transform to send messages or spy, and return to 100 crows once fully healed even after losing 30.

nodes.name: Blood Overdrive
nodes.description: "Go beyond you" For 10 minutes all parameters are greatly increased and all regenerations amplified. Afterwards, all parameters and regenerations are greatly decreased for 24 hours. 5 day cooldown.

nodes.name: Limit Break
nodes.description: "Time to go all out" Upon activation, for 4 minutes and 11 seconds all parameters and energy regeneration increase, plus ability slots are removed so you can use all abilities at once. This places immense strain on your body and can kill you. 7 day cooldown.

nodes.name: Phosphorus
nodes.description: You can turn into a living being of heat and radiation, with everything but your skeleton becoming irradiated energy. You can conjure irradiated fireballs, superheat yourself, or launch radiation blasts. Expect collateral damage.

nodes.name: Restraints and Amplifications
nodes.description: You can place restraints on yourself to amplify powers — sacrifice sight to boost hearing to daredevil levels, sacrifice an arm to strengthen the other, or restrict ability slots to strengthen the rest. Amplification equals restraint severity.

nodes.name: Power Charge
nodes.description: You can charge your body with energy to empower your next move — charge a fist for a stronger punch or legs to leap over buildings. More charged energy means a stronger result.

nodes.name: One For All
nodes.description: You inherit 9 people's collective power accumulated over generations. One For All grants incomparable physical enhancement, though overuse can break your body, plus you can awaken past users' quirks: Gearshift, Blackwhip, Float, Smokescreen, Dangersense, and Fa-Jin.

nodes.name: Door Crossing
nodes.description: You can create indoor portals from doors and entrances inside a building. This lets you teleport yourself and others door-to-door to traverse quickly or block others from leaving.

nodes.name: Kraft Works
nodes.description: You can affix objects to other objects or locations, making them completely inviolable and immovable without spacetime interference. All kinetic energy applied while affixed releases the moment it is released. Larger mass and energy cost more energy to affix, and maintaining affixation consumes energy.

nodes.name: Gate Creation
nodes.description: You can create semi-permanent gates to teleport through. To create one, you must be incredibly familiar with the location or have visited it, and focus for 1 minute to set it. You can maintain up to 10 gates at once, improvable as you grow stronger.

nodes.name: Web Slinger
nodes.description: You can shoot sticky, durable spider-web ropes from your body. They dissolve naturally after an hour.

nodes.name: Drake Form
nodes.description: You can take the form of a fire-breathing drake or hybrid at will. As a lesser dragon, it grants increased physical abilities, flight, and fire breath.

nodes.name: Klyntar Form
nodes.description: You can transform into a Klyntar, a symbiotic amorphous race that merges with biological matter and assumes their characteristics. Bonding with or taking over a host lets you share their powers while granting them your power and physical abilities. In this form you are highly vulnerable to loud noises and fire.

nodes.name: Psychometry
nodes.description: You can read an object's history by physical contact and expending energy. More energy reveals more history — how it was made, what happened to it, what it has seen — with greater accuracy.

nodes.name: Aqueduct
nodes.description: You can merge with and move through water at extreme speeds, at least 10x running speed. You need a body of water at least equal to your mass to merge into and move freely through. If that water is compromised, you take considerable damage.

nodes.name: Marked
nodes.description: You can place marks on objects or creatures to monitor at any time. You always know each mark's location relative to you and its bearer's structural integrity. You can hold up to 10 marks, increasing as you grow stronger.

nodes.name: Teleport
nodes.description: You can teleport — as long as you properly know a location or its coordinates, you can instantly teleport there. Teleportation is instant and scales slightly with distance, with even beginners skipping countries. Overuse can cause vertigo.

nodes.name: Shut Down
nodes.description: You can create a large zone around you that shuts off magical and sci-fi item functions. Inside, even Excalibur is just a very durable sword. Items far above your level are drastically weakened rather than shut off.

nodes.name: Stone Free
nodes.description: Stone Free lets you convert any body part into translucent string you control and move at will. The string shares your exact physical abilities and can be instinctively woven into complex patterns, etc.

nodes.name: Petal Burst
nodes.description: You can temporarily shift into a mass of rose petals to move at superspeed for a short duration. In rose form you resist physical attacks better, but larger mass costs more energy, and directional control is reduced.

nodes.name: Grant
nodes.description: You can grant people lesser versions of your abilities. Elite rank or below drops by one rank, while Epic and Legendary drop by two ranks. Only one ability can be granted per person at a time.

nodes.name: Man in the Mirror
nodes.description: You can enter any mirror as a portal to access the mirror dimension, a replica of the real world with nothing living inside. Aside from spacetime abilities, the only entry and exit is you dragging people in or out.

nodes.name: Metallurgy
nodes.description: Metallurgy lets you create metal at will and control it telekinetically. You can create any mundane metal you know, and telekinetically control metals you created. Stronger or more complex metals cost more energy.

nodes.name: Metallurge
nodes.description: You can conjure and control any metal whose composition you know, even legendary metals like Uru, Adamantium, or Vibranium. Higher-rank metals cost more energy, and you cannot permanently create metals stronger than your rank.

nodes.name: Threshold
nodes.description: While in an active slot, you take no damage from anything below a certain level. Anything that would hurt no more than a light cut is ignored completely.

nodes.name: Building
nodes.description: You can perform transmutation on a macro scale. You cannot build complex constructs or small applications, but can turn the ground into a proper building in under an hour. It moves slowly, so combat use is limited.

nodes.name: Compass
nodes.description: You can conjure a mental compass that acts like a regular compass.

nodes.name: Prophetic Compass
nodes.description: You can conjure a phantasmal compass in your hands that points toward your target. As long as you know the target and carry something related to it, you can track it down.

nodes.name: Tentacled Creature
nodes.description: You can turn into a hentai tentacle creature or manifest its tentacles at will. You resemble a ball with numerous tentacles that act as both limbs and reproductive organs.

nodes.name: Madness Wavelength
nodes.description: You emit a wavelength that alters the minds and perceptions of those it touches. You can drive a whole town to madness while passing by, and can tweak the madness exerted.

nodes.name: Time Accel
nodes.description: You can speed up your own body's time in 2x, 3x, 4x increments. Greater acceleration puts more strain on body and mind.

nodes.name: Divine Blade
nodes.description: You can conjure a sword of Divine Light and alter its shape. It is lightweight yet unbelievably sharp and durable, and burns struck targets with purifying holy flames. At the wielder's will, it cannot hurt even a fly despite full-power swings.

nodes.name: Soul Bet
nodes.description: Inspired by the Fae. If you get people to wager their souls in a bet, you can claim the prize, extracting their souls and taking possession of them. It works only if the opponent internally acknowledges defeat.

nodes.name: Martyr
nodes.description: You can take others' burdens onto yourself. By touching them, you transfer their injuries, exhaustion, curses, sicknesses, and other ailments to yourself.

nodes.name: Disillusioned
nodes.description: You can see through any physical deception and concealment — pitfalls, physical disguises, bent light, one-way mirrors, etc. Any physical illusion meant to deceive senses fails on you.

nodes.name: Piercing Eyes
nodes.description: Your eyes can see far and through objects, with level perfectly adjustable to your needs.

nodes.name: Dead Bone Pulse
nodes.description: A Kekkei Genkai letting you grow bones and bone constructs on and out of your body. You can reshape bones, reinforce them by increasing density, and manipulate your skeleton for defence. You can regrow bones, but still take damage from removing or growing them.

nodes.name: All Killing Ash Bones
nodes.description: All Killing Ash Bones lets you control your skeleton and grow bone constructs from your body. You can reinforce these bones, and piercing a living being makes them deteriorate to the molecular level until death. Sure-kill potency depends on the power gap between user and target.

nodes.name: Prophecise
nodes.description: You can tell the future across a large timeframe as prophecies. Though not very accurate, they can point to crucial information or important things. Vaguer prophecies cost less energy.

nodes.name: Future Observation
nodes.description: You can tell the future across a short or longer span. More seconds viewed costs more energy. You see the future that would have happened had you not used Future Sight. Overuse can cause temporary brain bleeding.

nodes.name: Future Reading
nodes.description: You can read the near future over a small, trainable timeframe. The future read is not absolute but highly probable, and more situational knowledge improves accuracy.

nodes.name: Future Prediction
nodes.description: You can predict the future by calculating a target's future. You can predict a dice rolling a 6, a slot machine result, an opponent's opening move, or rising and falling stocks. More information and better sensory abilities improve predictions.

nodes.name: Foresight
nodes.description: Yomi Hustle - You can place a foresight, an afterimage of yourself, anywhere in perception range. At any moment you can teleport to it, but it vanishes if you move over 100 meters away, leave it over 1 hour, or it takes damage. You can create only one, increasable through training.

nodes.name: Tinker PvZ
nodes.description: You can genetically engineer Plants vs Zombies plants, such as flowers that turn sunlight into energy, ones that punch people, or breathe fire. More powerful and esoteric plants need more resources.

nodes.name: Labyrinthian
nodes.description: You are myth's legendary minotaur. Physical abilities, especially strength and endurance, are amplified to inhuman levels plus bull traits. You can also turn any area you are in into a labyrinth, shuffling all entries and exits to lead wherever you want. Even a future reader would be stuck a hundred years in a forest.

nodes.name: Hyper
nodes.description: You are not just super, you are HYPER! You have extreme physical abilities and flight — the classic super package taken to the extreme. More energy expended means stronger and faster.

nodes.name: Divinity Healing
nodes.description: You are a god of healing and restoration, with domain over all healing to perform miracles by expending energy. For you, death is little different from sleeping and mythical poisons are a mild cold.

nodes.name: Law of Restoration
nodes.description: You can enforce the Law of Restoration on a target, forcefully restoring it to its deemed "restored" state. Even corpses can return to life and even erasure reversed if something remains. More powerful, damaged, or abnormal targets cost more energy. While slotted, it activates on your own death.

nodes.name: Inner Isles
nodes.description: There is an island inside your being. You can create doors to a spatial dimension within your existence — a small vegetated island in a vast lifeless ocean. Creating larger doors and maintaining doors consumes energy.

nodes.name: Sea Serpent of the End
nodes.description: You can transform into Leviathan, the Sea Serpent of the End. As this giant mythical sea snake, you control all water in range on a massive scale, tilting seas and drowning cities, creating more water serpents, and summoning flood-causing rains. All water-based abilities and effects are massively amplified in this form.

nodes.name: Gradual Transformation
nodes.description: You can gradually transform your body into any shape, but the slowness demands care. Turning into a cat takes roughly 3 hours, and you cannot increase or decrease mass by more than 500%.

nodes.name: Meltdowner
nodes.description: Meltdowner lets you create and control Particle Waveform High-Speed Cannons from altered electrons — incredibly powerful, hot electron beams from your body that slice any metal like paper. More energy expended means stronger beams.

nodes.name: Curse Breaker
nodes.description: Curse Breaker lets you break curses by touching them, or an area around you with training. Breakable curse strength scales with energy expended.

nodes.name: Shatter Curse
nodes.description: Upgrade to Curse Breaker - No curse is safe around you. You can dispel and break all curses you touch, with breakable strength equal to energy expended. With enough energy you can break gods' curses.

nodes.name: Mystical Eyes of Purity
nodes.description: Mystical Eyes of the Pure World let you cleanse any sight-locked target, breaking curses, cleansing disease and poison, dispelling charms, and removing any status effect against the target's natural state. More powerful afflictions cost more energy and strain your eyes more.

nodes.name: Point of View
nodes.description: You can adjust your viewpoint across three settings: 1st person is regular perception, 2nd person sees through the eyes of anyone you look at, and 3rd person views yourself like a rotatable surrounding camera.

nodes.name: Minimap
nodes.description: You have a minimap in your vision's corner that auto-maps where you go and reveals enemies in seen places as long as you know they are hostile. You can enlarge and zoom it freely.

nodes.name: Megamap
nodes.description: You have a megamap in your vision's corner, the cooler minimap. It maps everything within 2.5km wherever you step and tracks all living beings in real time, marking them red or blue for hostile or not. It doubles as satellite viewing.

nodes.name: Loboan Form
nodes.description: You can transform into a Loboan or Loboan hybrid at will. Loboans are alien werewolves with formidable physical abilities, sharp teeth and claws, and bloodhound-like tracking senses. Most notably, they unleash direct sonic howls powerful enough to cause severe damage.

nodes.name: Blood Golem
nodes.description: You can shed blood to form a ground puddle from which to summon one or several Blood Golems. Summoned strength or number scales with physical stats and blood shed (minimum 100ml).

nodes.name: Apothecary Physique
nodes.description: Apothecary Physique lets you manipulate your body's interior to reproduce any consumed chemical or digestible item's effects, like health, mana, iron-skin, or night-vision potions, as long as it was Epic rank or below. It also grants complete control over your biochemistry.

nodes.name: Seraph Tracers
nodes.description: "At the speed of heaven" You can manifest Seraphic wings, amplifying speed and granting free high-speed flight. While manifest, you resist mundane environmental effects below Epic rank — swimming in lava, walking on water or through natural fire, ignoring fall damage, breathing in space, etc. The wings are superhumanly strong, easily bisecting people and scaling with physical stats.

nodes.name: Nebula Mantle
nodes.description: "The very stars guide your flight" You can manifest cosmic wings granting fast flight without existing in physical space. While active they resonate with cosmic energies, boosting all spell power and accelerating energy recovery closer to night.

nodes.name: Icarus' Folly
nodes.description: "And so the sun never allowed a mortal to fly again" You can enact Icarus' Folly in an area, evoking the sun's wrath against fliers. Those exceeding 10 meters elevation burn in holy inferno, hotter the higher above ground they are. Zone width depends on energy expended — larger areas cost more. Victims instinctively sense flight's danger.

nodes.name: Bullseye
nodes.description: "Boom, headshot." Bullseye places reticle crosshairs on random spots of all targets in your vision; hitting one centrally with a projectile makes it a critical hit, amplifying power and damage. Training lets you place crosshairs more accurately.

nodes.name: Perfect Impostor
nodes.description: You can disguise yourself as others with an applied normality effect that convinces observers you are that person even when acting out of character. More out-of-character behavior costs more energy, and the effect fades if the target is absolutely stronger than you or you act in directly identity-compromising ways.

nodes.name: Sticky Icky
nodes.description: Your skin is uncomfortably sticky to others, as if soaked in glue or soda, though you feel no difference.

nodes.name: Tinker - Erotics
nodes.description: Tinker - Allows you to build technological constructs or items related to sexual events, such as aphrodisiacs, sexual instruments, contraceptives, etc.

nodes.name: Shrine
nodes.description: The Cursed Technique of the King of Curses. Shrine grants Cleave, Dismantle, and Furnace. Dismantle sends flying invisible slashes of varying power, Cleave creates stronger instant slashes on touched targets, and Furnace manifests a powerful fire arrow. With enough mastery or enlightenment, you may unleash the Malevolent Shrine.

nodes.name: Imagine Breaker
nodes.description: The Illusion Killer, Imagine Breaker is the ultimate negation tool. It can negate anything supernatural that could not exist on base Earth. It dwells in your right hand, but also negates your own supernatural capabilities like abilities and magic while active (Note: This is only the base Imagine Breaker and does not contain the beings sealed inside).

nodes.name: Genderswap
nodes.description: Allows you to swap your gender and the genders of those who can't resist. Swapped forms usually take a shape you find attractive, and partial swaps are possible.

nodes.name: Deception
nodes.description: Your words are imbued with lies, making them sound more convincing and believable. Stronger targets and more unbelievable lies reduce effectiveness and consume more energy.

nodes.name: Vainglory
nodes.description: You can assert a false truth by expending energy, convincing others of even far-fetched claims. Larger power gaps and harder-to-believe lies lower efficiency and raise energy cost.

nodes.name: Golemancy
nodes.description: Golemancy allows you to animate inanimate objects into golems under your control. Golem power depends on material quality and your power; stronger materials cost more energy, and max golems depends on max energy (minimum 10), with stronger golems taking more slots.

nodes.name: Elemental Sublimation
nodes.description: Allows you to turn your body into any basic element while retaining control, such as fire to burn, lightning to travel cables, or wind to fly. Damage to destroyed mass in elemental form reflects back to you.

nodes.name: Video Travel
nodes.description: Video Travel allows you to slip into device screens and travel to other screened devices on the same network or wired together.

nodes.name: Luck Drain
nodes.description: Allows you to drain others' luck by touch and add it to your own temporarily. More energy and longer contact steals more luck with exponentially scaling cost, and stolen luck fades over time, returning to its target.

nodes.name: Jinx
nodes.description: Jinx allows you to curse targets by touch to reduce their luck enough to disadvantage but not harm them. The effect grows with extra energy and power advantage, and can also be fired as a moderate-speed Hex projectile.

nodes.name: Misfortune
nodes.description: You can unleash an aura of misfortune that reduces the luck of those nearby, or narrow it to reach distant targets. More energy increases the reduction, and your power difference to the target dictates the effect.

nodes.name: Malus
