nodes.description: "Directing the hatred of fate" You can mark a target in sight with Malus, then expend energy to reduce the outcomes of their actions. Stronger maluses cost more energy and exhaust you, and overreaching against too strong a target can backfire.

nodes.name: Choosing Fate
nodes.description: You can see numerous possible futures excluding precognition and enforce your chosen future by expending energy. More powerful targets and more improbable futures cost more energy and incur larger backlash, though with enough energy even absolutely improbable futures can be enforced.

nodes.name: United We Stand
nodes.description: While United We Stand is active, you can select a familiar and add all its physical stats to your own. For each unused ability slot, you can draw strength from another familiar.

nodes.name: Tinker - Minimisation
nodes.description: Allows you to build miniaturized versions of existing technology without losing quality and with reduced energy use, provided you already know how to build it.

nodes.name: Tinker - Macro
nodes.description: Allows you to build scaled-up versions of existing technologies, such as hundred-meter warplanes, human-sized-shell cannons, or giant microwave death chambers.

nodes.name: Tinker - Ecology
nodes.description: Allows you to build nature-related contraptions that utilize, help, and benefit from it, such as Bio-Domes, efficient fertilizers, animal lures, solar panels, geothermal reactors, and terraforming equipment.

nodes.name: Tinker - Energy
nodes.description: Allows you to build energy production and use contraptions, such as hyper-efficient solar panels and wind farms, microfusion, bio, hydro, and arc reactors.

nodes.name: Tinker - Industrialisation
nodes.description: Allows you to build industrialisation contraptions like factories, efficient production lines, autonomous drone workers, and assembly lines to build things for you at larger scale.

nodes.name: Tinker - Augments
nodes.description: Allows you to build biology-augmenting contraptions like subdermal armour, biomonitors, hormone regulators, metal-bonded bone, and reinforced tendons and muscles.

nodes.name: Tinker - Nanomachines
nodes.description: Allows you to build nanotechnology contraptions like cell-altering nanobots, trauma-hardening nanomachines, machine-disrupting nanobots, nanocameras, and nanomachine clothes.

nodes.name: Tinker - Dimensions
nodes.description: Allows you to build dimension-manipulating contraptions like pocket dimension generators, teleportation sealers, dimensional rams, interdimensional portals, unbreakable spatial barriers, and drawing energy from parallel dimensions.

nodes.name: Tinker - Medicine
nodes.description: Allows you to build medicine-related contraptions and production, such as poison-curing, health-bolstering, and other medicinal cures.

nodes.name: Tinker - Destruction
nodes.description: Allows you to build destruction-related contraptions like Unstable Matter Rockets, Disintegration Cannons, Black Hole Generators, and general Doomsday Devices, generally inspired by your abilities and traits.

nodes.name: Tinker - Mind
nodes.description: Allows you to build mind-influencing and controlling contraptions like suggestion music, neuralyzers, mind control helmets, and mental reprogramming machines.

nodes.name: Tinker - Time
nodes.description: Allows you to build time-related contraptions like aging grenades, time-dilated training rooms, time-stoppers, stasis barriers, and time-dilation FTL drives. This speciality is very expensive.

nodes.name: Aid
nodes.description: You can heal yourself and others by expending energy, but only slightly, such as scratches, scrapes, and bruises. Effectiveness depends on your power difference to the target.

nodes.name: Minor Cure
nodes.description: You can heal others by expending energy, mending stabs, slashes, and broken bones, with more severe wounds costing far more. Effectiveness depends on your power difference to the target.

nodes.name: Cure
nodes.description: You can heal yourself and others by expending energy, with healing scale tied to energy spent and more lethal wounds needing more energy. Effectiveness depends on your power difference to the target.

nodes.name: Greater Cure Wounds
nodes.description: You can greatly heal yourself and others by expending energy, with stronger effects for more energy, even healing lethal wounds at higher cost. Effectiveness depends on your power difference to the target.

nodes.name: Restoration
nodes.description: You can heal yourself and others by expending energy to imbue potent healing energies. More energy yields more potent healing, with effectiveness depending on your power difference to the target.

nodes.name: Mind Rip
nodes.description: "Reaper of Minds" You wield offensive mind manipulation: mind blasts, gaze-driven mind damage, crushing weaker minds, body hijacking, and living nightmares. Less destructive uses cost more energy, and effectiveness depends on the opponent's mental strength and relative power.

nodes.name: Cry
nodes.description: You can shed very salty tears at will.

nodes.name: Super Polymerization
nodes.description: Allows you to temporarily fuse two living beings into a new entity with both abilities. Unwilling targets resist by power, stronger fusions cost more energy, and maintaining fusion drains energy over time.

nodes.name: Greedy Healing
nodes.description: "Restoration, but at what cost?" Greedy Healing consumes wealth you own instead of mana, with more wealth yielding more potent restoration. A dollar barely recovers a chipped nail, while enough wealth can restore limbs or possibly a life; stronger targets and larger effects need more sacrifice of coins, artefacts, items, or even people (Infinite Money Glitch invalid).

nodes.name: Tinker - Gravity
nodes.description: Allows you to build gravity-manipulation technology like anti-gravity thrusters, Zero-G fields, gravity anchors, and weight training rooms. At this low rank, don't expect black hole projectors or gravitron crushers.

nodes.name: The Tinkerer
nodes.description: Allows you to build Entity technology such as Doomsday Drivers, Multiversal Travel, Time Bombs, and any Tinker specialisation from their universe.

nodes.name: Tinker - One Punch Man
nodes.description: Allows you to build and replicate Metal Knight's technology like mass-produced weapons, Drone Bodies, giant mechs, and large-scale drones, including Dragon Class Mechs with enough time.

nodes.name: Tinker - Scraps
nodes.description: - Allows you to build far more functional technology from scraps and easily jury-rig existing tech from subpar materials.

nodes.name: Tinker - Big MT
nodes.description: Allows you to build Big Mountain Think Tank technologies including teleporters, modified monsters, pacification fields, sonic weaponry, and lobotomites.

nodes.name: Tinker - Kuseno
nodes.description: Allows you to build from Dr. Kuseno's knowledge base, including immensely powerful cyborg bodies scaling from city-block to continent-buster with enough time, testing, and resources.

nodes.name: Armageddon Blade
nodes.description: The All Incinerating Armageddon Blade allows you to conjure a blade of destructive flame and heat that massively amplifies Pyro effects and cuts almost anything. Its Flames of Armageddon embody oblivion, erasing existence instead of leaving ash, growing stronger with you, and unleashable as a sword beam for enough energy.

nodes.name: Frozen Dawn
nodes.description: The Frozen Dawn allows you to conjure a Frozen Spear that massively amplifies Cryo attributes while held. It unleashes frigid energy that freezes even mana and kinetic energy, dooming stabbed targets to freeze faster if weaker, and can create additional boomerang spears as projectiles.

nodes.name: World Crusher
nodes.description: The Hammer of Continental Destruction allows you to conjure an earthen hammer that massively enhances strength and Earth attributes. Strikes reshape terrain, unleash quaking shockwaves that tear hit beings inside out, and with enough power and energy can alter an entire planet in one swing.

nodes.name: Hulk Out
nodes.description: You can unleash a Gamma Mutate physique, growing large with godlike physical abilities. Physical strength grows with rage without discernible limit. (Note: Just the basic Hulk transformation, no connection shenanigans.).

nodes.name: Garm Physique
nodes.description: You can transform into Garm or a Garm hybrid, gaining immense physical abilities and terrifying presence. Your teeth and claws tear even dimensional fabric, creating portals and breaking boundaries.

nodes.name: Ghost Ammunition
nodes.description: Allows you to conjure ghost ammunition for your weapons that mimics normal ammo but costs energy and disappears 1 second after hitting.

nodes.name: Spectre Ammo
nodes.description: Allows you to conjure spectre ammunition from energy for held weapons, mimicking normal ammo. You can imbue them for more power and combine them with other abilities for special properties.

nodes.name: Tinker - Gel
nodes.description: Allows you to build gel-related technology like super lubricant, impact absorption gel, hardening gel, restraint gel, fire retardant gel, and gel bombs.

nodes.name: Tinker - Crystals
nodes.description: Allows you to build Crystal-related technology like preservation crystals, self-repairing plates, high-capacity energy storage, and eventually crystal transmutation.

nodes.name: Tinker - Metallurgy
nodes.description: Allows you to build Metal and Alloy-related technology like metal fabricators, wondrous alloys from mundane metals, superconductors, impossible-property metals, and metal arms and armour.

nodes.name: Dampener
nodes.description: You can weaken effects and abilities by contact. Weaker abilities and longer contact increase weakening until fully disabled.

nodes.name: Shut Off
nodes.description: You can shut off others' powers by physical contact, with energy cost set by your power difference to the target. Strong enough targets may only be partially affected.

nodes.name: Power Oppression
nodes.description: You can release a power-dampening aura around yourself. Effectiveness depends on your power difference to the target; weak targets are fully suppressed while strong targets resist.

nodes.name: Tinker - Vehicles (I)
nodes.description: Makes you supernaturally good at designing, modifying, and building Vehicles, producing engineering marvels that cannot exceed your current world's level.

nodes.name: Tinker - Vehicles (II)
nodes.description: Allows you to build vehicle-related technology like a tank-armoured sports car, all-terrain including air motorcycle, or hard-light-track train. But no Killdozers yet.

nodes.name: Tinker - Vehicles (IV)
nodes.description: Allows you to build vehicle-related technology like space vessels, supersonic flying cars, weapons, hard-light shields, and borrowing ideas from weak minor tinker abilities.

nodes.name: Tinker Vehicles (V)
nodes.description: No vehicle overkill enough. Allows you to build any vehicle, from FTL starships and warp-drive motorcycles to goliath doomships, star-landing craft, or a dapper car.

nodes.name: Tinker - Bio (I)
nodes.description: Makes you supernaturally good at designing, modifying, and building biological constructs. At this level, you can crossbreed and modify plants and create simple biology items like biomonitors.

nodes.name: Tinker - Bio (II)
nodes.description: Allows you to build biology-altering technology like operating tables, shock-absorbent dense bones, regeneration-granting artificial hearts, seamless replacement limbs, and homunculi.

nodes.name: Tinker - Bio (III)
nodes.description: Allows you to build biology-related constructs like homunculi vats, full biological overhauls, genetic alteration, scratch-built beings, and potent viruses.

nodes.name: Tinker - Bio (IV)
nodes.description: Allows you to build biology-related constructs like Cloning Vats, biological powers, cracking inherited-power genetics, full genetic overhauls, and sentient assimilating viruses.

nodes.name: Tinker - Bio (V)
nodes.description: Allows you to build biology-related constructs like decoding and granting scanned genetics-based abilities, scratch-building powerful creatures, and fabricating and assimilating Legendary rank and below biology abilities.

nodes.name: Tinker - Alchemy (I)
nodes.description: Allows you to build alchemy-related technology for reagents and potions like minor healing, stamina, toughening, or combat acids.

nodes.name: Tinker - Alchemy (II)
nodes.description: Allows you to build alchemy-related technology like healing, stamina, energy, disease-curing, minor permanent-buff, explosive gas, and incendiary acid potions. Stronger consumers weaken effects and vice versa, and more potent potions need better materials.

nodes.name: Tinker - Alchemy (III)
nodes.description: Allows you to build alchemy-related technology like body-altering, gunpowder, flesh-eating acid, Healing, mana, and Ironskin potions with notable potency. Stronger consumers weaken effects and vice versa, and more potent potions need better materials.

nodes.name: Tinker - Alchemy (IV)
nodes.description: Allows you to build alchemy-related technology like limb-restoring healing, mana-boosting, ultra-steroid, and Epic Tier physical-trait permanent-buff potions plus many reagents.

nodes.name: Tinker - Alchemy (V)
nodes.description: Allows you to build alchemy-related miracles with enough resources, from Panaceas, Elixirs, and Ichor to Elixirs granting Legendary rank physical traits.

nodes.name: Tinker - Augments (I)
nodes.description: Allows you to build Augment and Implant technology limited at this level to replacement limbs, metal bone plating, camera eyes, and metal teeth. You can surgically install them.

nodes.name: Tinker - Augments (II)
nodes.description: Allows you to build Augment and Implant technology like enhanced camera eyes, subdermal armour, reinforced tendons, hormone regulators, and hidden blades and guns. You can surgically install them.

nodes.name: Tinker - Augments (III)
nodes.description: Allows you to build Augment and Implant technology like mechanical bones, full-body augments enough for Augmented (trait), combat augments, transforming robotic arms, and metabolism regulators. You could make Robocops or Astartes-lites.

nodes.name: Tinker - Augments (IV)
nodes.description: Allows you to build Augment and Implant technology for full-body conversions into tank-flipping, bullet-dodging Cyborgs, fitting impossibly many implants into one body. Go build your Adam Smashers.

nodes.name: Tinker - Augments (V)
nodes.description: Allows you to build Augment and Implant technology to raise regular people to near-demigods, from brain supercomputers and time-dilating spines to million-ton-suplexing skeletons and laser eyes. Go build a Genos or Raiden.

nodes.name: Tinker - Defence (I)
nodes.description: Allows you to build Defence-related technology, at this level limited to reinforcing existing things plus basic shields and bulletproof glass.

nodes.name: Tinker - Defence (II)
nodes.description: Allows you to build Defence-related technology like sturdier protection constructs, limited fireproof coating, impact suits, EMP threading, and bulletproof fabric.

nodes.name: Tinker - Defence (III)
nodes.description: Allows you to build Defence-related technology like shield projectors, reinforced chassis, bullet-ignoring skintight suits, elemental coatings, and highly durable machines.

nodes.name: Tinker - Defence (IV)
nodes.description: Allows you to build Defence-related technology like city-covering forcefields, trauma-hardening cloth outfits, anti-teleport Spatial Locks, and elemental hyper-paint. With effort you could make a bicycle survive ocean depths, space, and volcanoes, or a phone survive nuclear war.

nodes.name: Tinker - Defence (V)
nodes.description: Allows you to build Defence-related technology like nigh-unbreakable space-time-bending forcefields, sun-resistant alloys, and nuclear-surviving suits. With time, resources, and experience, even gods cannot dent them.

nodes.name: Tinker - Ranged Weapon (I)
nodes.description: Allows you to build ranged-weapon technology, at this level mostly mundane but supernaturally well-made pistols, snipers, bows, and slingshots.

nodes.name: Tinker - Ranged Weapon (II)
nodes.description: Allows you to build supernaturally efficient ranged weapons and ammo like steel-piercing revolvers and rudimentary railguns.

nodes.name: Tinker - Ranged Weapon (III)
nodes.description: Allows you to build supernaturally powerful gunpowder, electromagnetic, and laser weapons and ammo, each with tradeoffs, such as bolter-rivaling thermite pistols or Gustav-dwarfing cannons.

nodes.name: Tinker - Ranged Weapon (IV)
nodes.description: Allows you to build supernaturally powerful gunpowder, laser, plasma, and electromagnetic guns and ammo, from army-mowing machine guns and block-wiping blasters to city-busting cannons and tank-ripping scrap guns.

nodes.name: Tinker - Ranged Weapon (V)
nodes.description: Allows you to build god-rivaling ranged weapons limited only by resources and time, like space-ripping sniper rifles, nuclear-pistols, and Death Star-dwarfing cannons.

nodes.name: Tinker - Fortification
nodes.description: Allows you to build fortification technology like self-repairing walls, hidden turrets, proximity sensors, missile batteries, laser traps, and spatial locks. Tech only works attached to a large enough building or area.

nodes.name: Tinker - Resident Evil
nodes.description: Allows you to build Resident Evil technology, specifically cultivating viruses like Tyrant, Uroboros, Progenitor, and parasites. It is time-intensive and can eventually remove side effects with much trial and error.

nodes.name: Tinker - Aperture Science
nodes.description: Allows you to build Aperture Science technology including turrets, portal guns, speed and jump gel, anti-fall boots, basic non-combat robots, and strong AI. Breadth over raw power.

nodes.name: Budding
nodes.description: You can grant others abilities as buds of your own that manifest as sidegrades capped at Elite rank, with max level set by their innate talent. Your budded ability weakens until they assimilate it, when you can retrieve the bud to restore strength, though you can retrieve anytime.

nodes.name: Tinker - Cosmetics
nodes.description: Allows you to build cosmetics-related technology like hyper-realistic masks, machine beautification, holograms, beauty cream, and perfumes.

nodes.name: Tinker - Electricity
nodes.description: Allows you to build electricity-related technology like Ultra Tesla coils and thunder-harnessing constructs, separate from magnetism.

nodes.name: Tinker - Dungeonmaster
nodes.description: Allows you to build dungeon-creation constructs, magical or technological, like bigger-inside rooms, indescrutable walls, dungeon-only traps, and utility rooms. Your dungeon needs an accessible entrance and plausible path to the core, tech only works inside, and inside tech is boosted.

nodes.name: Tinker - Sustenance
nodes.description: Allows you to build sustenance-related constructs like efficient farms, water purifiers and condensers, vampire blood alternatives, food bars, consumable life-force alternatives, and plant light projectors. More encountered sustenance needs unlock more varied tech.

nodes.name: Mystic Eyes of Depth Perception
nodes.description: These mystical eyes supernaturally reveal the depth of an object or location relative to something else.

nodes.name: Swiftness
nodes.description: You can amplify movement with energy to move faster, without affecting agility or senses. Faster speeds cost disproportionately more energy.

nodes.name: Impact
nodes.description: You can amplify physical impact by expending energy, making strikes deal more damage without amplifying stats.

nodes.name: False Data
nodes.description: You can falsify your statistics and abilities to show scrying and analysing abilities what you want instead of the truth.

nodes.name: Internal Duplication
nodes.description: Allows you to duplicate limbs and organs, like extra arms, eyes, or a second fittable heart. Extra parts cause strain.

nodes.name: Tunnel Effect
nodes.description: You can temporarily enforce quantum tunnelling on yourself to let attacks pass through harmlessly or phase through objects. It is draining, with exponentially rising cost the longer it lasts.

nodes.name: Unseen Hand
nodes.description: Allows you to summon numerous invisible hand-like appendages you freely extend and control. They are superhumanly strong and can merge into a slower, larger, stronger hand, with power and max count set by max energy.

nodes.name: Cor Leonis
nodes.description: Cor Leonis lets you sense allies as light spots and take their physical and mental conditions like exhaustion onto yourself. You can also transfer conditions to willing allies.

nodes.name: Return By Death
nodes.description: "You return by dea-" Each death returns you in time to a set spawn point. Spawn points are random but reset after sleeping over 6 hours. Does not activate with soul or existence erasure.

nodes.name: Conjure Ice
nodes.description: Allows you to create ice constructs from energy without controlling them afterward or freezing objects, such as ice walls, weapons, blocks, and boulders.

nodes.name: Conjure Rock
nodes.description: Allows you to manifest rock constructs from energy without controlling them beyond creation and shaping, such as rock weapons, boulders, walls, and blocks.

nodes.name: Wallmaster
nodes.description: You can make a wall from anything in your arsenal or any touched object or ground, from stone and ice to wind, sunlight, and raw energy. Size and durability scale with energy. Walls.

nodes.name: Swordmaster
nodes.description: You can make a sword from anything in your arsenal, held objects, or touched unoccupied material, from fire and ice to light, wind, energy, and swords. Power and duration scale with energy. Swords.

nodes.name: Knighting
nodes.description: You can convert one of your abilities into an armament bestowed on a willing recipient, with weapon powers based on that ability. Knights cannot refuse your orders, lose status permanently if reclaimed, must know the burden, and can be teleported to you every 24 hours.

nodes.name: Burden of Servitude
nodes.description: "Servitude at a price" Allows you to collar a target in exchange for a portion of your abilities or traits. Collared targets cannot disobey and can be summoned anytime. Stronger targets demand more granted abilities, grants are permanently lost even if killed, and too-strong targets are immune.

nodes.name: Greed's Deal
nodes.description: "Everything and everyone has a price." You can buy anything from anyone if you pay enough, from items to devotion or murder. Price depends on relative power and willingness; weak souls go for a dollar, strong ones may need epic items. Payment in gold or valuables burns out of existence.

nodes.name: Reaper's Voice
nodes.description: "Deal with their baser instincts, not their logic" You can command through fear, with greater fear and intimidation granting greater command, even for children, kingdoms, or lives. Obeyed commands cannot be opposed after, as the fear returns when resisted.

nodes.name: Subtitles
nodes.description: Who needs dub? You get subtitles for relevant attended sounds, transcribing speech in any language with tone like "Good for you to finally join us (Sarcastically)" and effects like [Assassin's Footsteps] or [Fireball Chant].

nodes.name: Tinker - Robotics (I)
nodes.description: Allows you to build Robotics technology, at this level only simple and mostly mundane robots like autonomous claw arms or butter-robots.

nodes.name: Tinker - Robotics (II)
nodes.description: Allows you to build Robotics technology like simple average-man-capable robots, gun-bots, up to B-1 Droids or B-2s with training.

nodes.name: Tinker - Robotics (III)
nodes.description: Allows you to build complex capable robots like combat, maid, or worker bots, up to Sentry Bots, Executor Droids, or GLaDOS with mind and resources.

nodes.name: Tinker - Robotics (IV)
nodes.description: Allows you to build powerful useful robots like army-wasting giants, moving castles, and dust-sized repair bots. Go build your Metal Gears.

nodes.name: Tinker - Robotics (V)
nodes.description: Allows you to build nearly any autonomous mechanical unit, from Metal Gear armies and ninja clans to human-like 100x-strong biorobots and nuke-proof superintelligent machines. Integrated other-branch Tinker tech is significantly boosted.

nodes.name: Kudoku
nodes.description: Kudoku lets you expel very weak poison via pores, nails, or mouth. While active-slotted, surviving ingested or inflicted poisons raises Kudoku's potency proportionally with more imbueable effects, from mild paralytic to godslaying venom. Starting rating is Trash, and it grants poison resistance scaling with potency when slotted.

nodes.name: Cursebed
nodes.description: Your soul assimilates curses afflicted on you over time, then lets you replicate and use them by expending energy. Stronger curses take longer to assimilate and strong enough ones can ignore the effect. (Does not affect Gacha Curses).

nodes.name: Hive Lord
nodes.description: You can transform to take on and mix-match traits of any Earth insect. Manifest features like a scorpion's tail and venom, dragonfly wings, cockroach resilience, and more.

nodes.name: Hell Flame
nodes.description: Conjure and shape infernal flames used by demons. They are especially strong against living beings, burning vitality with flesh while weakening them and hindering healing via their unholy attribute. Rather energy-intensive unless you are an Infernal.

nodes.name: Greater Hell Flame
nodes.description: Conjure and shape potent infernal flames used by high-ranking demons. Very hot and effective against living beings, they stick like glue and curse what they burn to hinder healing. Rather energy-intensive unless you are an Infernal.

nodes.name: Holy Light
nodes.description: Conjure and shape Holy Light used by Angels as balls of light, energy blasts, or blades of light. It sets Infernal, Unholy, or Necrotic targets alight with holy flames, but deals significantly less damage otherwise. (A/N: Holy Light is NOT light speed despite the name).

nodes.name: Greater Holy Light
nodes.description: Conjure and shape searing Holy Light used by high-ranking Angels, or call it down from the sky. It sets Infernal, Unholy, or Necrotic opponents alight on contact, burns away same-attribute attacks and curses, and spares anything you do not wish to hurt. Significantly reduced potency otherwise. (A/N: Holy Light is NOT light speed despite the name).

nodes.name: Star of Change
nodes.description: Temporarily change your race to any Race Change trait in the gacha ranked Rare or below while active. You can only transform into one race at a time.

nodes.name: Argonaut
nodes.description: Charge any attack to temporarily bypass your maximum energy output; longer charge yields more power. 10x power costs 10x energy. You can charge only one action at a time, and interruption wastes the energy without unleashing the effect.

nodes.name: Tinker - Vehicles (III)
nodes.description: This tinker ability lets you design and build technology related to vehicles, including impossible supernatural ones. Examples include a sound-speed ship that does not shake, an air-riding motorcycle via hard light, a sports car 10x better armored than a tank with a year of fuel efficiency, or a killdozer rivaling the Batmobile.

nodes.name: Fumofication
nodes.description: Touch a target to turn them into a fumo immune to all damage, though they still feel everything done to them. Stronger targets can resist, and duration scales with energy expended and power difference. You cannot Fumo someone for 1 hour after they awaken from the effect.

nodes.name: Void Shadow
nodes.description: Legendary Mechanic - Conjure an invulnerable shadow copy of yourself that cannot interact with the world. It moves extremely fast, can disrupt others' vision, and lets you see through its eyes. Lasts 30 minutes at base, one at a time; duration can be increased by training.

nodes.name: Void Distortion
nodes.description: Legendary Mechanic - Pull on the Void Dimension to cause spatial disruptions in the material world. It inflicts massive devastation and damage in exchange for incredibly taxing energy expenditure.

nodes.name: Choices & Choices
nodes.description: When you need to make a choice, activate to view up to 3 relevant choices and their vague outcomes. For example, [We shouldn't go +reputation with X --Reputation with Y, Z Dies].

nodes.name: Tinker - Resources
nodes.description: This Tinker speciality lets you design, modify, and build technology related to acquiring materials.

nodes.name: Fate Draw
nodes.description: Roll a random number out of 22 to invoke the effect of that Major Arcana Tarot Card. Cooldown: 120 Hours.

nodes.name: Inanimate Interrogation
nodes.description: "Interrogate" inanimate objects for information, such as asking a wall who entered in 24 hours, a weapon how to use it, or a building how to infiltrate it. Objects must tell the truth based only on what they have seen, heard, or know about themselves. Forcing more recall costs more energy.

nodes.name: Hustle
nodes.description: Yomi Hustle - "It may be your only move" lets you "Hustle" by performing a gesture lasting at least half a second, like snapping fingers with a taunt or lounging mid-fight. On completion you regain energy and stamina, more the longer and more stylish and aggravating the hustle. Can only be used in active combat against an enemy meaning you genuine harm.

nodes.name: Restraint Levels
nodes.description: Place "Restraint Levels" on willing or unable-to-resist targets, including yourself. They can seal abilities and forms or block certain power levels. They can only be lifted by you or a designated target speaking the unlock phrase.

nodes.name: Marionette Grasp
nodes.description: Take control of a target's physical body in your line of sight, moving them against their will. Stronger targets cost more energy to control and maintain. You can share senses, control additional targets at greater mental and energy cost, or narrow control to parts like fingers to save energy.

nodes.name: Edict
nodes.description: Impose rules by touching targets and expending energy; targets feel incredible mental compulsion to follow them, like forbidding milk, forcing travel at set times, or banning clothes in a room. Stronger targets are harder to affect, and edicts against self-preservation are exponentially harder.

nodes.name: Phantom Sensation
nodes.description: Project sensations of actions onto someone in your line of sight without physically affecting them. You can project groping, licking, scratching, choking, burning, stabbing, hanging, etc., provided you could do those things without the ability.

nodes.name: Mind Blast
nodes.description: Send a wave of shimmering psionic energy through your eyes. On hitting a sentient target it causes mental damage, confusion, and painful headaches. Effectiveness depends on the target's mental and magical power.

nodes.name: Geass - Command
nodes.description: Give an absolute command to anyone you make eye contact with; they must obey if physically capable. Usable only once per person, and targets comparable to or stronger than you can resist or ignore it. Does not cost energy to use.

nodes.name: Geass - Memory
nodes.description: Rewrite a target's memories through direct eye contact. Greater detail and volume cost more energy and time, scaling with power difference and willpower, and rewritten memories can be broken through. Training improves speed, efficiency, detail, and accuracy.

nodes.name: Geass - Suspension
nodes.description: Suspend the time perception of sentient beings in a dome around you, freezing them in place. Maintaining it greatly drains vitality and energy based on range size, target count, and target power. It affects all targets in range indiscriminately.

nodes.name: Conjure Lesser Water Elemental
nodes.description: Conjure or summon Lesser Water and Ice Elementals from your energy and command them, such as Nymphs, Water Fairies, etc., or similar beings from other worlds using water-based magic. Limited to Uncommon familiar power or less; power and form scale with your expertise and level. They draw on your energy to persist and act, vanishing if supply stops, but with enough time, energy, and skill you can make them permanent. Elementals are not counted as Familiars by the system.

nodes.name: Conjure Water Elemental
nodes.description: Conjure or summon Water and Ice Elementals from your energy and command them, such as Nereids, High Water Fairies, Undines, etc., or similar beings using water-based magic. Limited to Rare Familiar power or less; power and form scale with your expertise and level. They draw on your energy to persist and act, vanishing if supply stops, but with enough time, energy, and skill you can make them permanent. Elementals are not counted as Familiars by the system.

nodes.name: Conjure Greater Water Elemental
nodes.description: Conjure powerful Greater Water and Ice Elementals from your energy and command them, such as Sirens, Oceanids, Noble Water Fairies, Regice, etc., using water-based magic and other abilities. Limited to Elite Familiar power or less; power and form scale with your expertise and level. They draw on your energy to persist and act, vanishing if supply stops, but with enough time, energy, and skill you can make them permanent. Elementals are not counted as Familiars by the system.

nodes.name: Conjure Lesser Air Elemental
nodes.description: Conjure or summon Lesser Air and Sky Elementals from your energy and command them, such as Wind Sprites, Living Clouds, Wind Elementals, etc., using air and sky-based magic. Limited to Uncommon familiar power or less; power and form scale with your expertise and level. They draw on your energy to persist and act, vanishing if supply stops, but with enough time, energy, and skill you can make them permanent. Elementals are not counted as Familiars by the system.

nodes.name: Conjure Air Elemental
nodes.description: Conjure or summon Air and Sky Elementals from your energy and command them, such as Storm Elementals, Wind Fairies, Nimbus Clouds, Cloud Elementals, etc., using wind-based magic. Limited to Rare Familiar power or less; power and form scale with your expertise and level. They draw on your energy to persist and act, vanishing if supply stops, but with enough time, energy, and skill you can make them permanent. Elementals are not counted as Familiars by the system.

nodes.name: Summon Greater Air Elemental
nodes.description: Conjure powerful Greater Air Elementals from your energy and command them, such as Hurricane Elementals, Greater Wind Spirits, Greater Storm Elementals, Thunderbirds, etc., using air-based magic and other abilities. Limited to Elite Familiar power or less; power and form scale with your expertise and level. They draw on your energy to persist and act, vanishing if supply stops, but with enough time, energy, and skill you can make them permanent. Elementals are not counted as Familiars by the system.

nodes.name: Summon Lesser Fire Elemental
nodes.description: Conjure or summon Lesser Fire Elementals from your energy and command them, such as Fire Spirits, Living Candlelight, Fire Eaters, etc., using fire-based magic. Limited to Uncommon familiar power or less; power and form scale with your expertise and level. They draw on your energy to persist and act, vanishing if supply stops, but with enough time, energy, and skill you can make them permanent. Elementals are not counted as Familiars by the system.

nodes.name: Summon Fire Elemental
nodes.description: Conjure or summon Fire Elementals from your energy and command them, such as Fire Fairies, Fire Elementals, Fire Atronachs, Efreets, etc., or similar beings using fire-based magic. Limited to Rare Familiar power or less; power and form scale with your expertise and level. They draw on your energy to persist and act, vanishing if supply stops, but with enough time, energy, and skill you can make them permanent. Elementals are not counted as Familiars by the system.

nodes.name: Summon Greater Fire Elemental
nodes.description: Conjure powerful Greater Fire Elementals from your energy and command them, such as Firebirds, Greater Efreets, Flame Devourers, etc., using fire-based magic and other abilities. Limited to Elite Familiar power or less; power and form scale with your expertise and level. They draw on your energy to persist and act, vanishing if supply stops, but with enough time, energy, and skill you can make them permanent. Elementals are not counted as Familiars by the system.

nodes.name: Summon Lesser Demon
nodes.description: Summon Lesser Demons from the Underworld to serve and obey you, such as Imps, Capra Demons, Demon Eyes, etc., limited to Uncommon Familiar power or less. They are bound to your will while manifested and need your constant energy to stay summoned and use abilities; slain servants reform in the Underworld and can be resummoned, and you can strengthen them with more magic. You can make them permanent with a sufficient blood sacrifice by tier; for an Uncommon Demon, sacrifice of an Uncommon target. Permanent demons no longer need your energy.

nodes.name: Summon Demon
nodes.description: Summon Demons from the Underworld to serve and obey you, such as Demons, Succubi/Incubi, Taurus Demons, etc., limited to Rare familiar power or less. They are bound to your will while manifested and need your constant energy to stay summoned and use abilities; slain servants reform in the Underworld and can be resummoned, and you can strengthen them with more magic. You can make them permanent with a sufficient blood sacrifice by tier; for an Elite Demon, sacrifice of an Elite Target. Permanent demons no longer need your energy.

nodes.name: Summon Fiend
nodes.description: Summon Fiends from the Underworld, a nobler variant of demons, to serve and obey you, such as Fiends, Greater Succubi/Incubi, Oni (Fate), Soul Eaters (Overlord), etc., limited to Elite Familiar power or less. They are bound to your will while manifested and need your constant energy to stay summoned and use abilities; slain servants reform in the Underworld and can be resummoned, and you can strengthen them with more magic. You can make them permanent with a sufficient blood sacrifice by tier; for an Elite Demon, sacrifice of an Elite Target. Permanent demons no longer need your energy.

nodes.name: Summon Archfiend
nodes.description: Summon Archfiends from the Underworld, a royal variant of demons, to serve and obey you, such as Archfiends, Succubi/Incubi Kings/Queens, Oni Rulers (Fate), Arch Devils (Overlord), Devils (Chainsaw Man), etc., limited to Epic Familiar power or less. They are bound to your will while manifested and need your constant energy to stay summoned and use abilities; slain servants reform in the Underworld and can be resummoned, and you can strengthen them with more magic. You can make them permanent with a sufficient blood sacrifice by tier; for an Epic Demon, sacrifice of an Epic Target. Permanent demons no longer need your energy.

nodes.name: The Gates of Hell
nodes.description: Summon all but the strongest infernals from the Underworld to serve and obey you, such as True Demons, Devils (Chainsaw Man), Efreet Sultans, Greater Daemons (Warhammer), etc., limited to Legendary Familiar power or less. They are bound to your will while manifested and need your constant energy to stay summoned and use abilities; slain servants reform in the Underworld and can be resummoned, and you can strengthen them with more magic. You can make them permanent with a sufficient blood sacrifice by tier; for a Legendary Demon, sacrifice of a Legendary Target. Permanent demons no longer need your energy.

nodes.name: Roentgenium Manipulation
nodes.description: Sense and telekinetically control Roentgenium in a radius around you. Range and power can be increased by training, scaling with your energy reserves.

nodes.name: Charon's Bell
nodes.description: Ring the Ferryman's bell to call the souls of the dead to you, by default all souls in range, or a specific soul instantly if you hold something relevant like corpse parts or mementos, as long as their soul is in your dimension. Powerful unwilling targets can resist. Called spirits are not commanded but can be interacted with, and you can store 100 souls by default, equal to a grown man, increasing with energy reserves.

nodes.name: Summon Angelic Guardian
nodes.description: Temporarily summon a low-ranking Angel or Holy Spirit from the Heavenly Realm, such as Lesser Light Fairy, Angel Guardians, Archangel Flames (Overlord), 2 Winged Angels, etc., limited to Uncommon familiar power or less. Bound to your will, it needs your constant energy to stay and use magic; slain angels restore in the Heavenly Realm and can be resummoned, and more energy lets them exert more power. You can permanently bind one via a long prayer ceremony sacrificing appropriate valuables and energy.

nodes.name: Summon Angel
nodes.description: Temporarily summon a lower-ranking Angel or Holy Spirit from the Heavenly Realm, such as Light Fairies, Pixies, Unicorns, Principalities, 4 Winged Angels, etc., limited to Rare familiar power or less. Bound to your will, it needs your constant energy to stay and use magic; slain angels restore in the Heavenly Realm and can be resummoned, and more energy lets them exert more power. You can permanently bind one via a long prayer ceremony sacrificing appropriate valuables and energy.

nodes.name: Summon Principality
nodes.description: Temporarily summon a middle-ranked Angel or Holy Spirit from the Heavenly Realm, such as Noble Light Spirits, Principalities, Valkyries, 6 Winged Angels, etc., limited to Elite familiar power or less. Bound to your will, it needs your constant energy to stay and use magic; slain angels restore in the Heavenly Realm and can be resummoned, and more energy lets them exert more power. You can permanently bind one via a long prayer ceremony sacrificing appropriate valuables and energy.

nodes.name: Summon Dominion
nodes.description: Temporarily summon a very high-ranked Angel or Holy Spirit from the Heavenly Realm, such as Light Spirit Lords, Dominions, 8 Winged Angels, Archangels (Hota), Valkyrie Chiefs, etc., limited to Epic familiar power or less. Bound to your will, it needs your constant energy to stay and use magic; slain angels restore in the Heavenly Realm and can be resummoned, and more energy lets them exert more power. You can permanently bind one via a long prayer ceremony sacrificing appropriate valuables and energy.

nodes.name: Heavenly Gate
nodes.description: Temporarily call forth Heavenly Realm armies, swarms of lower angels or great guardian angels and light spirits, such as Empresses of Light, Thrones, 10 Winged Angels, etc., limited to Legendary familiar power or less. Bound to your will, they need your constant energy to stay and use magic; slain angels restore in the Heavenly Realm and can be resummoned, and more energy lets them exert more power. You can permanently bind one via a long prayer ceremony sacrificing appropriate valuables and energy.

nodes.name: Familiar Manifestation
nodes.description: Temporarily call upon a limb or body part of a familiar you own to use as an attack. The familiar itself takes no damage.

nodes.name: Kill Process
nodes.description: "The End of Machine" enforces "Kill Process" on any technology eclipsing Mundane Earth, forcing ruin upon it: chips torn apart, processors melted, chassis shredded, code mangled, and non-souls sent to oblivion. Potency scales with divergence from Mundane Earth tech and your power difference to the target, but even a normal person could down a spaceship with a glare. Can only affect technology and tech-based targets.

nodes.name: Elemental Sight
nodes.description: Attune to Elemental Forces and energy: feel air, see heat, hear lightning, taste earth. See all Fire, Water, Air, and Earth in line of sight through everything else, including brain electricity, blood water, and cable electricity. Magically charged elements appear more vibrant.

nodes.name: Corpus Weapon
nodes.description: Imbue a held weapon or your limbs with necrotic energy. It amplifies attacks, hinders healing, and directly hurts vitality, dealing extra damage to living targets by exhausting vitality. You can also throw it as a projectile from weapon or fist.

nodes.name: Necrotic Weapon
nodes.description: Imbue a held weapon or your limbs with withering necrotic energy. It amplifies attacks; wounds on living beings inflict spreading necrosis and rigor mortis if held long enough, while inanimate targets corrode and decay. You can also throw it as a projectile or temporarily extend the weapon beyond range.

nodes.name: Dread Blade
nodes.description: Suffuse weapons or limbs with potent Necrotic and Darkness energies, amplifying destruction based on energy expended. Living wounds are cursed to hinder healing and spread worsening necrosis and weakness per resistance, while inanimate objects corrode, wither, and degrade. You can also fire projectiles like flying slashes or temporarily extend the weapon.

nodes.name: Gravelords Blade
nodes.description: Channel the Gravelords' Blade into any weapon or your body, suffusing it with Death and Curses. It greatly amplifies destruction per energy expended; living wounds gain Gravelord's Curse, nearly unhealable, spreading death essence for damage over time and weakness, with a chance to instantly kill weaker targets, costing energy to maintain. Inanimate objects corrode and degrade. You can also fire projectiles, extend the weapon, or manifest a pure-energy weapon for extra cost.

nodes.name: Ruin Edge
nodes.description: Suffuse any armament or your body with cursed ruinous energies. They massively amplify destruction and decay whatever they strike, whether magic, physical defences, space, or nebulous targets. Living wounds gain Ruin Curse, unhealable unless lifted, causing continuous weakening and pain that you can always track, with a chance to instantly kill weaker targets, costing energy to maintain. Inanimate targets are corroded to dust unless toughest. You can also fire projectiles, extend the weapon, or manifest a pure-energy weapon for extra cost.

nodes.name: Lesser Animate Undead
nodes.description: Imbue a corpse with Necrotic energy to reanimate it as a lesser undead under your command, such as skeletons, zombies, wights, etc., at most as strong as an Uncommon familiar. Quality and power depend on corpse quality, corpse strength, and your power; stronger undead cost more energy. The number you can control scales with energy reserves.

nodes.name: Animate Undead
nodes.description: Animate corpses into undead such as Death Knights, Death Warriors, Undead Mages, Lesser Vampires, Wraiths, Bone Wyverns, or an undead version of the corpse, limited to Rare Familiar power or less. Tier depends on corpse quality and your power; stronger undead cost more energy. The number you command scales with energy, minimum 100 at once.

nodes.name: Greater Animate Undead
nodes.description: Animate corpses into undead such as Dread Knights, Liches, Vampires, Wraiths, Soul Eaters, Bone Dragons, or an undead version of the corpse, limited to Elite Familiar power or less. Tier depends on corpse quality and your power; stronger undead cost more energy. The number you command scales with energy, minimum 500 at once.

nodes.name: True Necromancy
nodes.description: Enact true necromancy sanctioned by Death itself to raise corpses into undead such as Gravelords, Night Liches, Vampire Lords, Nightmare Kings, Undead Dragons, Corpse Titans, or an undead version of the corpse, limited to Epic Familiar power or less. Tier depends on corpse quality and your power; stronger undead cost more energy. The number you command scales with energy, minimum 2500 at once.

nodes.name: Exalted Necromancy
nodes.description: Perform Exalted Necromancy beyond merely raising the Dead, raising corpses into undead such as Necro Kaisers, Overlords, Vampire Kings, Undead Dragon Lords, Reapers, etc., or an undead version of the corpse, limited to Legendary Familiar power or less. Tier depends on corpse quality and your power; stronger undead cost more energy. The number you command scales with energy, minimum 10000 at once.

nodes.name: Divinity Necromancy
nodes.description: Wield divinity to use the dead as army and servants; you can turn even an average man's corpse into an Undead Dragon or Gravelord. You can animate any corpse into a True Undead keeping all abilities and memories from life and further empowered by your divinity, as long as it is dead. Power and number scale with your power, with up to 100000 controllable even as a base human.

nodes.name: Authority of Death
nodes.description: Wield the Authority of Death, the End. Merely point to claim lives; claiming lives and resurrecting the dead is easier than breathing. You can even kill unkillable targets by granting the concept of death. Stronger targets cost more energy.

nodes.name: Divinity Earth
nodes.description: As a god of earth, wave a hand to move continents, snap fingers to call life-wiping meteors, raise an arm to raise mountains, or glare to send civilization-devastating sandstorms. As long as it is Earth and you have enough energy, you can do it.

nodes.name: Divinity Sky
nodes.description: Possess divinity over the Sky. Bring down kilometer-wide lightning pillars, alter atmospheric composition at will, create city-flinging tornadoes, create a planet's atmosphere, and make adamantite-tough clouds to float on. As long as it is the sky and you have enough energy, you can do it.

nodes.name: Tinker - Arcology
nodes.description: Design, build, modify, and construct technology for creating and maintaining Arcologies, self-sufficient megastructures housing people as self-contained cities. Includes construction drones, self-recycling soil, maintenance robots, surveillance, farming, recyclers, and all else needed for function. Such technology only works when creating or inside an Arcology.

nodes.name: Summon Lesser nature Spirit
nodes.description: Summon a lesser nature spirit, requiring sufficient fertile ground nearby, such as Junimo, Lesser Dryads, maneater plants, Ents, etc. Limited to Uncommon familiar power or less; strength depends on your power. It draws on your energy to stay manifested and use abilities, unsummoning if unfueled, but with proper skills, time, and energy you can make it permanent.

nodes.name: Summon nature Spirit
nodes.description: Summon a nature spirit, requiring sufficient fertile ground nearby, such as nature Spirits, Dryads, Giant Animated Plants, Treants, Dendroid Soldiers, etc. Limited to Rare familiar power or less; strength depends on your power. It draws on your energy to stay manifested and use abilities, unsummoning if unfueled, but with proper skills, time, and energy you can make it permanent.

nodes.name: Summon Greater nature Spirit
nodes.description: Summon a greater nature spirit, requiring sufficient fertile ground nearby, such as Noble Dryads, Haunted Trees, Treant Lords, Dendroid Warriors, etc. Limited to Elite familiar power or less; strength depends on your power. It draws on your energy to stay manifested and use abilities, unsummoning if unfueled, but with proper skills, time, and energy you can make it permanent.

nodes.name: Mirror World
nodes.description: Access a Mirror Dimension at will by turning any sufficiently reflective surface into a portal. Inside there are no living beings, only an empty reflection of the real world, and native objects cannot be removed, hold no energy, and provide no sustenance. You can throw objects and people inside, and entry and exit is only via your mirror portals.

nodes.name: Foxfire
nodes.description: Wield Foxfire, the Kitsune signature. Though weaker than same-tier flames, it lasts long and can change shape and texture to create disguises, illusions, and deceptions.

nodes.name: Nine-Tailed Foxfire
nodes.description: Wield Nine-Tailed pale blue flames. Though less potent than same-tier flames, they cost less energy to create and maintain. You can freely shape them in form, texture, color, and sound, even convincingly mimicking a person.

nodes.name: Sunlight
nodes.description: Conjure a ball of pure sunlight that hovers and moves at will. It perfectly mimics the regular sun and costs little energy to maintain. You can preload spheres with energy to make semi-permanent sunlight they slowly deplete.

nodes.name: Bamboo Sprout
nodes.description: Sprout supernaturally durable energy-imbued culms anywhere in vision, optionally sharpened. Use them for walls, spikes, or impalement. Created bamboo is permanent but loses supernatural durability over time, returning to normal.

nodes.name: Vinelash
nodes.description: Create supernaturally strong vines from your body under your control. Durability, strength, and size scale with energy; wield them like extra limbs as whips, grapples, or binds, and sprout thorns for extra energy. They vanish once unfueled.

nodes.name: Leaf Blade
nodes.description: Conjure a long leaf blade with supernatural durability and great sharpness, though still not very durable. You can also conjure smaller leaves as throwing projectiles. Created leaves are permanent but lose supernatural properties over time.

nodes.name: Razor Leaves
nodes.description: Conjure and telekinetically control supernaturally durable, sharp leaves. Launch sweeping knife-storms, pin targets, conjure larger weapon-leaves, or make razor whirlwinds. More energy yields sharper, tougher leaves in greater numbers.

nodes.name: Stun Spore
nodes.description: Conjure pale-green spore clouds that paralyze and immobilize when breathed in. Stronger opponents are less affected, ranging from day-long knockout to mild limb stiffness. Uningested clouds dissipate in 5 minutes.

nodes.name: Overclock
nodes.description: Overclock technology with your own energy to push it beyond limits. It performs better but burns durability faster and risks damage. More energy means greater boost and greater potential damage.

nodes.name: Tinker - Redundancy
nodes.description: Give technology you create or modify heavy redundancies, making it frustratingly hard to disable. You can make a fragile phone work flawlessly with shattered screen, exposed wires, water immersion, and half-melted chassis.

nodes.name: Vanish
nodes.description: Temporarily vanish utterly from reality, erasing your existence so nothing can track, hit, affect, or predict you. While vanished you rest bodiless in white nothingness, able only to think until you end it and reappear in place. It consumes energy and ends automatically when depleted.

nodes.name: Thermal Vision
nodes.description: Switch your vision to perfectly accurate thermal vision, seeing heat signatures without impairing regular vision.

nodes.name: Varied Vision
nodes.description: Switch between Thermal, Infrared, and Night vision at will without impairing regular vision.

nodes.name: Bubbling
nodes.description: Encase targets in bubbles about as durable as 1cm of glass, scaling with power, that slowly float or hover midair and pop when damaged. You can encase yourself and slowly steer the float.

nodes.name: Lube Dispensation
nodes.description: Dispense body-safe water-based lube from your body. Make your body slick at will, release it from any point like a dispenser, or shoot it like a low-power hose.

nodes.name: Rough Knuckle
nodes.description: Slightly augment fists with energy, letting an average man shatter bricks. More energy means greater augmentation, but it is inefficient.

nodes.name: Light Waltz
nodes.description: Cover body parts in a light-like aura reducing pressure on surfaces to almost nothing, letting you walk on cobwebs or water. It does not reduce damage taken; falls still hurt you but not where you land.

nodes.name: Camera Mark
nodes.description: Place glowing red runes on stable surfaces acting as cameras you can view mentally anytime. The count depends on maximum energy, minimum 5.

nodes.name: Project Image
nodes.description: Conjure stationary 2D planes showing images or video you accurately remember or imagine. They are as durable as 1cm of untempered glass.

nodes.name: Truth Assertion
nodes.description: Make others believe the truth of your words, but while active you cannot speak or communicate with intent to deceive. A glowing white choker appears around your neck while active.

nodes.name: Sweat
nodes.description: Sweat on command, either stopping sweating or sweating at supernatural levels to cool down.

nodes.name: Black Trial
nodes.description: Wield the Black Trial hunting sinned blackened souls. See souls by color: whiter is purer, blacker is more sinful. After observing a Black Soul you can mark it, track it anywhere, and teleport to it anytime.

nodes.name: Smoke Conduit Physiology
nodes.description: Wield Smoke Conduit powers with a mild physical boost. Absorb, generate, manipulate, emit, and briefly become Smoke, and absorb smoke to augment regeneration. Conduit abilities use absorbed element, not your energy. You start with basics and must train for complex techniques.

nodes.name: Neon Conduit Physiology
nodes.description: Wield Neon Conduit powers with a mild physical boost. Absorb, generate, manipulate, emit, and briefly become Neon, greatly augmenting speed, and absorb Neon Light to augment regeneration. Conduit abilities use absorbed element, not your energy. Note: You do not move at or near light speed. You start with basics and must train for complex techniques.

nodes.name: Oil/Napalm Conduit Physiology
nodes.description: Wield Oil/Napalm Conduit powers with a mild physical boost. Absorb, generate, manipulate, emit, and briefly become Napalm/Oil to fire blasts, douse foes, or restrain them, and absorb it to augment regeneration. Conduit abilities use absorbed element, not your energy. You start with basics and must train for complex techniques. (Lowered rating due to scarcity of element).

nodes.name: Ice Conduit Physiology
nodes.description: Wield Ice Conduit powers with a mild physical boost. Absorb, generate, manipulate, and emit Ice, briefly become Icy Vapor, and use cryokinesis for vapor blasts, icicles, erupting ice constructs, and more, absorbing Ice to augment regeneration. Conduit abilities use absorbed element, not your energy. You start with basics and must train for complex techniques.

nodes.name: Concrete Conduit Physiology
nodes.description: Wield Concrete Conduit powers with a mild physical boost. Absorb, generate, manipulate, emit, and encase yourself in concrete armor boosting physicals or fire concrete spikes, absorbing Concrete to augment regeneration. Conduit abilities use absorbed element, not your energy. You start with basics and must train for complex techniques. (In the absence of concrete, Sedimentary rocks can be used as a substitute).

nodes.name: Lightning Conduit Physiology
nodes.description: Wield Lightning Conduit powers with a mild physical boost. Absorb and manipulate Electricity and Magnetism to launch lightning bolts, EMPs, polarity fields, electromagnetic walls, etc., absorbing electricity to augment regeneration and with intensive training overdrive others' regeneration via bioelectricity. Conduit abilities use absorbed element, not your energy. You start with basics and must train for complex techniques. Note: No, you cannot time-travel or travel at lightning speed.

nodes.name: Video Conduit Physiology
nodes.description: Wield Video Conduit powers with a mild physical boost. Absorb artificial light from video displays to fuel Hard Light Constructs like weapons, armor, and temporary minions, angels, and demons, and with practice bend light for invisibility, absorbing Video to augment regeneration. Conduit abilities use absorbed element, not your energy. You start with basics and must train for complex techniques. Note: You can't pull people into Video worlds.

nodes.name: Fight Mode
nodes.description: Fill your body with adrenaline, norepinephrine, cortisol, endorphins, testosterone, and dopamine to enter an enhanced fight mode. Get your head in the game without suffering overdose consequences.

nodes.name: Anchor Back
nodes.description: Place a mark where you stand; while active you can teleport back to it. Greater distance costs more energy. Only one mark at a time.

nodes.name: Adventure Line
nodes.description: Manifest a yellow ground line leading to an adventure if followed. By adventure, an interesting reachable event, good or dangerous, like an undiscovered eatery or a lethal murderer on spree. Whatever you meet is guaranteed interesting.

nodes.name: Hormone Regulation
nodes.description: Control your body's hormones, secreting more, lowering levels, or shifting concentrations for effects like forced concentration or depression. Exercise caution to avoid harming your body or biochemistry.

nodes.name: Tanuki's Leaves
nodes.description: Wield Tanuki Yokai leaves, conjuring leaves that shapeshift into any desired object with altered size and texture. Durability and longevity scale with supplied energy, reverting when depleted. You can also leaf-disguise people while you keep supplying energy.

nodes.name: Tonguelash
nodes.description: Reinforce and elongate your tongue from several to dozens of meters. Use it as a whip, extra limb, or the other obvious uses.

nodes.name: Meal
nodes.description: Enhance food you cook to be more nutritious, amplifying existing ingredient properties. Taste improves proportionally to cooking quality.

nodes.name: Mental Out
nodes.description: Mental Out controls human and human-adjacent minds with incredible precision, controlling, altering personalities, or subtly manipulating them, but marks the target's eye. It works via hyper-specialized ultra-micro hydrokinesis, requiring extensive study to adapt to non-human biology. Effectiveness scales with power difference.

nodes.name: Rebake
nodes.description: Expend energy to recreate any food you cooked with your own hands as an exact permanent replica. Cost depends on complexity, ingredient expense, and volume. Cannot create food with supernatural effects.

nodes.name: Rasengan
nodes.description: Weave energy into a multi-rotating sphere inflicting incredible damage on hit. It needs time and concentration to build properly. With training you can enlarge it, throw it, or combine it with elemental abilities for variants.

nodes.name: Thought Acceleration
nodes.description: Concentrate to accelerate brain processing to think faster in less time. With practice and combat skill it can be used in combat. Overuse has negative consequences.

nodes.name: Caladrious Form
nodes.description: Turn into or hybridize the Caladrious, white bird of healing. You gain slightly enhanced physicals, can see sickness, and absorb ailments by touching diseased or cursed targets. You gain great curse and illness resistance, purging them by bathing in sunlight at a rate scaling with reserves. Unholy and dark abilities are blocked, while holy and recovery are enhanced.

nodes.name: Envenom
nodes.description: Imbibe poison to boost performance, greatly increasing physicals, awareness, alertness, and pain resistance. It damages your body with poison.

nodes.name: Sightline
nodes.description: When activated, create red lines connecting to everyone who can visually sense you, highlighting them through lines.

nodes.name: Soul Arrow
nodes.description: Draw energy from life and soul to shape a simple curving arrow projectile. Its power scales with soul might plus energy levels.

nodes.name: Great Soul Arrow
nodes.description: Shape life and soul energy into a refined, potent Soul Arrow that curves mid-flight toward targets. Its power scales with soul might plus energy levels.

nodes.name: Soul Spear
nodes.description: Condense refined soul energy into a powerful piercing spear that curves mid-air to home in and pierce defenses. Its power scales with soul might plus energy levels.

nodes.name: Crystal Soul Spear
nodes.description: Condense refined soul energy further empowered by crystallization into a crystalline spear that curves mid-air with incredible piercing power. Its power scales with soul might plus energy levels.

nodes.name: Bulk Up
nodes.description: Bulk up to reinforce all muscles to superhuman strength, letting even a base human tear apart and throw cars. Overuse causes extreme soreness and muscle tears.

nodes.name: Creation
nodes.description: Create objects and matter with magical energy if you remember exactly how to make them, from phones to gold bars to magical swords. Higher mass and more magical objects cost more energy.

nodes.name: Inner Gate
nodes.description: You hold an inner gate converting energy into elemental mana for varied elemental magic depending on aptitude.

nodes.name: Highlight
nodes.description: Mark a target by touch with a Highlight, giving them a colored outline you can see within eyesight range. Visible even if vision-impaired or blocked by obstacles.

nodes.name: Bequeath
nodes.description: Grant others percentages of your own base physical stats, like 10% Strength or 20% Agility. Granted amounts are permanently lost but retrainable; only unaltered base stats work.

nodes.name: Rescale
nodes.description: Reallocate your physical stats as percentage shares, defaulting to 500.0% split 100.0% each among Vitality, Strength, Toughness, Agility, and stamina. While active, freely redistribute as long as you keep enough to survive, e.g. 10.0% Agility and 190.0% Toughness.

nodes.name: Liaison
nodes.description: Select Liaisons up to your number of ability slots; they can wield all your currently slotted abilities through you using your energy. Requires Liaison slotted to stay active.

nodes.name: Absolute Terror Field
nodes.description: Harness your own AT Field, an invisible soul barrier centered on you visible only on sufficient impact. Reshape it with mastery; power scales with energy reserves and soul strength.

nodes.name: Challenge
nodes.description: "Come at me!" Designate targets in line of sight to feel an immense, hard-to-resist urge to maim or kill you. Targets must be in your sensory range and vice versa.

nodes.name: Dying Will Flame
nodes.description: Automatically gain a Sky Dying Will Flame matching your temperament.

nodes.name: Sky Flames
nodes.description: Dying Will Flames of Harmonization that also let you temporarily fuse with another ability to create a greater flame-based ability.

nodes.name: Storm Flames
nodes.description: Dying Will Flames of Disintegration that tear apart targets violently instead of burning.

nodes.name: Rain Flames
nodes.description: Dying Will Flames of Tranquility; these water-like flames weaken whatever they touch, reducing effect intensity.

nodes.name: Sun Flames
nodes.description: Dying Will Flames of Activation; these light-like flames boost whatever they affect — healing, ability output, or physical performance. Use can tax the affected target.

nodes.name: Lightning Flames
nodes.description: Dying Will Flames of Hardening that solidify and harden objects, e.g. turning air into walls, forming lightning barriers, or wielding lightning as sharp blades.

nodes.name: Mist Flames
nodes.description: Dying Will Flames of Construction that alter looks, texture, smell, etc. to fool the five senses and can condense enough to pass as real objects, but with comparatively weak firepower.

nodes.name: Cloud Flames
nodes.description: Dying Will Flames of Propagation that increase, replicate, and duplicate targets, e.g. copying a sword, boosting muscle mass, or making mirror images; stronger effects cost more energy. Excellent for large-scale effects despite weak firepower.

nodes.name: Drillmaker
nodes.description: Make, not break. Create energy drills you telekinetically control as projectiles or wielded weapons. Strength and rotation scale with energy expended.

nodes.name: Bloody Loan
nodes.description: "Future for the Present." Freely recover energy, but when you stop siphoning you suffer damage proportional to energy gained, from mild cuts to nigh-unhealable wounds to death.

nodes.name: Bloody Savings
nodes.description: "Present for the Future." Expend health and energy to store at a 5 to 1 ratio, reclaimable anytime while this stays in the active slot.

nodes.name: Barbs
nodes.description: While active, strikes and blunt attacks cost more energy but act as if covered in razor/barbed wire, leaving lacerations proportional to attack power.

nodes.name: Equal Blood
nodes.description: "This will hurt both of us." Increases damage targets take from your attacks, but you take a portion of the damage you inflict.

nodes.name: Trial
nodes.description: See people in grayscale by your sense of morality; the more immoral by your morals, the darker they appear.

nodes.name: Inversion
nodes.description: Invert the effect of any slotted Ability, e.g. Pyrokinesis to Cryokinesis or Curse to Bless, but double its energy cost.

nodes.name: Lesser Curse
nodes.description: Place a curse by touch lowering one chosen physical attribute — Strength, Resilience, stamina, Vitality, or Agility. Potency and duration scale with your strength advantage and energy spent; only one curse per target.

nodes.name: Curse
nodes.description: Apply one of three curses by touch: Weakness lowers Strength, Resilience, and stamina; Ruination hinders Energy and Vitality regeneration; Obsufication weakens all five senses. Potency and duration scale with your strength advantage and energy spent; only one curse per target.

nodes.name: Watcher's Curse
nodes.description: Apply the Watcher's Curse, placing a floating ethereal eye over the target that transmits its location and sight to you. Can also anchor abilities and spells cast through it.

nodes.name: Root
nodes.description: Grow ethereal roots into the ground, rooting you in place to drain energy and nutrients and accelerate vitality and energy regeneration.

nodes.name: Kamikaze
nodes.description: Expend your own Vitality to detonate a powerful violent explosion from your body. More Vitality means a stronger blast; minimum cost must considerably hurt you.

nodes.name: Tower Down
nodes.description: "Fractured Language" Temporarily bring down the Tower of Babel, making all communication impossible in 1km — written, spoken, or gestured remain incomprehensible. Range grows with strength; energy cost scales with people affected.

nodes.name: Physical Trauma Response
nodes.description: Flesh hardens against physical trauma: sudden impacts/strikes above a threshold compact muscles, fat, skin, and all layers at the impact point into brief armor without impeding movement.

nodes.name: Tinker - Mech (I)
nodes.description: Design, modify, and build Mech tech and large piloted armors. At this level, create basic mechs like construction exosuits or clunky mechs with standard armor and machine guns.

nodes.name: Tinker - Mech (II)
nodes.description: Design, modify, and build Mech tech and large piloted armors. At this level, create proper combat-ready mechs — sleek agile briefly-flying types, armored low-mobility types, or easily-repaired modular ones. Can also design mech-only weaponry/modules based on your other abilities and traits.

nodes.name: Tinker - Mech (III)
nodes.description: Design, modify, and build Mech tech and large piloted armors. At this level, create powerful versatile mechs rivaling Knightmares, e.g. large mechs enduring missile barrages with street-demolishing cannons and guns. Can also design mech-only weaponry/modules based on your other abilities and traits.

nodes.name: Tinker - Mech (IV)
nodes.description: Design, modify, and build Mech tech and large piloted armors. With enough resources and time, create skyscraper-sized esoteric energy-harnessing forcefield-protected Mecha with dozens of modules that withstand nuclear warfare and annihilate city blocks and cities with cannons.

nodes.name: Tinker - Mech (V)
nodes.description: Design, modify, and build Mech tech and large piloted armors. With resources, knowledge, and time, create your dream Mecha to shame Gundams — antimatter-powered Hadron cannons, planet-sized spacefaring mechs with Death Star cannons. Can also design mech-only weaponry/modules based on your other abilities and traits.

nodes.name: Tinker - Hydro
nodes.description: Design, modify, and build Water-based tech, from dehydration guns, sprinklers, hydro cannons, and efficient irrigation up to 100-meter-radius water-ripping bombs and water-fueled engines, depending on skills, experience, and materials.

nodes.name: Tinker - Aero
nodes.description: Design, modify, and build Air/atmosphere tech, from blow dryers, efficient turbines, wind bombs, flying machines, and blimps up to weather devices, tornado grenades, and vacuum bombs, depending on skills, experience, and materials.

nodes.name: Tinker - Henshin
nodes.description: Design, modify, and build transformation tech, e.g. armor-donning belts, car-to-jet transformers, combining jets forming a mech, lion-pen, anti-transformation bands, and stylish mandatory themed armors harnessing exotic materials, depending on skills, experience, and materials.

nodes.name: Tinker - Ultrakill
nodes.description: Design, modify, and build Ultrakill tech, specializing in robots from hyper-mobile units to mobile artillery to skyscraper-sized ones with overwhelming weapons and defenses. Built tech must be fueled primarily by Blood.

nodes.name: Pyronite Form
nodes.description: Temporarily transform into a Pyronite or hybrid at will, gaining boosted physical stats, durability, and energy-scaling natural pyrokinesis. Greatly boosts Fire Affinities but disables Ice/Water abilities.

nodes.name: Ectonurite Form
nodes.description: Temporarily transform into an Ectonurite or hybrid at will, manipulating body protoplasm to fly and turn incorporeal. While incorporeal can possess weaker-willed living beings, but deathly weak to sunlight and electricity.

nodes.name: Vulpimancer Form
nodes.description: Temporarily transform into a Vulpimancer or hybrid at will, a large brutish canine with greater physicality, keen smell, and echolocation. Vulnerable to high-pitched noise, flames, and bestial instincts.

nodes.name: Necrofriggan Form
nodes.description: Temporarily transform into a Necrofriggan or hybrid at will, a winged cryokinetic moth-like alien with superhuman physique and flight. Freeze on touch, exhale freezing wind, phase intangible while freezing, and resist extreme temperatures.

nodes.name: Petrosapien Form
nodes.description: Temporarily transform into a Petrosapien or hybrid at will, a living crystalline silicon alien with enhanced strength and extreme durability. Grow body crystals as weapons or from the ground, and with experience telekinetically control them for energy.

nodes.name: Volann Form
nodes.description: Temporarily transform into a Piscciss Volann or hybrid at will, a large shark/anglerfish humanoid with superhuman physicality and steel-tearing claws and jaws. Traverse water and breathe in it freely, but vulnerable to dehydration.

nodes.name: Vaxasaurian Form
nodes.description: Temporarily transform into a Vaxasaurian or hybrid at will, a giant dinosaur-like alien with massively enhanced strength, durability, and frame. Expend energy to grow several times larger.

nodes.name: Aerophibian Form
nodes.description: Temporarily transform into an Aerophibian or hybrid at will, a mantaray-like alien with slightly superhuman stats, extreme-speed flight, and Neuroshock blasts from eyes and tail. Highly resistant to fire, heat, and electricity; can traverse water and space freely.(Cannot Enter Hyperspace).

nodes.name: Orishan Form
nodes.description: Temporarily transform into an Orishan or hybrid at will, a hydrokinetic crustacean alien with increased strength and durable exoskeleton. Use energy-scaling Hydrokinesis and blast/drain high-pressure water from hands.

nodes.name: Amperi Form
nodes.description: Temporarily transform into an Amperi or hybrid at will, a ghost-like amphibious electrokinetic jellyfish with stretchable tentacles and free air/water float. Wield Electrokinesis to generate, absorb, and redirect electricity; can phase intangible while still shocking, or become pure electricity to travel conductors or possess technology.

nodes.name: Florauna Form
nodes.description: Temporarily transform into a Florauna or hybrid at will, a sentient plant alien with malleable exotic-plant body. Wield Chlorokinesis to control and fuse with plants, regenerate, and grow plants from your body, but extremely vulnerable to extreme temperatures.

nodes.name: Fusrodah
nodes.description: "Force, Balance, Push" Convert your voice into a concussive kinetic Shout that unbalances or launches targets. Power scales with energy levels.

nodes.name: Comprehensive Recovery
nodes.description: While Recovery stays slotted, every 24 hours slotted you are fully cured of all injuries, afflictions, curses, illnesses, and other health issues below Divine Rank. Removing it resets the timer.

nodes.name: Hoard
nodes.description: Access spatial storage for non-living objects like an inventory. While active, value stored (as gold coins) boosts physical stats, e.g. a thousand coins adds a grown man's strength.

nodes.name: Guard
nodes.description: Mark a target as your Guard ward; damage they would take transfers to you proportionally — their 10% damage becomes your 10% damage.

nodes.name: Greater Guard
nodes.description: Mark any number of targets as wards; damage meant for them transfers to you as if you took the hit — their decapitation could be your nick and vice versa. Maintaining marks costs energy.

nodes.name: Rampart
nodes.description: "Infallible Fortress" Massively boost all resistances and defenses while your feet stay within 10cm of activation point; even a human could face-tank a missile. Interruption triggers 10-second cooldown.

nodes.name: Slow Lane
nodes.description: Conjure shapeable, sizeable force fields usable as projectiles that stop and settle on hit. Movement inside is slowed proportionally to target strength and energy spent. Maintenance costs energy.

nodes.name: Mystic Eyes of Slowness
nodes.description: These mystic eyes slow targets in your field of vision. Slow degree scales with energy spent and target strength relative to you.

nodes.name: Mystic Eyes of Transfusion
nodes.description: These mystic eyes manipulate Vitality of targets in view — drain vitality to heal yourself, give your own to heal them, or transfer between two others. Amount scales with energy spent and relative strength; willing targets cost less.

nodes.name: Ram
nodes.description: The longer you travel in a straight line, the faster and stronger you become. While active you move only in straight lines, with control worsening over distance.

nodes.name: God Driver
nodes.description: As long as you keep moving straight, you grow stronger, faster, and tougher until a spear that can pierce gods. You move only in straight lines, losing control the longer you go.

nodes.name: Providence
nodes.description: "Cloak yourself in the Light of the Heavenly God". While active, a light aura massively amplifies all Resistances and Defenses, further amplified against Dark, Infernal, and Curse effects.

nodes.name: Sing
