nodes.description: Imbue voice with emotion and intent to resonate with listeners. Amplified when singing, further when singing skillfully.

nodes.name: Siren's Song
nodes.description: Imbue your voice with siren power to sleep or entrance susceptible hearers into trance. Amplified by skillful singing; strong wills resist better.

nodes.name: Greater Natural Weapons
nodes.description: Transform your body into natural weaponry without self-harm — plated gauntlet hands with bone knives, whip tongue with sharp tip, reinforced shark-like jaws, etc.

nodes.name: Diction
nodes.description: Infuse your voice with your abilities, applying their effect to hearers as if touched — Fireball Diction burns listeners, Hemokinesis Diction disrupts bloodflow. Both abilities must be slotted.

nodes.name: Chargeback
nodes.description: Convert blood into temporary gold coins that, when struck by a fast enough projectile, redirect it to the nearest enemy's weakspot. Attacks far beyond your level can break the coins.

nodes.name: Parry
nodes.description: Parry by striking an attack at the perfect moment to invert its force. Parryable attack types scale with user capability.

nodes.name: Deep Dredge
nodes.description: Summon deep abominations — tentacles, maws, spikes — from any nearby sufficiently large water body to maul enemies. Power scales with energy spent.

nodes.name: Abyssal Dredge
nodes.description: Invoke Abyssal Ones to conjure tentacles, maws, spikes, and temporary deep minions from any nearby water body for energy. Their wounds injure mind and body.

nodes.name: Ravage of Ryleh
nodes.description: Invoke Ryleh's wrath, using any sufficiently large water body as a gateway to summon tentacles, maws, monstrosities, spikes, madness waves, and Deep Kingdom familiars per energy spent.

nodes.name: Acid Rain
nodes.description: Summon black clouds raining harsh acid that burns flesh, tarnishes metals, and amplifies Poison abilities in range. Range and potency scale with energy spent.

nodes.name: Caustic Storm
nodes.description: Summon a storm of flesh-and-metal-melting caustic rain and harsh winds. Potency and range scale with energy spent, from a single-cloud shower to eroding multiple city blocks.

nodes.name: World Melter
nodes.description: Summon a ravaging acidic storm of flesh-stripping acid and life-ruining radioactive winds that pollute land. Inside its radius, all regeneration and healing are disabled.

nodes.name: Acid Cloak
nodes.description: Cloak your body in corrosive acidic energy that dissolves and burns on contact. Corrosion scales with energy spent.

nodes.name: Solver Slime Form
nodes.description: Freely turn your body into hyper-acidic corrosive slime that melts on contact while letting you morph freely. Potency scales with energy spent.

nodes.name: Acid
nodes.description: Expel and control body acid harming organic and inorganic materials. Quantity and potency depend on energy spent.

nodes.name: Greater Acid
nodes.description: Expel and control powerful body acid harming organic and inorganic materials; wounds are harder to heal. Quantity and potency depend on energy spent.

nodes.name: Melter
nodes.description: Release and telekinetically control powerful body acid melting organic and inorganic materials; wounds are harder to heal. Quantity and potency depend on energy spent.

nodes.name: Dissolver
nodes.description: Release and telekinetically control incredibly potent body acid with incredible melting plus energy-eroding properties that disrupt spells and abilities. Quantity and potency depend on energy spent.

nodes.name: Grand Dissolution
nodes.description: Expel and telekinetically control Grand Dissolution, an impossibly potent acid melting anything given enough energy — flesh, stone, magic, even space. Quantity and potency depend on energy spent.

nodes.name: Sympathetic Link
nodes.description: Share emotions both ways with someone by contact — feeling their pain/happiness, making them feel yours. Stronger targets cost more energy to link.

nodes.name: Conflagration Emotion
nodes.description: Share and spread your emotions over an area — courage to allies, hatred/anger at foes, fear/pain into armies. Energy cost scales with target strength, range, and target count.

nodes.name: House of Memories
nodes.description: Impart your memories to others, from simple information to traumatic experiences, ego-shattering foreign memory influx, or looping injury memories. Stronger, resilient targets and more memories cost more energy.

nodes.name: Arid Hell
nodes.description: Conjure superheated sand from your body and telekinetically shape it into walls, weapons, or melting waves. Quantity and heat scale with energy spent.

nodes.name: Ride on Time
nodes.description: Conjure temporary familiar vehicles with working functions, from cars and balloons to planes and attack helicopters. Larger, more complex vehicles cost more to create and maintain.

nodes.name: Force
nodes.description: Conjure and emit blasts of raw kinetic force. Power and scale with energy spent.

nodes.name: Astral Walk
nodes.description: Freely project your soul from your body, leaving it comatose while you wander and still use abilities normally. Maintaining ghost form costs energy, more when using abilities.

nodes.name: Grave Buster
nodes.description: Burst skeletal limbs and projections from ground near you — grabbing hands, skewering ribs, defending femurs. Size, quantity, and quality scale with energy spent.

nodes.name: Parthenogenesis
nodes.description: "Originally named Babymaker" Create 'Eggs' from your familiars with much energy and time; incubated eggs hatch as their Familiar's child with weaker versions of its abilities that strengthen with growth.

nodes.name: Morbing
nodes.description: Functionally the same as [Vampire Physique (Rare)], but you must shout "I'm beginning to Morb!" or "It's Morbing time!" to use it.

nodes.name: Flame Bone of the Starving
nodes.description: Expend energy to summon flaming giant-skeleton parts, e.g. ribs for defense, hands as gauntlets, underground impalers, and even detonatable parts.

nodes.name: Ganta Gun
nodes.description: A Branch of Sin expending vitality to condense blood into a fired bullet projectile; more vitality and blood means stronger bullets.

nodes.name: Crow Claw
nodes.description: The Crow Claw is a Branch of Sin expending vitality to condense blood into sickle-like blades on your body. Power depends on vitality and blood used.

nodes.name: Whip Wing
nodes.description: The Whip Wing is a Branch of Sin expending vitality to condense blood into body-emerging whips controlled like limbs. Power scales with vitality and blood used.

nodes.name: Blood Fist
nodes.description: The Blood Fist is a Branch of Sin expending vitality to condense blood into solid armoring layers that protect and empower strikes. Power scales with vitality and blood used.

nodes.name: Condor Candle
nodes.description: Condor Candle is a Branch of Sin expending vitality to remotely combust your blood into fire. Fire and combustion power scale with vitality.

nodes.name: Owl's Eyeball
nodes.description: Owl's Eyeball is a Branch of Sin expending vitality to form blood orbs you telekinetically control and detonate. Power scales with vitality and blood used.

nodes.name: Voljang Form
nodes.description: Transform into and maintain a Voljang or hybrid for energy: a towering fire-breathing gorilla with immense strength and volatile temper. Gain enhanced physicality, instincts, rage, fire breath, and body flames; surrendering to rage unlocks a stronger Berserk form.

nodes.name: Shogun Ceanatour
nodes.description: Transform into and maintain a Shogun Ceanatour or hybrid for energy: a massive bladed crustacean beast. Gain tough exoskeleton, large bladed arm-limbs, and underwater breathing/movement, but vulnerable when dry.

nodes.name: Lunagaron Form
nodes.description: Transform into and maintain a Lunagaron or hybrid for energy: an agile werewolf-like Fanged Beast expelling supercooled mist and icing its body. Gain enhanced physicality, senses, and agility, plus energy-fueled freezing breath and cold armoring ice.

nodes.name: Velkhana Form
nodes.description: Transform into and maintain a Velkhana or hybrid for energy: a powerful ice Elder Dragon with enhanced physicality, scaly defense, and flight. Breathe flash-freezing supercooled mist, manifest icebergs, and coat yourself in icy armor. Fire abilities unusable, cryokinetics stronger.

nodes.name: Nergigante Form
nodes.description: Transform into and maintain a Nergigante or hybrid for energy: a brute-force Elder Dragon with massively enhanced physicality, dulled pain, boosted Enhancer and Recovery potency, flight, weaponizable body spikes, and limb-regrowing basic regeneration.(No asexual reproduction included).

nodes.name: Amatsu Form
nodes.description: Transform into and maintain an Amatsu or hybrid for energy: the Calamity of the Skies Elder Dragon. Gain considerable physicality, free flight, and weather control to unleash wind, lightning, water, and ice.

nodes.name: Fatalis Form
nodes.description: Transform into and maintain a Fatalis or hybrid at will: the apex Elder Dragon predator. Gain massively enhanced stats, dragon-element wielding, searing flame breaths (plus Fire and Thunder Dragon Element if strong enough), and enhanced recovery and resilience to survive most lethal wounds.

nodes.name: Ignis Boost
nodes.description: While slotted, augment potency and efficiency of all Fire/Heat Based Abilities.

nodes.name: Hydro Boost
nodes.description: While slotted, augment potency and efficiency of all Water/Ice Based Abilities.

nodes.name: Aero Boost
nodes.description: While slotted, augment potency and efficiency of all Air/Wind Based Abilities.

nodes.name: Terra Boost
nodes.description: While slotted, augment potency and efficiency of all Earth/Metal Based Abilities.

nodes.name: Ten Shadows
nodes.description: Ten Shadows lets you summon 10 engraved Shikigami, each requiring a defeating ritual first to bind it. If a Shikigami (or any familiar) dies, transfer its power to a surviving Ten Shadows Shikigami. With skill, distort shikigami forms and wield their powers via limited manifestation.

nodes.name: Dash
nodes.description: Perform a momentary burst dash in any direction in a 360 angle around you.(Cannot dash above or below.).

nodes.name: Focused Strikes
nodes.description: Mark a line-of-sight target as your Target; while active you cannot harm anyone but that target, your attacks on others simply fail.

nodes.name: Familiar Arms
nodes.description: Temporarily convert familiars into wieldable armaments inheriting their abilities, e.g. Taurus Demon into Axe or dragon into Spear. Broken weapons wound but do not kill the familiar.

nodes.name: Drifting Mines
nodes.description: Expend energy to unleash drifting mines — floating explosive energy balls you can detonate anytime. Power scales with energy spent.

nodes.name: Weapon Mode
nodes.description: Turn yourself into a disposition-suited Weapon Form wieldable by others to share your abilities. Freedom is greatly restricted and damage taken reflects onto your real form.

nodes.name: Perfect Interface
nodes.description: Manipulate any machine interface as if wired to your nerves and brain via physical contact.

nodes.name: Adamantine Sealing Chains
nodes.description: Manifest and control Uzumaki Adamantine Sealing Chains as incredibly durable chains that suppress and seal bound targets' energy. Suppression scales with energy spent and your power advantage; chain power and count scale with energy used.

nodes.name: Sight +1
nodes.description: You can view locked nodes one extra connection away from unlocked nodes.

nodes.name: Sight +2
nodes.description: You can view locked nodes two extra connections away from unlocked nodes. Overrides Sight +1.

nodes.name: Far Sight
nodes.description: You can view locked nodes within a set distance of unlocked nodes, even if unconnected to them.

nodes.name: Trace Name
nodes.description: You can trace a route to the closest locked nodes whose name contains a chosen word or phrase.

nodes.name: Trace Description
nodes.description: You can trace a route to the closest locked nodes whose description contains a chosen word or phrase.

nodes.name: Glimpse
nodes.description: Single use. Reveal the full tree for 10 seconds.

nodes.name: Omnisight
nodes.description: Permanently reveal the entire tree.

nodes.name: Echo
nodes.description: Single use. The next ticket you are awarded pays double points.

nodes.name: Survey
nodes.description: You can see the names of locked nodes one extra connection away from unlocked nodes.

nodes.name: Source Compass
nodes.description: You can trace a route to the closest locked node of any chosen source.

nodes.name: Sight: Ability
nodes.description: You can view ability nodes one extra connection away from unlocked nodes.

nodes.name: Sight: Item
nodes.description: You can view item nodes one extra connection away from unlocked nodes.

nodes.name: Sight: Skill
nodes.description: You can view skill nodes one extra connection away from unlocked nodes.

nodes.name: Sight: Trait
nodes.description: You can view trait nodes one extra connection away from unlocked nodes.

nodes.name: Sight: Familiar
nodes.description: You can view familiar nodes one extra connection away from unlocked nodes.

nodes.name: Telekinetic Launch
nodes.description: Rip loose concrete, furniture, and machinery from the environment and hurl it as telekinetic artillery; charged throws stagger even the Hiss.

nodes.name: Seize
nodes.description: Weaken an enemy then seize their mind outright, turning them into a temporary ally that fights and dies for you.

nodes.name: Debris Shield
nodes.description: Tear rubble from the surroundings into a rotating barrier that eats gunfire, then launch the whole shield back at whoever shot you.

nodes.name: Evade
nodes.description: A short telekinetic dash that phases through incoming fire; upgraded chains link multiple dashes together.

nodes.name: Levitate
nodes.description: Rise and drift on telekinetic lift while raining debris from above; full upgrades allow true flight and meteor ground slams.

nodes.name: Icarus Landing System
nodes.description: Fall from any height wrapped in an electromagnetic glare shield that disperses on impact, landing unharmed every time.

nodes.name: Smart Vision
nodes.description: See living targets and machines through walls, with threats, cameras, and robots highlighted and assessed.

nodes.name: Glass-Shield Cloaking
nodes.description: Bend light around yourself to turn nearly invisible while moving slowly; it drinks energy fast so keep moving with purpose.

nodes.name: Titan Shield
nodes.description: Project hardened dermal armor that shrugs off bullets and explosions while active, at a heavy energy cost.

nodes.name: Remote Hacking
nodes.description: Breach cameras, turrets, robots, and door panels from a distance without ever touching a terminal.

nodes.name: CASIE
nodes.description: Read micro-expressions and pheromones to profile anyone mid-conversation, then nudge them toward the answer you wanted.

nodes.name: Psycast Skip
nodes.description: Teleport yourself or a nearby pawn a short distance, blinking through walls and out of danger at the cost of neural heat.

nodes.name: Psycast Farskip
nodes.description: Open a skipgate that relocates your whole caravan across the world map, or dumps an enemy raid somewhere far away.

nodes.name: Psycast Berserk Pulse
nodes.description: Drive every humanlike in an area into a murderous berserk rage, friend and foe alike. Do not stand in the pulse.

nodes.name: Psycast Invisibility
nodes.description: Vanish from enemy perception entirely and walk through a raid unseen; attacking breaks the effect.

nodes.name: Word of Serenity
nodes.description: Speak with irresistible calm that ends mental breaks on the spot and steadies volatile colonists.

nodes.name: Time Walk
nodes.description: Take an extra turn after this one. Two mana, one extra turn, and a permanent seat on every banned list.

nodes.name: Ancestral Recall
nodes.description: Target player draws three cards. One blue mana for the most efficient draw spell ever printed.

nodes.name: Counterspell
nodes.description: Counter target spell. Two blue mana that simply says no to anything.

nodes.name: Swords to Plowshares
nodes.description: Exile target creature; its controller gains life equal to its power. One mana of unconditional removal.

nodes.name: Dark Ritual
nodes.description: Add three black mana in a burst. The turn-one kill enabler since Alpha.

nodes.name: Giant Growth
nodes.description: Target creature gets +3/+3 until end of turn. One green mana of timeless combat math.

nodes.name: Nether Swap
nodes.description: Swap the positions of any two characters or objects in range, teleporting both at once.

nodes.name: Adrenaline
nodes.description: Gain 2 action points now at the cost of 2 next turn; the classic opening-move rush.

nodes.name: Chameleon Cloak
nodes.description: Blend perfectly into the surroundings, turning invisible for two turns unless you attack or cast.

nodes.name: Chicken Claw
nodes.description: Polymorph an enemy into a clucking chicken that wanders helplessly for its turn.

nodes.name: Tentacle Lash
nodes.description: Sprout a tentacle that lashes distant enemies for damage and disarms them.

nodes.name: Bull Horns
nodes.description: Grow horns that gore targets when you rush them, knocking victims down.

nodes.name: Infect
nodes.description: Infect a target with disease that eats through armour and keeps rotting them each turn.

nodes.name: Flay Skin
nodes.description: Strip all magic armour from enemies around you, leaving them open to every status effect.

nodes.name: Time Warp
nodes.description: Fane's special source skill: grant a character an entire extra turn after their current one ends.

nodes.name: Apotheosis
nodes.description: Take the first step toward godhood: all Source skills cost 3 less and attributes surge for two turns.

nodes.name: Temporal Rewind
nodes.description: Rewind time by seconds or minutes while retaining full memory of the undone timeline, then choose better.

nodes.name: Telekinetic Blast
nodes.description: Unleash concussive telekinetic force that hurls people, cars, and debris away from you.

nodes.name: Concentration
nodes.description: Slow the world to a crawl while aiming, lining up machine weak-point shots with perfect calm.

nodes.name: Silent Strike
nodes.description: Takedown unaware machines and humans from stealth for massive damage.

nodes.name: Survivalist
nodes.description: Hunter vision that highlights enemies, animals, traps, and salvage through the environment.

nodes.name: Loop Memory
nodes.description: Retain skills, relationships, and knowledge across loops of your life on Vertumna, redoing years better each time.

nodes.name: Seeker Subroutine
nodes.description: Launch homing energy seekers from your identity disc that hunt targets around corners.

nodes.name: Adenine Volley
nodes.description: Spray rapidfire nucleotide shots; pair it with another weapon to discover hybrid bioweapons.

nodes.name: Cytosine Precision
nodes.description: Fire precise nucleotide shots that strike weak points; pair it to discover hybrid bioweapons.

nodes.name: Guanine Spread
nodes.description: Unleash wide-spread nucleotide shots that blanket microbe waves; pair it to discover hybrid bioweapons.

nodes.name: Thymine Detonation
nodes.description: Detonate explosive nucleotide shots that clear clustered microbes; pair it to discover hybrid bioweapons.

nodes.name: Summon Tsunami
nodes.description: Call down a city-devouring tsunami wave, then watch the flooded districts from your disaster overview.

nodes.name: Firewall
nodes.description: Equip a defensive subroutine that hardens your disc against hostile code and viral attacks.

nodes.name: Timeline Shift
nodes.description: Shift yourself between two parallel timelines, carrying objects and consequences across with you.
